tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog

ཿ mi —3 na sdo/)me.uli ( 3lo 'as ra kurma 'phrin las kyis bsgrigs/rmetshotsho tsho tsho )pho nga —tsho wa rdzoḍarte gengaXtho ༷ ༷ ngasnatshoXrnge tsho nga shā ——byetsho rme tsho —— — snaX /snashāmo kā ༅/shā rdor+shar+sha rme phro do tsho mo sna tsho — mo te ༷ rdo podzi sna snaX de ge ༷ snatsho ( ba sgo mirigs)skrus dz+wa/ sne

bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i slob gzhi/bod rang skyong ljongs slob gzhi zhib bsher u lhan gyis zhib bsher mdzad/r+sha r+sha r+sha r+sha 44 44 zhe zhe r+sha r+sha r+sha r+sha zhe zhe r+sha r+sha zhe r+sha r+sha r+sha r+sha r+sha bre g+ne r+sha r+sha dhe ༄7//bar dus rtsom rig gces bsgrigs/ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭharko4shu 〈lhokuma'aphrin lasakyisabasgrigs/lorgyu19ze'isto/lha mirigasadaposkrun khang /

rtsom sgrig gsal bshad/gcig thengs 'di'i bod yig ched las slob gzhi ni 8 bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun ’ gyi dgongs don bzhin rtsom sgrig byas pa yin zhing /thengs 'dir rtsom sgrig byas pa'i slob gzhi'i nang 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus 〉〉dang / 〈〈rtsom rig rnam bshad 〉〉〈〈brda sprod rnam bshad 〉〉〈〈rtsom rig gshib bsdur rig pa 〉〉〈〈dmangs khrod rtsom rig rnam bshad 〉〉〈〈bod kyi bar rtsom gces bsgrigs 〉〉〈nye rtsom gces bsgrigs 〉〈deng rtsom gces bsgrigs 〉〈grub mtha' 〉〈legs sbyar brda sprod 'jug sgo 〉〈slob 'bring bod yig slob thabs 〉bcas slob gzhi bcu gcig yod/gnyis/ thengs 'di'i slob gzhi rtsom sgrig byed skabs nang don dang /rnam pa'i thad bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi snying bcud len gang thub bya ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog rgyal khab phyi nang gi sngon thon nyams myong dang / legs cha len gang thub byas te srol rgyun dang / deng rabs kyi 'brel ba mtshon gang thub dang / slob gzhi'i tshan rig rang bzhin dang / bed spyod rang bzhin/dus rabs rang bzhin mtshon gang thub byas yod pas/ slob gzhi 'di dag mtho rim slob grwa khag gi bod skad yig rtsom rig ched las dang thad kur 'brel ba yod pa'i ched las dang / rig tshan khag nang spyod chog pa ma zad/ yig spring slob khrid dang / rang sbyong rgyugs len gyi slob gzhir yang spyad chogagasum/ thengs 'di'i slob gzhi rtsom sgrig byed skabs mar khe /nga

lugs kyi mdzub khrid 'og ched las kyi rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs dang / rmang gzhi'i shes bya/ rmang gzhi'i rtsal nus bcas gtso gnad du bzung ste slob gzhi'i nang lta ba yang dag pa dang / dpyad gzhi cung phun sum tshogs pa/rgyas bshad khag bsdus shing gnad la 'khel ba/ gso skyong gi dmigs yul dang kha mi 'bral ba bcas kyi blang bya bton yod/ 'on kyang sgrig pa po'i chu tshad mi ldeng ba'am/ yang na thog ma'i 'dun pa bzhin ma byung ba'i zhan cha dang / chad lus mi nyung ba zhig yod srid pas/ slob chen slob gzhi'i spus tshad dang / yang sgos bod skad yig gi slob gzhi'i 'dzugs skrun yag po yong phyir rgya che'i mkhas dbang dang / klog pa po nas rtsa che'i dgongs 'char lhug stsol yong bar re smon zhu bzhin yod/bzhi/ slob gzhi rtsom sgrig byed skabs slob gzhi dang / rig tshan so so'i khyad chos gtso bor bzhag pa las/ rtsom sgrig gi rnam pa gcig gyur yong rgyur blang bya bton med/lnga/ slob gzhi'i 'di dag ni bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i bod rig pa'i tshan khag dang sgyu rtsal tshan khag gnyis nas rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur bzhes pa dang / slob gas ched mngags srol rgyun slob gzhi'i rtsom sgrig u lhan btsugs te mdzub khrid dang / zhib bsher gyi 'gan khur ba dang chabs cig gong 'og mthun 'grig gi las don byas yod/drug slob gzhi'i spus tshad 'gan len yong ched tshan khag dang / slob gas snga rjes su zhib bsher bzo bcos byas rjes slob gzhi 'dzugs skrun gyi dgos 'dun bzhin ljongs dang zhing chen rim pa'i slob gzhi'i zhib bsher byas te rikā pa'i lta ba dang / gzhung lugs kyi spus tshad 'gan len yong gang thuX bya/ du// thengs 'di'i slob gzhi rtsom sgrig gi las don nang bod kyi slob

gso dang / zhib 'jug las rig khag gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pa'i shugs che'i rgyab skyor dang / slob grwa'i tang u'i dbu khrid lhan rgyas kyis thugs 'khur dang skul lcag gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje zhu rgyu dang / slad phyin mu mthud rgyab skyor yong ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyu yin/

dkar chag1 mi la ras pa'i sha khyi'i mgur/ (1)2 legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter/ (16)2 bod yul la bsngags pa/ (24)4 bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba/ (29)5 po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/ (46)6 lha ḍa'i yi ge sum cu'i bya dka' mkhas pa'i dga' skyed/ (84)7 shar gangs ri ma/ (90)〈 rje tsong kha par 'gyod tshangs su phul ba'i bstod pa/ (95)'a mi la ras pa chung dus mthong tshul/ (101)10 rgyal po rwa ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud/ (111)19 snying gtam bzhi bcu ma/ (143)12 ku kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ (154)12 chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya/ (174)

gleng gzhi/bod kyi lo rgyus hril po'i bar ma'i dus rabs kyi rtsom rig bslab gzhi 'di ni/ nga chos slob chen slob mar yun ring slob khrid byas pa'i lag len gyi brgyud rim nang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu'i bod kyi slob gso'i gal che'i dgos mkhor dmigs te/ bslab gzhi 'di'i dus mtshams dbye tshul dang rtsom yig sgrig tshul thad/ nga tshos bod sil po'i dus (spyi lo /42lo nas 1642lo bar )nas dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang btsugs pa'i bar gyi dus mtshams la/ bod kyi lo rgyus hril po'i bar ma'i dus rabs shig yin par ngos 'dzin byas shing / dus rabs de'i nang byung ba'i gangs ri'i khrod kyi snyan ngag smra ba'i gtsug rgyan mang du byung ba'i nang nas/ grags can gyi rtsom rig khag bco brgyad tsam bsdu sgrig gi thog nas slob gzhir bkod pa lags/ de ltar bkod pa'i rtsom yig de dag la tshig gi sdod mal la brten nas rjod byed nyung dus brjod bya rgya chen po ston pa'i khyad par sogs/ rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur 'bum du grol ba'i bod hril po'i bar ma'i dus rabs rtsom rig gi dge mtshan du ma mchis pas/ mdor na bod hril po'i bar ma'i dus rabs kyi rtsom rig ni bod kyi rig gnas mtha' dang mu med pa'i nang nas ches gal che ba'i gras shig tu gyur/ khyad par du 1bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi rjod byed tshig gi nyams 'gyur phul du byung ba dang / 2bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i nyams 'gyur phul du byung ba/ 2 spyir 'dzam spyang

bar ma'i dus rabs nas bshad na'ang / bod kyi bar dus rtsom yig ni ches mang shos kyi gras su gyur yod pa/ 4bod kyi bar dus su bod kyi rtsom rig rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha yochos su tshang ba/ 5bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gis spyi tshogs 'tsho bar nus rtsal chen po thon pa sogs/ bod kyi bar rtsom la khyad chos lnga yod/de yang 1bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi rjod byed tshig gi nyams 'gyur thad/ bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi tshig brling zhing / tshig sbyor spros pa rgyas shing / nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pos brjod don rnams snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i khar/ mngon brjod dang / brda rnying / gtam rgyud sogs kyis legs par brgyan pa ma zad/bod yig gi ming tshig dang / chos lugs kyi ming tshig dang / lo rgyus thog rgyun du bed spyod byas pa'i ming tshig sogs ming brda phun sum tshogs shing tshig nyung la don rtogs sla ba/ gnad la 'phigs shing go rgyu che ba/ bsam gzhigs phun sum tshogs po'i rtog btags sogs 'char yan gyi thabs 'phrul ngo 'tshar che ba/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur rmad du byung ba/ lhag don tshan rig gi rtsa don dang yongs su mthun pa'i tshig rtsal gnad du thon pa'i rdo rje'i tshig gi lhun po kho nar grub pa/ yig 'bru re rer mu tig ltar 'od 'tsher ba'i tshig sbyor kho nas rgyan yod/ de ltar rgyan pa'i bar dus kyi rtsom yig rnams 'bri rtsal byang chub dang / tshig sbyor legs shing go brda 'phrod pa/ tshig 'khri sha stag mi byed par tshig nyung zhing don tshang bas phyis kyi mkhas pa tshang ma'i lad mo bya yul zhig tu gyur/2bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i nyams 'gyur gyi thog nas bshad na/ bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i nang don ni/ spyi tshogs kyi ༷tsho ba dang / tshan rig gi gzhung lugs/ chab srid kyi nang don/ chos

lugs kyi grub mtha'/ de bzhin rig gnas dang / dmag don/ khrims lugs/ lus rtsal/ yul srol sogs/ tshan rig dang ldan pa'i dngos po'i gnas lugs thams cad kyi don bde blag tu rtogs thub pa'i man ngag gsal shes kyi bcud bsdus pa du ma zhig bar dus rtsom yig nang gsal yod/2bod kyi dus rabs bar mar bod kyi lo paṇa rnams dang bcas pa'i rtsom pa po grags can nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon pa rnams kyis brtsams pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos sogs brtsams chos po ti brjod kyi mi langs shing / par shing thog bkod pa'i rtsom yig de dag las mang po zhig 'dzam gling yul gru kun tu khyab yod/ de'i phyir bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal nyams 'gyur rmad du byung ba'i yig cha ni/ bod rigs sa khul gang sar gangs ljongs sa mtho'i ri bo bzhin bskrun yod pas na/ bod kyi bar ma'i dus rabs ni bod kyi rtsom rig bya bzhag thad la goms stabs che shos su bskyod pa'i dus rabs shig yin zhes bshad na mi 'tshams pa gang yang med do/4bod kyi rtsom rig rigs pa'i gzhung lugs skor nas bshad na/ rtsom lus bcad lhug spel ma dang / brjod don sngon byung gtam dang skabs de'i gnas tshul/ snyan ngag che chung gi le'u'i khyad par/ mnyan bya dang lta bya'i dbang du gyur ba'i rtsom rig rtsom stangs shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ches bstan sogs sgo/ tshigs bcad la sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas phye ba'i grol rigs mdzod 'dus bzhi/ rtsom gshes la rgya gar shar lho'i thun mong min pa'i yon tan bcu/ rtsom rig phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ rtsom pa'i dgos pa la sogs rtsom rig gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gal che'i gnad don mang po zhig gtan la phab yod pas/ des bod rang nyid kyi rtsom rig gzhung lugs 'khrul med cig tu gyur nas rtsom 'bri'i bya ba dngos la khrid ston gyi nus pa bton dang 'don bzhin yod/ 3

5bar dus rtsom rig gis spyi tshogs 'tsho bar nus rtsal ji ltar thon yod tshul thad/ bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig ni 'dzam gling rtsom rig bya bzhag thog ngoganong mi dgos pa'i khar/ khyad par du 'dzam gling rtsom rtsal gar stegs thog gzi brjid chen pos yar 'dzegs yod/ sa skya legs bshad la mtshon na/legs bshad de ni dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos shig yin/ de'i rjod byed kyi cha la dpe dpe can ci rigs sbyar te/ tshig bde zhing don gsal pa/ rtsom stangs la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal bas/ 'dzam gling thog legs bshad kyi snyan rtsom ches khyad du 'phags shing / bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog dus rabs kyi khyad chos mtshon byed kyi rtsom yig gal che'i gnas su 'god pa sogs/ sngon byon bod kyi ma/rmis pa rnams ni/ bod kyi rtsom rig bya bzhag thad la bka' drin shin tu che'o/ de'i phyir las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar dang shes rig ldan pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis 'dzam gling lo rgyus thog tu khyad du 'phags shing 'od stong 'phro ba'i bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas gsar gtod byas yod pa des/ bod kyi rtsom rtsal ni khyad du 'phags shing phul du byung ba zhig yin stabs/ da lta'i dus su'ang bod kyi slob gso'i bya bzhag khag gi nang du tshod dpags byed thabs bral ba'i nus pa chen po thon dang thon bzhin pa mthong chos myong gyur yang / deng skabs rang mi rigs kyi bar dus rtsom rig la sbyangs pa mthar ma phyin pa'i bod rigs blo gsar 'ga' res/ bar dus rtsom rig la mchis pa'i rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang / gson nyams ldan pa'i tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan rtogs rgyu lta ci/ tha na spyir btang gi go ba yang lon dka' bar gyur ba'i dus 'dir/ nga tshos blo gsar gzhen nu'i blo sgo 'byed pa'i slad du dang / bod yig rig gnas slob sbyong gzhing mkhan tsho'i shes yon chu tshad mtho ru gtong rgyur phan du re ba/ de

bzhin bod rig pa'i 'brel yod ched las khag gi slob gzhir dmigs nas/bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi khyad chos ldan pa'i bar rtsom slob deb 'di'i rlabs chen bya bar bzhugs so/ 'on kyang bod kyi lo rgyus hril po'i bar ma'i dus rabs ni/ nang chos dar khyab shin tu che ba'i dus rabs shig yin rkyen/slob gzhir bsdu sgrig byas pa'i rtsom yig khag gcig gi nang don thad chos tshig 'ga' re yod pa ni g.yol thabs med pa zhig yin rkyen/ dge slob rnams kyis dngos gtso rtsod sgrub kyi rig pa spyad nas 'jig rten lha yis bskrun par lta ba'i chos lugs khag ni bag khum gyi gral rim dang / rim gras/ tshogs khag bcas kyi khe phan la zhabs 'degs zhu byed cig yin pas/ spyir log spyod gral rim mam bag khum stobs shugs kyi 'jig rten lta tshul dang / bsam pa ang dang po yin pa dag pa dang / rmang gzhi'i shes bya/ rmang gzhi'i nus rtsal bcas gtso gnad du bzung ste slob gzhi'i nang lta ba yang dag pa dang / gso skyong gi yul dang kha mi 'bral ba'i legs cha blang nas/ bod yig slob tshan gzhan rnams legs por sbyong thub rgyur rmang gzhi brtan po 'ding dgos pa ma zad/ khyon yongs kyi bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum legs po yong phyir/ bod kyi shes bya'i rnam grangs gang mang khong du chud thub pa bcas byas te/ blang dor gyi gnas la 'jug pa mi lhod pa gnang rgyu gal che'o/ mjug tu nga tshos bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig slob deb de nyid bsdu sgrig byed ring rang nus yod dgu 'don spel tshul du 'jug na'ang / phran ni rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs la mi mkhas shing / lag len gyi nyams myong zhan pa/ shes tshad kyis mi ldang pa/ lhag par du rtsom sgrig pa nyung ba sogs kyi rkyen pas/ bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig slob deb kyi dmigs tshad dang mthun dka' bas na/ slob deb 'dir 'gal 'dzol dang / cha mi tshang ba/ gson nyams ldan pa'i bod mkhas pa'i rtsom rig khag cig mi gsal ba bcas kyi skyon gang yang yod sriswā na/

slad bod kyi bar dus rtsom rig gi slob deb 'di nyid cha lag tshang ba zhig yong phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po dang bcas pa'i mkhyen ldan pa rnams nas skyon sel dge spel la sman pa'i dgongs 'char lhug bstsol yod pa zhu/ /bsdu sgrig pa/ mkhar bla kurma 'phrin las dge legs kyis/ spyi lo 2007lor/ /

mi la ras pa'i sha khri'i mgur/mgur glu 'di ni brjod byed kyi tshig sbyor legs shing go brda 'phrod pa/tshig nyung zhing don gsal ba/ mgur gang las kyang go sla ba'i rtsom rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan thog brjod bya'i nang don ni skabs de'i sa mtho'i sa khams dang / chu khams/ nags tshal/ ri dwags sogs rang byung khams kyi mdzes nyams la bstod cing / khyad par du dpe 'jig rten gyi snang ba dang bstun nas/ don sangs rgyas chos lugs dang sbyar te bstan pa'i bcoms chos ngo mtshar can zhig yin no/rje btsun mi la ras pa/rje btsun mi la ras pa ni/ rab byung dang po'i lcags 'brug (spyi lo 1040)lor yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su mang yul gung thang skya rnga rtsa ru 'khrungs/ chung ngur yab gshegs te sdug mang po mthong / de rjes mthu bslabs nas 'khon glan par mi mang po bsad/ slad nas sdig pa la 'gyod de sa rta (spyi lo 1078)lor lho brag tu chos byed par phebs te mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros dang mjal/ der lo drug zla brgyad tsam bzhugs te bla ma de las dbang dang man ngag rdzogs par blangs/ dgung lo zhe lnga pa shing bya (spyi lo 1084)lor stod phyogs skyid snang

dang gnya' nang khul du phebs shing sgrub pa'i dam bca' mdzad de lo dgu'i ring dka' spyad drag pos bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ de nas sa phyogs gzhan du 'byon bzhud mdzad de snod du rung ba'i slob ma rnams la gsang sngags kyi gdams pa ci rigs gnang / ras chung ba dang dwags po lha rje sogs slob ma grags can mang po byung / nyams mgur mang du bcoms te rjes rabs pas 〈rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar rgyas par phye ba mgur 'bum 〉zhes bya bar bsgrigs/rab byung gnyis pa'i chu yos (spyi lo 1123)lor sku gshegs so/ /mi la ras pa'i sha khri'i mguraX/na mo gu ru()/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid kyis thugs sras rnams rang rang so so'i ri khrod la bzhag nas/ rje btsun rang bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams ()dben gnas gnyi shang 'gur rta zhes bya ba'i ri mtho la gnyan pa/sprin dang na bun 'thibs pa las dus rgyun chad med par kha char 'bab pa/g.yas ri brag mtho la gzar ba la/ gcan gzan rnams ngar skad sgrog cing bya rgyal rgod po lding ba/ g.yon ri spang ri snum la 'jam pa la/ ri dwags sha ba dang / dgo ba/ rna ba rnams rang bzhin gyis bag phebs te rtse zhing 'phyo ba/mdun na nags tshal bzang po me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i nang na/ spra dang spre'u rnams yang rtsal sbyong ba/ rma bya dang 'jol mo la sogs te mdzes pa'i bya sna tshogs gsung snyan skyu ru ru glu len cing / sgra sgrogs la 'dab gshog gi gar stabs sgyur ba/ sgrub phug gi mdun na mar g.ya' chu gangs chu rdza chu rnams duswā rgyun chad med par lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing 'bab pa/ dben zhing

nyams su dga' ba/ btsan la mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dben gnas ka ta ya zhes bya ba'i phug pa na/ dkar phyogs kyi mi ma yin rnams kyis zhabs tog sgrub cing chu bo rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhugs pa las/ dus nam zhig gi tshe gnas de'i phur khyi skad lhang lhang ba dang / de rjes thug sgra chen po zhigabyung bas/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la sngar yin na nga'i gnas 'di bsam gtan shin tu 'phel ba zhig yin te/ da lan bar chad cig yong ba yin nam dgongs nas phug pa'i mdor byon/ pha bong chen po zhig gi khar dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po zhig gi ngang la bzhugs pa las sku mdun na tshur sha ba nag po spu nyag ma re'i rtsa ba la rngul thigs pa re 'bab pa zhig 'jigs skrag dngangs pa'i tshul dang bcas te byung ba la/ rje btsun gyi thugs la mi bzod pa'i snying rje chen po 'khrungs te/ sngon gyi las dbang gis lus 'di lta bu blangs pas/ tshe 'dir ci yang ma nyes rung mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal 'di lta bu myong dgos pa snying re rje/ 'di la theg pa chen po'i chos dhibashad nas dus gtan gyi bde ba la 'god dgos dgongs te/ sha ba la mgur 'digasungs so/ / rje lho brag mar pa'i duzhabs la 'dud/ / sems can sdug bsngal zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / khyod sems can sha ba'i lus la tsher ma'i mgo/ / sha lus tsher mgo mi la'i glu la nyon/ / phyi snang ba'i yul la bros bros nas/ / 'khrul snang ma rig pa'i nang nas thar dus med/ / phyi lus sems spangs kyis mi spongs ()kyis/ / 'khrul snang ma rig spong ba'i dus la bab/ /las rnam smin bden pa mgyogs drags pas/ / phyi sgyu lus bros pas ga la thar/ / 'bros na nang gi sems nyid bros/ / sems nyid byang chub gnas su bros/ / gzhan bros pas thar 'dod 'khrul ba yin/ / sems 'khrul ba shegs la 'di ru sdod/ / da lta khyod kyi snang ba la/ / 'chi ba snying nas ma bzod pas/ /ri pha ri'i logs nas thar du re/ / tshu ri'i logs la zin gis

dogs/ / re dogs ngang nas 'khor bar 'khyams/ / khyod la nā ro chos drug (kyegi khrid cig 'debs/ / phyag rgya chen po'i ()sgom zhig ston/ / zhes gsungs tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bu/ thos na snyan zhing yid du 'ong ba/ 'gro ba gang gi rna lam du song yang yid 'phrog par byed pa'i mgur de skad gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyi thugs rjes sha ba de'i 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal nye bar 'i nas mchi ma khrul (phrul )btang ste rje btsun la bag phab nas/ na bza' la ldag cing rje btsun gyi g.yon phyogs su nyal nas bsdad 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la/ gong gi khyi skad des sha ba 'di la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i khyi zhig yod nges pas/ ji lta bu zhig yod dam dgongs pa'i ngang la/khyi mo dmar mo rnga ma nag po'i tshom bu btags pa sder bzhi thams cad brag gis bshags pa/ lce dar yug tsam rkyong ba/ zhe snang gnod sems chen pos skad drag po 'don cing bar snang la glog ltar 'khyug pa zhig sha ba de'i rjes gcod cing byung ba las/ sha ba la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa de 'di yin par 'dug ste/ khyi 'di phyi snang ba'i dngos po gang mthong yang dgrar langs te zhe sdang gi bsam pa dang mi 'bral ba 'di'i zhe sdang 'di zhi na ci ma rung ste dgongs nas/ yid skyo shas kyis kun nas bslangs shing snying rje mngon du gyur pa'i mgur 'di khyi mo la gsungs so/ /rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ / sems can zhe snang zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'gro ba khyi yi lus la spyang ki'i gdong / /khyi lus spyang gdong mi la'i glu la nyon/ / khyod snang ba gang byung dgrar langs pas/ / zhe sdang sems ngan yid la 'khrug / sdig can khyi yi lus su skyes/ / sdug bsngal ltogs pa'i ngang la sdod/ / nyon mongs zug rngu zhi dus med/ / nang rang sems bzung bas ma zin na/ / phyi gzhan lus bzung bas ci la phan/ / 'dzin na rang sems 'ardzun pa'i dus la bab/ / sems zhe sdang spongs la 'di ru sdod/ / da lta khyod

kyi snang ba la/ / nyon mongs zhe sdang ma bzod pas/ / ri pha ri'i logs nas shor gyis dogs/ / tshu ri'i logs la zin du re/ / re dogs ngang la 'khor bar 'khyams/ / khyod la nā ro chos drug gi khrid cig 'debs/ / phyag rgya chen po'i sgom zhig ston/ / zhes gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyis thugs rje chen po'i ngang nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi chos gsungs pa des/ khyi mo de nyid kyi zhe sdang zhi nas skad sna nas 'don zhing / rje btsun la mjug ma bsgril ba dang /na bza' nas ldag pa sogs gus gus kyi tshul du byas nas/ rje btsun gyi g.yas phyogs su lag pa gnyis kyi bar du mtshul ba bcug nas mig mchi ma nyil le sha ba dang ma bu'i tshul du nyal nas 'dug go/ /de nas rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la/ sems can 'di gnyis kyi phyi la mi sdig can zhig yong gin yod nges te/ bcod chod na 'dir sleb ste yong dgongs pa las/ re zhig nas mi ngam gnag la mig rtsa 'khrug pa/ skra thams cad spyi bor bcings pa/ thu ba g.yas gzed dang g.yon gzed byas pa/ dgo slog zhags pa la brgyus nas ga sha (kyel drangs pa/ lag na mda' gzhu thogs shing dbugs khar 'tshangs pa rngul nag khrag tu zham me ba zhig slebs byung bas/khyi mo dang sha ba rje btsun gyi drung na ma bu'i tshul du 'dug pa dang / sgom chen pa 'dis khyi dang sha ba la ngan zhig byas sam snyam/ zhe sdang langs te kho na re/ras pa dang sgom chen pa 'di tsho bas khyab che ba mi 'dug ste/ mtho gangs dkar gyi ltongs su ri dwags gsod sar sleb 'ong / dma' rgya mtsho'i 'gram du nyasram gsod sar sleb yong / bar grong yul du khe tshong dang 'thab mo byed sar sleb yong gin 'dug pas/ re re gnyis gnyis shi rung mi sto ba 'dugakhyod kyis nga'i sha ba dang khyi mo bskyil thub 'dug pas/ khyod kyi ras gos kyis nga'i mda' yang e thub blta ba yin no zer nas mda' bkang byung ba/ ltong nas yar song ba dang / rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la dud 'gro ma rig sna'i

rang bzhin du gyur pa la yang chos bshad pas go zhing 'dug pas/ kho mi la chos bshad pas go ste yong dgongs pa dang / zhal nas mi khyod kyi mda' la deg long yong gis/ de bas nga'i glu la nyan long yong du chug cig gsungs/thugs mkhyen brtse'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje la mgur 'di gsungs so/ / rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / dug lnga zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 'gro ba mi yi lus la srin po'i gdong / /mi lus srin gdong mi la'i glu la nyon/ /mi lus rin chen dkon gsungs te/ / khyod 'dra mthong na dkon rgyu med/ /srin po'i gzugs kyi sdig pa can/ / ngan song sdug bsngal khyad bsad nas/ / tshe 'di'i 'dod pa sgrub lags kyang / /sdig pas 'dod pa mi 'grub ste/ / nang zhen pa log na dngos grub 'thob/ / phyi snang ba btul gyis mi thul gyis/ / khyod rang sems 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ / khyod sha ba bsad pas mi 'grangs te/ / nang dug lnga bsad na ci bsam grub/ /phyi dgra bo btul yang je mang 'gro/ / nang rang rgyud btul na dgra bo med/ / mi tshe sdig la ma skyel bar/ / dam pa'i lha chos byas na legs/ /khyod la nā ro chos drug gi khrid cig 'debs/ / phyag rgya chen po'i sgom zhig ston/ / zhes gsungs pa'i bar la nyan zhing bsdad 'dug ste kho'i bsam pa la tshig de rnams rang la nges pa cher med de/ khyi dang sha ba 'di gnyis sngar yin na zhe snang dang 'jigs skrag gis mthong glags med pa yin pa la/ de ring kho'i g.yas g.yon na phan tshun ma bu'i tshul du bsdad 'dug cing /nga rang yang dgun gangs dkar gyi ltongs su yang mda' sa la 'gril ma myong ba la/ da lan rang dbang med par brul song bas/ 'di yang na ngan sngags mkhan zhig yin par 'dug yang na bla ma khyad par can zhig yin par 'dug pas/ spyod lam la brtag dgos snyam nas/ sgrub phug gi nang du phyin nas brdos pas/ sngo'i rtsa ba dang kha lo min pa 'tsho ba'i yo byad ci yang mi 'dug pa

la/ dad pa dung dung ba zhig skyes nas/ bla ma lags khyed kyi bla ma dang dam chos nyams len rnams ji skad bya ba yin/ gnas dang grogs longs spyod rnams ci 'dra yod/ bdag kyang 'thad pa zhig byung na sha ba 'di'i srog phul nas bla ma khyed kyi phyag phyir 'brang ba lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/nga'i gnas dang grogs rnams 'di ltar yin pas nga'i phyir 'brang nus na shog cig gsungs/ khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje la mgur 'di gsungs so/ / bla ma tai lo dang nā ro ⑩ mar pa gsum/ / de gsum mi la'i bla ma yin/ / bla ma 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum/'di gsum mi la'i mchod gnas yin/ / mchod gnas de gsum gyis chog na ras pa'i phyi la shog / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum/ / de gsum mi la'i skyabs gnas yin/ / skyabs gnas 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsumaX/ / de gsum mi la'i nyams len yin/ / nyams len 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / g.ya' ri gangs ri rdza ri gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i sgrub gnas yin/ / sgrub gnas de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog sha ba dgo ba rna ba gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i sgo phyugs yin/ / phyugs de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / g.yi dang 'phar ba spyang gi gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i sgo khyi yin/ / sgo khyi de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /bya 'jol mo gong mo rgod po gsum/ / de gsum mi la'i khyim bya yin/ /khyim bya de gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /nyi ma zla ba skar ma gsum/ /'di gsum mi la'i spyan gzigs yin/ /spyan gzigs 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog /lha dang 'dre dang drang srong gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i khyim mtshes yin/ /khyim mtshes 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / spra dang spre'u dang mi dred gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i rtse grogs yin/ / rtse grogs 'di gasnam

gyis yong na mi la'i phyi la shog / bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i skyo grogs yin/ / skyo grogs 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / zwa dang rug pa thul ba gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i kha zas yin/ / zas 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / g.ya' chu gangs chu rdza chu gsum/ / 'di gsum mi la'i btung chu yin/ / btung chu 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog / rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsumaX/ / 'di gsum mi la'i gyon rgyu yin/ / gos 'di gsum gyis yong na ras pa'i phyi la shog/ ces gsungs pas/ kho'i bsam pa la mdzad spyod gsung lugs mthun par 'dug snyam/ dad pa lhag par skyes/ mchi ma lhug par shor/ phyag btsal zhabs spyi bor blangs te rje btsun rin po che la sha ba dang khyi mo mda' gzhu dgo slog zhags pa rnams 'bul bar phul nas/ dngos po 'di rnams kyang bla ma la 'bul/ bdag dang khyi mo 'dis kyang sngar sdig pa mang po byas/ da phyin chad sdig pa mi bgyid pas/ khyi mo glog spyang dmar mo 'di mtho ris kyi gnas su 'dren par zhu/ sha ba nag po 'di bde chen gyi lam la drang du gsol/ bdag khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje la yang chos gnang nas thar ba'i lam la drang du gsol/zhes zhu don 'di ltar glur phul ba/ nga'i g.yas na 'dug pa'i sha ba nag po dung ru'i kha rgyan can/ / 'di bsad na zhag bdun gyi mu ge sel tsam gda' lags te/ / 'di mi bdag la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ / sha ba nag po bde chen lam la drang du gsol/ / glog spyang dmar mo byang chub lam la drang du gsol/ / mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / g.yon na 'dug pa'i khyi mo glog spyang dmar mo 'di/ / btang na nam mkha'i bya yang zin tsam gda' lags te/ / 'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ / sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ / glog spyang dmar mo byang chub lam la spyang du gsol/ / mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /

'gas pa nag po a long gi kha rgyan can/ / 'dis bkyigs na byang kha'i 'brong yang thub tsam gda' lags te/ / 'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ / sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ / glog spyang dmar mo byang chub lam la drang du gsol/ / mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / dgo slog tim pa'i kha rgyan can/ / 'di gon na gangs dkar gyi ltongs su yang dros lags te/ / 'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ /sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ / glog spyang dmar mo byang chub gnas su drang du gsol/ / mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / nga'i lag pa g.yas na bzung ba'i nyag phran mda'/ / sgro bzhi mtshal gyi kha rgyan can/ / 'di brgyab na gang phog phigs tsam gda' lags te/ / 'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ / sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ / glog spyang dmar mo byang chub gnas su drang du gsol/ / mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / g.yon na bzung ba'i mchog dkar gyi gzhu/ / rgya rgyud gro ga'i kha rgyan can/ / 'di bdungs na gnam gyi 'brug kyang ldir tsam gda' lags te/ / 'di mi nga la mi dgos bla ma khyed la 'bul/ / sha ba nag po bde chen gnas su drang du gsol/ / glog spyang dmar mo byang chub gnas su drang du gsol/ / mgon po rdo rje thar ba'i gnas su drang du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ sha ba'i srog dang khyi mo la sogs pa'i 'bul ba rnams phul nas/ bla ma lags bdag kyang phyag phyir 'brang bar zhu lags/ bu smad rnams kyi lag nas 'tsho rgyags blangs nas 'ong bas/ bla ma gnas 'di rang du bzhugs sam/ gang du bzhugs kyi gsal cha zhig gnang ba zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun yang sha ba'i srog phul ba dang /kho rang blo chos la 'gyur ba la thugs mnyes nas/ khyi ra ba la bu sdig pa spangs nas dge ba bsgrubs pa ngo mtshar che phyis gang sdod kyi sar yong rung bas/ pa

thog tu 'khel ba dka' zhing / thog tu khel rung nga gnas nges med la sdod pas rnyed par yang dka' bas de bas chos byed na bu smad kyi 'khri ba chod la/da lta rang ba'i phyi bzhin chos la phyin na legs/ nga gnas nges med 'grims pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di ltar yin gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ / pho ya mtshan can ri khrod kyi ras pa nga / / dbyar zla gsum ri khrod kyi gangs la sgom/ /khams rmugs pa bsangs pa'i rlung dwangs yin/ / ston zla gsum ro snyoms ldum bu byedabu/ / lus 'byung bzhi gso ba'i 'bru tsam med/ / dgun zla gsum nags ma'i gseb tu sgom/ / rlung gdug rtsub can ngar ma'i sgrib yol yin/ / dpyid zla gsum g.ya' dang spang la sdod/ / rlung bad kun mkhris pa'i bcags sa yin/ / dbyar dgun med par sgom la yengs med brtson/ /lus 'byung bzhi 'jig pa'i sdug rtsis yin/ / dus rgyun du yengs med bya ra gtong / / nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'joms thabs yin/ / 'tsho ba gang byung za ba de/ /'dod sred chung ba'i skyid rtags yin/ / dus rgyun du chos la 'bad pa de/ / rnal 'byor brtson 'grus che ba yin/ / zhes gsungs pas/ khyi ra ba na re/ bla ma de ltar yin pa ngo mtshar che bdag snying nas chos shig byed pa la/bu smad rnams la yang kha ta zhig bcug chos rgyags shig kyang khyer nas myur du 'ong ba lags pas/ de bar 'di khar bzhugs pa zhu zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod snying nas chos byed na/ bu smad dang 'phrad don yang med/sdug khur byas chos byed pa la chos rgyags logs pa zhig mi dgos/ sngo dang shing gi 'bras bu la sogs te dka' thub kyi rdzas kyis chog pa yin/ mi tshe nam 'chi cha med yin zhing da lta'i bsam pa bzang po 'di 'gyur nyen yod pas/da lta rang nas 'dir sdod/ / bu smad la kha ta bcug pa'i thog mar ngas khyod rang la kha ta cig byed pas 'di la nyon gsung mgur 'di gsungs so/ / 'o na nyon hāng gson dang khyi ra ba/ /'brug 'ur sgra che yang stong sgra yin/ / 'ja'

kha dog legs kyang yal nas 'gro/ / 'jig rten nyams su dga' yang rmi lam tsam/ /'dod yon bde ba che yang sdig pa'i rgyu/ / 'dus byas ()rtag rtag 'dra yang myur du 'jig /rdzas kha sang yod pa de ring med/ /mi na ning yod pa da lo shi/ / grogs bzang po yod pa dgra ru ldang / / zas phan par zos pa dug tu 'gro/ /drin bzang pos bskyangs pa kha gyod che/ /sdig rang gis byas pa rang la gnod/ / khyod mgo brgya'i nang nas rang mgo gces/ / phyag sor mo bcu la gang bcad tsha/ / bza' mang nang nas rang nyid gces/ / rang mgo 'don pa'i dus la bab/ / tshe 'di mi rtag myur du 'chi/ / chos la phyi bshol byar mi rung / / brtse ba'i gnyen gyis 'khor bar 'phen/ / bla ma bsten pa'i dus la bab/ / tshe 'di ru bde la phyi mar skyid/ / dam chos byed pa'i dus la bab/ / ces gsungs pas/ khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje blo phyin ci ma log par dam pa'i chos la 'gyur nas/ bu smad kyi sar ma phyin par khrid zhus nas bsgoms pas nyams cung zad skyed pa rnams rje btsun la phul te/ da dung nyams su len lugs kyi gdams ngag thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes zhus pas/rje btsun mnyes te yon tan gyi mgo ma skyes 'dug da nyams su len lugs 'di ltar gyis sheg gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ / bla ma dam pa bston pa la/ / gsol ba snying nas yang yang thob/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro sgom pa'i tshe/ / bskyed rim (yiyang yang gsal 'debasagyis/ / 'chi ba mi rtag sgom pa'i tshe/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang soms/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i tshe/ /chung ngu chung ngu yang yang sgoms/ / sems can pha mar sgom pa'i tshe/ /yang yang drin lan dran par gyis/ / snyan brgyud zab mo 7sgom pa'i tshe/ /snying la rus pa thon par gyis/ / dam chos mtha' ru 'don pa'i tshe/ / mtho dman med par nar re skyongs/ / chos dang e mthun lta ba'i tshe/ / rtsab rtsub med par gcig la dril/ / so nam lha chos byed pa la/ / 'jig rten 1rdo ba

thams cad thongs/ / 'tsho ba lha yi sbyor ba la/ / sdug bsogs byas pas kha na med/ / ser snas bsags na mi 'phel ba/ / mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin/ / de phyir phyis kyi bsam sbyor bor/ / de phyir tshe 'di blo yis thongs/ /zhes gsungs nas/ dbang dang gdams ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang nas bsgoms pas/ nyams rtogs (1mthar phyin pa khyi ra ras pa zhes bya ba thugs kyi sras gcig byung ngo / / khyi dang sha ba yang de nas bzung ste ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol ba yin no/ / phug pa de na khyi ra bas phul ba'i mda' gzhu yang dus da lta'i bar du yod par grags skad/ gnyi shang 'gur rta ru thukāswā snakā ཿ ༵ ras pa dang mjal ba'i skor ro/ /0grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pas sku tshe gang bor theg pa chen po'i chos ston pa'i nyams mgur mang po mdzad yod pa de/ khong nyid kyi mi brjed kyi gzungs thob pa'i slob ma rnams kyis so sor zin bris su btab cing / phyis dus rabs bco lnga par grub thob gtsang spyon he ru ga'am ming gzhan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes pas phyogs gcig tu bsdus te (rje btsun mi la rasapa'i rnam thar rgyas par phye ba mgur 'bum 〉zhes pa bsgrigs/ 'dir 'aspyad (mi la ras pa'i sha khyi'i mgur 〉zhes pa 'di gong smras (mgur 'bum 〉'di las bshus rjosna bye kū/ ru/ na mo 'dud do zhes pa'am phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa dang / gu ru ni bla ma'am slob dpon zhes pa ste bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'o/ /()so mtshams/ sa mtshams sam bar mtshams zhes pa'i don/༷theg pa chen po'i chos/ theg pa chen po ni/ (mdo sde rgyan 〉las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / / thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / yang dag sgrub pa chen po dang / / sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ de dag kyang rim pa ltar theg chen gyi sde snod rgya chen po la dmigs pa dang / rang gzhan gnyis ku'i don grub pa dang / bdag med pa gnyis ka rtogs pa dang / bskal ba grangs 12 med gsum du gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / 'khor ba yongs su mi gtong zhing kun

nas nyon mongs pa med pas lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun gnang ba lta bu dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa yang dag par sgrub pa dang / lhun gyis grub cing rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las rnams yin la/ de bdun dang ldan pas na theg pa chen po'o/ /chos ni gsung rab ste theg pa chen po'i gsung rab ces pa'o/ /rjorje lho brag mar pa/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog mtshan snyan ha cang che ba'i lo tsā ba zhig rje btsun mi la ras pa'i bla ma yin/ rab byung song gi lo skor drug cu'i tha ma chu byi (spyi lo 1012)lor lho brag chu khyer gyi gro bo lung du sku 'khrungs/ mtshan chos kyi blo gros su gsol/ dgung lo bco lnga nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyi drung du saṃ skṛ ta'i skad dang sgra rig pa sbyangs/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du lan du ma phebs/ rje nā ro ba dang / paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes snying bo/ ku ku ri ba/ mi tri ba zhi ba bzang bo la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang po las gsang sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ grong 'jug gi gdams pa dang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud kyi chos skor rnams thob/ de nas bod yul du tshur phebs nas gsang sngags kyi chos dpe mang po bod skad du bsgyur/ rgya gar du byon tshul gyi nyams mgur mang du gsungs/ skal ldan gyi snrob ma mashā po bstangs/ dgung lo rgya brgyad pa rab byung gnyis pa'i me glang (spyi lo 1097)du/)/ byes 0sdu paX/sa// ji tsam spangs kyang spong mi thub pa'i don/ /dun ro chos drug rgya gar gyi pa: ta nā ro ta pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa zhig ste/ gdams pa 'di la sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhed pa'i dbye bsdu khyad par yod kyang / 'dir rje sgam po pa'i bzhed pa ltar na/ bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya ba gtum mo/ sgyu ma lam du byed pas 'tshang rgya ba rmi lam/ gnyid mthug lam du byed pas 'tshang rgya ba 'od gsal/ ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba 'pho ba/ grong 'jug 'pho ba'i cha lag dang / rmi lam sgyu lus gcig tu 'du zhing / bar do yang de'i yan lag tu byas nas chos drug tu bzhed do/ /()phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu mthar thug gam mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / de la rgyas 'debs pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa'i gzugs skad cig dang por thob pa de las bri ba dang gang ba med par ye ji bzhin pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis nam mkha' ji srid pa de srid du rtag tu gnas shing ga'ar yang de las 'dar mi spyod pa nyid kyis phyag rgya yin la/ spong ba dang rtogs pa dang sems pa te chen po gsum dang ldan pas na chen po ste phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o zhes bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo las gsungs/dug sha/ phrag pa dang mchan khung phan tshun bsnol mar 'ching ba'i thag pa la zer/ / 13

0bla ma tai lo dang nā ro/ bla ma tai lo ni dus rabs bcu bar byung ba'i rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig ste/ paṇa chen nā ro ba'i bla ma yin/ mtshan dngos shes rab bzang bor gsol/ des nub phyogs so ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang du zhabasal lcagasasgrog gsol nas lo bcu gnyis su sgrub pa mdzad pa'i mthar bla ma lha'i lung bstan ltar smad 'tshong ma'i g.yog mdzad nas lam gyi rtogs pa sbyangasapasagrub pa chen po'i sa brnyes shing / do ha rdo rje'i glu dbyangasagasungs pa tsam gyis grong khyer 'bum zag bcu gnyis kyi skye bo grol bar grags/ slob ma grub pa thob pa brgyad kyis kyang 'gro ba'i don de bzhin mdzad/ ā+oṃ lo ba khong la mi'i bla ma med de/ sangs rgyasardo rje 'chang dngosalas gsang sngagasargyud sde bzhi'i gdams pa gsan zhing / rdo rje rnal 'byor mas snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum gyi mdzod gtad pasagadams pa'i bcud thams cad 'a// trī kā kau zlos/ ra/bas bcu par rgya gar du byung ba'i grub chen zhig ste/ grub pa'i dbang phyug tai lo ba'i dngos slob dang / rje sgra bsgyur mar pa'i bla ma yin/ desadaka' chen bcu gnyisaspyad pa la mthar tshig dang brda la brten nas gsang sngags kyi don thams cad smyo/ tā sna ṭā kā /ji sdi ṅgi ༵ shārnyilha dīkā smi/ kū/ rtsa don gsum ste/ gnyis su med pa lta ba'i don dang / yengasapa med pa sgom pa'i don/ zung du 'jug pa spyod pa'i don no/ /༅rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum/ tshe mi 'gyur zhing srog mi 'gag pa'i rnam par shesapa'i rten te/ de yang rtsa khyim ltabu dang / rlung semasabadag po lta bu/ thig le nor ltabu dang gsum mo/mutshoṭa //sasdum bu byed/ rtsa sdum gyisalus kyi nusapa rang bzhin snyoms par byed pa ste 'tsho yi/(sa//sa/ rgyu rkyen du ma 'dus nas byas pa'am skyes pa'i chos te dngosapo dang don gcig rkunabaskyed rim/ sbyang bya'i gzhi dus kyi skye 'chi bar do gsum po sbyong byed sku gsum gyi lam khyer /sgomasapa'i stobasakyis sgo gsumatha malagyi snang zhen lasaldog pa'i gsang sngagasakyi lam ༷snyam brgyud zab mo/ bla rabs rim bzhin snyan nasasnyan du brgyud pa'i man ngag zab mo/ /(yinyamasartogs/ chosakyi don sgrub pa nyamasalen byasapa lasabyung ba'i yon tan/ /14

bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 sha khyi'i mgur las mgur rtsom gyi khyad chos ji ltar gsal bar byas 2 ཿ// 'a/ di'i yul ljongs bkod 'bri las skabs de'i bod kyi khor yug gi rnam pa gang zhig mtshon par byas 'dug/2 mgur 'dir dpe gang gi snang ba dang bstun nas don gang zhig bstan 'dug/

legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter/legs bshad 'di ni dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos shig yin/ de'i rjod byed kyi cha la dpe dpe can gnyis ci rigs sbyar te/ tshig bde zhing don gsal ba/rtsom stangs la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal bas/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog dus rabs kyi khyad chos mtshon byed kyi rtsom yig gal che'i gnas su 'god do/sa skya pa'o ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/chos rje sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung gsum pa chu stag (spyi lo 1182)lor yab 'khon dpal chen 'od po che dang yum ma gcig gar phu ma nyi khri lcam gnyis kyi sras su gtsang du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo chung dus su mtshan la dpal ldan don grub zhu zhing / rjes su khu bo rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan kun dga' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ de nas khu bo'i drung du sa skya gong ma'i gsung bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad ma lus pa gsan zhing / gzhan yang zhu don rdo rje skyabs lasakhyams chos sogs lung gi skor/ rma bya byang brtson dang tshur ston gzhon seng1 zlos tshad ma/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od las gdams pa sna tshogs

gsan te sde snod thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes shing mkhas pa'i snyan grags sa steng du khyab/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi mu stegs 'phrog byed dga' bo sogs bod du yong nas nang bstan la tshur rgol byed pa las rigs pas tshar bcad de bstan pa la bcug ces grags/ dgung lo nyer gsum shing byi (spyi lo 1204)lor kha che paṇa chen shākya shri dang mjal/ par+ṇa chen dang de'i slob ma sagha shri/ su gha ta shrī la sogs las sgra tshad sogs rig gnas che ba lnga dang / snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs rig gnas chung ba lnga ste rig gnas bcu la sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad de pa: ta'i mtshan snyan thob/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa rab byung bzhi pa'i sa 'brug lor kha che par+ṇa chen drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo so lnga pa me byi (spyi lo 1216)lor sa skya'i gdan khri mdzad/dgung lo re gsum pa shing 'brug (1244)lor hor rgyal po go dan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin khong rang dang sku tsha 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ phyag na rdo rje mched gnyis dang bcas lung cu sde bzhir(deng sang kun su'u zhing chen u we rdzong gi mnga' 'og yin )phebs nas rgyal po dang mjal/ yon mchod kyi 'brel ba chags/ bod du dpon rigs bsko lugs dang / khral 'ul bskul tshul sogs la zhal 'chams te/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yon mchod rnams la 'phrin yig btang ste bod kyi sa phyogs hor rgyal po'i mnga' khongs su bcug pas mes rgyal gcig gyur yong ba la mi nyams pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag dgung lo bdun cu pa rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag (spyi lo 1251)lor lung cu sprul pa'i sder sku gshegs/rje 'di'i gsung chos ni pod gsum tsam bzhugs shing / khyad par du 〈mkhas pa la 'jug pa'i sgo 〉dang / 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉〈legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter 〉〈tshig gi gter 〉〈tshad ma rigs pa'i gter 〉sogs bod kyi rig gnas dang tshad ma rig pa la shugs rkyen cher ldan1 sna'i

legs bshad gang mang yod/legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gteradu/(tshan bshus )'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /lha yi mchog dang klu dbang grub pa rig 'dzin gtso/ / drang srong rgyas pa grog mkhar pa ()dang rkang mig ()sogs/ / kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod pa/ / 'gro ba'i gtso bo kun mkhyen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rig pas dpyad na chos lugs mi 'gal zhing / / 'jig rten bya ba kun nas legs bsgrub pa/ / dam pa rnams kyi spyod tshul ci 'dra zhig /bshad pa 'di ni legs bshad rin chen gter/ /mkhas pa yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa/ / de dag legs bshad rin chen sdud/ / rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter/ / yin phyir chu bo thams cad 'bab/ / skye bo yon tan yod med pa'i/ / blang dor blo gros ldan pa mkhas/ / rdul dang 'dres pa'i lcags phye rnams/ / khab len rdo ()yis len par shes/ / legs bshad mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis/ / go yi blun pos de lta min/ / nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na/ / 'byung bo'i bya durnams long bar 'gyur/ / shes rab ldan pas nyis pa dag / sel bar nus kyi blun pos min/ / nam mkha' lding gis dug can sbrul/ /gsod par nus ()kyi khu tas mi//8 / blo gros chen po rgud na yang / / lhag par blo gros stobs ldan

'gyur/ / ri dwags rgyal po bkres pa na/ / glang chen spyi bo myur du 'gem/ /mkhas pa brtsad cing ma dris pa/ / de yi bar du gting mi dpog / rnga la dbyug gus ma bsnun pa/ / de srid gzhan dang khyad ci yod/ / rig pa nang par 'chi yang bslab/ / tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / / skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ / nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra/ / yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ / ma bsdus par yang rang nyid 'du/ / dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor/ / mkhas pa yon tan kun bslabs pa/ / mthar phyin gcig gis 'jig rten gsal/ / blo ngan shes pa mang na yang / /rgyu skar bzhin du gsal mi nus/ / mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang / / gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu'ang len/ / de ltar rgyun du spyad pa yis/ / myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'gro/ / mkhas pa shes rab kyis bsrungs na/ / dgra bo mang yang ga la tshugasabu/ / 'phags rgyal gyi ni bram ze'i bu/ / gcig pus dgra bo'i tshogs kun bcom/ / blo chung gros nyes 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ / blo ldan thabs kyis bde bar gso/ / chu klung rnyog pas chud gzan pa/ / chu dwangs nor bus dwangs par byed/ / mkhas pa ji ltar thabs rdugs kyang / / blun po 'jug pa'i lam mi 'gro/ / char sdod bye'u duskom na yang / / sa la babs pa'i chu mi 'thung / / shes rab ldan pa mgo bskor yang / / bya ba'i cha la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /srog chags grog ma mig med kyang / / mig ldan gzhan las lhag par mgyogs/ / blo gros ldan pa gnyis bgros na/ / blo gros legs pa gzhan 'byung srid/ yung ba dang ni tsha la las/ / kha dog gzhan zhig skye bar 'gyur/ / khong mdzangs bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ / gcig pu yin yang kun las rgyal/ / ri dwags rgyal po seng ge dang / /'khor los bsgyur ()la grogs mi dgos/ / thabs la mkhas na chen po yang / / bran du bkol bar ga la dka'/ / mkha' lding mthu /byi che

na yang / / gos ser can gyi bzhon par 'gyur du/ / 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol gyi/ / bde ba bsgrub pa shes rab yin/ / rgyal bu zla ba'i shes rab kyis/ / bran bzang 'di dang phyi mar bskyabs/ / dpa' zhing mthu rtsal che na yang / / mkhas pa min pas dpa' mi 'thob/ / 'byor ba thob par gyur na yang / / bsod nams med na ga la rtag / yon tan skyon gnyis sus kyang gsal/ / 'dres pa 'byed shes mkhas pa yin/ / chu las 'o ma ngang bas phyed/ / ba las 'o ma kun gyis long / / smras shing bskul par gyur pa na/ /dud 'gro la yang go ba skye/ / ma bskul gzhan gyis ma smras par/ / bsam pa shes na mkhas pa yin/ / blo dang ldan na ma smras kyang / / rnam 'gyur nyid las bsam pa go/ / bal bo'i se'u ma zos kyang / / kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/ /mkhas pa rang gi yul bas kyang / / yul khams gzhan na mchod pa 'thob/ /nor bu gzhan du brin pa tsam/ / rgya mtsho'i gling du ga la brin/ / mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug / bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ / bde ba chung la chags pa yis/ / chen po'i bde ba 'thob mi srid/ / blo dang ldan na nyam chung yang / / stobs ldan dgra yis ci byar yod/ / ri dwags rgyal po stobs ldan pa/ /ri bong blo dang ldan pas bsad/ / sems can gzhan dang rjes mthun pa'i/ / spyod pa shes na mkhas pa yin/ / dud 'gro yin yang rigs mthun rnams/ / khyu gcig tu ni mi gnas sam/ / nges par 'byung ba'i bya ba dga'/ / ma grub pa na dpyod pa'i tshe/ / mkhas rmongs gnyis kyi khyad par shes/ / grub nas dpyod pa blun po'i tshul/ / mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad pa yi/ / shes bya shes na mkhas par bgrang / / ba lang rgan gzhon dpyod pa la/ /blun po mkhas kyang yon tan min/ / rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms shing / /rgyal po'i bang mdzod nor gyis min/ / 'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te/ /ma~X pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms/ / legs bshad byis pa dag las

kyang / / mkhas pa rnams ni yongs su len/ / dri zhim 'byung na ri dwags kyi/ / lte ba las kyang gla rtsi len/ / legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las mkhas rnyi brtag pa ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o/ /ma///ga ṭī pazlo ba/ shad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba ni yongs gragasasu (sa skya legs bshad 〉cesapa dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten lugs kyi bstanabacos shig yin/ brjod bya khyon sdom rab byed dgu ru dbye ste/ dang po mkhas pa brtagapa/ gnyis pa ya rabs brtag pa/ gsum pa blun po brtag pa/ bzhi pa spel ma brtag pa/ lnga pa ngan spyod brtag pa/ drug pa rang bzhin gyi tshul brtag pa/ bdun pa mi rigs pa'i tshul brtag pa/ brgyad pa bya ba brtag pa/ dgu pa chos brtag pa bcasadagu yod do/ /rjod byed kyi cha la dpe dpe can gnyis ci rigs sbyar te tshig bde zhing don gsal ba/rtsom stangs la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal bas/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog dus rabs kyi khyad chosamatshon byed kyi rtsom yig gal che'i gnas su 'god/()drang srong rgyas pa grog mkhar pa/ sngar rgya gar du byung ba'i phyi rol pa'i drang srong rgyas pa dang grog mkhar rnam gnyis te/ rgyas pa ni phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' gcer bu pa'i ston par grags padangaphe/ groX /sdur sdi grog ma'i mkhanā du dka' thub grub pa'i drang srong zhig ste phyi rol du/dri byigan ༵ trī ༵ nā spra bye/ dīkā ṭā /sna pa/ ca/na pa'i ston pa ste/ phyi rol pa'i gtam rgyud du/sngar drang srong mdzes pa zhes bya ba zhig lha dbang phyug gis lha mo u ma'i srung mar ba'ag pa na/u ma drang srong la chagasapas sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du bstan kyang / khong gis rkang par mig phab ste brtul zhugs bsrungs pas lha dbang phyug mnyes te bstan bcos rtsom pa'i mchog sbyin nas drang srong rkang mig pa zhes phyi rol pa'i ston par gyur nasaphyogs chos kyi tshigs dgu du/spru ༵ / /na tshi/rdzu /smra sna/ /sna |todalca r+shakā pa/kā/ 'dren nus pa'i yon tan gyis rdo khab du/spya/ theg/ bya/ma sri/ byar ste/ ཿta zhes pa'i gnod byed gdon bgegs kyi bya yin pas na ༷/ṭī kār+shatā rnyi nga /sna/ /gci /can/ sbrul gsod par nus/ nam mkha' lding ste bya khyung kluḥ /gas

gsod pa'am za bar grags la/ de yang rgya gar phyi rol pa'i gtam rgyud du/ sngon rgyal po zhig la btsun mo 'dul bya ma dang bkra shisam zhes pa gnyis yod de/ lan gcig btsun mo gnyis nyi ma'i shing rta mthong bas/ 'dul byed mas dkar po dang bkra shes mas nag po yin zhes rtsod cing rgyal byas te/ gang bden pa rgyal po'i btsun mo dang mi bden pa g.yog mo byed pabyas/ de nas klu zhig yod pa la/ bkra shes mas bsnyen bkur bgyis te/ khyod kyis nyi ma'i shing rta nag por mthong bar gyis shig byas pas des khas blangs so/ /de nasabatsun mo gnyis lhan du klu de'i gnasasar phyin te dris pas/ nyi ma'i shing rta nag po yin byas pas 'dul byed ma g.yog mo byed dgos pa byung bas shin tu sdug bsngal bar gyur pa na/ drang srong skar mig gisasgo nga gsum byin te/ 'dis khyod la phan par 'gyur gyis/ zhag bdun ring ma brtol zhig zer ro/ /de 'dod pa myur pas/ nyi ma gsum na gcig brtol pa na/ glog tu gyur te nam mkha' la song ngo/ /yang drug na gcig brtol pas/ skar ma skya rengs su song ngo/ /bdun pa na gcig brtol pa dang bya khyung du song ste ma la phyag byas te/ khyod kyi bya ba gang dgos pa bdag gis bya'o zhesazer ro/ /klu yis nyesapas klu rnams med par gyis sheg ces smrasate/ de nas bya khyung gisaklu rnams za bar byed do zhesagrags so/ /0tshu/sa/ /dzugs/ dang nga/ /tsho zin pa dang / 'tshe ba bcas don du ma la 'jug ste/dusdur r+sha lda byi ('amad kāngakā dīsna da//'a blosamadzad pa'i (sa skya legasabashad sogasakyi brda don grol ba 〉las/ char sdod byi'u ni/ 'ga' zhig rma bya dang gong mo la bshad pa dang / la las khu byug yin zer ba sogasayod kyang / mngon brjod mang po dang rtogasabarjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi mchan du spang lo tsā bas khug rta yin par bshad de/ khug rta la char sdod byi'u dang / sā rat+na dang / tsa ta ka dang / char dga' dang / sprin la slong zhes pa sogs ming gi rnam grangasamang du gsungasashing phal skad la kha la yug zer ro zhesagasungasaso/ /du'akhor los bsgyur/ 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po ste/ mi'i tshe lo grangasamed nasabargyad khri yakā chad sna spyan/ de man chad ༵ mi byon te/ de'i lus dang yobyad dang / 'dul ba'i skye bo 0byi kha/ patre ma/ ༵ ༵ ༵ sna ༷༷ // //gos ser can gyi bzhon par 'gyur/ /zhesapa ni/ bya khyung mthu rtsal che yang gos ser can te lha khyab 'jug gi bzhon par 'gyur ro zhes pa'o/ /22

bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 mkhas pa yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa/ / de dag legs par rin chen sdud/ / rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter/ / yin phyir chu bo thams cad 'bab/ ces pa'i tshigs bcad der deng skabs kha cig gis/ mkhas pa rnams ni yon tan gyi bdag nyid du gyur pa yin kyang / rang gi yon tan 'di lta bur blo khengs nas ma bsdad par da dung gzhan gyi yon ta/ gazlo dang gang yang 'bad pas len zhes 'grel 'dug pa der 2 / skya sdug/ par+sha sdo ཿkā /bod kyi rtsom rig bya bzhag thad nus pa ji ltar 2 nā ༵ yo/ga/sa bshad kyi dzod byed kyi cha la thun mong min pa'i khyad chos gtso bo ji ltar ldan 'dug/

bod yul la bsngags pa/'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i mkhas pa'i yid dbang 'phrog pa'i rtsom pa rin po che'i phreng ba rnams ni/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas rtsom pa 'di 'dra myur 'jug pa/ / glog 'gyu bas kyang ches myur zhing / / rtsol ba med par 'byung ba ni/ / mtsho ltar ngang gis lhun grub lags/ / de don phun sum tshogs gyur pa/ / rlom chen blo yi dbang bo mchog / 'gas kyang sngon chad ma dpyad pa/ / dpyod ldan gang gis rnam dpyad pa/ / yid gsal bgyid pa gangs ri'i rtser/ / nyi ma shar ba lta bu ste/ / kun nas dga' ba bskyed pa ni/ / bsam gtan ro myong lta bur mchis/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom pa rnams 'bad rtsol la mi ltos par 'byung ba dang / tshig nyung ngus kyang don rgya chen po ston pa dang / tshig gi rgyan bzang bos mkhas pa rnams yin 'phrog par byed pa dang / mkhas par rlom pa brgya'i blo gros phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pas kyang dpyod par mi nus pa'i don zab mo ston pa yin te/ bod yul gyi bstod pa 'di las/ gling chen po bzhi las bye brag tu 'dzam bu'i gling gi lte ba bskal pa bzang bo'i rnam 'dren stong rim par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mos gtsos rgyal ba sras bcas dpag tu med pas nye bar bskyangs pas dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i bod yul 'di la ni/ ri mtho la sa gtsang zhing yul bzang ba/ga~X ri tshar du dngar ba/ chu klung dri ma med pa/ rin chen gter gyis phyug

pa sogs snod kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs shing / lugs gnyis blang dor la mkhas pa'i dam pa rnams kyis gsang gsum 'khor los rtag tu sgyur ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi grib bsil snum pos phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs ba/ bcu phrag snang ba'i 'od zhags dkar bos dam du 'khyud pa sogs bcud kyi dge mtshan ma lus par tshang ba rnams ni/ snyan tshig rgya mtsho'i klong las 'phyur ba'i sdeb legs tshig gi phreng bas lhug par brjod pa'o/ /rtsom pa po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar gong du gsal/༄༅/ / oṃ susti sidhe/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo lha mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu yis/ / 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la/ / nyi zer phra ba'i cha shas 'jug pa ltar/ / g.yeng ba dumed par rtse gcig gis btud pa/ / bdag kyang ji ltar nus pas rdzogs pa yi/ / sangs rgyas tshig gi phreng bas bstod bgyi ste/ / sa stong dpag bsam ljon shing ()rab bskyed ces/ / lhug phran myu gu'i tshogs rnams cis mi skyed/ / dbus kyi gling chen po bzhi ba/ bye brag tu 'dzam bu'i gling dhi/ bde bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi reg pas mngon par mdzes pa/ byang chub kyi snying bo rdo rje'i gdan dulas byang phyogs kyi rgyud/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i zla ba dri ma med pa'i gangs ri dpal dang ldan pas brgyan pa'i khrod/ / lha rdzas kyi nor bu nye bar 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i phung bo ltar/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i/ rin po che du ma'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa/ sa'i cha glang bo'i spyi gtsug ltar mtho la skye dgu ma lus pa'i sgron me/ nyi ma'i )/la

'khor gza' las thar ba ltar rdul dang bral bas gtsang ba'i 'jug ngogs dang ldan pa/ bsil ba'i sgra dbyangs nye bar sgrogs pa'i chu klung dri ma med pa 'bab pa dang ldan pa'i 'gram ngosas/ rgyal ba sras bcas dpag tu med pas nye bar bskyangs pas dam pa'i chos ①kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i bod kyi yul 'dir/ thugs rje dpag tu med pas bskal pa brjod kyi mi lang bar smon lam durgya mtsho'i rdul dang mtshungs pa 'byongs pas/ skye dgu ma lus pa'i don mdzad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la legs par bshad pa'i chos kyis rab tu rgyas pa/ snyan ngag gi lo 'dab kyi snying bo nye bar 'khrigs pa/ grags pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri'i tshogs la blo gros gsal ba'i skye bo'i tshogs kyi bung ba'i phreng ba/ yon tan rmad du byung ba yid 'phrog pa'i cha byad can dad pa'i yid kyis bstod pa'i tshig gi rnam par g.yo ba'i dar dir gyi sgra sgrogs pa'i tshogs kyis gtibs pas kun nas khyab pa/bsod nams dri ma med pa'i chu klung las 'byung ba'i sdong bu rnam par rgyas pa ltar rab tu dregs pa'i lha yi dbang bo rnams kyis rgyun mi 'chad par btud pas legs par brgyan pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la bdag kyang rnam par g.yeng ba med pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas lus nye bar btud pa'i yan lag mchog gis gtugs te skye bo'i rna bar 'jug pa'i tshig gi phreng ba rnams kyis rgyun mi 'chad par bstod cing gus pa dang ldan pas skyabs su mchi'o/ / rnam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' zhing / / zla zer bzhin du dri med pa/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dul/ / nyin re zhing ni phyag 'tshal lo/ / kho bo'i blo gsal dri med chu gtsang las/ / byung ba'i bstod tshig pad+mo'i phreng mdzes pa/ / legs sbyar ngag gi ze'u 'brus rab brgyan pa'i/ / phreng ba 'di ni rdzogs sangs rgyas la 'bul/ / de ltar sgo gsum mkha' ltar dngas pa la/ / shar ba'i bsdebs leXsdu tshig gi bsil zer can/ / dri med zla ba ltar dkar dge ba gang / /

des ni 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs 'dra bar shog / bdag nyid chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs kyi rdul la reg pas blo gros gtsang ba'i 'khon jo sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis lo bcu dgu lon pa'i tshe/ dpal sa skya'i dbon gakāswā shinā /nā rin po che'i 'byung gnas su nye bar sbyar ba'o/ /dugayeng ba/ 'dod pa'i yon tan sogs la rnam par 'thoba'i semasagayeng ba drug gang rung /rjodapag bsam ljon shing / de yonye 'khor thams cad na dpag bsam shing la bya skad snyan par sgrogs pa mang bo yod pa'i shing las 'dod yon rnam pa lnga bsam pas 'byung ba yod do/ /lha /mas kyi bsod nam kyipa dus susbyang lhangasapas me rtog rnying ba thams cad 'thor zhing me du'/ ṭā pa/ dī spya mas 'a ḍiṅge/ pa/ pye gyi/ da/busanasabyang du ri nag po dgu 'das pa'i mtshamagasugangasari ste ri bo gangasacan zhesabya ba yod cing / de'i byang na ri bo spos ngad ldan pa yod la/ de gnyisakyi bar du sngon bram ze dus dpog ces bya bas lha dang 'khor los sgyurab thob byed kyi mchod sbyin byas pa'i 'brasakhu dron mo pho ba ma drosapa ltar gyur pa la ma dro4pa zhesagrags pa klu'i rgyal bo ma dros pa gnasapa'i mtsho/ sman dang rin po che dang nags tshal dang chu klung thamasacad kyi 'byung gnas sugyur pa chu zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcur mnyam pa yod do/ /de'i phyogs bzhi nasakha 'bab kyi chu bzhir gragasapa shar phyogs na brag glang bo che'i gdong 'dra ba nas chu klung gaṅgā dngul gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab pa/ lho phyogs na brag khyu mchog gi gdong 'dra ba nas chu klung si be+eḍūr+ya'i bye ma 'dren cing 'bab pa/ nub phyogs na brag rta'i gdong 'dra ba nas chu klung pas shel gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab pa/ byang phyogs na brag seng ge'i gdong 'dra ba nas chu klung si tā gser gyi bye ma 'dren cing 'bab pa/ de'ang chu phran lnga brgya lnga brgya dang bcas te mtsho ma dros pa la lan bdun bdun g.yasasubaskor nas phyogasabazhi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ / mtsho 'gram du dzasbru bṛk+ṣa zhes bya ba'i shing sdong 'bras bu mngar bo rdza ma tsam yod pa de smin nas chur lhung ba'i sgra lasadzasbru zhesabya ba 'byung zhing / shing des nye bar mtshan pa'i gling yin pasan dzasbru'i gling zhes grags la/ 'bras bu de klu'i rgyal bo rnams kyi/ nyar sprul nasaza bar byed cing / ma zos pa rnams dzasbru chu bo'i gser dhisdo trī shā par ba//ga sa/ yu/la gyi chu klung ne+e rañja na zhes pa'i nub phyogs su yod pa/ / rje

gdan ni/ spyir sa tshigasakyi dbang du byas pa'i lho 'dzam bu gling gi yul dbus dang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ bskal pa stongs kyang mi 'jig par 'byung ba'i gnod pa dang bral te gnam la zo ba btags pa ltar sdunapa pa/ dbus su byazlo chub shing gis brgyan nas yod pa sogs gnas kyi mchog tu gyur pa medapa pa/ byinā /gaḥkālda na/mas/ dang / las dang / myang 'das gsum brjod byar byas shing /gsung rab rjod byed du byed pa ste/ gang la dmigasan lus can rnams kyi sgrib pa zad cing yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ ji skad du/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang / /sgrib pa kun sel dam pa'i chos/ /zhes so/ /dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ des bstan pa'i chos yin pas dam pa'i chosasam/ yang na dam pa ni mchog tu gyur pa yin la chos kyang yin pas dam pa'i chos zhes sam/ yang na skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis spyad duḥ/ ṭī ༵/'i shādri ṅgi nā rji/ /dri nā // /spra // /de tho/ba par gyur cig ces smon pa la'o/ /()sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun/ 'dusam byas sogs yon tan brgyad ldan gyi skyabs gnas mthar thug sangs rgyas dkon mchog bsam med gnyis med sogs kyi yon tan brgyad ldan gyi 'phags rgyud kyi rnam byang bden pa chos dkon chog rig grol gyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa'i gang zag dge 'dun dkon mchog de yang ma rig bag chags dang bcas pa'i gnyid las sangs shing shes bya thams cad la blo rgyas pas sangs rgyas dang /dam pa'i chos 'gog lam gnyis kyis gdul bya rngams nyes ltung dang 'khor ba dang ngan 'gro pa/ sdo /na pas na chos/ dge ba thar ba sgrub par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa can yin pas dge bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 bod yul la bsngags pa'i bstod rtsom 'di dang bod kyi gnas bstod gzhan gyi dbar khyad par gang 'dug/2 lo na shin tu phra ba'i sa skya paṇa chen gyis bka' rtsom di 'dra rtsom thub /8 pa/ / zlordo t+na ༵ ༵ ṅgi /sna/sa bstod kho nar zer ba yin nam/

bstod dbyangs rgya mcho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba/snyan rtsom 'di ni brjod bya bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mnga' ba'i rang gi bla mar bsngags shing / rjod byed snyan ngag gi rgyan rkang pa thung ngu dang / ring po dang / shin tu ring po rnams rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyi sdeb sbyor gyi snyan rtsom khyad 'phags shig yin/'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ rab byung bzhi ba'i shing lug (spyi lo 1235)lor yab zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang yum ma gcig kun dga' skyid gnyis kyi sras su sa skyar 'khrungs/ dgung lo chung dus nas yi ge 'bri klog sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga la dka' tshegs chen po ma dgos par mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu ba shing 'brug (spyi lo 1244)lor khu bo sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta hor rgyal po go dan gyis gdan drangs pa ltar lung cu sde bzhir phebs skabs zhabs phyir byon/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa lcags phag (spyi lo 1251)lor sa paṇa sku gshegs khar rang nyid kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bdag por bskos/dgung lo bcu dgu ba chu glang (spyi lo 1253)lor hu pi li (go pe la )swā byen

han gyis gdan drangs te hor gyi bla mchod mdzad/ lo der sa paṇa gyi sku gdung ngo mtshar can byon pas rgyal po hu pi li sogs dad nas 'phags pa la dbang zhus pas/ thog mar rgyal po gtsos mi nyi shu rtsa lnga la gsang sngags kyi dbang gnang / dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum dang / ti shrī'i go gnas/ g.yang ṭi las byas pa'i tham ga bcas phul/ dbang thengs gnyis pa gnang ba'i dbang yon du bod chol kha gsum gyi srid dbang yongs rdzogs phul nas bod sa gnas kyi chos srid gnyis ga'i dbang gi bdag por bskos/ rab byung bzhi ba'i chu byi (spyi lo 1252)bod du phebs/ gong mas 'phags pa la bod kyi chos srid gnyis ku'i bdag por bskos ji/'i 'ja' sa mu tig ma phul/de'i phyi lor sa skyar byon/ bod du lo ngo gsum bzhugs ring la kha che'i parnyi ta shrī ta thā ga da bha dra dang / glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ snar thang mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags sogs mkhan chen nyi shu lhag tsam bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ de nas gong ma'i bka' ltar slar rgya nag tubebs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing yos (spyi lo 1255)lor snye thang mkhan chen grags pa seng ge'i drung du dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ rab byung lnga ba'i sa sbrul (spyi lo 1269)lor hor yig gsar pa gtan phab kyis phul te rjes su tham ga'i thog bed spyod byed srol yod/ dgung lo so drug pa lcags rta (spyi lo 1270)lor slar yang rgyal po la gsang sngags kyi dbang gnang ba'i yon du shel dam gling drug ma dang / gnam gyi 'og sa yi steng na rgya gar lha'i sras po/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas/ yi ge rtsom mi/ rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug pa po/ gnas lnga rig pa'i parnyi ta 'phags pa ti shrī zhes pa'i 'ja' sa dang go gnas phul/ me byi (spyi lo 1276)lor slar bod du phebs nas sa skya'i chos rgyal mdzad cing / gtsang chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la bsnyen brdi/ te chu mig chos 'khor mdzad/ dgung lo zhe drug pa rab byung lnga ba'i

lcags 'brug(spyi lo 1280)lor lha khang bla brang du sku gshegs/bstod dbyangs rgya mcho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba/na mo gu ru mdzi sgo ṣā yarjo/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang gi rang bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar gdod nas rnam dag srid dang zhi ba'i rjodangos po kun gyi rang bzhin nyid gyur nyer zhi yang / / gzhan don dga' ba'i thugs rje'i rgyal mtshan rnam par bsgreng zhing sna tshogs thabs brtson shes bya kun sbyangs smon lam rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pas/ / thun mong pa dang phul du byung ba'i yon tan dpal gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i sku gsung thugs ldan gsang ba mtha' yas mi zad pa/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las bzang pos sna tshogs gdul ba'i 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor yongs su rdzogs mdzad bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo bsod nams rgya mtshos rnam bskrun zhing / / ye shes tshogs ()kyis che ba'i sku/ /brnyes pa khyod kyis srid pa yi/ / nyes pa rtsad nas gzhom pa'i slad/ / 'jig rten spyod las rnam grol bas/ / yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan gyi/ / cha yang nyams pa mi mnga' na/ / 'chi 'pho lha yang ga la mchis/ / de lta mod kyi gdul bya yi/ / ri la 'char dang nub par snang / / 'on kyang mdzad pa'i 'phrin las la/ / 'phel 'grib yang ye ()ma mchis shing / / dngos grub dag kyang mos pa yi/ / yid kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i slad/ / bcom ldan bzhugs dang gshegs pa dang / / khyod kyi sku dang sku gzugs 'di/ / tha dad lta bur snazlo na

yang / / rang gi rang bzhin dag pa dang / / mdzad pa dag gis rnam kun tu/ / gnyis su med par bdag gis 'tshal/ / srid la sred pa'i srad bu'i 'ching bral slad/ /thogs med slad du 'dir yang thogs med lags/ /'gro ba kun la thugs rje goms pa'i phyir/ / 'dir yang thugs rjes rjes 'dzin gdon mi za/ / de slad bsod nams bye ba phrag brgya yis/ / nye bar bsgrubasapa'i sku ltar sku gzugs 'di/ / kun nas mos slad mkhyen brtse nus payis/ / rnam par gzigs shing nye bar dgongs nas kyang / / mos pa ji bzhin byin gyis rlob mdzad la/ / re ba'i 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs bgyi'i slad/ /thun mong pa dang phul du byung ba yi/ / dngos grub rin chen char yang dbab tu gsol/ / de ltar dngos grub don du dngos grub 'byung gnas skyob pa khyod la bdag /dngos po kun gyis kun tu 'dud cing mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho yis/ / nye bar mchod phyir mchod 'os khyod kyi tshul yang tshul bzhin nges bgyi'i slad/ / legs par gsungs pa'i gsung gi mdzod las ji ltar rtogs bzhin gleng bar 'tshal /yon tan pha rol phyin pa bzhidu/ / brnyes pa khyod kyis dam pa'i don/ /'gro 'ong med par thugs chud slad/ / mi g.yo bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ / de lta mod kyi cho 'phrul gsum 0gyis rnam par 'phrul khyod bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing / / gzhan du gzhan la mos pa ji bzhin kun tu sprul pa'i sku yi rnam 'phrul gang / / skad cig gcig la'ang bgrang ba las 'das nye bar ston mdzad yid ltar mgyogs pa ste/ / mdzad pa de dag rmad du byung ba'i 'bras bu mchog gis brgyan par smos ci 'tshal/ / bsam gyis mi khyab dam pa'i don/ / gzigs pa khyod kyis chos kyi dbyings/ / brjod du med par thugs chud slad/ /mi gsung bar yang bzhugs pa lags/ / de lta mod kyi mi 'ardoXs bzhi buyis bsnyengs pa rjodang bral zhing / / so so yang dag rig pa

bzhi ()la kun nas dbang 'byor khyod/ / bye ba phrag brgya'i chos kyi sgo yis sna tshogs rab bkra'i dngos/ / nye bar mtshon phyir gzhan don chos kyi char chen 'bebs mdzad lags/ / dag pa gnyis (kyekyis rnam dag pas/ / dbyings dang kun tu ro gcig phyir/ / spros pa'i mtshan ma rab zhi'i slad/ / mi rtog par yang bzhugs pa lags/ / de lta mod kyi mgon po khyod kyis bskal pa rgya mtshor 4)shes bya kun la kun nas legs sbyangs shing / / sdug bsngal rgya mtshor rnam par bying ba'i sems can rgya mtsho grangs mtha' yas la rab tu brtse ba yi/ / thugs rje chen pos rnam par brlan pa'i yang dag thabs la rab tu brtson mdzad smon lam rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / legs par grub pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed mkhyen phyir mkhyen pa'ang shes bya ji bzhin bkra ba lags/ / de ltar gang la phyag bya ba'i/ / yul de phyag 'os thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin lags par legs 'tshal nas/ / slar yang de la phyag bgyi'o/ /kha dog med cing dbyibs dang bral/ / gong bu med cing rdul yang med/ /bstan du med cing bltar med pa/ / gzugs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan yidang ldan/ / dpe byad brgyad cus ⑩rnam par spras/ / 'od zer phreng bas lam me ba/ / bltar 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ge med cing ming dang bral/ / tshig gi tshogs ni rnam par spangs/ /sgra med mnyan du med pa can/ / brjod bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'gag pa med cing sgo kun nas/ / yan lag drug cus brgyan pa yi/ / dbyangs kyis chos rnams legs sgrogs pa/ / mnyan 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rnam shes med cing yid dang bral/ / rnam par rtog pa kun spangs shing / / mtshan ma thams cad rab zhi ba/ / dmigs med ()khyod la phyag 'tshal lo ji lta ba dang ji snyed mkhyen/ / ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi gter/ / 'asdi zlo'i

yid la mnyam 'jug pa/ / bsam bya khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang gi rang bzhin gdod ma nas/ / 'dus ma byas pa'i mtshan nyid phyir/ / gzhi med slad du khyad par dang / / bral ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor ba'i chos rnams bgrang yas pa/ /lam gyi bden pas (yob bsgyur phyir/ / yon tan rgya mtshos khyad par du/ / 'phags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa'i chos/ / gang lags gang gis rnam kun tu/ / spang ba'i slad du bya byed las/ /grol ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang / / thabs dang rnam par gtong ba yis/ / yul dus rnam par mdzad pa yang / / rgya chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mnyam dang mi mnyam srid zhi yi/ /'du byed gang lags bcom (gzhom )pa'i slad/ / mtha' rnams kun la mi gnas pa/ / rnam grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dzin dang grol ba'i ye shes kyis/ / 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ / mnyam pa nyid du legs pa yi/ /srid zhi'i dbang phyug phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun 'byung spros pa'i mtshan ma yis/ / rnam pa kun tu ma spros shing / / spros pa nye bar gcod mdzad pa/ /spros bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spros pa yis/ /rnam pa kun tu rab spros shing / / mdzad pa'i 'phrin las spro mdzad pa/ /spros bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpe rnams bye ba phrag brgya yis/ / dpe tsam nyid du'ang mi bzod cing / /dpe zla kun dang rnam bral ba/ / dpe med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpe dang gtan tshigs thams cad dang / / yi ge ming dang tshig gi tshogs/ / brda rnams kun gyis rnam kun tu/ / mtshon bya khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de slad bla ma'i bla ma ste/ /chen po'i chen por gyur pa lags// mchod 'os rnams kyis mchod 'os pa/ /phyag 'os khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar phyag 'os thub pa khyod la phyag bgyis nas/ / slar yang bsod nams zhiX snyi mchog la bsod nams kyi/ / myo tog dam pa kun nas spel slad kun

bzang gi/ / rnam 'phrul ji bzhin mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par bgyi/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i rdzas ltar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i rnam 'phrul spro phyir mchod pa'i rdzas/ / snam sbyar chos gos snam phran glegs bu (7na nas sbyar legs pad+ma dmar po ltar dmar ba/ / gser gyi ri mo gser gyi 'od 'byin bkram pas cher bkra lcags ri'i khor yug mu tig gi/ / phreng ba zung gis phreng du dngar zhing zung du sbyar 'di ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul gyis sprul pas/ / mchod pa'i rnam 'phrul zhing khams rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ / rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi/ / rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la/ / lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad ni 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgya legs gnas pa/ / kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ / chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun kun nas khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid par/ / rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas/ / kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pas mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig/ mchod rdzas dri med lha yi gos/ / yid dbang mdzes pa sang gi sku/ / mtshan gyi dpal gyis 'bar ba gang / / kun nas g.yogs pas mdzes byas pa/ /rin chen gser gyi lhun po'i rgyal/ /tsha zer bye bas bzhu ba'i sprin/ / pad+ma rā ga'i mdog snang bas/ / yongs su bskor ba lta bu lags/ / yang na bcom ldan khyod sku dri med nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor lta bur kun nas rab tu gsal ba gang / /chos gos 'od zer snam phran glegs bu'i phreng ba spel legs nye bar 'khrigs pa blta na sdug pas yongs bskor pas/ / mdzes pa gzhan kun skar ma'i tshogs ltar zil gyis mnan nas gdul bya rab dga'i swā /ga

pad+mo'i tshal rab rgyas byed cing / / snyan dngags mkhan gyi sbrang rtsi 'dzin pas snyan dngags ngag gi bstod dbyangs dar dir kun tu sgogs par bgyid pa lags/ / yang na khyod sku lhun po bzhin/ / chos gos nam mkha' lta bur mchis/ / de la gser gyi ri mo ni/ / bkram pa gza' skar tshogs ltar bkra/ / yang na rgyal ba'i gzhal med khang mdzes shin tu dwangs pa'i yid bzhin mtshor/ / na bza' chos gos chu skyes dmar po'i 'dab rgyas lta bur snang ba'i dkyil/ / bcom ldan khyod sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i snying po ltar yang mdzes pa ste/ / mtshan gyi dpal dang dpe byad bzang po'i ze'u 'bru'i phreng bas spras pa lags/ / de slad de yi snyan pa'i dri bsung phyogs bcur khyab pas nyer bsdus pa'i/ / dad ldan bung ba'i sprin phung lta bur ze bar 'khrigs pas khyod kyi sku/ / dpal gyis 'bar ba mngon sum snang bas yid dab 'phrog pas bsngags pa yi/ / dar dir sgra dbyangs sgrogs par bgyid rnams dngos grub sbrang rtsis tshims mdzad lags/ / yang na thub pa khyod kyi khams/ / chos rnams kun gyi dbyings nyid lags/ / de la kun rdzob cher bka'i chos/ / nye bar bstan pa nyer mtshon slad/ / khyod sku lhun po ltar brtan pa'i/ / rten la zhing khams rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / rnam par bkra ba'i chos gos ni/ / brten pa ltar yang gyur pa lags/ / yang na gang tshe thub pa'i rnam 'phrul mig 'phrul mkhan gyi sgyu 'phrul lta bur sprul mdzad pa/ / de tshe zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed 'grib pa med par khyod kyi sku yi dkyil 'khor la/ / kun tu snang ba'i snang ba dam pa skye dgu kun la kun nas skyed mdzad ji bzhin du/ / 'di yi sku gzugs brtan par bzhugs la chos gos zhing khams rgya mtsho bkram pa'ang snang ba lags/ / de 'dra snang bas gang gi yid/ / kun nas 'phrog par bgyid pa ni/ /'dod ldan dag gi lha mo'i lus/ / yid 'ong mthong ba lta bur mardoswā/ / kun nas nyon mongs dri bral slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma

lags so/ / nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa (nyas/ / kun tu rtog pa kun bral yang / / 'gro ba'i yid ni yongs bsgyur pas/ / sgyu ma'i sprul pa lta bur mchis/ /dge ba'i sa bon brtas bgyid slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ / de yis dad pa'i chu gter ni/ / rnam par rgyas par bgyid pas na/ / char chen rab tu 'bebs bgyid pa'i/ / rnam par sgrogs pa'i sprin 'drar mchis/ /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi/ /lo tog yongs su 'phel ba yi/ / rten gyi dam par gyur pas na/ / sa chen dang yang 'dra bar mchis/ / kun gyi bla na lham pa'i slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ / dad can rnams kyis smon bgyid pa'i/ / 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa/ / de kun yongs su rdzogs bgyid pas/ / lha yi dpag bsam shing 'drar mchis/ /yang srid rnam par sun 'byin slad/ /shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /gsol ba btab na sgra med kyang / / dad ldan rnams kyi yid la chos/ / shin tu nges par bgyid pa ni/ / rang rgyal rnams kyi 'phrul 'drar mchis/ / phrin las rtsol ba mi mnga'i slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ / skye dgu'i blo gros pad+mo ni/ / kun nas kha 'byed bgyid pas na/ /chu skyes rnam par rgyas byed pa'i/ / tsha zer byed pa lta bur mchis/ /gdung ba dag kyang sel bgyid slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ /'gro ba'i log par sred pa yi/ / yid kyi dri ma 'phrog bgyid pas/ /mig gi rab rib rnam sel ba'i/ / bsil zer byed pa lta bur mchis/ / kun tu 'grib pa ma mchis slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa rnam sel zhing / / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi/ / rgyan gyi dam par gyur pa na/ / dbang gi rgyal po (sto bur mchis/ / ye shes chen po'i dbang bgyid slad/ / shin tu mtshungs pa'ang ma lags so/ / dī star

rmad du byung ba'i chos/ /shin tu ngo mtshar gyur pa rnams/ / khyod kyi cha yi dpe zlar mchis/ / kun nas mtshungs pa 'ga' ma mchis/ / de slad dpe rnams thams cad kyis/ / mtshon yang bas pa (to mchis so/ / rang bzhin yon tan rgyan gyi phul/ / bla na med pas legs brgyan slad/ / gzhan gyi bcos ma'i rgyan rnams kyis/ / brgyan par bgyi yang ci zhig 'tshal/ / de lta mod kyi 'phags mchog dang / / 'gro mchog rnams kyi nyin dang nyin/ / bstod pa'i rgyan gyis rnam kun tu/ / brgyan par bgyid pa ma lags sam/ / de slad bdag kyang mchod pa dang / / sna tshogs bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi/ / rgyan rnams kun gyis mgon po khyod/ / kun tu brgyan phyir spobs par gyur/ /'di ltar mchod pas mchod par bgyid 'os ma lus kun bdag mgon po mchog khyod mchod sprin rgya mtsho snyan tshig char rgyun bstod dbyangs 'brug gi sgra dbyangs ldan pas legs mchod pas/ / de ltar mchod pas mchod byed du 'os ma lus lus can chos kyi dbyings gtugs nam mkha'i mtha' klas kun gyis kyang ni kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod sprin lta bus legs mchod cing / /yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan tshogs rnams yon tan shes pa'i dad pa'i dbang byas yon tan bsngags pa'i bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho dbyangs can tshig dang tshangs dbyangs 4)ltar snyan legs bsgrags pas/ / sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rnam par sbyangs nas bsod nams rgya mtsho kun nas rgyas pa'i dpal las legs byung mchod sprin rgya mtshos yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas rtag tu mchod gyur cig/gcig la mchod pas mchod 'os kun/ / kun nas mchod par 'gyur ba ste/ / dngos grub bde blag nyid stsol bas/ / yul 'di bla na med par 'tshal/ / ngo bo rnam dag bkod pa rmad/ / sems kyi rnam 'phrul phul byung bas/ / zhing kun rgyas par 'gengs pas na/ / mchod yas dam pa nyid laXsdu grang / /dmigs pa med bzhin gzhan don dmigs/ / snyan dngags

snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs bcas/ / gus pas 'dud bzhin gus mchod pas/ /tshul 'di chos tshul ma lags sam/ / phyag 'os phyag dang mchod pas mchod slad bdag dang gzhan gyis tshul min bgyis pa'i nongs pa gang de slan chad bsdam pa'i yid kyis bshags/ / dge dang dge 'bras gang dang gang yod de dang de la dga' bas yi rang dge legs rgya mtsho kun tu spel slad rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / gang dang gang bzhugs de dang de la 'khor lo rin chen bskor bar bskul zhing 'khor ba ji srid brtan par bzhugs gsol de dag gis/ /ji lta ji ltar spyod pa spyad pa de lta de ltar gzhan gyi don phyir bdag gisaspyad bgyi ma lus skye dgu'ang spyod gyur cig / byang chub spyod pa'i yan lag yan lag bdun ⑩ / bdag gis ji ltar spyad pa spyod pa ltar/ / skye dgu 4)kun gyis spyod pa spyad byas nas/ / rang byung rgyal ba lha yi lhar gyur cig /mchod 'os yon tan rgya mtsho legs mchod pa'i/ / dge des 'gro kun mchod bya'iganas thob nas/ / de dag kun la mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ / mchod byed kun tu bzang por bdag gyur cig / bstod 'os rnams la bstod cadabyangs snyan pa'i sgras/ / bstod pa'i dge ba gang des lus can kun/ /bstod byar gyur nas de dag rnams la bdag / bstod byed snyan dngags mkhan du'ang 'gyur bar shog / bdag kyang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad la/ / bla med mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod byed cing / / bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sgra yis bstod par shog /mthong ba'i chos 'dir chos la rab dad pa'i/ / chos rgyal chos kyis rgyal zhing zhabs brtan la/ / chos bzhin chab srid legs skyong skye dgu kun/ / chos dang zang zing dpal gyis 'byor bar shog / 'dir ni chos don phun tshogs pa/ /yang dag spobs pas dbang byas nas/ / tshig sbyor snyan pas ba/chos
