pa gang / / dbyangs kyis kun nas bsnyad pa'i tshe/ / 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dgyes 'gyur zhing / / blo gsal rnams kyi yid 'phrog la/ / blun po'i rna ba'i dpal bskyed pa/ / 'di 'dra so so rig pa'i rgyu/ / tshig gi sdeb sbyor sbyor ba'i tshul la tshul bzhin shes pa'i shes ldan zhing / / don gyi rin chen chen po'i chen pos ches cher mdzes byed sna tshogs kyis/ / gang blo'i khang mdzes mdzes par rab spras spros pas spros pa'i yid dbang phyir/ / gzhan gyi snyan dngags ngag gi dpal 'phrog 'phrog byed yid rab 'phrog par sbyar/ / kun+da'i phreng ba kun nas bstar 'dra'i so yi ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba can/ / dkar nag rnam 'byed gsal ba'i mdangs ldan mig gi pad 'dab rnam par rgyas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i rlung gi shugs kyis ro 'dzin snying po bskyod pa las/ / snyan tshig dri bsung phyogs bcur khyab pas shes ldan bung ba'i yid rab 'phrog /tshul 'di mkhyen rab rgya cher rab rgyas kun nas brtse ba'i thugs mnga' ba'i/ / chos kyi rgyal po bzang po'i zhabs kyi zhabs pad spyi bos gus blangs shing / / blo gros rgyal mtshan yon tan nor bu'i dpal gyis mtshan pa legs 'dzin pa/ / theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs bzang pos rnam par 'phags pas sbyar pa yin/ / khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po bla ma bde bar gshegs pa la/ chos gos rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya bas mchod par byed pa'i rab tu bsngags pa/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dge slong chos smra ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ sa mo lug gi lo 4〉gun zla 'bring po la/ rgya nag po'i rgyal po grangs med pa byung pa'i gnas bkra shes dang / dge mtshan du mas rnam par brgyan pa cong to'i mkhar chen podī sbyor ba'o/ / tshul 'di ni rkang ba thung ngu dang / ring po dang / shin tu

ring po rnams spel zhing 'byung bas rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi phreng ba lta bu zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor yin la/ 'di'i don dran bzhin pa'i dbyangs rnam par dag pas brjod cing gzhan dag la'ang bsnyad na/ rgya che ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po nye bar bskrun par 'gyur ro snyam du'ang bsams mod/ / de lta na'ang tshu rol mthong ba'i byis blo'i ngang tshul du gyur pas tshig dang / don gyi cha la 'gal ba dang / 'khrul bar gyur ba de dang de dag legs par sbyangs pa'i thugs shin tu dang (dwangs )pa'i me long ltar gsal bar shes bya'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan kun tu snang ba/ shin tu mkhas pa'i skye bo rnams dang / dam pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid la shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la goms pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes shin tu gzi che ba brnyes pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyi thugs kyis bas par 'gyur ba ni/shin tu gnong ba'i yid kyis bzod par gsol zhing mchis pas/ rigs pa dang rnam par grol ba'i spobs ba rdo rje'i ngag phyin ci ma log pa'i don dang ba/sbya snanā ༵༵sa grub kyang stsal du gsol lo/ /rjomadzi sgo ṣā ya/ legs sbyar gyi skad de/ bod skad du 'jam dbyangs zhes bya la/ mdzi ni 'jam/ sgo ṣā ni dbyangs/ ṣa'i dbyangs a dang / a yu'i a'adra 'dus kyi ring por bsgyur/ yudabyangs med a la drangs pas sgo ṣā ya ste 'jam dbyangs kyi ched du zhes pa'o/ /dusrid dang zhi ba/ srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba myang 'das/()ye shes tshogs/ tshogs gnyis kyi ya gyal 'ig dmigs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs te stong spyad /nga sdugā sems kyi rtsis zin pa'i 'bras bu ye shes chosasku 'thob par byed pa'i zag med duya/ ye bar+sha ta/ sna/sa sam rnam pa kun tu zhesapa'i brda rnying /༷stun tan pha rol phyi/ ṭā bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi ducho nā/shā sna/sdu brdzu 'a/phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang / /sa su

bstan pa'i chu 'phrul lo/ /skye bo phal ba la mi srid pa ston pa ste lusakyi sgo nasanam mkhar 'phur pa dang / me ltar 'bar ba sogs pa ni rdzu 'phrulagyi chu 'phrul zhes bya'o/ /gzhan gyi semasashes pa'i sgo nasanyesadamigasadang legasapa'i yon tan gang yin pa semasadang mthun par ston pa ni kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul te gdams ngag lta bu'o/ /sems kyi rgyud la nyon mongasapa'i shasagang che ba brtags nasa'adod chagasache na ni migatsang ba/ zhe sdang che na ni byams pa/ gti mug che na ni rten cing 'brel ba bsgom pa la sogs te gnyen po gang yin ston pa ni rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /()mi 'jigasabazhi/ spyir bdag gi don phun sum tshogs pa brnyes pa la mi 'jigs pa dang /gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogasapa mdzad pa la mi 'jigasapa gnyisate/ dang po la/ rtogs pa phun tshogasal mi 'jigs pa dang / spangasapa phun tshogasal mi 'jigs pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ bar du gcod pa'i chosabastan pa la mi'ajigasapa dang / ngesapar 'byung ba'i lam ⑧pa/shā ༵ ༵ mi ///rdzu ༵ // pa/ ༵ /rdzu pa/ trī/nga //dusosoyang dag rig pa bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' chos sna tshogasatha dad pa'i mtshan nyid ma nor bar shes pa'i phyogasabazhi ste/ chos so soyang dag par rig pa dang / don so so yang dgapar /ga pa dang /dros pa'i tshig sosoyang dag par rig pa dang / spobs pa sosoyang yo/sna ༵ r+sha wakā pa /ji kāXnā/pa/ dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyisadag pa'am/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang / /bye gyis bye masadag pa gnyis/ de gnyisaldan pa'i dbyings mthar thug ni smyoshār+shasdu n+dha rnyi ma tsho dam gās/ 'a/dir rgya mtsho zhesapa mang po ston pa'i tshig ste bskal pa ha cang yi/tā sbya ༵ /rnyi/sa mtshan/ skyes bu chen po'i bsod nams kyi mthu las grub cing bsod nams dematshon par byed pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis yod de/ 1dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/2dbuskra gyen du 'khyil ba/ 2dpral ba'i dbyes mnyam pa/ 4mdzod spu/ 5spyan mthon mthing ba mchog gi rdzi ma lta bu/ 6tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba/ 7tshems mnyam pa/ /tshems shin tu dkar ba/ 'tshemasathags bzang ba/ 10rdo bro ba'i mchog dang ldan pa/11'gramapa seng ge'i 'dra ba/ 12lngags shin tu ring zhing srab pa/ 12gsung tshangs 42dbyangs lta bu/ 14dpung mgo shin tu zlum pa/ 15sku'i gnas bdun mtho ba/ 16thang

song rgyas pa/ 17pags pa srab cing mdog gser 'dra ba/ 18bzhengs bzhin du ma btud par phyag pus mor slobs pa/ 19ro stod seng ge'i 'dra ba/ 20sku shing nu gro dha ltar chu zheng gab pa/ 21ba spu re re nas skyes shing g.yas su 'khyil ba/ 22sku'i spu gyen du phyogasapa/ 22'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa/ 24brla legs par mdzes shing zlum shing zlum pa/ 25zhabs kyi long bu (long mo'i tshigs )mi mngon pa/ 26phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'jam zhing gzhon sha chagasapa/ 27phyag dang zhabs dra bsa'abrel ba/ 2/sor mo ring ba/ 29phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ 20zhabs shin tu gnas ༵/ /1zhabs kyi mthil ting ba yangasapa/ 22byin pa ri dwagasarje ye'i lta bu ste sum ༷/rdo byed pargyad/ cu// sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste/ 1sen mo zangs kyi mdog lta bu/ 2sen mo'i mdog snum pa/ 2sen mo mtho ba/ 4sor mo rnamasazlum pa/5sor mo byin gyis thob/ 6sor mo rnams rgyas pa/ 7rtsa mi mngon pa/ /rtsa mdud med pa/9longabu mi mngon pa/ 10zhabasami mnyam med pa/ 11seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa/12glang po che'i stabs su gshegs pa/ 12ngang ba'i stabasasu gshegs pa/ 14rgya mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa/ 15g.yas phyogs su ldog cing gshegs pa/ 16mdzes par gshegasapa/ 17mi g.yo bar gshegasapa/ 1/sku 'khril bag chags pa/ 19sku byi dor byasapa lta bu/ 20sku rim par 'tsham pa/ 21sku gtsang ba/ 22sku 'jam pa/ 22sku rnam par dag pa/ 24mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa/ 25sku kho lag yangs shing bzang ba/26gom pa snyomasapa/ 27sku shin tu gzhon mdog can/ 2 sku zhum pa med pa/ 29sku rgyas pa/ 2༷sku shin tu grimasapa/ 21sku yan lag dang nying lag shin tu rnam par 'byed pa/22gzigs pa rab rib med cing rnam par dag pa/ 22dku zlum pa/ 24dku skabasaphyin pa/ 25dku ma snyings pa/ 26phyal phyang nge ba/ 27ltob g.yas phyogs su'akhyil ba/2/lteb zab pa/ 29kun nasamadzes pa/ 40kun tu spyod pa gtsang ba/ 41sku la sme ba dang gnag bag med pa/ 42phyag shing bal ltar shin tu 'jam pa/ 42phyag gi ri mo mdangs yod pa/ 44phyag gi ri mo zab pa/ 45phyag gi ri mo ring ba/ 46zhal ha cang yang mi ring ba/ 47zhal gzigs kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba/ ji ljags mnyen pa/4'jigasasrab pa/ 50lngags dmar ba/ 51glang po che'i nga ro dang 'brug gi sgra dang ldan pa/ 52gsung snyan cing mnyen la 'jam pa/ 42mche ba zlum pa/ 54mche ba rno ba/55mche ba dkar ba/ 56mche ba mnyam pa/ 57mche ba byin gyis phra ba/ dirashadīkā mtho

ba/ 59shangs gtsang ba/ 60spyan rnam par dag pa/ 61spyan yangs pa/ 62dzi ma sdug pa/ 62spyan dkar nag 'byes shing pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i mdangs lta bu/ 65smin tshugasaring ba/ 65smin ma 'jam pa/ 6(smin ma spu mnyam pa/ 6〉smin ma snum pa/ 6〈snyan shal stug cing ring ba/ kyi snyan mnyam pa/ 70snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams pa/ 71dpral ba legs par 'byes pa/ 72dpral ba dbyes che ba/ 72dbu shin tu rgyas pa/ 74dbu skra bung ba ltar nag pa/ 75dbu skra sdug pa/ 76dbu skra 'jam pa/ 77dbu skra ma 'dzingasapa/7/dbu skra mi gshor ba/ 79dbu skra dri zhim pa/ raXphyag dang zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis dang g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa sdong ris 'khyil ba dang bcas brgyad cu'o/(stedamigs med/ dmigs sumed pa ste bden par ma grub pa stong ba nyid/༷lam gyi bden pa/ kun 'byung spong bar nusashing 'gog par thob par nusapa'i 'phags pa rnamasakyi ye shesani lam bden gyi ngo bo yin te/ kun 'byung spong byed kyi gnyen por zag med kyi la/ sgom pa ni zin rdo bu bstan par bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor mi bsru yi/sdu lha/ ༵ /shā /sardor+sha rnyingazhi r+sha sa/ kyi/ bye brag ste rnam pa gling gru bzhir bcad pa'i grwa/(khor dang nga yir 'dzin pa/ dngos po la bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa ste bdag gi ba la dmigs nas rnam pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par 'dzin pa'i 'jig tshogs lta bu'o/ /yi/bang gi stal po/ nor rī yid bzhin dbang rgyal te dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i kyabadri byā mdīkā sdo / /sdu pa /tha' dag pa/ yongs surdzogs pa sogs don du ma la 'jug ste/yiḥ/dri r+shardoX'i hān/ zhing brjid pa mchog tu gyur pa'i lha tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs ste/〈bstod sprin rgya mtsho'i 'grel ba 〉las/ dum bu dum bur chad pa ma yin par yun ring du gragasapa bzhin de /zhin gshegs pa'i gsung yun ring du lhang lhang grags pas na tshangs nyardzus tāḥ rnyisna dṛ byā yasna /sna dīsna/ lag bdun/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi 44 yan lag ste/ de dag ni/ rang bzhin yan lag gnas yan lag /gsum pa nges 'byung

yan lag ste/ /ba'i ba phan yon yan lag yin/ /rnam gsum nyon mongs med yan lag /ces smos te/ byang chub kyi sgra ni chos thams cad stong bar khong du chud pa ste rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de yang chos rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag dang sbyar te/ de ni gtso bo yang byin la /than lag kyang yin no/ / gzhan drug ni de'i grogs su gyur pas na yan yisdu //du/ /sna spyan/ phreng/ ba'i dar ṭīka 〉tu phung bo lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi bcas chos dgu la btags pa'i gang zag la skye dgu zhes gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chosargyan gyis 'dod khams nas shi 'phos te 'dod khams dang gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams su skye ba gsum dang / gzugs dang gzugs med khams gnyis la'ang de ltar sbyar bas dgu la skye dgu zhes pa yin par gsungs la/ 'ga' zhig gis grangs kyi dgu ma yin pas skye rgu zhes ra mgo can yin zer ba sogs bshad tshul mang ngo / /phoyis mo lug gi lo/ rab byung bzhi ba'i sa lug lo ste spyi lo 1259lo yin/bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 〈bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 〉snyan rtsom 'di dang 〈rten 'brel bstod pa'i 〉nang don thad khyad par gang 'dug2 bstod rtsom 'dir thun mong min pa'i khyad chos gang ldan 'dug2 bstod rtsom 'di bod kyi nye ba'i dus rabs bstod rtsom gyi thog ma yin zer na 'grig gam/45

po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/rtsom yig 'di ni rtsom pa pos rtog pa 'char yan gyi klong du ngo mtshar gyi gar stabs ci dgar sgyur ba'i thabs 'phrul la brten nas/ srog chags ngang pa'i rgyal po sogs la sgro btags nas/ phugs bsam gyi lha lam bsnyegs par byed pa'i chos lugs kyi 'tsho ba dngos la gdeng 'jog byas pa'i bcad lhug spel ma'i bcoms sgrung khyad 'phags shig yin/ ciklong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer/rdzogs chen pa'i srol gtod pa po rnying ma'i slob dpon klong chen pa dri med 'od zer ram/ ming gzhan tshul khrims blo gros zhes pa ni/ rab byung drug pa'i sa pho spre'u (spyi lo 1308)lor yab bstan pa srung dang yum 'brog bza' bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su dbus lho g.yo ru gra'i cha stod grong du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga'i steng nas slob gnyer gyi dbu btsugs/ snga gzhug tu kurma pa rang byung rdo rje/ sa skya bdag chen/ rnying ma rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza sogs mkhas grub mang po slob dpon du bston/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyi mdun du dogs bkrol mang du mdzad/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs ma lus pa thugs su /spya de mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas phal mo

che dang / khyad par du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi dpal chu bo ri dang o rgyan yul sogs su zhabs kyis bcags/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ chu stag (spyi lo 1362)lor 〈chos 'byung rin po che'i gter mdzod 〉ces pa phyag rtsom mdzad/dgung lo nga drug pa rab byung drug pa'i chu yos (spyi lo 1363)lor dpal bsam yas mchims phu ru sku gshegs/khong gi gsung chos ni/ khams pa chos grags bzang pos mdzad pa'i 〈kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyi rnam thar mthong ba don ldan 〉zhes pa ltar na/phyi'i gnas thun mong gi skor bstan bcos dgu bcu go lnga/ nang gi gnas rgya cher bshad pa'i bstan bcos chig brgya nyer brgyad/ gsang ba'i gnas de kho na nyid ston pa'i bstan bcos sum cu ste gsung chos nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs par grags/po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam/rgya gar skad du/ po ta la ā na n+ta pā ri/ bod skad du/ po ta la ()kun hā ༵༵༵ ba'i gtam/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag gang sku mchog tu dkar zhing 'dzum pa'i mtshan dpes bumadzes pa'i ri bong 'dzin/ / kun mkhyen ri dwags gzugs brnyan gyis bkra phrin las 'od dkar phreng ba can/ / ma lus 'gro rgyud skye bo'i mkhar khyab gdul bya'i snying mun sel ba'i lha/ / gau rī rin chen mtshan mo'i mig ni dering bdag blo'i kun+dar skyongs/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i steng na 'dzum pa'i sku/ /'gying bcadī stan+da

ltar dkar 'od stong 'phro/ / lha yi lhar gyur mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /yon tan rgyan rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / don zab rgya mtsho'i gling nas legs 'khrungs shing / / snyan tshig me tog mdangs bkra 'phags pa'i ri/ /mthong thos dran pas bde ba ster ba'i gnas/ / shar ri'i rgyal bo gru 'dzin bsngags par bgyi/ /de yang 'di ltar gangs ri'i rgyud/ chu bo lo hi ta dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram/ rang byung gi bde bar gshegs pa'i bzhugs gnas/ sngon gyi sems dpa' chen po dag gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / skye shing stug po'i phreng bas bskor pa'i grong dag skye bo mang pos gang zhing / 'dod rgu'i chogs kyis mngon par 'byor ba'i yul 'khor bzang po dpal gyi bsam yas zhes bya ba yod de/ lhun po'i dulho phyogs gangs ri'i ra ba'i rgyud/ / sngon gyi sems dpa' du ma byon pa'i gnas/ / skye bos gang ba'i grong dang gtsug lag khang / / rang byung thub dbang rgyal po'i mgon dang bcas/ / de dang lho phyogs su ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig na/ rtswa ljang ser gyi myu gus khyab pa'i sa phyogs skye shing sna tshogs kyi ljon pas bskor zhing me tog gi tshal na bung ba snyan par sgrogs pa'i gzhir yid du 'ong ba'i chu pad+ma'i drwa bas khebs par/ ngur ba mang pos glu len cing khrung khrung bde bar rgyu ba'i rdzing bu shin tu nyams dga' ba zhig na/ ngang ba'i rgyal po tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i duchus brlan par byas pa zhig kyang 'dug par gyur to/ /lhag bsam rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa'i bya/ / thos pa'i lus bzang brtson pa'i 'dab gshog can/ / don bzang bdud rtsi'i btung ba rab 'thungs nas/ / nyams dang rtogs pa'i dar dir sgra 'byin mdzes/ /de'i tshe grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni sdig spyod dag gis gang ste chodi zlozhin du spyod pa rnams la 'tshe zhing / rab tu byung ba dag kyang thos pa

dang tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin don du mi gnyer zhing 'dod yon 0gyi rdzing bur 'bab la/ khyim pa rnams kyang ngo tsha dang gna' bo'i gzhung lugs bzang po dag las nyams te/ dkon mchog dang pha ma mi mchod cing ngan g.yo'i rnam par spyod pas gnas pa mthong nas/ skye bo dam pa rnams kyi yid kyang mngon par skyo zhing / tshul bzhin du spyod pa kha cig smre sngags 'byin pa ni/kye ma deng sang phyogs 'dir ni/ / gna' dus bzang po'i nyi ma nub/ / da dus ngan pa'i zla shar bas/ / dam pa'i pad+mo zum pa dang / / mnyam du sdig spyod kun+da rgyas/ / bdud sde'i mun pas khebs pa bzhin/ / rin chen ljon shing sbrul gdug dag gis bkris/ / skye bo dam pa'i mtsho bsil rdzing bu bskams/ / bstan pa'i nyin byed nub ri'i rtser lhung zhing / / legs ldan 'gro ba'i mig kyang ldong la ltos/ / zhes pa'i gtam gleng ba rdzing bur thos te/ngang ba'i rgyal po de yang yid skyo bar gyur pa dang / / nam zhig gi tshe ri bo gangs can nas 'ongs pa'i lha'i bu kha cig chu 'dzin dul ba sna tshogs kyi shing rtar zhugs te/ sil snyan 'khrol zhing glu gar byed bzhin pas spos chu'i rgyun dang me tog gi char 'bebs shing / nam mkha'i lam nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ sprin gyi bzhon pa'i nang na lha tshogs dag / mchod pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'gyed cing / / rol mo sil snyan bstod dbyangs 'brug sgra can/ / grags chen 'di dag gang du bzhud dam kye/ / lha de dag gis smras pa/ shar ri'i dbang po yid 'ong po ta la/ / drang srong spyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang du/ / sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis rab mchod cing / / chos kyi rnga sgra zab mo nyan du 'gro/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ kye dbang po dag gnas de'i yon tan dang bkod pa ji lta bu/ lhas smras pa/ yid 'ong 'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas po ta la/ / mdzes shing nyams dga' drang srong chen po'i gnas/ / sdu/da

pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur du'agro/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ / skyed tshal me tog bung ba 'phur lding zhing / /mtsho bsil rdzing bu tsan+dan nags khrod rnams/ / bya dang ri dwags mang pos rab tu gang / / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ / shar ri rgyal po'i rtse nas nyi shar bas/ / 'jig rten 'od kyi snang ba phyogs bcur 'gyed/ / ma rig mun pa sel ba'i dpal du shar/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ / yangs pa'i 'od dang lhun grub nyi zla'i 'od/ / sna tshogs 'od dang rin chen rgya mtsho'i 'od/ / 'dres dang ma 'dres 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gro/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ / shing dang 'bab chu nam mkha'i khams kun nas/ / sna tshogs chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi 'chad/ / brjod kyis mi lang yon tan rin chen gter/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas de 'dra'o/ / srid mtsho 'dir gnas thar ba ga la yod/ / zhi ba'i tshal du kun nas 'gro 'dod na/ /shar ri gru 'dzin 'jig rten dbang po'i gnas/ / spyan ras gzigs mgon bzhugs der sgom du 'dosabu/ / zhes brjod pa dang / ngang bas smras pa/gnas der 'gro ba'i lam ni gang / lhas smras pa/ gangs ri'i yul gyi shar phyogs na/ / me tog rgyas pa'i skyed mos tshal/ / 'od zer sprin zhes bya ba yod/ / de dbus rgyal sras pho brang ni/ / gangs ri rin chen ldan zhes bya/ /de yi drung nas shar phyogs su/ /chu klung dri med ldan yang 'bab/ / de 'das rgya mtsho'i 'gram zhig na/ /skye bo mang pos gang ba yi/ / grong khyer tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas yod/ / der ni khyed cag ngal sos la/ / shar ri rgyal po'i lam yang dris/ / zhes brjod de shar phyogs logs su song nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /yon tan dga' ba rnams kyi chos tshul ni/ / dam pa rnams la brten nadī /ba tu skye/ / bdud rtsi'i char gyis dbyar gyi pad mtsho bzhin/ / ngang

ba'i rgyal po mchog tu dga' bar gyur/ /de'i tshe ngang ba'i rgyal po de yang 'gro 'dod par gyur nas smras pa/ rdzing bu'i gnas 'di me tog 'bras mang zhing / / yid 'ong ngang ba'i grogs dang ldan na yang / / sna tshogs yul gyi nyes pas rab skyo zhing / / nags kyi yon tan thos nas gzhan du 'gro/ / zhes brjod pa/ ngur ba mang pos smras pa/pad+ma'i mtsho na bya tshogs sgra 'byin zhing / / ge sar gsar bas rkang drug myos pa'i tshal/ / bsil bu'i rdzing bu 'di dag lhan cig tu/ / bdag cag btang nas 'dab bzang gang du bzhud/ / ngang bas smras pa/ gling gi snying po 'dzam gling shar gyi phyogs/ /ri bo ta la legs par brgyan pa ste/ / sman shing me tog ljon pa'i phreng bas dkrigs/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ / nam yang bde med 'khor ba dug sbrul gling / / las dang nyon mongs dubargyas gtses grong khyer las/ / zhi ba rin chen gling 'gro thar ba'i gnas/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ / chags dang 'jungs dudang ser snas ma bsags pas/ / 'gro kun 'ga' ba'i nor ni bdag la med/ / chog shes 'phags pa'i nor dang ldan pa yis/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ / mdza' dang mi mdza' de bzhin bdag gi lus/ / lhan cig 'dus kyang so sor 'gyes chos can/ /mi rtag (kyesnying po med pa'i tshul mthong nas/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ / thugs rje gangs ri'i ngos la nyi shar bas/ / rmad byung byin rlabs chu rgyun bsil ba 'bab/ / 'gro blo gdung ba'i me tshogs zhi mdzad pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs der sgom du 'gro/ / zhes brjod pa dang / bya'i tshogs de dag gdung ba'i smre sngags 'byin zhing / me tog la sogs pas mchod de bskor pa byas nas ngang ba'i rgyal po de'i zhabs drung na 'khod de/ kye 'dab bzang bdag cag rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bduswā /'i

dga' ston mchog tu gyur pa dag ston cig ces brjod pa dang / ngang bas smras pa/ grogs dag tshe ni ston ku'i sprin ltar g.yo/ / bsags pa 'dzad cing 'dus pa rnams kyang 'bral/ / 'byor ba rgud cing mi rtag snying po med/ /'gro ba 'di dag mtha' bzhi'i (snos can du/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ / las dang nyon mongs chu klung bzlog dka' zhing / / sdug bsngal rba rlabs shugs drag bzod par dka'/ / e ma thar dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ / de ring nyid nas brgal phyir brtson par bya/ / byis pa rnams ni sbrul dug khrod 'dra zhing / / 'dod yon rnams ni lan tshwa'i chu dang mtshungs/ / mdor na 'khor ba'i nyes pa sna tshogs dag / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ /deng nas zhi ba'i yon tan dran bya zhing / / dben pa'i gnas su byang chub sems bskyed nas/ / yangs pa'i stan la bde ba'i lus bsrangs te/ / sems kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin gnyug ma'i don/ / rang bzhin spros dang bral ba'i (tong la zhog / rjes la 'khor gsum (togapa'i bsngo ba bya/ /stong ba'i 'dab stong snying rje'i snying ba can/ / sangs rgyas pad+ma myur du 'byon par nges/ / zhes brjod de rdzing bu'i gnas de nas song ba na/ngur ba'i tshogs mang po de dag gis shar phyogs su gangs ri'i ra ba mthong ba'i ngos sman shing sna tshogs kyi ljon pas dkrigs pa zhig tu bskyal te/ dad pas (3khyag 'tshal zhing gdung ba'i smre sngags 'byin pa/ kye ma grogs dag mi rtag 'gyes chos can/ /so sor 'bral ba'i chos nyid 'di lta bu/ / de ring bdag cag rnams la mngon sum gyur/ / ngang ba'i rgyal po gcan du bzhud la nye/ /pad+ma med par pad+ma'i mtsho bzhin du/ / de ring bdag cag rje dpon bral bas skyo/ / nang gi tha ma phyi phyag 'tshal ba'i dus/ / slan chad khyod zhal mthong ba shinā snro dkon/ / ces zer zhing mngon par mi dga' bzhin du ngur ba de dag

phyir log go/ /snga nas 'dus kyang so sor 'bral ba'i chos/ / 'khor ba'i rang bzhin yin te phan pa med/ / gang la 'bral med bde chen rin chen gling / /zhi ba'i tshal du 'gro ba yong re ran/ /de nas ngang ba'i rgyal po de yang rang gi nye 'khor ba bzhin bzang dang lhan cig shar phyogs logs su song ba las/ skyed mos tshal mthing ga nor bu'i 'od ltar 'tsher ba'i nang na ri mchog tu dkar ba zla ba 'char ku'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i drung nas shar phyogs su chu klung dkar po dal gyis 'bab pa mthong ste bzhin bzang gis zhe sa dang bcas dris pa/ rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bur 'tsher ba'i nags/ / yid 'ong nang na rab dkar sa 'dzin zhig / dwangs pa'i sbyi klung dag dang mnyam du 'gran/ / mdzes pa 'di dag ci zhig lags sam nga/ nga/ ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ 'od zer ldan gyi nags tshal mdzes pa'i nang / /chu klung dri med ldan yang 'tsher zhing 'bab/ / phal cher 'jig rten dbang po'i pho brang mchog / gangs ri rin chen ldan de yin pa snyam/ / zhes brjod de song ba las/ nags tshal 'od zer ldan pa yid du 'ong ba'i shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis 'khrigs shing / phu chu bsil ba'i rgyun lhung sgra dang bcas pa kha du ma nas 'bab pa/ nags kyi mthongs rnams nor bu an+da rnyil gyi kha dog 'tsher zhing ut+pala'i drwa bas khebs pa'i rdzing bu me tog sna tshogs pas gang bar bya dang ri dwags du ma rgyu zhing bung ba ling ling du gyur pa zhig tu phyin te bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ zhi ba'i nags 'dabs dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ / bsam gtan (r+sād pa dag gis skyed mos tshal/ / phug dang brag ri chu bsil rdzing bus gang / / me tog 'bras mang sman shing ljon pas dkrigs/ / phu chu'i rgyun dag lhung sgra snyan sgrogs shing / / yid 'ong bya rdo/sa

mang po bde bar rgyu/ / rkang drug ldan rnams snyan pa'i glu len zhing / / dus rlung bsel bus me tog gsal bar 'grims/ / 'gying mdzes lding ba sprin gyi phung bo yang / / phyogs 'dir dad pa'i glog phreng gar byed cing / / bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i 'brug sgra sgrogs pa dang / / mnyam du mchod pa'i char zil bsil ba 'bebs/ / de 'dra'i gnas 'di nags tshal 'od zer ldan/ / lha dang drang srong mang pos bsten pa ste/ / rang byung 'jig rten dbang po'i (7skyed mos tshal/ /sna tshogs bkod pa'i 'od zer 'gyed la ltos/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ ri ngogs yangs pa'i ljon shing rnams ni dga' bas bro gar byed pa bzhin/ / shang shang (1spon ljongs me tog rnams ni 'dzum pa'i mdangs rab gsal ba bzhin/ / 'khri shing khrod kyi bya tshogs rnams ni snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs len pa bzhin/ / chu rgyun gtsang ma'i na chung rnams ni lbu phreng do shal 'dzin pa bzhin/ / tsan+dan bsil ba'i kha yi sbubs bskyod snyan drung bung ba 'phur lding zhing / / nor bu'i do shal sked ngos la reg 'bras bu'i chun 'phyang 'dzin ma'i tshogs/ / lo 'dab gsal ba'i stod g.yogs dang bcas yal ga'i lag rtsed dud pa yis/ / me tog phreng ba'i g.yab mos 'debs shing de ring bdag cag bsu ba 'dra/ / khu byug myos pa'i gdangs snyan rnams ni dri za'i rgyud mang sbreng ba bzhin/ / chur nyal 'dzum pa'i na chung rnams ni bung ba'i gling bu sgyur ba bzhin/ / chu gtsang pad+mas khebs pa rnams ni dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa bzhin/ / sngo zhing snum pa'i nags khrod rnams ni lcug phran bro gar byed pa bzhin/ / zhes brjod de mthar gyis ()slong ba las/ gangs ri rin chen ldan zla ba chu shel gyis mdzes pa'i ngos la 'jig rten dbang po'i sku rang byon yod pa/ tsan+dan sna tshokāswā kyi ljon pas dkrigs pa'i drung nas bskor pa/ phyogs su chu klung dri med

ldan shar gyi rgya mtshor 'bab pa mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis dris pa/ yid 'ong gangs ri'i tshal na 'dzum pa'i sku/ / dkar gsal 'od kyi drwa ba phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /ston ga'i sprin dkar nang na zla gzugs bzhin/ / mdzes pa 'di 'dra gang gi sku yin nam/ /ngang pa'i rgyal pos smras pa/ gangs ri'i drung na lhun gyis grub pa'i sku/ /'dzum mdzes bzhengs shing 'od stong 'gyed pa ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal sras thugs rje can/ / 'gro ba'i don la phyogs 'dir byon pa snyam/ /zhes brjod de drung du song nas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog sna tshogs dang spos dri zhim pas mchod nas ngang ba'i rgyal pos bstod pa/ gangs ri'i mgul na 'dzum mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ / mi g.yo mi gsung spros dang bral ba ni/ / chos nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa ()bzhin/ / mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo /bzhin bzang gis bstod pa/ gangs ri pad+ma'i drung na mdzes pa'i sku/ /zla ba kun+da'i mdangs 'dra phyag g.yas las/ / yi dwags bkres skom zhi mdzad 'o rgyun 'bebs/ / btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod de skyed mos tshal de las kyang 'das nas shar phyogs logs su song song ba las rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang nye zhing thang dang shang shong dzosten tu rgya che ba/snga dro'i tshe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang rgya mtsho'i nang nas 'char ba snyam byed cing / phyi dro'i dus su sa'i 'og tu nub pa 'dra ba/ phyogs rnams ni smig rgyu 'gyu ba'i gos dang dri za'i grong gis brgyan cing / rkang gis 'gro ba'i mgron po shugs 'byin pa'i sa phyogs mya ngam gyi dgon pa rkyunyan tu bgrod dka' ba zhig la nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba na/ bzhin bzang rab tu skyo bas nam mkha'i ngos su blta zhing smre sngags 'don pa/ phyogs rnams smig rgyu g.yo bas gar bsgyur zhing / /nyi ma rgya mtsho'i nang nas sa 'og nub/ /dri za'i groX snang

phyi phyir bsnyegs pa bzhin/ / mya ngam thang las skyobs shig spyan ras gzigs/ / zhes brjod pa na/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ kye bzhin bzang /'dir de tsam du bgrod dka' zhing skyo ba'ang ma yin gyi/ cung zad spro srings shig ces brjod nas yang smras pa/ srid pa'i mya ngam dgon pa bgrod dka' zhing / / sdug bsngal smig rgyu 'du byed dri za'i grong / /las dang nyon mongs nyi zla mdangs bkra'i gnas/ / bzod dka' bzod na 'di dag cis mi bzod/ / rgya mtshor mi 'ga' 'tsho ba tsam gyi phyir/ / sdug bsngal brgya phrag mang po'ang bzod byed na/ / rin chen chos phyir cung zad ngal ba yi/ /dman pa'i sdug bsngal ci phyir bzod mi byed/ / sngon chad mnar med la sogs gnas rnams su/ / don med phyir yang sdug bsngal bzod byed na/ /rang gzhan don chen 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ / dman pa'i sdug bsngal dga' bas bzod par bya/ / 'on kyang bden pa'i stobs kyi byin rlabs dang / / bdag gi legs smon sngon sbyangs bsod nams stobs/ / de dag mthu yis yid 'ong nyams dga'i gnas/ / mtsho dang rdzing bus brgyan pa mthong bar shog / ces brjod ma thag tu de nas kyang zla ba phyed kyis bgrod dgo~X pa'i mya ngam gyi dgon pa de nyid snga dro tsam gyis legs par bgrod par gyur skye/ bo/ dam pa'i mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ / legs smon bsod nams stobs kyang bsam mi khyab/ / mchog la bsten pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ / dge dang mi dge'i rnam smin bsam mi khyab/ /de ltar bgrod pa'i shar phyogs na yid du 'ong ba'i gnas skye shing sna tshogs kyi ra bas bskor pa'i dbus na grong 4〉nga gtsug lag khang mang po phyed tsam gsal ba dag mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ 'khri shing ra bas bsdidī pa yi/ / grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni/ / phyed tsam 'dzum pas

blta ba bzhin/ / mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci zhig kye/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ skye shing phreng bas bskor pa'i grong khyer dbus/ / gzhal med khang mthong yid 'ong mdzes pa ni/ / nor bu'i chun 'phyang gser gyi drwa bas g.yogs/ / grong khyer tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas yin nam snyam/ / zhes brjod de mthar gyis de'i nye 'khor du phyin pa na/ tsan+dan 'khri shing gis bskor ba'i 'obs chus yongs su gang bar me tog sna tshogs kyis khebs shing / chu bya sna tshogs pa rtse zhing lding ba mthong nas bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ me tog 'dzum pa'i na chung dag / mdzes pa'i bya dang lhan cig tu/ / rdzing bu'i nang na gsar du rgyas/ / 'di ni lha yi pad mtsho'am ci/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ 'obs kyi chu rlabs g.yo ba dag / 'khri shing gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa yi/ / lbu ba sbreng ba'i lo 'dab rgyas/ / dpag bsam rnams la 'gongs pa bzhin/ / zhes brjod de grong khyer gyi gzhir song ba na/ skye bo mang pos gang ba'i grong dang gtsug lag khang de dag rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang nye ba'i phyir dgun gyi dus su nyi ma'i 'od zer ha cang mi tsha zhing /zla ba'i 'od zer chu'i mdangs dang 'dres pa tsan+dan sa mchog gi tshal ltar shin tu bsil la/ sos ka dang / dbyar dang / ston rnams ni zla ba'i 'od zer mchog tu mi bsil zhing / nyi ma'i 'od zer rgya mtshor lhung ba'i stobs kyis nor bu me shel dwangs pa'i phung po nye bar gnas pa bzhin du rab tu tsha zhing /phal cher rmugs pa'i do shal dang mtsho rlangs 'khyil ba'i khrod nas chu'i zegs ma phra mo dag char zims bu ltar 'bab cing sbrang ma'i sgra skad sna tshogs su grags pa de'i phyir/ sbrang skyabs dang / bsil khang dang / 'phyang khang dang /phyed pheb dang / skar khung drwa ba can dang / smyug ma'i bsil khang la sogs la bkod pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing tshong 'dus dang bzhi mdo rnams su rin po che dang / sman dang / kha zas dang / bzhon pa dang / gos sna tshogadī ltos

bkram pa'i tshogs khang yid du 'ong bar skye bo mang pos gang zhing / srang dang sum mdo rnams su yul dang phyogs tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i mgron po du ma lang long du gyur cing / gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang bsam gtan spyod pa'i rab tu byung ba mang pos gang bar mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis smras pa/yid 'ong grogs dag 'dod rgyas rab 'byor cing / / phyogs kyi skye bo mang po nye bar 'dud/ / gtsug lag khang rnams mchod pa'i sprin 'phro zhing / / bsam gtan spyod pa dag gi skye bos gang / / zhes brjod de song ba las/ grong khyer de'i shar phyogs na yid du 'ong ba'i mtsho me tog brgyan pa zhes bya ba ha ri tsan+dan 4sto sogs pa'i ljon shing sna tshogs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i dbus/ pad+ma dang / ut+pal dang / ku mu ta la sogs pa me tog rnam pa du ma'i drwa ba'i khebs pa'i mtsho/ bzhan dang ngur ba sgra 'byin pa zhig tu phyin te/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ me tog drwa bas legs par 'dzum pa'i mtshor/ / gnyis skyes 4〉ga' ba'i sgra snyan sgrogs pa ni/ / yid 'ong 'dod lha'i rdzing bu 'phos pa bzhin/ /zhi ba'i gnas 'dir bdag cag 'dug par 'os/ /zhes brjod de 'khri shing rwa ba'i mtshor zhugs pa dang / de na gnas pa'i bya sna tshogs pa dag rab tu dga' bas bsu zhing bstod de smras pa/ pad+ma'i mtsho las ma byung zhing / /nyi zer gsal bas ma phyes kyang / / bzhin gyi chu skyes dpal dang ldan// mdzes pa khyed cag gang nas lhags/ /ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ yid 'ong gnas ni yon tan mtha' yas shing / / dpal rgyas pad+ma'i 'byung gnas mtsho chen bzhin/ / gangs ri'i ze bas legs par bskor pa nas/ / zhi ba'i gnas 'dir bdag cag lhags par gyu/ da/ ga/ gis smras pa/ kye bzang po gnas de'i yon tan ji lta bu/ ngang baX /la pos smras pa/ gangs ri'i yul ni 'phags pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /

yid 'ong grong dang gtsug lag khang rnams ni/ / mkhas pa'i skye bo mang pos rab tu gang / / bstan pa'i nyi 'od rgya cher 'phro ba yin/ / zhes pa brjod de yang dris pa/ 'jig rten dbang po bzhugs pa'i ri/ / yid 'ong me tog brgyan pa yi/ / lam ni gang yin ji tsam zhig / de ring gsal bar rab tu ston/ / de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis ni shes par dka' ste/ 'on kyang gtsug lag khang 'di na dge slong chos smra ba skye bo cha/nga po'i slob dpon du gyur pa zhig mchis kyi der dris shig dang khyed cag la phan pa nye bar ston par 'gyur ro/ /des kyang legs so zhes smras te gtsug lag khang der song ba na/ dge slong ba bslab pa gsum dang mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug cing /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i zhal mthong ba zhig mchis pa de'i zhabs drung du song ste dad pas phyag 'tshal nas smras pa/ gang gis 'ching rnams rab bcad de/ / 'gro ba byang chub lam 'dren pa'i/ / rgyal sras thugs rje can gyi zhing / / gru 'dzin lam ni bstan du gsol/ /dge slong des smras pa/ khyed cag gang nas lhags/ zhes smras pa/ ri bo gangs can nas so/ /dge slong gis smras pa/ kye bzhin bzang dag skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi lam nyid ni 'di nas shar phyogs logs na yod de/ yi ge zhib mo la brten nas rtogs mod kyi bgrod par dka'o/ / khyed cag ni lhag par yang skal ba dang ldan te/ 'di ltar lo bcu gnyis nas shar gyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram ku mu ta rgyas pa'i gling du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po klu rnams la chos ston pa'i phyir 'byung bar gsungs na sngar ni lo bcu zhig thal te ring por mi thogs par khyed cag dang mjal bar nges so/ /ngang bas smras pa/ de tsam du 'dug par mi spro na thabs gzhan stso| 9zhig

dge slong gis smras pa/ de lta na zla ba phyed kyi bar du sdod cig dang 'dir po ta la'i yul nas ngang ba zhig chos nyan pa'i slad du mchi ste de dang lhan cig song zhig des kyang legs so zhes bstod de zla ba phyed du nyin mo dge slong chos smra ba de las 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga dang / a mo bha pā sha'i rgyud la sogs pa chos zab mo rnams nyan zhing mtshan mo me tog brgyan par gnas bcas te 'dug go/ /dam pa gangs ri'i drung na ngang ba dag / yid 'ong thos pa'i chu rgyun gnyer ba ni/ / pad+ma'i rdzing bu nyid du rab 'khrul nas/ / don zab sprang rtsi'i snying po 'thung ba bzhin/ /de nas zla ba phyed kyi nyin mo tshes bco lnga'i nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba'i shar phyogs nas ngang ba'i dbang po zhig me tog dang 'bras bu'i tshogs mang po khyer tegatsug lag khang dang dge slong chos smra ba de la mchod cing bstod dbyangs dag sgrog par byed do/ /dwangs pa'i mkha' la rgyal sras dag pa'i bya/ / thabs dang shes rab gshog gnyis rab brkyangs te/ / bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i dar dir sgra 'byin zhing / / me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis mchod cing lhags/ /de'i tshe dge slong chos smra ba des kyang 'phags pa zla ba dri ma med pa'i mdo la sogs pa zab mo'i chos mang du bshad de smras pa/ yid 'ong gangs ri'i 'gram nas 'ongs pa'i bya/ / dad dang brtson pa'i gshog yangs ldan pa zhig / spyan rasagazigs dbang drung du gus pas 'gro/ / bzang po khyod kyis de yi lam mkhan mdzod/ / ces brjod pa dang / des kyang de bzhin du bgyi'o zhes smras te/ mtsho me tog brgyan pa'i 'gram du 'ongs nas smras pa/ gangs ri pad+ma'i mtsho nas 'ongs pa'i bya/ / rab dkar dge ba'i shugs kyis bskyod pa dag /gswā sdu'i lus kyi 'dab gshog rab bskyod la/ / tshur shog 'jig rten dbang

po'i drung du 'dong / / zhes pa'i tshig 'dis bskul pa dang / ngang ba'i rgyal pos mchog tu dga' bas smras pa/ legs so dwangs pa'i mkha' la mdzes pa'i bya/ / yid 'ong mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gangs ri zhig / mkha' la 'ong na de dang mtshungs pa bzhin/ / khyod dang lhan cig gru 'dzin blta bar bgyi/ /zhes brjod nas me tog la sogs pas dge slong chos smra ba de mchod de phyag 'tshal nas rang gi 'khor dang lhan cig tu po ta la'i ngang bas lam mkhan byas nas shar phyogs logs su song ngo /de dang mnyam du me tog brgyan pa'i mtsho/ / yid 'ong nang gnas ngang ba lnga brgya yang / / dngas pa'i mkha' la gshog pa rab brkyangs nas/ / shar ri rgyal po'i drung du snyegs la brtson/ /de ltar ngang ba'i tshogs dag song ba las nyin zhag 'ga' tsam na/ shar gyi rgya mtsho'i nang / yid du 'ong ba'i mtsho pad+mas khebs shing / rin po che sna tshogs kyi gling be+eḍūr+ya'i phye ma brdal ba/ tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po'i tshal mthing gar 'khrigs pa zhig na/ nor bu an+d+ra rnyil gyi rang bzhin nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog ltar sngo ba'i khang bzang zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ut+pal mthing ga 'khyil ba 'dra ba las/ / nor bu'i gzhal med khang mthon 'od kyis mdzes/ / ge sar drwa bas g.yogs pa'i skyed mos tshal/ / mdzes par gsal ba ci zhig lags sam kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po nor rgyas kyi pho brang me tog rgyas pa can yin te rin po che sna tshogs kyis kun tu gang ngo/ /bzhin bzang gis smras pa/ kye bzang po bdag cag 'gro ba'i gnas spyar ni ji tsam zhig na yod/ lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ da dung shin tu ring de nas nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song song ba na/ rin po che'i ri mardo/ tu

dkar ba gangs ri'i rgyal po (o ba'i 'od kyis 'tsher ba lta bu zhig mthong ste ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ nor bu chu shel 'tsher ba'i lhun po la/ / nyin byed 'od kyi drwa bas g.yogs pa bzhin/ / chu srin 'dzin khri'i phoyinanas na mdzes pa'i ri/ /ring nas gsal ba 'di 'dra ci yin kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po pad+ma'i pho brang sprin gyi snying po yin te nor bu 'od kyi snye ma dang ke ke ru rkyu7)ga mang ngo / /de las kyang 'das te nyin bzhag 'ga' tsam song ba las/ ri mchog tu dmar ba rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis gnyer bas res 'ga' chu'i gting du nub pa snyam byed pa zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ chu gter zab mo'i nang na mdzes pa'i ri/ /nor bu pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing / / dus rlabs g.yo bas rtsed 'jo bgyid pa bzhin/ / mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci zhig lags sam kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po mtha' yas kyi pho brang 'od kyi drwa ba yin te nor bu spug dang mu sa ra gan+dha dag mang ngo/ /de las kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba na ri bo mchog tu ser ba kur gum gzhon nu'i mdog 'dra ba zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ gser ri 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes pa la/ /in+d+ra nī la'i stod g.yogs 'dzin pa bzhin/ / mthing ga rgya mtsho'i chu rlabs gos gyon pa'i/ / mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci zhig lags sam kye/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po (ཿ tram̐/ rdor+sha zlo ngabra zlo / gser gyi drwa ba can yin te nor bu mthon ka dang chu de dag kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba na/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi gling nor bu be+eḍūd+ma'i bye ma brdal ba/ tsan+dan sna tshogs kyi skyed mos tshal na dbyar gyi ut+pal rab tu rgyas pa lta bu'i ri ljang gur snang ba zhig mthong ste/65nga ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bur mdzes pa'i ri/ /

ljang gur 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'gyed pa ni/ / tsan+dan ljon pa'i tshogs dang 'gran pa bzhin/ /ring na gnas pa 'di 'dra ci zhig kye/ / lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni klu'i dbang po rgya mtsho'i pho brang rin chen snying po yin te nor bu 'od kyi drwa ba dang pad+ma'i snying po dag shin tu mang ngo / /de nas kyang 'das te nyin zhag 'ga' tsam song ba'i mtshams na/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes shing / tsan+dan sa mchog gi tshal mthing gar 'khrigs pa/ gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i gling nor bu sna tshogs kyis bkram zhing rgya mtsho'i mdog kyang ljang gur 'tsher ba zhig mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ dwangs pa'i mtsho na ri chen snying po'i ri/ tsan+dan ljon pa'i phreng bas bskor pa ni/ / mthing gar 'tsher ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ / nor bu'i gling na mdzes pa ci zhig kye/ / lam mkhan gyis smras pa/'di ni klu'i dbang po gtsug na rin chen gyi pho brang 'od kyi snying po yin te/'dzam bu'i gling na yod pa'i rin po che'i rigs thams cad dang / khyad par nor bu mthon ka chen po dang / be+eḍūrla dang / pad+ma'i drwa ba dang / nyi zla'i 'od dang / sprin gyi snying po dang / mching bu dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu bsam 'phel rnams kyis kun tu gang ngo / /de ltar ngang ba'i tshogs dag ri bo che'i ri dang / gling dang mtsho'i bye brag sna tshogs pa gzhan dang gzhan dag las kyang 'das te/ pos ku'i dus zla ba gsum gyi bar nyin re bzhin dngas pa'i mkha' la 'gro zhing mtshan mo rin po che dang pad+ma dang nor bu'i mtshor gnas bcas te/ 'jig rten dbang po yid la byed cing shar phyogs logs su snyegs pa la brtson par gyur to/ /nyin bzhin dwangs pa'i mkha' la mdzes pa'i bya/ / gdangs snyan ngang pa'i ca co 'phel ba ni/ / pad+mo'i mtsho gling nyid du rab 'khrul nas/ / 'od steng ldan pa dag kyang nyi 'od 'gyed/ / mtshan mo chu gling ngang bas b.rī/ pa

dag /dri zhim kun+da'i tshal du rab 'khrul nas/ / skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor pa'i ri bong 'dzin/ / bsil ba'i 'od zer drwa ba 'gyed la ltos/ /de nas gling de dag las 'das pa'i shar phyogs na/ tsan+dan sna tshogs ljon pas dkrigs pa'i gling sngo zhing snum snum ltar 'dug pa'i dbus na/ ri mchog tu dkar ba zla ba 'char ka ltar mdzes pa'i steng na rin po che'i khang bas brgyan pa/ rgya mtsho'i mdog kyang nor bu 'od kyi snye ma ltar dkar zhing 'tsher ba dag mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ gangs can ri ni rin chen 'od 'phro zhing / / khang brtsegs nor bu'i drwa bas g.yogs pa bzhin/ /tsan+dan nags 'khrigs 'o ma'i chu gter nang / / kun nas mdzes pa 'di 'dra ci yin nam/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni 'phags ma gi rī'i 4)lo brang rgya mtsho'i sprin yin te/ lha dang grub pa dang rig sngags 'chang rnams kyis nye bar brten pa'o zhes brjod de/ / gling der song ba las rin po che'i shing ljon pa nor bu'i drwa bas dpyangs pa 'bum phrag du mas dkrigs pa'i bar bar na lha dang drang srong du ma rab tu rgyu zhing pad+ma'i mtsho las bung ba snyan par sgrogs pa'i glu dang ser bur ngad kyis bsu ba zhim po dal bus ldang ba la bsams te/ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ rin chen ljon shing du ma'i nags khrod na/ / lha dang drang srong mang pos rab tu gang / / dus rlung sel bu'i ngad kyis g.yo ba yi/ /me tog char ba lding zhing 'bab la ltos/ / bzhin bzang gis smras pa/'od 'phro pad+ma'i sprin gyi khang bzang na/ / sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa 'khog gis glu len zhing / /nyi zer gsal bar 'dzin pa'i na chung dag / phan tshun g.yo bas bro gar byed pa bzhin/ /de nas nags khrod dag kun tu rgyu zhing song ba las/ mthar gyis rin po che swā /gas kyi ri'i rtse mor gangs ri'i stod g.yogs ltar dkar ba'i steng na

khang bu brtsegs pa mthong ste/ lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ sna tshogs rin chen snying pos brgyan pa'i ri/ / rol pa'i sprin gyis stod g.yogs 'dzin pa bzhin/ / gau rī rin chen pad+ma'i khang bzang du/ / grogs dag tshur shog dga' bas 'dong bas gyis/ / zhes brjod de/ ri de'i rtse mor 'dzegs te phyin pa na 'phags ma gau rī'i pho brang nor bu 'od zer sprin gyi khang ba'i sgo drung na klu'i bu mo mang po rin po che'i srad bu 'khal zhing glu len pa dag mthong nas/lam mkhan gyis de dag la smras pa/ kye gzhon nu dag 'dzam bu'i gling nas lhags pa'i ngang ba dag 'phags ma blta zhing chos nyan pa'i slad du mchis so zhes sbyon cig de nas klu'i bu mo gcig song ste 'phags ma la bsnyad pas/des kyang rjes su gnang nas bu mo de phyir byung ste ngang ba de dag la nang du 'jug pa'i brda byas so/ /de nas gzhal med khang gi nang du song ba las rin po che'i khri la 'phags ma gi rī mchog tu dkar zhing 'dzum pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba'i sku dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas legs par brgyan pa mi'am ci dang klu dang lha ma yin gyi bu mo 'bum phrag du mas bskor te pi wang sbreng ba mthong nas drung du phyin te/ ngang bas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos bstod pa/ shin tu mi g.yo spros kun bral ba'i lha/ / 'dod (gdod )nas zhi zhing rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ / bsam med brjod bral go rī chos kyi sku/ / rgyal ba'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhin bzang gis/ gangs ri'i ngos la zhi ba'i char sprin bzhin/ shin tu yid 'ong bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ / go rī rin chen mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ gti mug 4)pun bral mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam mkhan gyis bstod pa/ thugs rje zhi ba bsil ba'i rdzing bu las/ /rmad byung byin rlabs chu rgyun bzang po 'bab/ / 'gro ba'i nyon mong61 me

tshogs zhi mdzad pa/ / kun mkhyen ye shes brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes brjod de zhabs kyi drung du 'khod pa na/ 'phags ma gi rīs de dag gi bsam pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos gsungs pa/ dngos kun mi rtag 4)dang bzhin snying po med/ /gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla 'dra zhing / /lbu ba rdos 'dra chushing 4(nga po bzhin/ /rang bzhin med la sna tshogs snang ba'i chos de dngos kyis stong gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ /'gro ba 'khrul ba mi lam sgyu 'dra'i tshogs/ /zhi ba'i tshal du bdag gis drang bya zhes/ / byams pa'i rang bzhin snying rje'i chus brlan la/ /byang chub sems nyid brtan por gzung bar bya/ /de bzhin nyid dang rgyu dang kun tu snang / / yon tan gzigs pa rnams kyi spyod yul te/ / yul dang sems bral rang bzhin gdod ma'i ngang / / sems nyid rgyal po dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ / gcig dang tha dad 47thul ba'i chos nyid la/ /bltar med bsam yul bral ba'i tshul gyis bzhag / gang gang mthong ba rang bzhin gnyug ma'i grogs/ / me dang shing ltar mkhas pas rtogs par bya/ /bde dang sdug bsngal bar ma'i dngos kun la/ /sna tshogs las dang byang chub sems nyid dang / /chos nyid grogs te gnyen po gsum dag gis/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin thar ba'i lam du bsgyur/ /'di ni chos kun snying po'i bcud phyung bas/ / sangs rgyas pad+ma myur du bskrun par byed/ / ces gsungs ma thag tu ngang ba'i tshogs de dag gis chos kyi rgyun zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /skye bo dam pa rnams dang 'phrad pa dag/ / sna tshogs yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur te/ / gzungs 'grosgobs chos kyi mdzod la mnga' brnyes nas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha mthar mchog tu 'gro/ /66denas bya'i tshogs de dag gis 'phags ma gi rī las rjes su bstan pa

thob nas/ lan brgya stong du mar phyag 'tshal zhing g.yas phyogs nas bskor pa byas te me tog la sogs pas mchod nas phyir byung ste/ gling de dag las kyang 'das nas zla ba phyed kyi bar du song song ba'i shar phyogs nas rgya mtsho'i nang gi nor bu'i bye brag gis steng gi chu'i kha dog kyang sna tshogs su bsgyur zhing /rin po che'i shing ljon pa 'bum phrag du ma'i kha dog gsal ba'i dbus na/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i ri mchog tu dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i ngos la skyed mos tshal mthing ga 'khrigs shing steng na lha'i gzhal med khang 'od kyi drwa bas mdzes pa mthong ste/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ rin chen rgya mtsho'i nang na mdzes ma'i ri/ /rtse mo dkar gsal 'od kyi khang bas mdzes/ / ngos rnams nor bu an+da rnyil ltar sngo/ /yid 'ong 'di 'dra ci zhig lags sam kye/ / lam mkhan gyis zhe sa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te smras pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs gnas po ta la/ / me tog brgyan pa'i pho brang chen po ste/ / bdag cag rnams kyang gus pa'i sems btud la/ / dad pa'i 'dab gshog g.yo ba'i phyag 'tshol cig / ces brjod ma thag tu thams cad kyang so so nas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs par byed do/ /lhag par dad pa'i gshog gnyis thal sbyar te/ /'jig rten dbang bo'i drung du phyag 'tshal ba/ / bung ba'i gling bus bsgyur ba'i pad+ma dag / bser bus bskyod pa'i bro gar byed pa 'dra/ /de nas mthar gyis song ba na ri de'i chu mtshams rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis gnyer ba'i phug cig mthong nas/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos dris pa/ nyer nyer lbu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ / chil chil rlabs kyis bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho dag/yang yang brag ri'i phug 'dir snyegs la brtson/ / kye kye phyogs 'dir ci zhig bzhugs pa lags/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'di ni rang byung dbang po'i phug rdi/ te/

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rang byon pa dag bzhugs kyi bdag cag dad pas phyag 'tshal du 'dong ngo / / zhes brjod de song ba las/ rin po che'i phug yangs shing nyams dga' ba'i nang brag ri'i ngos la so so'i snang ba dang mthun par gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i sku rgya mtsho'i rlabs phyir sdud pa'i tshe snang zhing nang du 'jug pa'i tshe mi snang ba zhig mthong nas kha cig gis smras pa/ rin chen phug yangs dag gi brag ri'i ngos/ / rang byung 'jig rten dbang po shar ba la/ / rgya mtsho'i chu yang dag pas phyag 'tshal zhing / / dul ba'i lus kyis khrus gtsang gsol ba bzhin/ /kha cig gis smras pa/ / shar ri rin chen 'jig rten dbang po'i phug /rang byung rgyal ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ / dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas ma bzod de/ / klu mchog rnams kyi gnas kyang bskyod pa bzhin/ / zhes brjod de me tog la sogs mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba na/ / kha cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcu gcig zhal phyag stong bar mthong nas bstod pa/ mdzes sku pad+ma'i steng na pad+ma bzhin/ / 'dab stong rgyas pa'i phyag stong mdzes pa la/ / spyan stong mnga' ba mgon po bcu gcig zhal/ / zla ba dri med 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha cig cig gis phyag bzhi bar mthong ste bstod pa/ yid 'ong gangs ri lta bur mdzes pa'i sku/ / zhal gcig phyag bzhi rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs/ / thugs rje zhi ba bsil ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ / mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha cig gis phyag gnyis par mthong ste bstod pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum dang ldan pa'i sku/ / rtag par brtson pas mi bzhugs bzhengs pa ni/ / snying rje'i ngang can phan bde'i 'od stong 'gyed/ / btsun pa spyan rastu /zigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes brjod de mthar gyis ri de'i drung nas

'dzegs te 'jig rten dbang po'i skyed mos tshal rin chen sprin du song ba na/nang gi nye bar len pa'i rkyen gyis phyi rol gyi yul yang tha dad du snang ste/ gang dag chu bur gyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis skyed mos tshal gyi gzhi de nyid tsan+dan gyi ljon pas dkrigs shing / pad+ma dang ku mu tas gang ba'i chu rgyun gtsang ma kha du ma nas 'bab pa/ me tog gi tshal na bung ba lding zhing bya dang ri dwags mang po bde bar rgyu ba'i gnas/ thang mtshams su rgya mtsho'i chus bskor cing rtse mo gangs ri'i ze bas gsal ba'i steng na gtsug lag khang tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyis kha bsgyur pa g.yu'i phebs nor bu'i me tog gis mdzes shing / ri de'i khor yug tu dpag tshad phyed bzhi dang phye/ thur du dpag tshad sum brgya mtsho'i nang nas 'thon par mthong ste smras pa/ 'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas yid 'ong po ta la/ / rtse mo gangs ri'i drwa bas g.yogs pa'i steng / / khang brtsegs yid 'ong nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ / ngos rnams dri zhim ljon pas rab 'khrigs shing / / mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka ngur bas khengs/ / bang mtshams rgya mtsho'i chu rlabs gnyer ba yis/ / phyogs kyi tha gru'i khyon rnams 'jal ba bzhin/ / sna tshogs 'od zer 'khrugs pas mdzes so kye/ /gang dag lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis ri'i rgyal po po ta la rang gi mos pa dang rjes su mthun par chen po dang thung ngu dang yangs pa dang dog pa dngakha dog dang dbyibs rnams skad cig skad cig la ji ltar 'dod pa de'i gzugs dang bkod par 'gyur zhing snang ba'i phyir tshad ma nges shing rgya yongs su mched pa'i tshul gyis mthong ngo / /de yang 'di ltar thang mtshams rnams na rgya mtsho'i chus yongs su bskor ba'i nang na lha ma yin dang klu mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyi grong khyer sprin gyi snying po'i khang bzang gis 'khor zhing / ngos rnams gser dngul dang nor bu'i drwa bas g.yogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing gis 'khrigs pa'i bar bdī /ga

be+eḍūrla dang in+d+ra tī la dang gser gyi dril bu tshad du sbreng bas sbrel legs pa'i nagasakhrod rin po che'i mtsho dang rdzing dang lteng ka mang pos brgyan par sprul pa'i bya dang ri dwags mang pos glu gar dang rtsed 'jo bgyid cing / nam mkha'i mthongs dang skyed mos tshal kun tu 'od kha dog rnam pa lnga'i drwa ba dang /gur dang / bla bre dang / khang brtsegs dang / zlum 'khrigs dang / mig mangs ris dang / grong dang / nags dang / skyes pa dang / bud med kyi gzugs su snang ba rnams 'od kyi gur khyim na glu gar dang rtsed 'jo bgyid pa'i bar bar rnams su 'od kyi rtsibs gar dang / gyen rgyug dang / rab 'khyil la sogs pas mdzes pa'i bkod pa sna tshogs par snang zhing / ri de'i rtse mo nor bu chu shel 'tsher ba'i steng na 'jig rten dbang po'i pho brang rin po che sna tshogs pa las grub pa mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa/ be+eḍūrla'i phebs 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi gtsug tor gyis mtshan pa mig 'phrul ltar kun tu snang ngo/ / de dag gi stong gi ngos na nam mkha'i po ta la rgya mtsho'i nang gi po ta la dang 'gran pa lta bu zhig snang ba ni chu dwangs pa'i nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang nam mkha'i zla ba ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i bkod pa gnyis su snang ba la bsams te/ ngang ba'i rgyal pos smras pa/ shar ri rgyal po yid 'ong po ta la/ / me tog sman shing dri zhim dwangs pa'i mtsho/ / rin chen ljon shing mang po'i ra bas bskor/ / rtse mo nor bu chu shel snying po'i steng / / khang brtsegs yid 'ong mchod pa'i 'od zer 'gyed/ / rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa ji bzhin du/ / nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yid 'ong po ta la/ / 'od lnga'i nang py-i /nga la rang bzhin med/ / sna tshogs bkod pa'i cho 'phrul 'gyed la 70ri'i drung na chu'i rba rlabs gnyer ba la bsams te kha cig gis smras pa/

rin chen sprin gyi snying pos brgyan pa'i mtsho/ / mthing gar 'khrigs pa'i lag rtsed dud pa ni/ / dad pa'i gdung shugs g.yo bas rab bskyod de/ / dul ba'i lus kyis phyag kyang 'tshal ba 'dra/ /yang kha cig gis smras pa/ rin chen 'dzin ma'i chu gter chen po yang / /chab sgra snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs rab sgrogs shing / / lhun po 'khor bar dus rlabs g.yo ba ni/ / bsod nams blo yis skor bar byed pa 'dra/ /yang kha cig gis smras pa/ mtshan mo mkha' la gza' skar shar 'dra'i chu/ / lbu ba sbrengs pa'i zegs ma 'thor ba ni/ / me tog char ba zil gyis 'bab pa yis/ /'jig rten dbang po'i gnas 'dir mchod pa bzhin/ /kha cig gis skyed mos tshal gyi bkod pa la bsam te smras pa/ rin chen ljon shing me tog drwa ba can/ / nor bu'i tshal gyis legs par sbrengs pa dag/dad pas 'jig rten dbang po mchod pa'i phyir/ / shar ri rgyal po'i drung du lhags pa bzhin/ /yang kha cig gis smras pa/ chur nyal 〈nyematsho na bya tshogs sgra 'byin zhing / /'dab gshog g.yo bas bro gar byed pa ni/ /sprin gyi glang bo myos pa'i tshogs 'di dang / /skyed mos tshal 'dir lhan cig 'gran pa bzhin/ /yang kha cig gis smras pa/ ljang ser rtswa yi myu gu rnams ni me tog 'dzum pa'i do shal 'phyang / / 'od zer gsal ba'i shing drung rnams ni zhi ba'i drang srong mang pos gang / / chu gtsang pad+mas khebs pa rnams ni sil khrol lbu ba'i rgyan phreng 'dzin/ / yin 'ong nags kyi bkod pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul lags so kye/ /yang kha cig gis 'od kyang snang ba la bsams te smras pa/ nags kyi mthongs 4yong yid 'ong nam mkha'i khams/ / 'od lnga'i snang ba sna tshogs mched pa ni/ / drwa ba drwa phyed 4༄ma 'khrigs za 'og ris/ pad+ma'i da/zlos

dang khang brtsegs bla bre'i gzugs/ / gyen 'greng rtsibs shar nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'gro/ / kun gyi nang na lha yi skyed mos tshal/ / lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin rnam 'phrul zhing / / bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan 'khrol la ltos/ /zhes brjod de skyed mos tshal gyi nang du rgyu zhing song ba las/ bya dang ri dwags du ma gcig la gcig bag phebs shing rdzing dang me tog 'khri shing ra ba'i nang na gnas pa dag mthong ste/ bzhin bzang gis dris pa/ skyed mos tshal 'di'i bya dang ri dwags kyang / / phan tshun byams shing dul ba'i ngang tshul can/ /'du 'dzi spangs te bsam gtan sgom pa bzhin/ / drang srong spyod tshul 'di 'dra su las bslab/ /lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ dam pa rnams dang 'grogs na de yi dri/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i bsung gis khyab par byed/ / des na 'di dag mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis/ / chos dang ldan zhing zab mo'i ting 'dzin 'phel/ / zhes brjod de mthar gyis ri de'i steng du song ba las/ rin po che 'od kyi snying po'i pho brang nor bu'i drwa bas g.yogs shing mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla re gsal ba can mthong ste/ de'i sgo drung du song nas sil snyan 'khrol zhing bstod dbyangs dag blang ba / 'jig rten dbang phyug bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha 4) / kun nas dgyes pa'i zhal gyi pad mtsho yis/ / 'dab brgya'i sbrang rtsir spyod rnams rab gzigs te/ / bdud rtsi'i chos kyis 'gro ba tshim par mdzod/ / ces brjod pa dang / gzhal med khang de'i nang nas lha'i bu zhig phyir byung ste smras pa/ kye bzhin bzang dag gang nas 'ong ci zhig don du gnyer/lam mkhan gyis smras pa/ 'dzum mdzes gangs ri'i drung nas 'ongs pa ste/ / sna tshogs mchod pa'i 'od kyi sprin 'phro bas/ / 'jig rten dbang po mchod cing bstod pa dang / / yid 'ong chos kyi gsung dbyangs nyan du mardoswā/ / zhes brjod pa dang / dri gtsang khang gi sgo phyes te nang du 'jug

pa'i brda byas so/ /de nas de dag gzhal med khang gi nang du song ba na nor bu sprin gyi snying po'i khri la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po zla ba 'char ba ltar 'tsher zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba lha'i gos dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing shin tu 'dzum pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sum khri drug stong gis bskor nas bzhugs pa mthong ngo / / de'i tshe rang rang gi mchod pa'i yo byad kyis mchod de zhabs la 'dud pa'i phyag 'tshal zhing / ngang ba'i rgyal pos bstod pa/ mchog tu dkar ba gangs ri'i sku ni rta bdun gzi byin 'gyed 'dra zhing / / pad+ma'i mig ni thugs rje'i zhal bzang phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'dab brgya 'dzum/ / bde 'byung gtsug gi nor bu'i dpal ni khyod zhabs 'dzin pa'i khur gyis lci/ / drang srong mchog ni rgyal sras dbus na mchog tu mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhin bzang gis bstod pa/ 'od zer gsal bas rgyan rnams 'khrol ba'i sku/ /'gying bcas pad+ma'i steng na mi g.yo zhig / thugs rje drwa ba 'khyil ba'i 'od 'phro ba'i/ / mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me rtog brgyan pa'i mtsho'i ngang ba rnams las kha cig gis bstod pa/dus sprin 'dzum pa'i thor tshugs nang na 'od dpag med kyi glog phreng can/ /thugs rje'i 'brug sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab tshangs pa'i rnga chen gsal bar sgrog/ snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs chu char bsil bas 'gro blo'i yid mkha' rab 'gengs shing / / srid gsum (ton bde'i me tog gis bkra 'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ khyod zhal ku muta gnyen gyi dpal/ /gdul bya'i mkha' la rab mdzes pa'i/ / nges pa la ni su yis 'gong / /'phrin las 'od dkar can la 'dud/ / 73

yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ thugs rje'i phyag la bsil ba'i chu sbrengs pas/ bdud sde'i snying la gdung ba'i drod 'bar zhing / /yi dwags rnams la bsil ba'i bdud rtsir (krobab/ / btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ khyod gdong zla ba shar bas mi zum pa'i/ /thugs rje mchog gi 'dab stong phyogs bcur rgyas/ / gdul bya'i bung ba lding ba'i skyed mos tshal/ /'jig rten dbang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ mchog tu zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs kyang 'jigasagazugs rngams pa'i sprin 'phro zhing / / thugs rje'i rang bzhin kun la snyoms kyang bdud dpung pham pa'i cho nge 'debs/ / mdzad pa'i chu bsil 'gro la 'gyed kyang log rtog gdung ba'i drod 'bar zhing / / bdag med ()stong ba'i sgra chen sgrogs kyang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren la 'dud/ /yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ mdzes sku yid 'ong ston zla'i dkyil 'khor ni/ / sgra gcan btud kyang gza' bral phyogs bcur gsal/ /nyin byed min yang 'od stong drwa ba 'gyed/ /gling bzhi'i dpal du shar la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyis mi phye zhing / / nyin byed zer gyis mi 'dzum pa'i/ / 'dzum mdzes zhi ba'i ku mu ta/ / mdzad pa'i 'dab stong rgyas la 'dud/ /yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ nyin byed gdul bya'i pad+mo 'dzum par mdzes sku 'gro kun mtshan mo'i mig / chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil na gsal yang mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs g.yo/ / snying rje'i rta bdun shugs kyis bskyod kyang ting 'dzin mi g.yo rab brtan zhing / /'od zer drwa ba phyogs bsta/ 'gyed kyang bdud gling mun par mdzad la 'dud/ /

yang kha cig gis bstod pa/ mtha' yas mdzes ma'i tshogs 'di dag /nam mkha'i rjes 'gro mkhyen brtse'i khyon/ / ma 'dres ngo bo gcig nyid du/ /shong ba khyed sku'i yangs pa mtshar/ /yangs cig gis bstod pa/ 'dzum mdzes zhi ba'i pad+mo 'di ni ge sar gsal ba'i tshogs min zhing / /gsung snyan tshangs pa'i rnga sgra 'di ni byed pa'i sgra dbyangs zab mo min/ / kun mkhyen thugs rje'i nam mkha'a'adi ni sprin bral nyi zla'i lam min zhing / / phrin las tsha zer snang ba 'di ni nyin byed 'od stong min yang mtshar/ / ces brjod de sil snyan 'khrol zhing 'jig rten dbang po'i yon tan yid la byed bzhin pas 'khod par gyur to/ /mgon po thugs rje'i 'dab stong rgyas pa'i drung / / 'dab bzang rkang drug ldan rnams lhags pa ni/ / dad pa'i 'dab gshog g.yo bas gar byed cing / / snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs dar dir sgrog la brtson/ /de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis ngang ba'i tshogs de dag la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos gsungs pa/ bzhin bzang ngang ba'i tshogs dag tshur nyon 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ / mtshon dang dug dang me yi 'obs 'dra rtag tu sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i gnas/ / mya ngan gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'phel zhing mi 'dod brgya phrag char bzhin 'bab/ / gcig nas gcig tu rnam par brgyud cing nyam nga'i g.yang la pha mtha' yas/ / mtho ris grong (lta bde ba rnams kyang rmi lam bzhin du rnam par 'gyur/ / byis pa rnams ni mchog tu sred pas yul gyi chu bor rab lhung zhing / / nyon mongs rba rlabs shin tu shugs drag las kyi rlung rab 'khrug pas bcom/ / gti mug ma rig mun pas ldongs shing chags dang khro ba'i gnas su gyur/ / srid pa'i mtsho chen shin tu 'jigs rung skye shi'i klong 'khor dang bcas shing / / rga nad rgud pa'i dus rlabs gnyer bas 'jig rten gsum (2 khong khyab pa'i/ / rdi /na

gting zab thar dka'i gnas las khyed cag brgal ba'i blo gros skyed/ / sna tshogs rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi spangs te dben par zhi ba'i bsam gtan sgoms/ / chos kun rang gi sems las byung ste sems ni sems nyid ngang las byung / / sems nyid gzhi rtsa kun las 'das te gang las ma byung 'dus ma byas/ / rang bzhin rnam dag gdod nas zhi zhing nam mkha' lta bur rtogs par bya/ / de nyid don la rang gi sems ni spros dang bral bar lhan ni bzhag/'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam/ / chos rnams kun gyi snying po yin/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal dka' las/ / sgrol ba'i gru yang 'di nyid do/ / e ma bzhin bzang ngang ba dag / da dung bshad kyis legs par nyon/ / ston ga'i sprin rnams mkha' la 'gro ba'i dpes/ / tshe ni mi rtag g.yo zhing snying po med/ / skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can du/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ / tshong khang skye bo 'du zhing 'gyes pa'i dpes/ / lhan cig 'dus pa'i mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / / rang gi lus kyang 'bral ba'i chos can du/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ / mtshan mo gnyid kyis log pa'i rmi lam dpes/ / sna tshogs chos 'di thams cad rang gi sems/ / bag chags gnyid las byung ba'i chos can du/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ / mkha' la sprin rnams rang sar dengs pa'i dpes/ /las dang nyon mongs bde dang sdug bsngal kun/ / dang po'i byung sar thim pa'i chos can du/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ /dwangs pa'i mtsho la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i dpes/ / sna tshogs dngos kun snang yang snying po med/ / rnam kun stong ba'i gzugs brnyan chen po ru/ / de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par bya/ / nam mkha'i mthongs la 'ja' tshon dengs pa'i dpes/ / sna tshogs 'gyu ba ye shes rig pa'i gdangs/ / rig pa rakā sdur grol ba chos sku'i ngang / / spang blang dgag sgrub med par rtogs par

bya/ / yangs pa'i mkha' la bya tshogs lding ba'i dpes/ / sems nyid ngang la yengs med rig pa'i bya/ / gang shar 'dzin med phyogs lhung bral bar bzhag/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil du gnas pa yin/ / zhes gsungs ma thag tu ngang ba'i tshogs de dag gis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa khong du chud cing snying rje mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa thob ste/ so so nas mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs kyis mchod cing bstod nas 'jig rten dbang po'i drung na mchi ma 'byin cing 'dug go/ /dad pa'i rang bzhin chu 'dzin g.yo ba las/ / snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs 'brug sgra sgrogs pa dang / / mnyam du gdung ba'i glog phreng gar byed cing / /mchi ma'i char zim bsil ba ngang gis 'bab/ /de nas tshe ji srid kyi bar po ta la'i gnas de nyid du res 'ga' 'phags pa'i drung du chos nyan cing / res 'ga' skyed mos tshal gyi rdzing bur klog pa dang bsam gtan la brtson pas 'bras bu thob par gyur to zhes grag go/ /de lta bas na tshul khrims dang ldan zhing mang du thos pa dag gis 'du 'dzin rnam par g.yeng ba spangs te/ rang gi yul la mdun par ma zhen pas skye ṭā 'phags pas rten pa'i nags su bsam gtan sgom pa la brtson par bya / nyi/ zer gsal ba'i shin tu 'dzum pa'i mtsho skyes tshal ni mig med 'gro ba'i spyod yul min/ /dri za'i dbang pos snyan par sbreng ba'i rgyud mangs nga ro sgra 'dzin bral bas thos sam ci/ / ma la yar (yokhrungs dri zhim tsan+dan bu ga'i srin bur nam yang nyer mkho'i gnas skabs med/ / dam pa rnams ni rmongs pa'i tshal na kun gyis bkur zhing grags pa'i 'od kyis mdzes gyur tam/ /yun ring lhan cig gnas pa blun po'i blos/ / nam yang 'di na mkhas pa mthong ba med/ / rdzing bu'i nang gnas rus sbal tshogs rnams kyilha/7 /

mdangs bkra pad+ma'i kha dog mi mthong bzhin/ / thos bsam rdzing bu'i nang na rab rgyu zhing / / dul ba'i lus mdzes bslab gsum 'dab gshog rdzogs/ /blo ldan ngang ba'i tshul 'dzin bsam yas pas/ / gru 'dzin kun tu dga' ba'i gtam 'di byas/ / dge ba de yin bdag dang 'gro tshogs spros kun zhi ba'i nam mkha' la/ / chos sku'i dkyil 'khor gzod nas zhi zhing rang bzhin lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ / nges pa lnga ldan gzugs brnyan gyis bkra 'od gsal snying po longs spyod rdzogs/ / sna tshogs sprul sku'i 'od zer 'gyed pas 'dul bya'i pad+mo 'dzum par shog sdeb sbyor chu klu legs par 'bab pa'i gnas/ /mngon brjod pad+ma'i tshal gyis khebs pa 'dir/ / blo gsal 'dab bskyod tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam mang du thos pa'i snyan dngags mkhan /snakā 〉na bsam yas pa ngag gi dbang pos rang byung pad+ma'i gnas su sbyar ba phyogs dus kun tu bde chen gyi char bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus su nye bar gnas ṭ+wā bzhin du 'bab par gyur cig / sarba marga lam̐/ /ma/hā / ༷ kā/ ta la zhes pa ni rgya gar lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin dang lha sa'i pho brang dmar po ri gnyis la 'jug mod/ 'dir snga ma ste spyan rasagazigs kyi zhing khams la zer zhing / legs sbyar skad du po ṭa la zer/dumatshan dpe/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu tham pa la zer te/ rgyal dbang bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos/ mtshan dpe 'di dag la ci'i phyir mtshan dang dpe byad ces bya zhe na/ rang gang la ldan pa'i gang zag skyes bu chen por mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid lta bu yin pas na mtshan dang / sen mo zangs kyi mdog can de nang du 'du byed thams cad la chags pa dang bral ba'i yon tan de nyid gzhan la go bar byed pa'i phyi'i dpe lta bu yin 78 pas sam pha rol la sku'i mdzes pa bskyed pa'am ston byed yin pagan dpe byad ces bya zhes

du// zlos pazlo // /na/ po/ ste/ de ni 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉du bkod pa ltar na/phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nam mkha' stong ba mtha' las 'das pa zhig yod pa las/phyogasabacu nasatwang g.yos te/ phan tshun du phul bas rlung rgya gram zhesapa/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngo skya shin tu sra ba/ rngams su dpag tshad sa adrug 'bum dang / rgyar grangs med pa cig chags so/ /de'i steng du chu'i phung bo la brten nas/ rgya mtsho chen po rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong nyi shu/ rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang stong phrag sum brgya phrag phyed dang lnga'o/ /de'i steng du gser gyi sagazhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ dpag tshad sum 'bum bzhi khri/ de'i dbus rin po che sna tshogasalas grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni/ rang thag gi lte ba lta bur lhun gyis grub ste/ shar dngul/ lho be+eḍūr+ya/nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'o/ /ri rab de ni dpag tshad brgyad khri mtsho nang du nub ste/ brgyad khri steng du 'phags pa'o/ /de'i mtha' bskor na gser ri bdun dang rol // zloshān yod la/ ri rab kyi steng na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnagasogs yod par dhi/ // yo/ na'/di/ // / ṭ+wāṃ shā sna trī / kū bsdus tshig ste/ de la gzugasadang / sgra/ dri/ ro/du//shā//sa trī /hā /bzhi/ mtshams bzhi/ steng 'og gnyis dang bcu'o/du'ados/ 'gro ba'am song pa'i don te 'dong yin nam brtag()las dang nyon mongs/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis nang gi 'du byed dang srid pa gnyis ni las dang / ma rig pa dang sred pa dang len pa gsum ni nyon mongs pa'o/ /(to/judīkā pa/ mo: yongasa'adzin gyis/ 'jungs pa ni zhen chagasache ba'am ser sna'i brda 0mi lhag kā / sbyang pa/ re nas 'jig pa'i chos te/ de dang dngos po/ 'dus byas/ byas pa yi//pa /r+sha ga// /la/ ba lung 〉las/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad cing / /mthon po rnamasakyi mtha' lhung 'gyur/ /phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin zhesagasungs pa ltar/ bsags mtha' 'dzad pa dang / mtho mtha' lhung ba/ 'dus mtha' 'bral ba/ skyes mtha' 'chi ba ste bzhi'o/ / 79

rkunaspros dang bral ba/ spros pa ni rgya che ba'i mtshan ma dang rtog pa'i don yin la/ spros dang bral ba ni mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa dang / stong ba nyid dam chos nyid do/kuna'akhor gsum/ skabs 'dir lusangag yid kyi las gsum la go dgos/(spredad pa/ de'i ngo bo ni/ dmigs yul las 'bras sogs yod pa dang yon tan can dang nus pa sogs 'dod bya'i yul gang rung la dmigs nas rnam pa rang stobs kyis yid ches pa dang dang ba dang mngon par 'dod pa gang rung gi rnam pa can byed lasadage bar gyur pa'i 'dun pa skyed pa'i sems byung ste/ 〈kun btus 〉las/ dad pa gang zhe na/ yod pa nyid dang yon tan can dang nus pa rnams la mngon par yid ches pa dang dang ba dang 'dod pa ste 'dun pa'i rten byed pa'i lasacan no zhesagasung4shing / dad pa la dbye na/ yid ches pa'i dad ༷༵ hāzlo ga/tasnanga~Xkānā r+sha/yi/rdo / shā /sna sdi spyanā ༵ k+to ṭ+wāṃ sdu sna sdi/ ma /'dres par rtse gcig tu yi//sna lta / da/ bsdus sna/ ga/shā sna bye ༵ rnyi rno dri/ sna ṭ+wāṃ /// k+ta /sna /sa bya'o/ /(7shang shang / skabs 'dir me tog rnams rlung gisagayo ba las byung ba'i sgrar go dgos/zhonamathar gyis/ mthar gyis ni rim gyis zhes pa'i don/zhonamanyam par bzhag pa/ mnyam bzhag ste/ ting nge 'dzin sgom skabs gang zag dang chos gyi bdag med pa'i stong ba nyid la sems rtse gcig tu dmigs nas mnyam par bzhag pa zhes bya la/ yang na sems dmigs pa gcig la dmigs te bying ba dang rgod pa'i skyon gnyis dang bral ba'i sgo nasartse gcig tu 'jog pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /phoyishang shong / shang shong zhes pa ni grangasaganas che ba zhig la'ang 'jug mod/ skabs 'dir snyisdor+sha / rdo/mar+shar+sha/ ༵ sna kā spya dāgā sargya/nga gragasakyis thag ring ba'i sa dang / 'brog dgon pa ②/ spya /lapa sdir+sha ཿkā r+sha ༵ pa'i pa ga / dh+ri tram̐ /dang/ / bzo rigs bco brgyad yod pa grong khyer dang /grong khyer du ma yod pa grong brdal dang / grong brdal du ma yod pa yul ljongs dang / yul ljongs du ma yod pa yul 'khor zhes kong sprul yon tan rgya mtshogagasungs la/ (brgyad stong 'grel chen 〉las/ bzo'i bye brag bco brgyad tshang ba la grong khyer dang / de rmi tshang ba'i khyim gcigaganyis sogs la grong dang / tshong ba mang po yod pa'i gnas la grong rdal dang / mi 80rigs bzhi tshang ba'i yul phyogs la ljongasazhes gsungs/ mngon brjod 'ga' zhig tu/ bye

kā'i /nga /sa ཿsa /cingapa yul/ //bum phrag grong gis yul 'khor dang / /brgyad brgya'i yiha rdo tsa/ nang len sa/sbyar/ skapa /shad tsan/ dan dkar po dang lha'i ljon shing gnyis la 'jug pa yi/lhas/ bye//ra rdo kā sdo nā sdo kā dī /spya/ chag/ sa dang / bram ze/ so/ rab tu byung ba bcas don yi/ // // py-i ༵ ṭā/ snaX smra t+ta kā dzī /dī trī ṭ+wāṃ rnyi ṭī zlo ya/nga zer/:lha rdo /khri//rdo rī sdi pri sdi sdir+sha g+ni / /sdo dā kā/ga ste/ sman la'ang 'jug par grags/phosprechu dwangs/ nor bu ke ta ka ste/ dbyadros can dga' blo nas/ ke ta ka ni dwangs byed ces pa ste/ chu rnyog sdu dwangs par byed pa ste/ 'di la nor bu dang shing 'brasasogs ci rigs yod ༷༵༵ /shā tā gi spri gastang ṭ+wāṃ ni/ dkar mo dang / 'od zer can ma dang / lha mo mu ma sogs don du ma la 'jug 'dir 'phags ma dkar mo ste sgrol dkar ro/ /4)sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa/ 'di ni bung ba dang me tog dang pad ma bcas kyi thun mong gi ming yin yi/rte /snas dri sdir+sha gāng / sa do/ na/ gcig de yang ma rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ dmigasayul bden bzhi'i sogs pa'i chos gang yang rung ba la dmigasanas rnam pa yul de la rang stobs kyis rmongs pa'i rnam pa can byed las nyon mongs gzhan skyed pa'i sems byung ste/ (kun btus 〉las/ ma rig pa gang zhe na/ khams gsum pa'i mi shes pa ste chos rnams la log par nges pa dang the tshom dang kun nas nyon mongs pa 'byung ba'i rten byed pa'i las can no zhes gsungs la/ rang yul la rang stobs kyis rmongasapa'i semasabyung zhes kyang bya'o/ /po'idangos kun mi rtag bem shes kyis bsdus pa'i dngosapo rnams rgyu rkyen gyis 'du byas pas na 'dus byas/ de yang skad cig gis gnas skabs phyi ma skye zhing snga ma 'gags pasangan/ mi rtag tu 'gyur ba dang 'jig rang phyir mi rtag pa yin zhes (bshes springasa'agrel ba 〉las yi/ shādri sa/ 'bras bu thogs pa na sdong bu dang bcas pa skam 'gro ba'i shing zhig yin la/ la las ga ma la ngosa'adzin/ akyu yongs 'dzin gyis/ chu shing ni chu klung gi 'gram bye ma'i nang du skyes pa'i 'om bu yin par bshad cing / 'om nag ces kyang 'byung ngo zhesag/rdos/

yigacig dang tha dad/ rang bzhin gyis gcig dang rang bzhin gyis tha dad/yigazungs/ gzungs zhes bya ba ni tshig dang yoge ji srid du brjod pa'i don gzhan du mi 'gyur bar ngesapa'am/ ji skad du brjod pa de nam du yang de dang mi 'bral bar gzung ba ltabu la bya zhes lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis gsungs la/ gzungs kyi ngo bo ni/ dran pa dang shes rab khyad par can gyis byed las dge ba'i chos rnams 'dzin cing mi dge ba'i chosarnams yi/dri k+taX /maḥ kātā /spya r+shaswā /ma /grangs shegaḥ/ swā sdu phye/dbar sna rdo/ sdu sdo d+ngha brnyi ༷sgri/ra dang mthongs sgor sogs kyi mdzes rgyan/yonathugs rje'i lha/ snying rje'i lha ste 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan gzhan/4)srid gsum/ srid pa gsum gyi bsdus ming ste/ sa 'og klu'i srid pa/ sasteng mi'i srid pa/nyapa/ / sbya/ srir+sha spra // // sdu/sbo ta ste/ 'chi ba med pa zhesapa'i don/ de'i mini 'gag tshig dang / mṛ ta 'chi ba'i ming yin pa don 'gyur bdud rtsir bsgyur pa'o/ /de la bdud ni lus can rnams kyi srog 'phrog par byed pa'i dug dang nad sogasayin la/ de 'joms par byed pa'i gnyen po sman lta bu la rtsi zer ro zhes dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo grosakyis gsungs/〈yibadag med/ bden bzhi rnam pa bcu drug gi nang gses sdug bsngal bden pa la/ mi rtag dang / sdug bsngal/ stong ba/ bdag med bcas bzhi yod cing / bdag med la (bshes springs 'grel ba 〉las/ chosathams cad bdag med pa ni/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin stangs bzung bya'i bdag de ni dngos gnas la nam yang yod pa ma yin te/ yul gyi sgo nas phyi nang bar gsum/ dusathog mtha' bar gsum thamasacad du med cing de ltar du shes pa ni bdag med pa'i rnam pa yid la shes pa'o zhes gsungs pa ltabu'o/ /zhonamatho ris grong / 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi nang nasamathon pa'i phyogs sam rigs te lha'iganasal zer ba yin/ ri rab lhun po'i steng na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas yod cing / de'i /bus / zlorgya byin gyi pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang rin po che sna tshogs yidrok+ta/ rnyi/ /bye ༵ sa /gsum mam srid gsum dang don gcigazhonam la ya/ 'di ni legs sbyar gyi skad yin la bod skad du dri ldan zhes pa'i don te/ sman gyi 82 grong khyer lta na sdug gi nub phyogasan yod pa'i brag zhun dang / cong zhi/ chu tshan sogasasman

skye pa'i sman ljongasari bo zhigabasam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal rang bzhin smos dang /2 ngang pa'i rgyal po dang bzhin bzang gnyis kyis thar lam du gshegs pa des skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnad don gang zhig gsal bshad byed kyi 2 )sdo dri/nga gis kyang 'char yan gyi rtsom yig thung ngu zhig bris dang /

bho ṭa'i yi ge sum cu'i bya dka' mkhas pa'i dga' skyed/snyan rtsom 'di ni bod kyi ka bshad rtsom rig dang snyan ngag zung ldan rgyan sogs kyi sdeb sbyor la brten nas/ bya bar dka' ba'i sgra rgyan gyi snyan ngag khyad du 'phags pa zhig lags so/rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa/bod kyi dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'i srol btod pa po rje tsong kha pa chen po ni/ rab byung drug pa'i gser 'phyang zhes pa me bya (spyi lo 1357)lor yab klu 'bum dge dang yum shing mo bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo gsum la sha ba ri rdzong du kurma rol pa'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan kun dga' snying bor gsol/dgung lo bdun pa chu yod (spyi lo 1363)lor bya khyung du chos rje don grub rin chen gyi drung du rab tu byung ste mtshan blo bzang grags pa zhes gsol/ dgung lo bcu drug thog chos rje don grub rin chen gyis bskul cing bdag nyid kyang spro shugs drag po bzlog tu med pa bskyed nas dbus su phebs par bcoms/dgung lo bcu bdun pa chu glang (spyi lo 1373)lor dbus gtsang dag pa'i ljokāswā su byon/ de nas rim pas 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod/ gsang phu

bde ba can/ myang stod/ zhwa lu/ snar thang / sa skya/ bo dong phyogs su slob gnyer gyi don du byon/ dgung lo nyer bzhi ba lcags bya (spyi lo 1381)lor yar klung tshogs chen mkhan po tshul khrims rin chen gyis mkhan po dang / shes rab mgon pos las kyi slob dpon/ bsod nams rdo rjes gsang ste ston pa mdzad de/ dge 'dun grangs dang ldan pa'i dbus dge slong gi sdom pa mnos/snga phyir lo tsā ba mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang paṇa chen ma ti ba/dbu ma ba brtson 'grus seng ge/ lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/rje red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ bu ston thugs sras chos kyi dpal/ bra gor mkhan chen chos skyong bzang po sogs skyes chen dam pa mang po spyi bor bsten nas/ thun mong gi rig gnas spyi dang sgos su zab mo mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ thos bsam sgom pa'i rim pa brgyud de/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis mdo sngags kyi bstan pa la dag ther mdzad cing / bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir rgyal bstan nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad pa bka' drin mchog tu che'o/ /rab byung bdun pa'i chu bya (spyi lo 1393)lor 'ol khar rdzing phyi'i byams pa zhig gso mdzad/ me byi (spyi lo 1396)lor gnyal gyi lung ra chen mo tshugs/sa byi (spyi lo 1408)lor rgya nag gi rgyal po chen po tā ming yun lo rgyal pos rje rin po che la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po bzlog tu med pa skyes nas nan gyis gdan 'dren zhus kyang / dgag bya che ba dang dgos pa chung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis dngos slob shākya ye shes sku tshab tu mngags/ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa glang (spyi lo 1409)lor lha sa cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i mchod tshogs btsugs pa dang 'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab ste/ chos kyi sbyin pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa mdzad/ dgung lo re gcig pa me bya (spyi lo 1417)lor dga' ldan du dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod mdzad/ yangs pa rāḥ kyi

rten rnams bzhengs/ dgung lo re gsum pa rab byung bdun pa'i sa phag (spyi lo 1419)lor dga' ldan du zhi bar gshegs/rje 'di'i bka' rtsom byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i bstan bcos che chung dang drang nges legs bshad snying po/ sngags rim chen mo/ rim lnga gsal sgron sogs dang / snyan ngag grags chen rten 'brel bstod pa dang / bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ 'chi med grub pa/ tshangs pa'i cod pan bcas bstod chen bzhi bcas mdo sngags kyi bka' chos po ti bcu dgu bzhugs/ rje rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rje dge 'dun grub pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ byams chen chos rje sogs mkhas grub kyi slob ma sdogang yas pa bskyangs te zhwa ser gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong legs par mdzad bho ṭa'i yi ge sum cu'i bya dka' mkhas pa'i dga' skyed/su sti/(1) ston zla rgyas pa'i dpal las lhag par mdzes/ / tshangs dbyangs snyan pa'i gdangs kyang zil gyis gnon/ / zab yangs rgya mtsho'i gting las dpag dka' ba/ / dbyangs can lha mo'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ / 'o ma'i rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil bar ngang mo'i phang phung (2)chas pa'am/ / gangs ri shin tu mtho ba'i tog la zla 'od zhu ba 'bab 'dra yi/ /gang sku yid la dran pa tsam gyis 'gro la spobs pa mchog stsol pa/ / sgra dbyangs lha mo rkang drug ldan de bdag blo'i pad mtshor rol pare mdzod/ / gang zhig rgya chenā /gas gnyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i dpal las legs 'khrungs shing / /
