mtha' yas yon tan nor bu'i rang bzhin gdul bya lha mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /rim gnyis nyi zla'i ska rags dang ldan skye dgu'i gling bzhi'i dbus na brjid/ / dpal ldan bla ma lhun po mchog de bsngags la su zhig btang snyoms byed/ / gang gis rab rgyas sde bzhi'i lung dang shin tu mdor bsdus kā ri ka (3)/ ka ma la ltar dag pa'i yid kyis lhur blang chos gos gur kum kha/ / kha dog mdzes pas kun nas klubs pa'i sku ni brtsa dzi ba ga (4)/ ga nas bltas kyang brjid pa ji bzhin 'gro mang dbus na nyam mi nga / / nga yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur bla ma mchog des 'gro la dge legs stsol/ / khengs dang dregs pa'i rgod pa gang gis skyed par byed pa'i rgyan rna ca/ / ca co bag med spyod tshul ring du dor ba khyod kyi grags pa'i cha/ / cha shas phyogs rnams kun tu khyab cing dam pas bsngags pa'i shing lo'i ja/ / ja sogs rnam dag 'tsho bas chog shes gyur pakhyod sku bco lnga'i nya/ / nya rgyas rgyu skar khrod na ji bzhin 'phrin las 'od kyis phyogs kun khyab/ / gsung rab zab mo'i de nyid ji bzhin legs par 'byed la parnyi ta/ / tā ras (5)rjes bzung lus can re ba rdzogs por skong la ā shad tha/(6)/ tha dad 'dzin pa nye bar zhi ba khyod thugs zung 'jug tha mi dad/ / da lta khyod sku dul bas gzhan yid rab tu phrogs pa 'di mthong na/ /na tshod song song ring nas dul ba'i drang srong rnams kyang spa bkong 'gyur/ /rmad byung rgyal ba'i rnam thar tshul la sku tshe snga mar legs sbyangs pa/ / pa ra mi ti'i (7)spyod tshul lhur len lus can rjes su 'dzin pa'i pha/ / pha mtha' bral ba zab mo'i mkha' la mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od kyis khyab pa/ / ba mo'i gdangs ltar dkar ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ba kun la snyoms pa'i ma/ / ma lus sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus la gus pas 'dud/ / khyod ni le lo'i mtshon gyis mi phegs brtson 'grus mchog gi ka ba tsa/ / tsa ri dang mtshungs gnas 'dir bsgoms nas lus la gnod pa'i grang dang tsha/ / tsha grakā ltog

bsngal khyad du bsad cing 'gro gdung sel la ka ran dza/(8)/ dza la dregs ldan cher rlom rnams kyang nyid kyi gam na srog chags wa/ / wa skyes du mas bskor yang ri dwags dbang po'i drung na zhum bzhin 'gyur/ / lhar bcas 'gro ba du ma'i rab dang yid kyis skye bsten 'os dgu'i zhwa/ / zhwa bzang tog ltar kun gyis bkur yang mi g.yeng ting 'dzin zas su za/ / za ma nor la sred pa dor zhing rtse gcig zhi gnas lhan ne 'a/ / 'a cag 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig tshul khrims dri bzang ngad ldan ma la ya/ / ya mtshan du mas mngon par mtho ba khyod la su zhig 'dud mi byed/ / khyod kyi thugs la brkam dang khro ba ji bzhin ri bong mgo na rwa/ / rwa yi ming kyang mi dmigs ji bzhin kun nas spangs pa khyod sku la/ / la las reg dang mthong dang thos pa gang yin de yang lus kyi sha/ /sha rus gting nas dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba med de sems med sa/ / sa steng 'gran zla bral ba khyod ni 'gro ba'i dpal du brtan gyur cig / bho ṭa'i yi ge sum cu'i bya dka' mkhas pa'i dga' skyed gad rgyangs ha/ / ha ha zhes sgrogs ngo mtshar gnas 'di ka nas brtsams te tha ma'i a/ / a yig bar du thog mtha'i tshul gyis rjes khrid rgyan du byas pa 'di/ / 'di phyi'i skyabs gyur bla ma mchog gi yon tan cha tsam bsgrag phyir bkod/ / bkod pa'i dge des grags pa'i gzhir gyur byang chub mchog de thob par shog / ces mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa'i mnga' bdag lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba du ma'i dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo ltar mngon par mtho ba chos kyi rje grags pa byang chub dpal bzang po'i che ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu las chu thigs tsam zhig blangs te bya dka' ba'i tshul gyis sbyar ba 'di nyid chos rje de nyid kyi zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos mang du reg pa'i snyan dngags mkhan shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis sbyar pa'o/ /88

ma// /ragre///sa/ smon pa/ dge ba/ bsod nams/ཿr+sha t+na snang/ /tshipa ༵ /dri bye /byi ba/()bca dze ba ga/ rtsa lag 'tsho/ mdza' bshes/()tā re/ mchog nyid/ sgrol mdzad/()ā shad tha/ bsam pa/ཿsna shā / /// sdo snal tsho phyin pa/bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 bod kyi thun mong min pa'i rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal gang lags/2 khyed rang gis drin can yab yum gnyis la bstod pa'i ka bshad tshigs bcad gcig bris dang /2 mtshan byang du bho ḍa'i yi ge sum cu'i bya dka' zhes gsungs pa'i bya dka' ba 'di gang yin/4 sgo ḍa'i yi ge sum cu'i bya dka' mkhas pa'i dga' skyed 'di'i rtsom gyi brjod snying gang yin/89

shar gangs ri ma/rtsom yig 'di ni rtsom pa pos rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i gdan sa'i phyogs su sprin dkar lding ba las dge ba'i bshes gnyen dran tshul du bcoms shing / gzhan yang skabs de'i grub mtha'i chags sdang la zhe thag pa nas thugs skyo ba'i tshul du bcoms pa'i grags can gyi mgur rtsom khyad 'phags shig yin no/rje dge 'dun grub pa/rje tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob dge 'dun grub pa ni/ gtsang ru lag gi sa'i cha dpal ldan sa skya'i nye 'dabs srad kyi lung lag gur me'i ru par yab mgon po rdo rje dang / yum jo mo nam mkha' skyid ces pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bdun pa'i lcags lug (spyi lo 1391)lor sku 'khrungs/ mtshan pad+ma rdo rjer btags/ dgung lo bdun lon pa'i tshe yab 'das/ khong rang 'khyar nas snar thang du slebs/ dpal snar thang gi mkhan rabs bcu bzhi pa'i sprul sku rje grub pa shes rab las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ brgya ston tsan+d+ra pa dang shākya dpal bcas pa las yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs pas tshigs chung ngus mkhasapar mkhyen/ dgung lo bco lnga pa shing bya (spyi lo 1405)lor gnas brtashā chen po'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing

dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ mtshan dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang por gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags stag (spyi lo 1410)lor grub pa shes rab kyis mkhan po dang / slob dpon chen po blo ldan pas las chog pa dang / chen po grags pa shes rab pas gsang ste ston pa mdzad de/ kha skong ba 'os pa grangs tshang pa'i dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos po brnyes/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing lug (spyi lo 1415)lor dbus la phebs te rje bla ma dang mjal/ lo ngo bcu'i bar gsang phu ne'u thog dang / ri bo dga' ldan dang / 'phan yul gros la sogs par mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bla ma drug cu tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par bka' drin mtshungs med kyi bla ma gsum ste/ dang por bka' drin che ba mkhan chen rin po che grub pa shes rab dang / bar du bka' drin che ba thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ tha mar bka' drin che ba mkhas grub shes rab seng ge zhes par grags/de dag las mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs shing mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes/ dgung lo so lnga pa shing sbrul lor gsang phu'i 'chadatan mdzad/ so drug pa me rta (spyi lo 1426)lor gtsang du phebs/snar thang byang chen dang / ri phud dang / brag dmar sogs su bzhugs te lo bcu gnyis kyi bar 'chad nyan dmar zhing grwa tshogs 'phel bar mdzad/dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sa rta (spyi lo 1438)lor dbus su phebs/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa lcags sprel (spyi lo 1440)lor shes rab seng ge dang lhan du slar gtsang la phebs/ dgung lo nga bdun pa rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos (spyi lo 1447)lor bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal pa'i gling btab cing rjes nas byams chen sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ dgon pa btab nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi bar bstan pa'i bdag por mdzad de 'chad nyan nam yang chag pa merdo pyar

gnang / dgung lo gya bzhi pa rab byung brgyad pa'i shing rta (spyi lo 1474)lo'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sku gshegs/spyir dgung lo so lnga nas gya bzhi'i bar dam pa'i chos kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pas/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang /bzang po dang / rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i slob mas gangs ri'i khrod ma khyab pa mi snang la/ gtso bo ni/ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang po/ rdo rje slob dpon bzang po bkra shis/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga'i bde legs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i nyi ma/ smon lam dpal legs pa'i blo gros/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grub/ mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs mang ngo/ / bcoms chos 'dul ba'i gleng shāḥsnas/ /mdo ṭīka tshad ma'i ṭīka rtsa 'jug gi ṭīk+ka sogs po ti bdun tsam shar gangs ri ma/na mo gu ru/ shar gangs ri dkar po'i rtse mo na/ sprin dkar po gnam la snyegs 'dra ba/ de mthong ba'i mod dul bla ma dran/ drin bsams shing bsams shing dad pa skye/ sprin dkar po lding ba'i shar phyogs na/ 'brog dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba der/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i drin po che/ pha blo bzang grags pa yab sras bzhugs/ lam rim pa gnyis ()kyi rnal 'byor sogs/ chos zab la shin tu rgyas par gsungs/ bod kha ba can gyi skal ldan la/ mgon khyod kyi bka' drin bsam mi khyab/ sgos snyoms las 'dzin pa'i dgā ༵dun grub/ blo cung zad chos la phyogs pa 'di/ rje yab sras rnams kyi

bka' drin yin/ drin che bar nges so yab sras rnams/ dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ rje yab sras khyed rnams ma gtogs par/ skyabs re sa gzhan du mi 'tshol bas/ thugs brtse ba'i lcags kyus drang du gsol/ drin ji bzhin 'khur bar ma nus kyang / sems chags sdang dbang du ma song bar/mgon khyod kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ dus nam yang brtson pa 'gyid par smon/lar med lta gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ rang bstan pa 'dzin par khas len zhing / gzhan bstan 'dzin dgra bo'i dwangs mar 'dzin/ tshul 'di la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ gzhan phung bar 'dod pa'i kun slong dang / rgyud mtshan 'dzin dam pos bcings lags kyang / lam mthon por gnas pa'i khas len byed/ 'di brtag na kun gyis khrel ba'i rgyu/ lam gol sar ()rgas pa'i sdug yul kyis/ chos tshul bzhin byed pa'i gang zag la/ rgyud khong nas 'khrugs pa'i gdug sems can/ gdon thugs la zhugs pa ma lags sam/ dgra nyon mongs 'dul thabs mi byed par/ gshags 'gyed pa 0tsam gyi 'chad nyan yang / 'dre shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pa la/ glud nub sgor gtong ba don re chung / don de ltar go ba'i bshes gnyen rnams/ spyir lus can kun la bka' drin bsam/ sgos chos mdzad yongs la dag snang 0sbyong / dgra nang na 'dug pa'i nyon mongs 'dul/ mi kho bo'i rjes 'jug grogs po rnams/yid phyogs su lhung bas mi 'ching bar/ blo gzu bor gnas pa'i rtog dpyod kyis/ lam drang por zhugs pa cis kyang legs/ gtam 'di la brten nas 'gro ba rnams/ byarmas snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed dang / dbyings spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba yis/ dpal bla med byang chub myur thob shog sku la mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhing / gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus brgyan/ thugs ni zab yangs mkhyen brtse'i gter/ dpal ldan bla ma'i bkra shis shog ces pa 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa chen po dge 'dun grub pa /snal

bzang polha gdungs dbyangs su mdzad pa'o/mchakā kādala'aphral dang de ma thag pa'i dus/dulam rim pa gnyis/ skyes rim dang rdzogs rim mam/ lam rim dang sngags rim/༵༵༵ /gol ༵// lam nor ba'am lam log pa/()sdu gas 'gyed pa/ kha bshags/ gtam gyis 'thab rtsod byas pa ste/ deng skabs kha 'thab rjod/ /snang / yang dag pa'i snang ba/bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 rtsom yig 'di mgur rtsom yin min dbye zhib gyis dang /2 tsom yig 'di'i nang / drin ji bzhin 'khur bar mi nus kyang /sems chags ldang dbang du ma song bar/ mgon khyod kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ dus nam yang brtson pa 'gyid par smon/ lar da lta gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ rang bstan pa 'dzin par khas len zhing /gzhan bstan 'dzin dgra bo'i dwangs mar 'dzin/ tshul 'di la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis skabs de'i bod kyi gnad don gang zhig gsal bshad byed kyi 'dug 94

rje tsong kha par 'gyod tshangs su phul ba'i bstod pa/gangs can skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rje bstod 'di ni/ lo tsā ba gang gis dang por rje'i lam rim chen mo sogs gsung rtsom 'ga' la mjal rjes/ dgongs pa'i zab gnad ma lon par 'gal ba'i khur chen bco brgyad sogs dgag bzhag mang du mdzad/ dus phyis slar yang khas len nang 'gal gyi rigs pas rgyas 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa'i dgag pa mthar phyin zhig mdzad par dgongs nas/ rje'i gsung gzhan rnams la zhib gzigs dang mno bsam yang yang btang mthar/ rang gi 'dod dgongs las ldog ste rje'i gsung gi nying bcud rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dri med legs bshad gser sbyangs btso ma'i khams lta bu rnams kyis yid kyi brtan pa cig car du 'phrogs nas/ rang dbang med par mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa dang lus kyi ba spu ldang ba sogs dbang non chos kyi rjes 'brang gi dad pa'i ngang tshul bcos ma ma yin pa zhig 'khrungs pa dang mnyam du snga ma'i log rtog dang skur 'debs la 'gyod tshangs dang bcas pa'i rtsom yig khyad 'phags 'di btsams pa yin/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen ni/ rab byung bdun pa'i /rdo bya

lor (1405)yar 'brog stag lung du sku 'khrungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs pad bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa mdzad pa la/ kun gzigs lnga pa'i rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang las rig pa'i gnas thams cad la 'khrul ba'i dri ma tsam yang spangs pa stag tshang lo tsā ba zhes bsngags brjod mdzad/ dus phyis su yar 'brog stag lung du sa skya'i dgon lag tu gyur pa thar gling chos sde gsar du btab ste dge 'dun stong phrag lhag gi tshogs pa bskyangs/ gsung rtsom la/dus 'khor spyi don/ grub mtha' kun shes/ rig gnas kun shes sogs dang /bsgyur rtsom ni bstan 'gyur las sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos sogs dang /gzhan gso dpyad byung tshul gyi lo rgyus sman gyi spyi don dang bcas pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog sogs gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ nam 'das kyi lo tshigs gsal bar ma nges/rje tsong kha par 'gyod tshangs su phul ba'ibastod pa/na mo gu ru mdzi sgo ṣā ya/ blo chen rgyal ba durnams kyi spyan snga ru/ /bzang po'i smon lam rlabs chen grub pa'i mthus/ / grags pa'i sgra chen thub bstan 'gro ba'i dpal/ / blo bzang grags pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag yas tshogs gnyis kun gyi rtse mor son/ / bgrang yas rgyal ba kun gyi ring lugs 'dzin/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi dge ba'i bshes/ / bsam yas yon tan kun gyi gter la 'dud/ / gangs can shar phyogs tsong kha'i skyed tshal du/ / dpal 'byor yongs 'du'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / / yon takā spyal ga phyogs kyi mtha' 'jal ba/ / snyan grags dri bsung 'phro ba khyod la

'dud/ /dri med mkhyen yangs 'jigs bral gzhon blo sogs/ / gangs can mkhas pa'i mkhas pa kun bston nas/ / spyi dang khyad par gzhung lugs mtha' dag la/ / rmongs pa'i mun kun spangs pa khyod la 'dud/ / rtog bral tshul khrims ()brtul zhugs rgya mtsho che/ /mang thos lung rigs nor bus lhag par gtams/ / mkhas mchog klu dbang kun gyis gus pas bsten/ / rnam dpyod gting mtha' med la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyod blo'i nyi ma gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ /mdo dang rgyan gyi pad tshal rgyas mthong nas/ / bdag blo khengs pa'i 0ku mud lhag par zum/ / zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ / byang phyogs 'di na tshig tsam byang ba'ang dkon/ / don la sgro 'dogs chod pa de bas dkon/ / bstan don nyams su len pa srid mtha' tsam/ /'di gsum mthar phyin khyod la snying nas 'dud/ /la la rigs bral lung gi grub mtha' du'ajog / kha cig lung bral rigs ltar snang ba tsam/ /lung rigs gnyis gas rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun/ / legs par 'byed pa khyod la gus phyag 'tshal/ /kha cig 'dul ba (kyegatsor byas gsang sngags spong //gzhan dag sngags la mos blos 'dul ba 'gog / rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag 'gal med du/ / rdzogs par nyams su len mkhas khyod la 'dud/ /mtshan nyid ()mchog bzung gsang sngags bza' chos dang / / sngags kyis khengs nas mtshan nyid kha bshad tsam/ / mdo sngags mtha' dag ma tshang rdzogs byang du/ / 'gro thabs med par gzigs pa khyod la 'dud/ / la la spyod pa zhib mos lta ba du'agog /kha cig lta ba mthon pos spyod pa 'dor/ /lta spyod phan tshun grogs su shar ba yi/ /don 'di lhag par 'doms pa khyod la 'dud/ / 'ga' zhig bshad pa gtsor byed sgom la smod/ / la la sgom gyis chog 'dzin lung la smod/ / bshad sgrub gnyis gas lung rtogs dudam pa'i chos/ /'dzin tshul gsal mdzad khyod la gus pas 'dud/ / mdo sngagasta dhi

mtha' dag khyad par rdo rje theg() / rgyud sde (kyematha' dag khyad par bla med (yidon/ / rim gnyis (totha' dag khyad par sgyu lus (spra/ / sngon med legs bshad (yinater chen khyod la 'dud/ / mdor na thub bstan mtha' dag ma lus pa/ / bshad sgrub gnyis kyis ches cher gsal mdzad pa/ / gangs can 'di na bstan 'dzin mtha' dag gis/ / rtag tu bsngags par 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ / bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / bdag nyid chen pokhyod bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan/ / bdag bas gzhan gces lhag bsam phul byung gis/ / bdag gi srog ltar srung bar byin gyis rlobs/ / khyod la gtsor byas ha cang mchog 'dzin gyi/ / phyogs lhung gdon gyis thub bstan dkrugs pa yang / / dag snang (7sgrogs med thugs mnga' khyod nyid kyis/ / myur du ba~X snakā snrunān 'dzin mthun gyur cig/༷rgyal ba/ sangs rgyasakyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs te/ phung bo'i bdud/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/'ashā bdakā gi /dud/ /lha'i bu'i bdud bcas bdud bzhi lasarnam par rgyal bsan rgyal duḥl pa~Xd spo/nga ba/'i sems pa ste/ tshul 'chal gyi gdung ba sel ba'am rang gi kha na ma tho ba spong ba'i sems pa'o/ /ming gi rnam grangasal nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims rnams so/ /(nyangs pa/ rang gi yon tan sogs legs par rlom zhing gzhan la mthong chung byed pa'i bsam pa dang spyod pa'i ming ste/ khengasapa skyungs/ khengs pa spongs ltabu/ tshig bsdus na mkhengs mizhes 'bri chog ste/ nga rgyal khengs dregs ma skye/ rgyun du khengasaskyungasagyisaltabu/()grub mtha'/ spyir grub mtha' zhesapa ni lung rigasagang rung la brten nasarnam rtog gis sgro btags pa'i cha gzhan bkag ste rang gi blo ngor yang dag par 'thad pa'i don de nyid grub pa'am dam bcas te 'dzin pa'i tshul de lasagazhan du med do snyam nasathag bcad pa'i cha de la grub mtha' zhes bya ba dang thag bcad pa de gzhan la smra bas na grub mtha' smra ba zhes zer/98 de yang grub mtha'i skad dod la/ si snya zer zhing de don mang bor 'jug kyang skabs 'dir ni

si grub pa dang an+ta mtha' la go dgos pas de gnyis mtshams sbyar bas grub mtha' zhesapa yin te/ rang gi rigs pas grub cing / de las phar yang 'gro ba med pas na mtha'o/ /()'dul ba/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa (chosasgor zhugasapa'i dge bsnyen dang / rab sbyong / dge slong rnams kyi bslab khrims )brjod bya'i gtso bor byasanas ston pa'i sde snod la ()mastun/ nyid/ mdo phyogs gzhung chen bka' pon lnga ste/ tshad ma/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/rjo〉spyad// skatānākā r+sharji r+shar+sha/ lam 'bras bu gsum gyi sgo nasarang gisashesabya'i gnas tshul dang du/dri shālha ༵ 'ardospya ( sbri kā /da daX ༷/ sdir+sha/na sgrub pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gnyis/()mdo sngags/ mdo sngags gnyisarno/ dbang bo rtul bo chags bral gyi lam la mos pa la rgyu lam byed ston pa /do k+to sde snod gsu/ dang sde/ da/zlo po rnon po chags can gyi lam la mosapa ༷/ trī d+dhir+sha gā lamasto wadapa tre /su d+dhikā sapa 'i // gi jim cho/ sa/ gang zhig yul mi spong bar lam du byed pa'i myur bde'i thabasakhyad par du 'phags shing rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod pa'i tshul gtso bor ston pa'i rigs su gnas/ rjod byed brjod bya zag med kyi bde ba'i rgyu lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa rnams dang / de'i phyogasasu gtogs pa rnams kyang ste de dag la/ gsang sngags kyi 31 dang zhe/ rgyud sde hāng / rdo rje theg pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dang /nyardzu/ ji /buswā gag pa ༵ na r+shakya /saX snga/ga/sa rdo rje theg pa'i dbang dang / lam gyi rnam gzhag sgrub thabs las tshogs sogs ci rigs ston pa'i chos kyi sde tshan/smyo'i med/ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med du sbyor bas rnal 'byor/ rgyud thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pas na chen po/ de'i gong na rgyud gzhan med pasan bla na med pa/gronarim gnyis/ sngags lam gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis/(smosgyu lus/ yul can bde ba chen po nyid yul sgyu ma ltar 'char ba'i bogs 'don par byed pa'i phyir lam gyi bogs 'don ni sgyu lus te/ de'i sgra don yang / rnam pa med kyang rnam pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa'am/ snang yang rang bzhin ma grub pa'i phyir sgyu ma'i lus zhes bya'o/ /rkunaspegs bshad/ spyir legs par gsungs pa dang legs bshad ces pa la bka'i dbang du byasapa dang de ma yin pa tshul gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ (lha'i bugazhusapa'i ma/ /las

chosarnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'dus/ / legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel te/ /zhes legs par gsungs pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' kho na la byed dgos/ gnyisapa/ don phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i bstan bcos te 〈brgyad stong 'grel chen 〉las/ legs par smras pas zhes pa nyesamed par smra ba/ lhur byed pas 'brel bas brjod/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis bstan/ spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis bshad de/ gnyis gas rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyes pa med par smra ba lhur len pa'i sgo nas tshig snga phyi 'brel nas brjod/ brjod bya gang yin rang gi mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyisaka'i sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa ni bstan bcosal yang tshang ba'i legs par bshad tshul lo/ /0tāshā /dri sna/ ngasna ༵/ srid snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i zhing du snang ste sku dang ye shes kyis bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 rtsom pa pos rgyu mtshan gang la brten nas 'gyod sems gnang 'dug/2 snyan rtsom 'di'i tshigs bcad dang po gsal por 'grel dang /2 /sdu yig 'di slob sbyong byas pa brgyud khyed rang la myong 'tshor gang byung 100

mi la ras pa chung dus sdug mthong tshul/rtsom yig 'di ni rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las btus shing /rnam thar ni dus rabs bco lnga pa'i grags can gyi rtsom dpe che shos shig yin la/ bod khams kun tu ma zad/ de'i snyan pa 'dzam gling yongs la khyab nas rgya yig dang / h+pha ran si/ ri pin/ khyad par du ma yig ji ma ji bzhin du bsgyur ba'i dbyin yig thog bkod yod/ bod rigs sa khul nas bshad na/dpe cha 'di ni rnam thar rtsom yul thams cad kyi lad mo bya yul zhig tu gyur la/'dzam gling rtsom rig gar stegs kyi rtse mor 'jogs pa'i gzi byin shin tu che ba'i rtsom yig phul du byung ba zhig yin/ de'i nang don ni rje btsun mi las chung dus sdug bsngal tshad med nyams su bzhes pa'i skor bkod yod/gtsang smyon nye ru ka dus pa'i rgyan can/gtsang smyon he ru ka rus pa'i rgyan can ni/ 'khrungs yul gtsang myang stod stag tshal du myang ral ba can dang nyi ma 'od zer sogs kyi rgyud pa yab sngags 'chang sangs rgyas dpal ldan dang / yum sangs rgyas 'dren gnyis kyi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i agi ra zhes pa'i chu sprel (spyi lo 1452)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun pa sa stag (spyi lo 1458)lor mkhan chen kun dga' sangs rgyas kyi drung du rab tu byung ste mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshanā sbyos

gsol/ de nas bzung dgung lo bcu bdun gyi bar rang yul du slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad par tsa rir byon te rje btsun sha ha rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge dang mjal/ ri chos skor gsum/ thar gru skor gsum/nā ro chos drug phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ lhan gcig skyes sbyor/ do ha skor gsum dang mdzod drug ro snyoms sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos skor phal mo che'i lung gsan/ rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te gsang mtshan mi skyod rdo rje zhes btags/ de nas dpal 'khor chos sder byon nas g.yu lung ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i drung nas chos mang po gsan cing / de gzhan slob dpon kun dga' nyi ma dang paṇa chen don grub grags pa sogs bsten nas gsang sngags kyi dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa sogs mang po gsan/ gangs te se dang / tsa ri/ la phyi chung bar/bal yul sogs yul nges med du byon/ cha lugs kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku gcer bu la mi'i g.yang gzhi khrag can gsol/ rgyu rlon gyi ga sha dang gdu bu byas/ mi thod rlon par klad pa dang rgyu ma sogs rtsibs mas dkrugs te gsol/phal cher he ru ku'i cha byad rus rgyan dang thod pa/ rkang gling / kha ṭī rnams 'chang zhing dur khrod dang grong gseb nges med du byon nas tha mal gyi blor mi chud pa'i tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas gtsang smyon zhes grags/ mdzad pa ni/ bal yul gyi 'phags pa shing kun gyi zhig gso dang / grub gnas mang por bka' brgyud kyi sgrub sde btsugs/ snyan brgyud glegs bam du bkod pa po ti bcu gsum la zhu dag gtsang ma dang / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar ljags rtsom mdzad/ nyams mgur phyogs gcig tu bsgrims shing par du brkos/grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang las 'bras la rtsi 'jog che bas dge sdig chung ngu tsam yang khyad du mi gsod/ slob ma grangs kyis mi chod pa 'ardi/2/ yongs grags su thugs sras zhe dgu / thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs

sras brgyad/ bla chen bla chung drug cu/ rtogs ldan nyer brgyad/ ston sgom nyi shu/ grub chen bco brgyad sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/ mthar dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug pa rab byung dgu ba'i me yos (spyi lo 1507)lor ras chung phug tu sku gshegs so/ /mi la ras pas chung dus sdug mthong tshuladu/mi la ras pa lo bdun tsam slebs pa'i tshe/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan de bsnyung gzhi ()drag po rang zhig gis zin nas/ sman pa dang mo ma ()rnams kyis kyang mi 'tsho bar lung bstan cing bor/ gnyen nye 'brel rnams kyis kyang mi 'tsho bar shes/ khong rang yang mi 'tsho bar kho thag chod nas/ a khu dang a ne la sogs gnyen nye ring grogs dga' bshes yul mi khyim mtshes drag pa ()kun bsags te/ bu smad nor dang bcas pa bcol gdams byas nas/ mthar pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug pa'i kha chems yi ge rgyas par byas te/ kun gyis thos par bsgrags/ don bsdu la ngag tu nga da lan gyi nad 'dis mi gtong ba 'dug cing / des na nga'i bu 'di yang da lta chung 'dug pas/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i gnyen bshes kun la bcol gdams bya rgyu la/ ba'i phu na nor gnag rta lug gsum/ mda' na 'or ma gru gsum gyis gtso byas pa'i zhing sprang mig tu mi tshud pa 'ga'/ khang pa'i 'og na phyugs ba ra bong gsum/ steng khang na jig gser dngul zangs lcags g.yu dang gos dar 'bru'i bang mdzod la sogs te/ mdor na mi nor gzhan la smon mi dgos payod pas/ 'di rnams kyi steng nas cha shas shig nga rang gi rjes su thongs/de lhag rnams khyed 'dir tshogs kun la nga rang gi bu 'dis khyim so ma stu/ gyi

bar la bcol lo/ / khyad par du a khu dang a ne gnyis la bcol lo / bu 'dis khyim so pher ba dang / mdzes se dang chung gnyen bsgrigs yod pas/mo rang mna' mar bsu nor rnams lhag lus med par phog la/ pha shul bus 'dzin tu chug cig de bar la nga'i bu smad gsum gyi skyid sdug khyed a khu dang a nas gtso byas pa'i gnyen tshan kun shes so/ /sdug tu ma 'jug cig nga shi dur khung nas blta'o zhes gsungs nas grongs so/ /de nas yab kyi gshegs rdzongs durnams byas/ de lhag gi nor rnams kun kha 'chams par/ myang tsha dkar rgyan rang tshags byed du chug kha 'dzin dgos pa kun gyis zur nas ci legs gyis zer ba la/ a khu dang a ne gnyis na re/ mi nye byas rung drung po nye/ khong ma smad bunged kyis sdug tu mi 'jug nor rnams kha chems bzhin nged kyis tshags byed zer nas/ nga'i zhang po dang mdzes se'i pha ming dug lo rgyus byas rung ma nyan par pho nor rnams a khus byas/ mo nor rnams a nas byas/ gzhan rnams phyed mar bgos te/ khyed ma smad rnams gso res byed zer nas/ nged ma bu gsum la nor dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i khar/ dbyar zhing las byed dus a khu'i g.yog dgun bal las byed dus a ne'i g.yog lto khyi'i lto la las bong bu'i las/ gos hrul phrag thag chad pa la dres ma'i ske rags bcings pa gyon nas/ las dal med byed dgos byung bas yan lag rnams ser gar song / lto gos ngan pa'i stobs kyis kha mdog kyang skya la sha rin pa/ skra dang po gser g.yu'i ral pa nyil le ba dhil/ phyis skya bo seng seng shig sro'i ral pa nyil le ba byung bas/ mthong ba dang thos pa'i mi sems chung kun mchi ma 'chor ba dang / a khu dang a no la lkog lab dir re ba byung rung 'dzem med byas/ nged ma smad la sdug po rang btang bas/ a mas a ne la khyung tsha dpal 'gran du mi 'dug bdud mo stag 'gran du swāhā/ byas pas/ a ne la bdud mo stag 'gran du ming chags/ de dus

'jig rten pa'i gtam dpe la/ mi bdag bdag tu re/ bdag po sgo khyir 'don zer ba de nged ma smad la byung / sngar yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mi drag zhan kun nged kyi zhal 'dzum dkar nag lta ba yin te/ phyis nor yod rgyal po'i tshul du song nas/ a khu dang a ne'i zhal 'dzum dkar nag lta ba byung / a ma la yang mi rnams kyis lkog lab tu khyo phyug chung ma grung / bal 'jam snam bu legs zer ba de bden par 'dug ste/ mi go chod re med tsa na dpe 'di dang 'dra/ dang po myang tsha dkar rgyan khyo bzang gis mgo 'don dus/ mo blo khog che la grung / lag bcud che zer ba yod de/ da grung zhan gyi shan phyed nas gda'o zer/ sdug res byung na lab res kyi dpe der/ rang las zhan pa kun gyis rgyab nas 'phya ba dubyung / nga la mdzes se'i pha mas gos lham so ma re byin nas/ mi nor du ma song na/ nor mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba bya ba yin pas nor med snyam pa mi dgos/ dang po yab mes rnams la'ang nor rting sor byung ba yin/ khyed rang tsho la'ang nor yod pa'i dus yong zer nas sems gso yang yang btang /de nas nga lo bco lnga tsam lon pa'i tshe/ a ma la pha mas byin pa'i zhing skal bre pe stan chung bya ba ming mi snyan rung ston thog gzhun po 'ong ba zhig yod de/ zhang pos so nam byas pa'i nas skye 'phel du ci 'gro byas nas/ phag tu gsog gan yod pa yang mang rab tu song ba la sha mang po nyos/ nas dkar mo mang po la phye byas/ nag po mang po chang du btsos pas myang tsha dkar rgyan ma smad nor slong byed pa yin pa 'dug zer ba byung / de nas nged rang gi khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad ma der gdan mang po g.yar nas bting ste/ a khu dang a nes gtso byas pa'i gnyen nye 'khor/ grogs dga' bshes yul mi khyim mtshes rnams dang / khyad par yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku gshegs khar zhal chems kyi yi ge rgyus yod pa rnams bos te/ a khu dang a ne la ༵ /ga

'dzugs/ gzhan gzug thob pa la gzug/ lhu thob pa la lhu/ chang dkar yol gyi g.yang tshe dang bcas pa'i ston mo bzang po drangs nas/ a ma gral gyi dbus su langs te/ 'o lags so/ bu skyes pa la ming / chang drangs pa la gtam bya bar gda' bas/ nga yang gtam tshig gsum pa zhig gtong ba lags pas/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku thim kur zhal chems gsungs pa rgyus yod kyi mi bgres pa a khu dang a nes gtso mdzad/ 'dir bzhugs kyi gral pa rnams snyan gsan par zhu zhes brjod nas/ zhang pos yab kyi yi ge bklags pa'i mthar/ a ma'i yi ge 'di'i don gsung ngag dang bcas pa/ 'dir bzhugs kyi bgres pa kun gyi thugs la gsal bas rgyas par zhu mi dgos par gda'/ don dril ba la/ sngar phan a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis nged ma smad gsum la mgo 'don yang dag mdzad pa thugs la btags/ da nga rang gi bu dang / mdzes se gnyis khyim so zin par 'dug pas/ nged rang gi nor bcol rnams sprod pa dang / mdzes se yang mna' mar bsus nas yab kyi zhal chems bzhin pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug par zhu byas pas/ a khu dang a ni gnyis ci la mi 'cham rung lto la 'cham pa dang / nga bu gcig por song ba dang /a khu la bu mang po yod pa'i stabs kyis/ a ne dang a khu gnyis gcig tu dril nas khyed kyi nor ram de gang na yod pa yin/ dang po mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan kho rang khams bzang ring la khang zhing gser g.yu mdzo rta gnag lug rnams nged kyis g.yar btang ba/ kho rang 'chi khar nor bdag po la sprad pa yin/ khyed rang dbang ba'i nor gser se gcig yigam/ nas phul gang ngam/ mar nyag gcig gam/ gos dar rkyang sna gcig dud 'gro tshe 'dzugs gcig kyang mig gis ma mthong ba la da 'di 'dra zer ba/ khyed kyi kha chems kyi yi ge sus bris/ sdug smad tsho ltogs grir ma bsad par gsos pa nged rab yin/ lar (nya ngan la dbang bskur na chu la bre 'jal byed bya ba de 'di 'dra 106

la zer ba yin zer/ snam bu'i stan la har langs byas/ se gol gtogs/thu ba sprugs/ rkang pa brdabs nas nan tar ma song na khang pa yang nged dbang bas/ ma smad tsho phyir songs zer zhing a mar thal lcag gis brdungs/nged ming sring gnyis phu rung gi lcag gis brdungs/de'i tshe a ma ni/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nged ma smad kyi las skos la gzigs dang / nga shi dur khung nas blta'o gsungs pa de da gzigs pa'i dus la bab gda' 'o zer/ ngu zhing 'gyel nas khre log log byed cing 'dug nged ming sring gnyis kyis ni ra mda' (spro ba min pa ma byung / a zhang gis ni a khu la bu mang po yod pas rgol ma nus/ gzhan yul mi nged rang la dkar ba rnams ni ma smad tsho'i snying rje ba la zer mi ngu ba mi 'dug gzhan rnams kyang shugs ring nar nar 'dug a khu dang a ne ni nged la nor dgos zer/ nor khyed rang la 'dug pa/ yul mi khyim mtshes la sha chang phangs med bshigs nas ston mo bsham rgyu 'dug pa/ khyed kyi nor ram de nged la med/yod na'ang mi gtong bas ma smad tsho mang na dmag drongs/ nyung na mthu thongs zer zhing thon song / de'i phyi bzhin khong la dkar mi rnams kyang thon song /a ma ni de nas kyang ngu thag ma chod par 'dug pa la/ zhang po dang mdzes se'i pha ming sogs nged rang gi dkar mi kun a ma'i sems gso phyir bsdad nas chang lhag rnams 'thung zhing / a ma la da ma ngu ngus pas mi phan/ de ring 'dir ston gral du tshogs pa kun la nor slong re gyis/ nged 'di na yod pa kun gyis kyang ci drag re ster/ a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis kyang ci drag re ster yong zer ba la/ a zhang na re/ de ka gyis la bu 'di yon tan zhig slob tu thongs/ khyed rang ma smad nga'i sar sdod la zhing gi so nam gyis/ ci phan byed pa las 'os med/ gang na'ang a khu dang a ne la ngo mi tsha ba zhig byed dgos zer ba la a ma na re/ rang gi nor la dbang rgyu ma byung ba'i slong byas pa~X /ra

gyis bu tsha mi sos/ a khu dang a nas nged rang gi nor gyi cha gcig sprad rung ster dgos med/ bu 'di yon tan zhig slob tu cis kyang gtong / nged ma smad a khu dang a nas gsha' ma rang ma bcol ba'i rting la/ rnga gdang rgyug dang dud pa lang rgyug byas nas/ khong gnyis kyi mngon blo 'char ba yin/zhingagi so nam yang 'di ka nas byed zer nas/ rtsa'i mi thod gad kha bya ba na sngags rnying ma ba'i slob dpon klu brgyad mkhan grong chog la shin tu brin pa zhig yod pa der nga klog slob tu btang / de dus gnyen rnams kyis kyang nor slong sna re sna gnyis byin 'dug khyad par mdzes se'i pha mas rgyags chu sdor me shing yan bskur nas/ nga klog slob sar mdzes se mo rang sems gso la yang yang btang byung / a zhang gis a ma dang sring mo mi las dang sprang du mi 'gro ba'i dus kyi lto byin/ a ma sprang du a zhang gis ma bcug par mi'i las nyin 'khal nyin thags byed cing / nged ming sring la ci phan dang nor ci gsog byas/sring mos ci lcogs kyis mi g.yog dang / rnga gdang rgyug dud pa lang rgyug byas nas lto gos ci rnyed byas rung / lto skya la gos hrul ba yid pham pa las skyid po rang ma myong gsungs pas/ de'i tshe chos nyan du gyur tshad thugs skyo shas (kyenang nges 'byung (kro sgo nas mchi ma 'dor zhing dar cig kun kha rog par 'dug /ga/ ba/sngal gyi bden pa (lkol phyin thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa k+to sdu/kā snruswā/ /du mi la ras pa chung dus sdug mthong tshul 〉zhes pa'i rtsom 'di ni (rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsunayi la ras pa'i rnam mgur 〉la4bshus shing kha yig sgrig mkhan gyis sbyar ba yin/(rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur 〉ni rab byung brgyad pa'i sa sprel (spyi lo 1488)lor 108gtsangaston he ru ka rusapa'i rgyan can gyisamadzad pa yin la/ brjod bya ni rje btsun mi la

ras pa'i tshe gang bo'i bsngags 'o4pa'i mdzad chen bcu gnyisarnam par thar ba'i tshul zab cing rgya che ba rnams rim gyis bstan te/ thog mar yab mes brgyud pa'i 'byung khungs dang bcas te sku bltamasapa'i mdzad pa dang / gnyis pa nye ba dgra ru gyur te sdug bsngal bden pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i mdzad pa/ gsum par mthu bsgrubs nas dgra bo rnams tshar bcad pa'i mdzad pa ste thun mong 'jig rten pa'i mdzad pa gsum dang / mtshan ldan gyi bla ma btsalaba'i mdzad pa dang / dka' spyad kyis sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i mdzad pa/ smin grol gyi gdams pa thob pa'i mdzad pa/ nyams rtogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa'i mdzad pa/ chig brgyud kyi gnams ngag thob ste bla ma'i drung nas byon pa'i mdzad pa/ slar yang sgrub la yi dam bcas pa'i mdzad pa/ rtse gcig tu ri la bsgoms pa'i mdzad pa/ sgrub 'brasasngon du gyur te 'gro don:kha ba'i mdzad pa/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdusapa'i mdzad pa ste zhi ba myang 'das kyi mdzad pa dgu bcas mdzad chen bcu gnyisabastan pa'o/ /༵༵༵nga mi'/deḥkā kā // rngu sdidī kāswā sbyinā gzhi/rjodakri ༵/ 'dir mi drag pa ste/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi phyogs la dbang nges can ldan du/lhags rdzo/ngas/ gshin po'i ched du yar dkon mchog la mchod pa/ bar dge 'dun la bsnyen bstar/ mar ngan slong la sbyin gtong sogs rnam dkar dge sgrub gang rung byed pa'i ༷dri kāsnam/ḍil/ du byung ba'am ma dang bu mo gnyis/ 'dir ma bu gnyis la go dgos/༷pha ming/ pha dang ming po ste/ pha rgan dang pha ma gcig pa'i spun che ba/༷nyil le ba/ thur du sil bur 'phyang ba'am babasapa/()'phya ba/ gzhan la smod pa'am skyon sbyor ba/4)se gcig se ba gcig ste/ gser zho gang brgya cha la bgos pa'i cha gcig gi ljid tshad/spyilar/ gzhi'am rtsa ba dang spyir zhesapa'i don gnyis la 'jugayir mda'/ dpung rogasadang / zla bo/ rjesa'aded/ rjes 'brang bcas don du ma la 'juga.aṅgi /kārjerāḥswā par+shakā r+shakā / dri/ ba'am zhen pa gting nas log pa'i don/nyingeX 1byung / 'khor ba'i gnasabatson ra dang 'dra bar ngesapa dang de las thar bar 'dod ༷༷r+sha ba~X /gyi bden pa/ bden pa bzhi'i nang gses/ rang rgyu lasanyon gyi bskyed ༵༵ nyer

len gyi phung po ma dag pa'i snod bcud zag bcasa'abrasagyur gyi dngosapo thamasacad de/ de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi phung po nad ltabu shes par bya ba yin pa 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor mi bsru bar snang bsasdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya'o/ /bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 / la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin la dbye zhib cig 2 skya sna tā sdoka/ ra rgyan gyis dgra bo'i mdun du dpa' mi zhum pa'i spyod tshul 'dis don gang zhig gsal ston byed kyi 'dug/2 rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mdzad chen gnyis shod dang /4 rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar cha tshang klog ste rje btsun mi lar sdug mthong tshul rtsad 'tshol gyis dang / 110

rgyal po rwa ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud/gtam rgyud 'di ni khyab 'jug gi ma zhi ba'i 'jug pa bcu'i nang tshan/rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu rwa ma ṇa'am dga' byed du sprul nas/ srin po lang ka mgrin bcu bsad par phyi rol pa la grags pa de nyid do/ rtsom de'i brjod bya gtam rgyud de nyid las btsams shing / rjod byed mkhas mchog daji'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun par/ sgra dang don gyi rgyan rmad du byung ba sha stag gis spras nas/ snyan ngag gi rang bzhin gsal bar byed pa'o/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa ni/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum zhes grags pa'i char gtogs/ bod chos rgyal gyi gdung gis bzung pa'i yul gru zhang zhung zhes par grags pa la yab yum rigs rus cho 'brang phul du phyin pa'i rgyud du rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel (spyi lo 1404)lor sku 'khrungs/ chung dus yi ge'i phyi mo slob pa nas bzung bslab par bya ba'i chos gang dang gang la'ang slob dpon gyi zhal nas lan re gnyis thos tsam gyis tshegs chung ngus thugs su chud/ de rjes dbus su phyin te rje rgyal ba yab sras gsum dang mtshungs med chos rje dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs te/ mdo rgyud kyi bshad lung dang zab mo'i dbang khrid rjes gnang su bum pa gang byo'i tshus snas

gsan zhing / sgra tshad snyan ngag sogs thun mong gi rig gnas mtha' dag la yang sbyangs pa mthar phyin mdzad pas/ zla med pa'i mkhas pa kun gyi rtse mor son te zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa zhes rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i slob ma'i nang gi rnam dpyod phul du byung ba zung gi ya rgyal du grags par gyur/dgung lo so lnga pa sa rta (spyi lo 1438)lor 〈rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod 〉mdzad/ rje 'di tha snyad kyi gtsug lag ma lus pa la dbang 'byor pas/dga' ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin nang la snyan ngag 'di las mkhas pa ma byung skad/de nas nags shod sbrus mda'i gdan sar phebs nas legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston gyis blo gsal gyi tshogs skyong bar mdzad/ dgung lo nga lnga pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa stag (spyi lo 1458)lor thar 'dod skye bo'i 'jug ngogs chab mdo byams pa gling zhes grags pa'i chos sde chen po'i khri la mngon par 'dzegs te phar phyin dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/gzhan dgon sde chen po gu ru dpal 'khor gyi khri la zhabs pad bkod de mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyis bstan 'gro la sman pa'i bya ba mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re drug pa rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang (spyi lo 1469)lor nags shod spus mda' rnam rgyal dpal 'bar du sku gshegs/ rje 'di'i brtsams chos ni/rnam nges 'thad ldan gyi 'grel bshad dang / dus 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs sogs mdzad cing / mkhas grub rin po che'i dus 'khor ṭika chen rtsom 'phro lus pa 'jug rdzogs par yang mdzad/ gzhan yang snyan tshig gis yongs su srud pa'i lha dang bla ma'i bstod pa/ 〈rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod 〉la sogs pa gangs can bod kyi snyan ngag mkhan kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu ltar gyur pa'i snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i bka' rtsom yang mang po mdzad/112

rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud/rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam gyi rgyud las btsams pa'i snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mangs kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo bzang ()gzhal med khang chen du/ / bsod nams rin chen la chags te/ / bdag nyid la ni snying nye ba/ / sangs rgyas dbang gi rgyal por 'dud/ / zlos gar snyan tshig ro 'dzin dang / / bral ba'i skye bo lkugs pa ste/ / de lta bas na glu snyan dag / 'dod pas dbyangs can mgrin par bston/ / smra bo'i kha yi pad+mo mchog / ngag rig tshogs 'dis phyag 'os te/ /gang gi lce yi ge sar rdul/ / nges par rgyud mangs ma de'o/ / shes bya ma lus rgyud mangs kyi/ / khog pa'i nang du zhugs pa gang / / blo gros sor mos bsnun pa las/ / kun rig byed mkhas ma de rgyal/ /'dzam gling ngang mo'i rjes song ba/ / ngang ba'i sde dpon rnga yab duste/ / 'char kha'i dmar ba la chags pas/ / rjes song ā di gzhon nu 'odhi/ /dri med zla ba chu shel lhun po khong rab yangs pa dpag tshad bye ba'i khor yug gi/ /shel gyi rtsig ngos rang 'grogs 'od kyi snang bas skyengs gyur phyi phyir bros shing byer pa ste/ / kha dog lnga yi rin chen ka ba g.yo med btsugs pa'i 'ja' tshon chun pos brgya byin lag pa stong bar byed/ / pho brang khor yug keng shu'i 'bras bus me yi grogs bcas pha gu'i rig pa lta ba myos byed grong khyer ro/ / 'dzin ma dus pa'i gos dkar can/ / bar bar khrag gi spyazlo ka

'khyil/ /la lar khrag rgyun dron mo 'bab/ / rgyu ma'i do shal can de dag /mche ba ring bos nu ma gnyis/ / 'dral dogs mgrin pa 'degs shing rgod/ / drag shul spyod pa'i sa de yis/ / gshin rje'i grong la bag yod sbyin/ / mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams kyi rje/ / 'bod sgrogs mgrin pa lnga zung gis/ /lnga ba'i dus ④kyi 'jigs spang phyir/ / bde byed bumachod pa'i cho ga byas/ / dbul ba 'dor 'dod don mthun dag / rgya mtsho'i gru chen nang 'jug bzhin/ /'dod chen re ba'i me mchod kyi/ / tsha ba'i 'jigs pa'i lha chen ni/ /'ja' tshon 'dzin phyir bsnyen pa bzhin/ / de la ches cher ring ba nyid/ /rdo leb steng gi sa bon la/ myu gu sngon po re ba des/ / rang gi mgo ni 'bras yod bzhin/ / de yi sbyin sreg rdzas su byin/ / rigs sngags lcags kyu'i sbyor mkhas kyis/ / snying la zin to glang chen de/ / gshong bu'i 'dam stegs la 'dred nas/ /dza hu'i bu mo'i burgya mtshor lhung / /bdag po'i bka' lung nyi ma'i zer/ / phog pas u ma'i pad tshal gyis/ / mchog sbyin sbrang rtsi nye bar bstabs/ / rab tu khengs pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ / glang bo lag mang nga rgyal byed/ / sbrang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug pa/ / me tog la yang mdung dag bsnun/ / mgrin bcu dang ba'i bu mo ni/ / rig byed gdong gi pad tshal du/ / mngon par dkar par 'dod pa ste/ /g.yo sgyu'i mun par su zhig 'jug / ces smras drag po'i dga' ma duyis/ /dmod pa'i dug mda' mi bzad 'phangs/ / dus mthar khyod kyi rgyal srid ni/ / nu ldan dag (nyegis nyams byed shog / ces te lha chen gam du song / / brang 'gro'i kha chu bsdogs pa bzhin/ / srin dbang ba ku la yi shing du/ /'dod chen kha yi bur chang gis/ / myos pa'i snying ni le lo yi chu skyes khong bar 'dzin ma yin/ / tin ta'i 'bras bu ne tso yi/ / gshog pa'i godi sdu/ stod g.yogs can/ /ge sar nu 'bur mgrin dag gi/ / sen rjes

rkang stegs lhur len no/ /rta mgo can dude'i re ba yi/ / rgyu skar do shal 'god pa la/ / mtshan mo'i bu mo dmar ser can4)/ / yab kyi bka' las 'gong ma nus/ / bde 'byung ral ba'i skyed tshal du/ /mtho ris chu yi khrus rtsom pa/ / de tshe spre'u mig gsum can/ / 'di ni grub pa'i gegs yin zhes/ / yungs dkar rdo rje rdo tshogs dang / / hūṃ phaṭa (kye'abrug sgras ri klung bkang / / gnyid myos byis pa'i kha nang du/ / ma yi nu sor zhugs pa gang / / so non sta re'i 'jug pa ni/ / rang gzhan gnyis ka phung byed do/ / rta dmar can ⑩lha'i snag gi gnyen/ / lus skyes bskyod pa'i dri bzhin yang / / gnam sa 'khrugs byed 'thor rlung ste/ / dus mtha'i nyi ma gsum gyi mig / smin dkyus du ba'i ral ba can/ / mgo skyes gser gyi khu ba yis/ / skar ma'i 'bras yos za ba bzhin/ /de yi mjug ma zad mtha' yi/ /zhags pa 〈kyenam mkhar 'phar ba das/ / phye ma leb kyi rnga yab bzung / / nam zhig grub pa'i bcud len byed/ mya/ ngan med pa'i rkang 'thung ni/ / me tog 'dzum par dgod byed pa/ / tshogs can ma yi rkang gdub kyi/ / sil sgra las ni 'phyar g.yeng byed/ / mgrin bcu'i zla bas lha chen gyi/ / ri bong gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa ni/ / mgo bo'i nor 'dzin me mchod kyi/ / thun mtshams gos dmar can la ltos/ / ka ling ka (yiyi bdag po de'i/ / kha yi rgya mtshor mchog sbyin gyi/ /ga bur gang gā'i ji snyed rgyun/ / nga las longs zhes drag pos smras/ / ca co'i glu yis co nas 'dren (yikhyod ci yang mchod tshig ce spyang skad mtshungs lus gcu zhing / /cha lugs tsog bus cho ga la 'bad chu gtsang mchod yon rin thang che ba'i skyogs nang du/ / ja yi btung ba'i u ma'i jo bo ji tsam dgyes pa'i je 115

mang 'dod yon ju rtse'i gos sogs zong 'di dag / nya gang zla bar 'chi ba'i nyi 'od nye ba'i skabs med nyo tshong re ba nyung ngu min 'di'i slad du'o/ / te bor (1yun ring bya dka' dag / the tshom med par spyad pa'i tshig / de ltar ga chad (kyesmra ba ni/ / ni tso'i sgro thul can gyis thos/ / rtag tu 'tshe byed rta dmar can/ / yid 'gro'i srog gi bzhon pa ste/ / 'di dag 'grogs pa'i 'bod sgrogs srog/ nyal 'gro g.yo med re ba des/ / phyags kyi bdag po'i 4)sa 'dzin gdong / ba spu'i rtswa ljang gzim mal du/ sto/ rab tu gnyid myos zil ba ni/ /ngo tsha'i bser bus bcings pa nyid/ / g.yo sgyu'i me lces 'jig rten 'di/ /lhag ma med par za byed pa/ / thod pa can gyi ro 'dzin gyi/ /pad mtshor dbyangs can ngang mo dkar/ / kha yi ge sar pho nya pa/ / dbyangs can glog gi phreng ba ni/ / rgyud mangs sprin gyi sgra dbyangs can/ / yid ltar mgyogs de mgrin bcu yi/ / kha yi chu 'dzin mngal bzang du/ / zhugs pas rang gi mdangs bzang nyams/ / ge sar rdul tshogs la sred pa'i/ / pad ma gzhon nu bung ba la/ / ngo 'dzum gnag par 'dod pa ni/ / rang dbang gsod byed gdung bas phrogs/ / sred med bu yi so ldan gyi/ / 'gram pa dbyangs can zla ba yi/ / rdul gyi thigs pa mdzes pa ni/ / mkha' la skar tshogs phreng ba bzhin/ / gang gi kha yi chu gter ni/ / g.yo sgyu'i myos chus gang ba ste/ / de las 'ongs pa'i bab rtsol gyi/ / rlangs pa nam mkha'i yol ba nyid/ / mtshan mor rgyu ba'i mgon po che/ / rkang drug pa de 'chi med kyi/ /mkha' la bgrod par 'dod na yang / / re ba'i me drod nyams byed pa/ / lha chen gyis so bu yug gi/ /'tshub ma gangs ri'i zegs ma spros/ / rang mgo lnga ba zung gi ni/ / mtha' mar lnga ba nyid 'os zhes/ / dar dir col chung sgrogs brdi//sa/ / brang ni 'dzin ma'i tho bar byas/ / hwags ⑩kyi la du dhi

'dod pa des/ /byi ba'i brun dag thob pas tshim/ /de ni rgyal srid 'dzin ma la/ / 'phrin yig rkang rjes 'god pa na/ / rgya mtsho'i mngal las zla dkar bzhin/ / 'chi med bu mo'i lang tsho ni/ / glo bur nyid du rnyings byed pa/ / mdangs bkra bu mo mdzes ma btsas/ / kun gsal mngal las bde sogs kyi/ / bdag po'i rkyunyegazhu ni nyer 'ongs pa/ / mig stong rang gi lag pa yi/ / mtshon cha gzhan la dga' ba med/ / nyi ma rang gi grog mo ni/ / srin po'i grong na 'dug pa de/ / ma bzod rgya skyegs 'dzin ma la/tsha zer 'gyed phyir rings par 'ongs/ / dge 'am gzhan gyi mtshan ma yi/ /gzugs la blta phyir lag pa ni/ / dngul dkar me long gnyis skyes rkyunyekyi/ /gdonga'i co 'dri bzhin du bstan/ / kā ko la 4)yi srin bu 'di/ / chu yi grogs su 'os zhes smras/ / de nas de ni dbu phreng bzhin/ / 'bab pa dga' ba bskyed phyir btang / / rang nyid gar 'gro'i gtol med pa'i/ / chu klung dga' ma khyer te bros/ / khur bu'i lcid kyis ngal ba'i chu rgyun dzam bu'i grong khyer zhing pa yis/ / rdzing gi mal chen rtsi thog za 'os snye ma mtho ldan bshams par zhugs/ / der ni ngal pas dran pa stor te mig zum gnyid kyis non par gyur/ / mu tig phreng 'dra'i ba lang kha chu dra bas 'brel bar sbrang bu bzhin/ /lo tog 'dod pa de dag ni/ / gnyid kyi bde ba mi sems te/ / yur ba rnam par rgyal byed kyi/ / sgo glegs bsal phyir brtson pa bskyed/ / dag byed 'dod de bsgrims pa la/ / rin chen sgrom zhig rnyed par gyur/ / lag sor nyi 'od tshogs kyis ni/ / pad ma'i tshal de mngon par phye/ / mig yangs de yis ltar byed gzhan/ / ri mor bris pa'i mig tu byas/ / de mthong rdzi ma'i sred ldan gyis/ rang gi dga' ma 'khyud pa brjed/ / zla 'od 'thung tshe ku mu da'i/ / 'dab mas grogs la 'dud par dor/ / ched du gdags ༵ /da

par ni/ / de ming rol rnyed ma zhes grags/ /las dkar shing rtas legs drangs pa'i/ ci / rā ma ṇa ni gzi 'od 'bar/ / chu klung grog mos dor ba dag / me tog dus der lhan cig byung / /'ug pa'i rkan gyi sgra dang ni/ / lhan cig gtor len mig lhung bzhin/ /'di ni rgyal po dga' ba'i bzhin/ / 'dzin pa'i me long nyid 'os zhes/ / bsam pa gcig cig zhing pa yi/ / skye bo'i tshogs la byung bar gyur/ / de lus gser gyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ / rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes pa ste/ / snyan grags rin chen rna cha ni/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i 〈yirna rgyan no/ / sa steng 'di na sred ldan rnams/ / de yi gtam la chags gyur te/ /mig yangs mdzes ma gzhan dag la/ / rmi lam du yang chags ma gyur/ / dbyangs can ming ni gzung 'os te/ / spra mo'i lag pa su zhig 'dzin/ / skye dgu'i rig sngags mkhan de rnams/ / sī hā'i ming gi bzlas brjod kyis/ / 'gram pa rus pa'i 'phrul 'khor ni/ / dral ba nu ma'i ngogs su 'phyang / /lang tsho de ni 'dzin byed pa'i/ / rgyal pos rang srid phu nu tshul/ / khyi yi zas bzhin byin gyur te/ /'di yi mdzes pa gzhan dag gi/ /mig gis mthong na'ang mi rung zhes/ / sems shing sems shing nags su song / / phyugs kyang rtswa dag mi sems na/ gcan gzan spong la mtshar ci yod/ / ces bsams phu nu la ghu yis/ / rgyal srid tha chung 'jigs sde (1la/ / rigs kyi rgyal sa de byin nas/ / des kyang nags tshal mdzes par byas/ / de dag nags kyi lha yin te/ / nags tshal bdag po 4)de yi bran/ / gnyis ni 'dod pa'i bde ba dang / /gcig ni bsam gtan bde bas tshim /de tshe lang ku'i bdag po'i snying ni rang gi dga' mar chags pa'i bdud rtsis mngon par khengs pa ci yang 'dzin/ / kwa ye yid kyi re ba'i pir gyis ri mo /sdus pa'i lang tsho 'bri byed kho bo'i lag pa gcig nyid de/ /'di yi 'gran

zla gnyis pa yod ces mang thos 'dod pas khyed cag ne tso'i gtam rjes 'jug pa 'ga' yod dam/ / zhes smras lan du 'khor gyi skye bo sī tā'i ming gi mdung thung rnon pos sgra 'dzin phug rnams 'di skad lo/ / mi gang mang du ma thos pa/ / de dag khron pa'i nya yin te/ / gnag rdzi rang gi g.yas zhar mar/ /dbang pos 'khyud par dogs pas gdungs/ / de thos mgrin bcu'i snying la ni/ / chags pa'i dug mda' dam pos zin/ / drang srong gis ni dmod pa bzhin/ / rang nyid dud 'gro'i gzugs su byas/ / dga' ba byed kyi skyed tshal bcom/ /'dam bu'i tshal rnams glang pos bzhin/ /sā tā'i snying ngo gdon tshogs kyi/ / chu 'dzin sgra dbyangs g.yo ba can/ / ro 'dzin glog gi gzhu las ni/ / sa skyong ri dwags 'di zungs zhes/tog sgra dang bcas gnam lcags kyis/ / bdag po'i sgra 'dzin ci yang dkrugs/ / kwa ye nyon cig sa 'di la/ gdugs dkar gcig gis khyab pa yang / / dor na dbang phyug skra phreng ni/ / bsrung na nam mkha' lhod pa'o/ /gang yang mna' yi bka' mchid ut+pal sngon po'i phreng 'di mig zur dang 'grogs rna ba'i rgyan du 'os pa ste/ / rnam bkra dbang bo'i gzhu mchog la sred nu zho'i lto can gom pa'i 'gros 'khyor phyogs bslad mgron por rkyunyegyur ces thos/ bye ma'i rdul brtsegs phrag pa la zhon nyi ma'i chu rgyun me tog dus 'dir ri dwags lus la ngal pa ster/ /dri med shel gyi rtsig ngos la chags rab bkra'i pad tshal pir gyi ri mos bung ba'i 'gram pa nyams so lo/ / zhe sdang chu yis khyer ba de/ / tshig gi chu char mi 'dod de/ sos ma'i tsha bas gdung ba ni/ /me yi 'od dang 'grogs pa min/ / rje bos ri bo la 'dzegs pas/ / zla ba gzung bar nus ma yin/ /khro chu 'khyags pa'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin/ /sor mo'i rtse mo bsrel ba dag / mthu mchis na ni nam mkha' yi/ / me long 'dzin la skyabs ci 'tshal/ / rol rnyed ma ni nga ro can/ /khyi dag rang mtshang1 /snang

mthon pos/ / dgra bo'i skyon bzhin nags tshal du/ / nam mkha' 'gongs pa'i sgra chen byas/ / gzhu 'dzin rje bo rā ma ṇas/ / ri dwags gzung bar ma nus te/ / 'theb long 4)sbyor ba med pa 'ga'i/ / tshig mda'i shugs kyis 'ben dag phug /yan lag cung zad nyams gyur na/ /sman dpyad dka' ba ma yin yang / /snying la tsher ma zug na ni/ /tsher 'dzin dag gis 'don par dka'/ /legs bshad smra ba rnam dpyod can/ / mkhas pa nyid do co 'dri'i tshig / mdza' bo'i gnad du bsnun pa la/ /blun po las ni mkhas pa su/ /chung ma tshig gi rta dmar can/ / dus mtha'i rlung yi'adras g.yos pa de/ /khros kyang gzhung bzang ma btang bas/ / rta gdong me 4)dang mtshungs pa yi/ /'obs kyi ra ba'i 'od chen ni/ /la bhū na dang mna' mar bcas/ dgra bo'i mun pa sel phyir byas/ / rang nyid rngon pa'i brtul zhugs blangs/ /ngang ba shug gis dor ba dang / /gnyis 'thung glang mos dor 'dra ste/ /nyi ma gzhon nu'i phyogs 'gro ba'i/ /ri dwags grib ma bzhin du song / /skabs der mtshan mo rgyu ba'i mgon/ / rang gi bu mo la chags pas/ /kun nas rmongs pa'i gdong mun can yi/ / sī tā'i zla ba bzung phyir 'ongs/ / de gzugs slong ba bor bcos shing / / ngag gi gdangs ni sa yi mgon 4)/ /rā ma ṇa ltar 'chos pa des/ / yi ge gsal ba min par ni/ /sī tā sī tā zhes pas bos/ / bud med ngang tshul mi brtan pas/ / yid bsdus 4yil ni gtam 'di smras/ / rab tu bsnyel ldan rgyal po'i gsung / /bdag ming sgrogs pa 'di gzigs sheg / brnangs pa lta bu'i tshig 'di las/mtshon na mgon de nyams su dogs/ / thub yid bsdus sam bsam gtan la/ /mnyam bzhag rna ba'i bu gar ni/ /'os pa min pa kun bzhus pa'i/ /khro di ༵ de blug par bya/ / bkra shis dang ni khyim gyi dbang / / lhan cig pha

rol skyod byas pa'i/ / sna nag ma 4nyedemu cor gyis/ / 'khrugs te kha las so lhung bzhin/ / bzhin gyi char sprin nag po las/ / ser ba drag po 'bab pa nyid/ / drag po'i dga' ma khros pa yi/ / dmod pa'i dug chu 'di yin te/ /'di yis sa yi bdag po che/ / thu bo rngon par byas pa'o/ / skal ngan ma 'dis sdig pa yi/ / dug gi tsher ma'i sa bon btab/ / ltos shig rā ma ṇa yi stobs/cha tsam 'dzin pa'i lus can dang / / mkha' lding gshog pa'i rtsal la ni/ /'granakhyed sgro ldan su zhig yod/ / snang ba'i bdag po sha ba ris 4)/ /mgyogs chen ri dwags zla ba'i lus/ / tsha zer mda' yis bkas pa yis/lus phyed mkha' la snang 'di'o/ / de yis drang bo'i rtsub tshig dang / rab tu kyog pa'i dpe bstan kyang / / chu phran bzhin du ca co dang / mngag gzhug ma bzhin ches chung gi / tshig dag smra la goms pa des/ / rgya mtsho'i 'khor lor slebs bzhin byas/ / mchod sbyin 'o 'tsho las 'ongs pa'i/ 'chi med lang tsho'i 'dab brgya 'di/ / dbyar skyes grogs dang bral ba na/ / ba mo 'di dag 'khyud snyam sems/ /rje bo'i nyi ma nub gyur cing / / yid dga'i 'dab ma zum pa na/ /lcags kyi sgro ldan chu skyes kyi/ / sbrang rtsi 'thung bar 'dod snyam des/ / de thos kyos po rab brtan kyang / / sa g.yos shing bzhin 'khrugs te 'dar/ / 'od kyi dra ba dus rma tha' yi/ / bsreg za'i 'khor lor byin brlabs te/ / tshang zla dang ni dran pa dag / lhan cig stor bar 'tshol phyir song / / mig 'phrul rjes song dub pa de/ / gzhu mchog ngal gso'i gnas su gyur/ / gnam ru'i mgo la lag pa gnyis/ / bsnol te re zhig gnyid kyis log / ma bgros na yang ut+pal rnams/ / de yi rna long mchod 'os zhes/ / bsams te gzhu rgyud la 'khril bas/ / ta la'i srid du mngon par 'phags/ /la ghu ma na mya ngan gyi// thang la dub pas gom 'gros 'khyor/ / brtson pa'i lcag gis gnādi pa

des/ / rta gdong me lce bzhin du'o/ / dbang bo'i gzhu yis bkra ba yi/ /ut+pal sngon po'i ri bo ni/ / yin dra nī la'i thor cog can/ / mthong 'di lhun po yin snyam byed/ /'di las phu bo mtshon par byas/ / bsams te de yi drung du song / / ut+pal chun pos rna lung dang / / sna bug nor de 'gags pa thob/ / rā ma r+ṇa yi gnyid dang ni/ / phu nu'i mya ngan mnyam du sangs/ /mig 'phrul yin yang ri dwags de/ / dpung pa gtum po des 'jigs te/ / stong ba'i ngang du bros pa ni/ / ston ma'i sprin dag yal ba bzhin/ / 'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i thig ler ni/ / lhun po sngon med gnyis byung ste/ / 'dzin ma'ang khur bo 'di theg pa/ / e ma shin tu stobs dang ldan/ / 'du byed ngang tshul rig pa yi/ / dpa' bo de gnyis 'khor lo bzhin/ / sa 'dzin khyon ni 'jal ba 'dras/ / dka' thub nags su mngon par gshegs/ /'od kyi dra ba'i lding khang na/ / dpal mo chu yi ma ma can 4)/ / lta byed dkyus ring ut+pal zung / / zil ba 'god pas ci yang brel/ / nu ma'i bar ni dog par yang / / khu tshur yab kyis bskrun pa yi/ / 'o ma 'dzin pa gsum pa zhig / khrang zhing rgyas pa rnam par mdzes/ / ro 'dzin skyed tshal nyams dga' bar/ / rab dkar so phreng ku mud tshogs/ / 'dab ma 'dzings pas 'dam bu'i tshal/ / bsreg zas zos pa'i sgra yang ngo / / rig 'dzin rnams dang bla ma yang / / rang dbang bral bas dmar ba yi/ / thun mtshams ma 'di'i mdzes pa ni/ / chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi dpung / / rab tu chags pa mi zad pa'i/ / chu yis gang ba'i ril ba dang / /sred pa'i srad bu se ral khar yi /'phyang ldan srin po'i dbang bo ni/ / drang srong gzugs can nye bar 'ongs/ / de ni bza' ba gzhan 'dod kyang / / ku ba'i phor bu stong ba yis/ / kha zas 'dod pa go bar byas/ / mchod 'os 'di yis zas zos nadi/22/ bdag nyid bdag po'i bkres pa bsal/ / skyed tshal du ni chu zhugs

pas/ / bung ba ngoms par 'gyur ba nyid/ / ces bsams sbyin la zhugs pa de'i/ /lag pa'i lcug phran 'khril bag can/ / bsreg za'i yol bas bsregs gyur te/ / re ba'i blo ni nyam chung nyid/ / glang chen smyon pa'i ral gri yi/ /'khrul 'khor rang phyogs nyams byed de/ / rta mgo'i cod pan 'dzin pa des/ / rdzu 'phrul gyis ni mdzes ma de/ / rkang mthil ri mo dang bcas pa/ /lang ku'i yul du khyer te song / /mi mthun rta dmar can 'grogs pa'i/ / gru nang gnas pa'i tshong dpon bzhin/ / chung ma'i slad du mkha' lding gis/ /ngang ba'i bu mo bzung ba bzhin/ /rnga yab gling ba'i sa skyong gi / skyed tshal de ni sī tā la/ / ya mu na yi spun zla (kyeyi/ / btson ra brgya las nges par 'jigs/ / ngag gi nyes pa can ma de'i/ / yid ni nyes pas ma gos te/ / rang nyid dug gi ljon shing du/ / mthong ba de yis 'di ltar bsams/ / srin pos nges par bzung ba 'di/ / sha khrag gsar ba'i slad du ste/ / las 'di'i sa bon grung po ni/ /sngon tshe zhing bzang 'di la btab/ / brtse ldan sa la spyod pa'i dbang / / 'gro la sdang mig 'tshub ma tsam/ / 'thor ba'ang spangs te sha dag la/ / sred pas ri dwags gzung phyir bskul/ / e ma 'di ni nges pa ste/ /lus la rang gis rma byung na/ / zug gzer bdag gis myong ba las/ / ri gzar 'bab chu su yis bzlog / bdag cag skra yi 'khri shing gi/ / dog po'i mchu sgros 'dab ma 'khyud/ / rje bo rkang ba drug pa de'i/ / sbrang rtsi'i bgo skal bdag gis spyad/ / yab kyi sen rjes zla tshes dang / / bral ba'i 'o ma 'dzin pa 'di/ /dug sbrul gyis bzung yan lag ste/ / sen mo'i gnam lcags dbab par bya/ / srin po'i ba mos ma reg pa'i/ / sngon du bdag srog pad ma'i tshal/ /yud kyis nyams byed mtshon dang ni/ / g.yang sa nam zhig rnyed par 'gyur/ / de yi snying gi me dugs ()kyis/ / skyed mos tshal de bcozlo /sa

te/ / ā di'i bu yang tsha ba de/ / ma bzod rgya mtsho 'thung phyir brgyugs/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams kyis ni/ /rigs kyi lha bzhin de mchod kyang / / bye'u'i tshogs la khra dag gis/ / bsnyen bkur byas pa bzhin du'o/ /de tshe sa skyong rā ma ṇa/ /smig rgyu'i chu yis bslus pa ste/ /'bab chu dron mo'i rgyun dag rnyed/ / sos ga'i gnyis 'thung dbang de la/ / lag ldan phug gus legs smras kyis/ / 'khur 'dzum 'dzum dkar nye bar bstan/ / 'di ni ba spu chu 'dzin ma'i/ / phang ba las ni 'ongs ba ste/ / ba tshwa'i chu 'dis skom pa las/ / ches che'i sdug bsngal byed par nges/ / rgyab ring ()kha chu'i zhags pa de/ / rkang ba'i gru yis brgal nas ni/ / khor yug ri bo'i mtshan ma las/dka' thub nags tshal phyogs der song / / rgyang ring nas kyang rgyal po mched/ / ngo shes gyur pa'i 'dab bzang tshogs/ / sde dpon bcas pas mngon par bsus/ / de dag chem zhes 'khod pa na/ / cho nge'i sgra bcas 'phur ba dang / / brang dag sa la sdeb cing 'bab/ / dga' ba bzhin gyi mchu sgros kyis/ / phu nu la ni don 'di bsnyad/ / zas la brkam pa'i rol rnyed mas/ / 'di dag sgo nga zos par nges/ / mkha' la lding ba'i gdugs dkar gyi/ /'dab ma g.yo zhing nye bar phyin/ / der ni rgya mtsho chen po yi/ / lus kyis bor 'dra'i gshong chen mthong / / nags tshal sī tā dang bcas pa /yid kyi yul du ma gyur to/ / rgyal po dga' ba'i rtsa ba ni/ / chad pas rkang 'thung sa la 'gyel/ / tshangs spyod dpal ldan yid bsdus kyis/ / dri bzang bsil bas gsos pa thob/ /'bab chu nar bo'i rgyun lugs de/ / gang las babs pa'i phyogs der song / / der ni 'jigs rung dmar ser can/ / mi rgod 'dra zhig mthong bar gyur/ / mig lpags chu 'dzin bar las ni/ / 'od zer dmar po 'di/sdu ldan pas/ / nyi ma'i gzi byin pham byed de/ / bstan pas mun pa

'phrog pa bzhin/ / ral ba'i rdo rje me char g.yo/ / lus skyes rngul chus lan bur bcings/ / dus mtha'i rlung dbugs ngar sgra can/ / mjug ma ldan pa'i srin po bzhin/ / gom pa'i grangs kyi 'dzin ma'i tshad bcal yang / / sa chen sdar ma'i ngang tshul rtsig ngos kyi/ / sī tā'i rkang rjes lo 'dab gsar ba'i tshon/ / dpa' bo'i chad pas 'jigs bzhin yongs ma bzung / / de tshe mkha' la gdong phyogs nyal/ / rkun po 'di zhes bsdigs pa bzhin/ / sor mos gzhu bdungs kun gsal mas/ / ngud mo'i 'brug gi sgra chen shor/ /mchog ma'i rwa las 'ongs pa yi/ / rdo rje'i me char tshogs kyis gang / / spre'u'i rgyal po lhun po yi/ / spyi bo nges par pham byed de/ / ral ba'i lo 'dab g.yo ldan pa'i/ / mgrin bzang lus kyi rkang 'thung ni/ / gzhu rgyal mda' chen gyis skrag ste/ / sor mo'i lcug phran spyi bor zum/ / spu phreng sog les ljon shing 'gugasakhyed glang chen smyon pa'i myos bum mthon po gser gyi byang bu rdo rje'i srad bus mngon par brgyus pa'i cho ga can/ 'phrog byed khros pa'i dpung ba gtum po gyen du 'phyar bas ral ba'i me tog mkha' la 'thor byed sder mo'i mtshon rnon thur du 'bab pas nges par 'joms/ / rgyab ring ro 'dzin phug pa'i bsreg za ches cher 'bar ba'i dug gi me lces lus can kai ri ()kha ba'i phung bo nyi 'od gos bzang gyon pa ste/ / mi bdag snying gi ri sul 'dir ni dmag dpung gdugs dkar lhan cig dor ba'i rkang gdub g.yer khas 'dzin ma'i rdul tshogs len par zhugs 'di rigs sam kye/ / de tshe mi dbang mgrin pa'i sgras/ / dril bu'i sgra la co 'dri byas/ / lag pas 'dzin ma'i khor yug ni/ / ra ba bzhin du 'khyud pa dor/ / ngal gyis rkang ba'i ri mo ni/ / sa la 'god par byed ni nyon/ / rgyu skar dbus su bgrod na ni/ / zla ba rang srid nyams byed pa/ / sa la lang tsho'i yon tan gyis/ / grags ldan sī tā khyod shes sam/ / 'gro blo rmongs pa'i 'dam rdzab tu/ / mdog legs dug gi ༵ /ga

byung / / mdzes sdug la chags sbrang rtsi de/ / bung ba'i ro 'dzin nyams byed de/ /ri bong mtshan ma de bzung na/ / zla ba bdag gis nyi ma yi/ / rgyal sa lasbed dor byas te/ / dka' thub mkha' yi nags su 'ongs/ / ma rungs dbang bo'i gzhu yi gzugs/ / 'dzin ma'i ri dwags mthong ba na/ / rgyu mangs dbyu gu 'di 'os zhes/ / se'u lnga zung (kye'adzin des smras/ / nags na gnas bcas grong 'dabs sems/ / chags pa rgyas shing rab zhis stongs/ /so gnyis (yidor nas ri dwags 'dzin/ / gnas min gnas su byed 'di zhes// nags kyi rje bo'i (yirna long la/ /'khyud par 'os pa'i rgyan bzang byin/ /nor 'dzin gdong gi gzugs brnyan ni/ / gtsug gi nor bus 'dzin byed cing / de yi gdung ba'i khur chen yang / / de yi phrag la 'phos pas ngal/ /mgrin pa'i rkang 'thung 'dar ba las/ / skra tshogs lo 'dab g.yo byed cing / / re bas bskrun pa'i gus ldan de/ / yi ge nyams pa (1byed cing smras/ming ris pir gyis ring zhig bris/ chu rgyun brub dus chung ngur byung / / de shes med de sems med de/ / mo mchog yod do cog thos sgrogs/ / rā ma'i mda' las 'gongs pa yi/ / ri dwags ya mtshan che ba ste/ / sī tās gdung ba ster ba 'di/ / kye ma de bas ngo mtshar che/ / ya mtshan 'di 'dra sprul shes pa'i//byed po de yang bsngags par 'os/ / thag ring gnas pa'i dgra bo ni/ /mthu chen yin yang 'jig par nus/ / snying la rtse mo can zhugs na/ thabs gang gis ni zhi bar bgyid/ / yang smras dang por phang ba yi/ / brang 'gro stobs chen 'di gzhom bya/ / phyogs las rgyal ba gnyis pa ni/ / bdag gi sor mo'i cod pan no/ / de gnyis bsam pa'i chu bo ni/ / 'dres te gshong bu dma' bar lhung / / 123shin rje'i mjug ma 'dzin de gnyis/ / lto 'gro dgra bo gzhom 'dod

bzhin/ / phan tshun 'khyud de 'thab pa las/ / 'dzin ma'i lto la ngal ba byin/ / nags tshal phreng ba'i tshogs dag ni/ / rngul gyi go skabs thob par gyur/ / kun gsal mdzes ma 'dar ldan ma/ / rdul 'tshub yol ba'i phag na 'chel/ / lha bu gzhon nu 'dzam gling mes/ / tshig pa'i dud tshogs yin zhes sems/ / zhe sdang tsha bas gdung ba yi/ / lus kyi gangs ri las 'ongs pa /rngul gyi 'bab chu'i klung chen tshogs/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i gsos su gyur/ /dgra gnyen mgal me'i 'khor lo ni/ / myur ba myur bar 'khor ba na/ / sa yi bdag po mig la ni/ / a long bzhin du de snang gyur/ / myur gro kriṇi sā ra (kyeyi/ / rkang ba'i 'degs 'jog su yis bgrang / / gdong bzhi'i srang gi tshad kyis ni/ / mnyam par byas pa'i shugs 'char de/ / pheg rdob sbyor ba'i lag pa bzhin/ / sgra bcas phan tshun gyes par gyur/ / nyi gzhon shar gyi grong las ni/ / ltad mo'i slad du lhags pa gang / / mthon mthing mkha' yi khang bzang gi/ / ba gam rtse la 'jogs pa de/ / g.yul ngo'i 'jigs pas byed sha thon pa'i()spyan/ / phyi bzhin gzigs pa dang bcas rta bdun la/ / bzhon te bros pas nub kyi ri bo'i steng / / slebs ma thag tu mun pa'i 'obs la brten/ / spre'u'i dbang bo shugs ring lcags kyu yis/ / sa bdag snying la 'debs pa bzhin du 'ongs/ / kwa ye nam mkha' lding gi mgrin pa'i phug /ne tso'i ro 'dzin mdzes pa 'dzin 'di mtshar/ / lha yi chu bo ral ba'i yur ba las/ / gyen du 'gro 4)'di dug can skal bas thob/ / de yi ngan smras gom pas sa spyod kyi/ / snying gi them skas yang yang 'jogs pa nyid/ de ni bcas pa nyams pas skyengs ldan zhing / sgrim mkhas le lor gyur te ngo tsha nas/ / sa la ches cher rtog cing lta ba yi/ / bka' nyan bran bzhin gdong ba dud par gyur/ / grong 'joms dmar ser spu phreng ni/ / ri mo'i gos la chags pa gang / / mgrin bzang mgrin pa'i gre 'gyur gyis/ / stong grogs lhur shāshā glu

dbyangs byas/ / phyogs kyi mgon gang dpung ba la/ / mkha' yi me long rtags 'dzin pa/ / de tshe grogs khyod sgro ldan gyis/ / nyin mo'i mgon po 'ba' ler bsnun/ / spre'u'i mgon gnyis 'thab mo'i slad/ / zhe sdang lag pa 'khyud pa na/ / stobs ldan sī tā'i bdag po yis/ gzhu rgyal gnam lcags byin par gyur/ /ut+pal 'dab ma so ldan gyi/ / mche ba bsnun pas lus bor ba'i/ / ro ni dkar mo zhes pa yi/ / 'ba' le'i dga' mas gangs rir khyer/ / mig yangs ma de'i mig las ni/ / rgya chen mig chu'i rgya mcho 'khrungs/ / de yi zegs ma 'thor ba de/ / rgyu skar phreng ste mkha' la rgyu/ /mgrin pa bzang dang dkar mo gnyis/ / dga' dang mya ngan lhan cig ste/ /gzhu 'dzin rje bos rang gi ni/ / mchis brang stor ba'i gtam de bsnyad/ /dbang phyug sras po nags kyi rje/ / lta byed gsum pa yab kyi rigs/ / ha nu man tha dregs pa can/ / mgrin bzang bran yin des de thos/ /sha za'i yul 4)du bgrod 'dod pas/ / mchongs pa chen po gcig bskyod de/ / rtsal chen rlung yab 'phur lding gis/ / dri bzhon bdag po'i grong khyer slobs/ / ma ni rlung lha'i rigs yin te/ / rlung gi bdag pos bza' ba dang / bca' ba lhag par bcas pas mchod/ / slar yang phyi rjes gom pa ni/ / chu gter phyi phyir log pa bzhin/ / dor te mgrin bcu'i skyed mos tshal/ / sī tā'i btson khang ra bar phyin/ /rā ma ṇa yi sor gdub kyi/ /rtags las de yi pho nyar shes/ / ral khur spyan sras 4)ral ba snum pos yab kyi gzhung bzang rjes su zhugs pa skyed byed ma'i/ /dza hu'i bu mo rtag tu 'khyil des rā ma'i yid la ring nas gnas bcas dri ma'i rgyun/ / 'khyud pa'i gegs su btson khang ma ma de yis rab brnyas sems kyi rnyog pa'i tshogs de yid 'ong dang / / phrad pa rnyed dka' lcags kyus non pa'i lag ldan gzhon nu rang gi da/shā sna'i bde ba bzhin/ / don mang bya bas gom pa'i 'gros/ / 'khyor ba

'di dag bha ra ta'i/ / 'khar ba la brten grog mkhar gyi/ / rjes 'brang long ba brgyud pa nyid/ / dmod pa'i chang gis myos pa yi/ / ba shiṣ+ṭha 4)ni thig le can/ / dus sbyor ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor gyi/ / rang gi phyogs 'di nyam pa thob/ / sna tshogs mdog can 'dam gyi mngal/ / 'dzin kyang rdul dang bral ba des/ / smre sngags de smras slar smras pa/ / chen po rgyad kyang chom rkun pa/ /nyam thag 'bros pa'i ngang tshul gyi/ / rjes su bsnyegs pa gnas med de/ /dpa' bo shi ba mchog yin gyi/ / g.yul ngor 'bros pa de lta min/ / bder skyes skyed tshal rkang 'thung tshogs/ / nags kyi gar mkhan spu phreng gi/ / sog le'i phreng bas gzer gyur pa/ / sa ldan sos bzung 'dam bu bzhin/ / rtswa dang shing dang gel ba dang / / 'dam skyed 'jigs pas snyem pa rnams/ / spyi bo sa la sbyar nas ni/ / spre'u'i dbang por phyag 'tshal byed/ / gsod bdag skyes rnams myur gsod byed/ / nyin mo rgyu ba'i srin po ni/ / dbang phyug mjug ma can de yi/ / rjes 'gro 'gro ba'i go skabs phrogs/ / mthar byed dbyug to 4)pham byed pa'i/ / mche ba non po bla 'og rnams/ / mi phyed phyag rgya bcings pa 'di/ /dri bzang lte ba can gyi ni/ / kha yi phug par gnas 'os zhes/ / grong gi bud med tshogs rnams sgrogs/ / mtshan rgyu'i bza' shing nags kyi tshal/ / do rar nags kyi gar mkhan rol/ / las kyi lcags sgrog mgul rgyan ni/ / mgrin pa'i rang byung rgyan du blangs/ / gshog pa ldan yang las kyi ni/ / mkha' yi pha rol 'gom mi nus/ /rgyug mchong thig le can de yi// spu nyag re rer sna tshogs mdog / sbrang bu'i tshogs ni ngal ba yis/ /'dar ldan lag pas 'bad de bzung / / ri dwags dbang po rang lus kyi/ / rma yis nyen mthar sbrang bus 'joms/ / phyogs kyi 'khor lo gzer bu dang / /'brel te dgra yi dpung gis mnan/ /sha khrag 'dod pa de dag gis/ / srog la thub tshod bcoms pa na1/29/tshe

yi dngos grub sbyin byed pa'i/ / bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha las lud/ / kwa ye ltos shig nags khrod kyi/ / bdag po nyes par byed pa la/ / 'gong bar mi nus byed po yi/ /khrims lugs nges pa gnyis yod de/ / de las 'gongs na drag po yi/ / dmod pas khyed cag cig char 'joms/ / dmyal ba rnams dang stobs ldan dang / / lhan cig sa 'og btson rar 'phen/ / gang yang mar me snum gyis ni/ / dngangs te 'chi bar byed pa ste/ / gnyen du 'os pa'i dgra 'joms na/ / skabs gsum pa 'os bza' ba dang / / btung ba bldag par bya ba yis/ / shin tu 'grangs par byas te bsad/ / chu klung tshogs kyis cher gang ba'i/ / rdzing bu bde bar gnas pa min/ / ci ga mi bzad nyes pa yis/ / blo chen srog ni 'gog pa na/ / snum ldan ras kyis 'khyud pa yis/ /mjug ma'i rkang 'thung bsreg zas 'joms/ / e ma blo ldan bden smra yi/ /dgra bo'i ngag ni su yis 'gongs/ / lha rnams dga' ba mtshon cha can/ /mche rnon rnams ni spre'u'i gzhu/ / 'bab stegs chen po bston gyur pa/ /gtsang sbra lhur len drang srong bzhin/ / li shi'i chu gter mngal las thon/ /rgya skyegs rang bzhin pho brang de/ / pad ma rā ga'i lhun po bzhin/ / de nas snying bor gyur pa yi/ / rin chen sbur len khang brtsegs ni/ / dpa' bo mgrin bcu'i gzhal yas khang / / mda' lnga ba yi 'jug ngogs te/ / brgya byin yid kyi lcags kyu'o/ / mtshal dang in+d+ra nī la dang / / margad gser gyis kha bsgyur pa'i/ /la cha'i grong dang grong khyer phreng / / 'dzin mas 'ja' tshon gos bzang bsten/ / gang gi rnga ma ri bo yi/ / gtos dang mnyam pa'i ras kyis g.yogs/ / de yis 'bru mar rgya mtsho 'thungs/ / de las dus mtha'i me ltar sbar/ /rgyug mchong rgyug cing mchong ba yis/ / rnga yab gling de 'khrugs par byas/ /nyin byed bdun dag shar ba yi/ / nags tshal chen po bzhin du 'di/0/ / tag ces sgrogs pa rtse mo can/ / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten yiza bar

rtsom/ / rnga yab gling ni gru gsum ste/ / mngon spyod me thab de nang du/ /srin po'i tshogs kyi yam shing las/ / drag po'i bu 4yiyisasbyin sreg byas/ / sngon med rig sngags mkhan de yis/ / dgra bo 'phrul 'khor sbyor bas bcom /skye dgra rnams la nam du yang / / srin po'i 'jigs pa med par byas/ / rnga ma'i snying bor 'bar byed ni/ / reg par rtsom tshe gzhil ba'i slad/ / dug can phang bar 47'jug rtsom pa/ / dug so skrag pa'i dbugs kyis bcil/ /kun gsod dgra des mchongs gcig gis/ / rā ma'i drung 'ongs gtam bsnyad de/ / yan lag bzhi ldan dpung gi rdul/ / chu 'thungs 'gog pa nye bar bshams/ /'dzam bu gling dang de yi bar/ / chu srin 'byung gnas dar ba dang / /che ba'i chu la sprel tshogs kyi/ /rkang 'thung zam pas sgrol bas chas// drang srong grog mkhar zhes bya ba/ / rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi bsam gtan pa/ /de yis nya mid ces bya ba/ / chu srin nya mid stong gsum gyi/ / stong chen lus kyi tshad 'dzin pa'i/ / zam pa chen po nye bar btsugs/ / 'bar ba'i lhag ma sgrasgrogs ni/ / dpung tshogs phru ma btab ste gnas/ / margad dogs pa 4)gser gyi brang 'gro'i lto yis 'khyud cing ke ke ru 4)yi mig dag rig rig glog gi lce g.yo brla yi ngos la rnam par 'phyang / / nyag phran tshogs ni mtheb long sbyor ba'i 'phrul 'khor gshog pa'i sgro ldan bdag cag gnam du rgyug la ltos pa med ces 'gran pa bzhin du mchong bar rtsom/ / gzhu rgyud mchog ma'i chu ma la rol dregs pa'i nga ros sprin gyi sgra la dman pa nyid ster 'on pa'i tshogs la sgra dbyangs ston byed ru mtshon 'phyar/ / me lce stong gi dra ba 'khrigs pa'i ral gri 'bar dang ral gri gzhon nu chu gri dang ni ka na ya ()sogs long long g.yo zhing tham tham zug pas phyogs kun 'gengs/ / rig dang sgyu rtsal mthar son par/ / dgra thabs mkhas pa dpa' bo'i tshogs/ / 'bros pa lta bustu spyan

cing 'degs/ / sa la 'byar zhing nyal bar rtsom/ / 'dar ba ltar ston g.yer bag ()byed/ / bzung zhing bzung zhing bsnyen pa dang / / kye kye haṃ haṃ chom chom zhes/ / khrag rgyun 'dzag ldan so sgra 'byin/ / ya lad tshogs ni dngul dkar gyi/ /dri med me long bzhin du 'bar/ / rngul gyi thigs pa rgyas pa yis/ / gser ldan ma la bsang gtor byed/ / rab tu tsho rnams 'gags te 'gyel/ / sdar ma 'bros pa'i gdong dang ni/ / dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs pa yi/ / gdong ba 'thab pa'i pheg rdob kyis/ / nam mkha'i ngos kun ral ba bzhin/ / so ldan sna zhags bskyod pa yis/ / la la lha yi mdun sar 'phen/ /'ga' zhig sdang ba'i sems dmyal me/ / rang nyid sreg pa'i phyir du sbor/ / gang tshe rang gi pha yi gros/ / goms pa dmar ser can dbang gis/ / mgyogs 'gro'i mgo (kyebral sgra sgrogs ni/ / 'chi bar gyur pa de de bsnyad/ / gzhu 'dzin dbang bo rā ma ṇa'i/ / gzhu rgyal mtheb long sbyor ba byas/ / mtshun gyi lha ()yi mtshon non ni/ / mchog gi mgrin 'khyud rdzu 'phrul 'dzin/ / rnga yab gling rje mtho ris kyi/ / them skas zhabs kyis brten pa thob/ / ba shiṣ+ṭha yi dus sbyor ni/ / bsru med rig par nges par byas/ /khrag gis dmar ba'i rgya mtsho ni/ / ba lang rje bzhin 'gongs byas te/ / rang gi yul dang bkra shis dang / / mchis 'brang lhan cig thob par gyur/ / sa bdag rgya mtsho 'phel byed de/ / lang ga'i mgon po sgra gcan gyis/ / bsgribs te gsang bdag nags tshal gyi/ / zlos gar mkhan po'i rdo rjes bcom/ / yongs 'du rkang 'thung 'o ma'i na chung margad khu ba'i gos gyon zhing / / mkha' 'gro'i phreng ba spu sdug rnam bkra bde sogs dga' ba'i gzhu pham byed/ / de dag glu dbyangs pi wang sgra snyan pad skyes mgrin sgra shang shang skad snyan bsres pa sgrogs/ / bsam gtan gnas 'di 'byung bo'i kun rtog gdi ni/ ting 'dzin goms par byed/ /lwa ba dkar po'i rdo leb stong / / ri

'joms dukun dga'i rol ba 'dzin/ / de yi rnam sgeg dman pa zhes/ /grub pa'i sa de khong bzhan bgyid/ / rab dga'i dga' ston dpal 'byor 'di/ / lag ldan chung ma g.yo med du/ / rtod thag gdags sa'i dbyug pa ste/ /thig le can gyi yid 'dzin grong / / 'di las gzhan na thar ba yi/ /bde ba gya nom rdzun yin zhes/ / chos dkar rgya chen mkhyen pa rnams/ /bzlas brjod phreng bas sor mo brel/ / bsngags 'os bsngags par mi byed par/ / bdag cag kha yi khang bzang na/ / bde bar gsos pa don med ces/ / ro 'dzin tshogs 'di cig car sgrogs/ bu ram shing ni kha ba dang / /bdud rtsi ro bro med bgyid pa/ / rab bsil ma dang 'grogs pa yi/ / rab dkar 'di yis zla ba 'joms/ /dpa' bo'i rgya las thar ba yi/ / ri bong gzhon nu'i gdong ba ni/ /rgyab tu phyogs shing rgyug ldan pa/ / mang po'i mdog can 'ga' zhig ni/ / sgra sgrogs rjes skyes yid 'jog gang / / u pa kur+ṇa'i drung du song / / 'o dod 'bod pa brgya byas kyang / / ting 'dzin g.yo bar mi nas te/ / sdug bsngal yus kyis brnangs pa yis/ / tab tab por gyur de dag gis/ / khro chu tsha bas rna ba yi/ / bu ga rnam par sreg par gyur/ / bsam gtan chang gis myos pa las/ / sangs pa de la shi ba dang / / rjes mthun lo rgyus gtam smras pa/ /mkhyen par mdzod cig lus kyi mgon/ / kye ma drag po'i mchod sbyin brgya'i/ / nyi ma las ni bka' bzlog ma'i/ / dmod pa me khyer stobs ldan te/ /wa yis gdong lnga pham byas bzhin/ / spre'u'i tshogs kyis srin po bsad/rnga yab dur khrod chen por gyur/ / zhi bar 'dod pa'i rtse mo can/ / rlung gis gtsubs na 'bar gyur te/ / me dang 'grogs na tsan dan yang / / sreg par byed pa bskyed par nges/ /mig ser zhes bya'i nad byung na/ / zla ba rang nyid gser du ston/ / zhi ba pa de 'khrugs nas ni/ / sna bug gnyis lastu /sa

ma tha' yi/ / mgyogs 'gro dmar po'i bzhon pa can (yi/ / rdul tshogs 'khyer ba'i dpung gi tshogs/ / spros pas spre'u rgyal po dang / / rgyal po las gzhan keng rus byas/ / gang yang dbul ba'i khu tshur gyis/ / dngul chu'i thigs pa bcings pa bzhin/ /dam pa rnams kyi yid las ni/ / khro ba ring du mi gnas so/ / bsam gtan zas 4yil sred pa de/ / g.yeng bar gnas pa gnas med de/ / ma yi la du la sred pa'i/ /byis pa shes ldan ngal ba min/ /na ra'i bu dang mi 'dra'i dpung tshogs rus pa'i lus can gangs ri pham byed rang rang lus/ / mtha' dag so yi phreng ba nyid bgyis g.yul ngo'i rmad byung rang phyogs dge la dgod la bzhin/ / dpa' chen ha nu man tha'i yab kyis dur khrod keng rus 'od ris skal bzang byed pa'i sman/ / dza hu'i bu mo'i 'o ma'i bcud 'dzin lha yi ri bo ⑦dzasbu py-ik+ṣa'i 'bral med grogs/ / bya ba byas gangasrid pa'i sbyor bral yan lag 'byung (nyezhes ngur smrig tshon gyis phyogs dag la/ / 'od dmar 'grems mdzad sems kyi dbang kun pha rol son gyur 'khor tshogs dad spro lag sor zum pas snying kha mdzes/ / de dag nam yang dge las mi g.yo skyil krung 'dzin byed tshangs pa'i bste gnas grub pa'i grong / /nyi mas brjed byas zla ba'i phon po rtse thog tshogs ni nag po brtsegs du'ajoms rgya mtsho'i bcud/ / bye ba'i snying bo bdud rtsi'i bum pa myu gu re re'i khu bas khengs byed 'chi med zas/ / e ma 'di yis mgrin sngon mgrin pa dung du sgyur byed de dag rnga yab rtse mos mchod/ / nags tshal bdag po'i mchong gar gyis/ /dpal ldan gangs ri ti se bsnyen/ / sman gyi rig byed ma goms pa/ de yis 'dod pa'i 'bras ma rnyid/ / sred med bu yi stobs 'char bas/ /gangs ri'i mgon po yungs 'bru bzhin/ /lag pa'i mthil du bkod nadi /4/ / sha bral nad pa'i tshogs dbus phyin/ /

lo brgyar bskams pa'i 'khri shing ni/ / skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun 'bab pas/ / skad cig nyid la lang tsho yi/ / me tog phon pos rnam par mdzes /dga' ma'i kha yi bur chang gis/ / myos pa'i sngo bsangs ba ku la/ / so phreng ge sar gsal ba yi/ / gad mos 'dzin ma'i khor yug 'gengs/ / gang gis reg na nyes brgya yi/ / rgyad pa drungs nas 'byin pa'i sman/ / dam chos rin chen dang mtshungs par/ / kun dga'i gter des mtha' dag tshim/ / gang gi rus pa'i dum bu yang / / mda' lnga'i bu mo skyengs pa'i lus/ / byed pa 'di yis rtog 'dod la/ / ngo tsha ster bas gangs ri khengs/ / mthong thos reg pas 'chi ba sel ba'i mthu ldan ming gi sgra chen ri bor grags ldan rgyal ba'i myu gu'i chu gter mchod yon zigs ma can/ / gang gi lto bar rkang ba rab bsnol mi de dag kyang zhi ba'i ros tshim sa srung bu yi 'dren byed chu shel li khri'i rdul/ / rnam bkra'i 'od zer 'od ldan du 'khrul sngon gyi lha yi glang chen dregs pa chu dang gci ba gang dgar zag ldan srid pa yi/ / thor cog mchog 'dis bdud dang mu stegs ka lan ta ku'i gshog pa ngal byed dzasbu nā da'i rkang 'thung gis brten ma pham mtsho'i/ / ra bar gnas bcas dpal mo khyab 'jug chags pa'i lag sor las gzhan rtsod par nus min 'khor bsgyur rgyal po'i 'bas mthil sa la min/ / tsa ta ka yi gdung ba sel byed bsil ba'i chu ni mkha' nyid las zhes sa spyod kyis smras stobs ldan dmar ser rje la'o/ /gzhan don sbrang rtsi kho na'i slad/ / 'jug ldog 'phur lding gis ngal te/ /lag pa lag ldan khros pa yi/ / sna zhags lta bu'i gangs ri 'phangs/ / mon sran de'u 'phar 'dra ba/ / lus ngan phyogs kyi rdul brtsegs dbang / / mgo bo yon po dud nas ni/ / slob ma mkhan po'i mdun sar bzhin/ /rnam dpyod rnam par yangs pa'i khyon gyis nam ma kha'i tshad 'jal rgya chen kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i dpe yis rjes su dpag bya shes bya'i dkyil1 ༷/ra
