lag pa'i mthil gang mngon sum nyid du gsal byed pa/ / zla med 'di nyid bla ma yang ni bla ma min byed khyab 'jug dngangs pas sor mo'i tshogs kyis 'khor lo stor zhing kun las rgyal ba'i be con can kyini dbyug gu bral ba'i long ba nyid/ / phyogs kun bslad pa'i mgron po'i go sar mkhas pa'i tshogs 'god glu dbyangs 'gyur khug bye ba la zhugs tam bu ra yi chung ma'i hu)mgrin pa khwa ta'i nga ro'i ngang tshul la 'jug yi ge gsal ba'i go skabs phrogs/ / ngag rig tshogs 'di thal mo sbyar ba'i yid kyi lam du dran dbang 'di yi snyan ngag shing rta rtag tu 'dren byed tshul lugs 'di mthong lugs gzhan dag ni chu 'od tunyekyis bkag chu shing nyid/ /mig yangs kho bo'i mig gis ni/ / dri med me long dngos kun kyi/ / gdong ba cig car snang ba can/ / 'gro 'di'i dpal du bston gyur cig / grogs dag phugs kyi ra bar ni/ / gser gyi 'khri shing 'di skyes te/ / mig dag don yod byed pa dag / dal bar 'dug pa mi rigs so/ / rmad byung shing rta'i srol btang nas/ / gnag gi lam du 'jug byed pa/ / de dag bdag gis nam du yang / / khang bzang bde bar ji ltar bkri/ /rdo yi sna can tunyechu shel gyi/ / dri med them skas la khrid nas/ / rnam par rgyal ba'i khang chen du/ / brgya byin gyis kyang gzhug nus min/ / de ltar rangs byed bgrod dang nags gnas rje'i/ / spyod tshul zhi dang bde ldan skyong ba can/ / nyam nga ba dang dpa' dang shis pa yi/ / ngo mtshar stong gi ri mo bkra ba yi/ / snyan dngags glu dbyangs srad bus nye bar bres/ / mang thos dri med sdeb sbyor lugs brgya can/ / spobs pa'i dregs pa kho nas 'di byas so/ / sa bdag sras po rol rtsed la chags pa/ / rkang 'thung rtsa nas 'byin cing pha bong 'degs/ / gyad dang nye bar sgrin byed gcod 'breg sogs/ /rtsal gyis pha rol gnon pa ma mthong ngam/ / ngag gi zla ba 'di yis ma bsdams pardi/36/ ca co'i dri ma'i ra ri 'dzin na yang / / lhun grub spobs pa'i 'od

rigs 'bar ba yis/ / nyes pa'i mun pas nam yang brdzi mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam gyi rgyud las btsams pa'i snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mangs kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa dri ma med pa'i rigs pa'i mig gis lta ba la mkhas pa'i mdun sar phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob cing tha snyad kyi gtsug lag ma lus pa'i pha rol tu son pa'i mkhas pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gi 'bas kyi pad mo la phyag byas pa/ yul byang phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba'i snyan dngags mkhan zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pa'i dpal gyis/ sangs rgyas ༵༵ pa/ // ༵ kā rno rdo kā kā/ shārnyi zlo/ zlozlorno dzo zlo bye // 〈sna /dri :sdo rgyal bzlo gli6 du rnam par bsdebs pa'o/ /ma//byed //nga la/ /srid mtha' 'gog byed rnams kyi gnas lugs zab mo ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs ()༵ dīhā gror+sha dīr+shadī sbya/ gling gi gling g.yog gnyis ni rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan gnyis yin la/༷/ rdo r+sha / ṅgi zlom sgri sditā / rnyirnyi nam shārnyi swā rnyi sdinal po'i // ༵ rnyinā rdo/ me/ sbyin skyes te/ de'i bu 0byi nā spra pa pa'i sdirdo sdidī /rdogs pa'o/ /༵༵༵ rdokā/ mo/lha nākāngag rdi/ rdo/ rnyi'i mitā sdo /sna zlo/ py-i /hu zhes pa bsam gtan la gnas pa'i tshe/ chu rā gaṅgā( ca cos rang gi bsam gtan la gnod par bsams te hub kyis 'thungs/desagaṅgā'i 'bab yul gyi srog chags rnams kyi srog la nyen pas drang srong la gsol te phyir du/sna 〉spra // ༵ rdo hu/ sdo /bye zlo/ sbyo/ /po'i dga' ma lha mo u ma'o/ /ཿnā /nā kā snangan ma hā/ sna/ ṅgi hā/ k+to bu/ ṭā tā //sa rno /dzes/ mas 'gram chu gto/ sdus kha

yi/ nākā ༵ byin /sna ཿkās rgya/la po mgrin bcu pa'i mgrin pa steng ma rta mgor yod pas rta mjo yi/shā/ byer/ can/ 'ardor lha dbang phyug chen po'i bu spre'u'i gzugs su byasapa de'o/ /:rta //ra/ hā/ //sdu me sdo /mdzod 〉du rta dmar can me dang me lha'i ming du bshad kyang /(tshig gter 〉las rlung dang rlung lha'i ming du gsungs pas/ 'dir rlung yin zhing rta dmar rdzi// shā hā/ zlo shā/ spya snar /spya tā/tha'i me'i 'gas pa/zhonaka ling ka/ bya rigs shig ste/ rgya mtsho'i gling 'ga' na gnas shing reg bya shin tu 'jam pa pakhoraglos bsgyur pa'i rgyal po'i btsun mo rin po che'i lus kyi reg bya'i dper 'os pa zhig (yico /shā kā zlo/ kā// skra nas 'then pa zhes pa ste/ (mdo sde rgyan 〉las/ co nas 'dren bzhin nyesapa'i tshang tshing nas/ / tshan gyis drangs te byang chub la 'god do/ / zhes 'byung la/༷dir sdu/ brdol spyang 'jugs kā las grol ba'i ched du mgrin bcus dbang phyug chen po la huX byeX/ nashi/ tre da zlog kā // pasra/ ba// dam pa/ drag pa bcas don mang po la 'jug mod byi/ /hā kyi/ /// r+sha// lhadabang phyug chen po/༵༵ /sa/ (byi / sdu ḍi dīpa ༵ /〉las/ mar dang / bag phye dang / pi pi ling dang / bca' sga dang / na le sham dang / rgyan 'brum dang / bal bo'i se'u dang / 'o bu'i 'brasabu la sogs ②pa/ 〉sna ༵ dh+ri ༵/ ga / sa byas bye zlo/sna k+ta dī/'i bdag po ste lha'i dbang po brgya byin/tshonaganyis skyes/ bya dang bram ze gnyibasal 'jug kyang 'dir bram ze'o/ /6)kā ko la/ dug gi ming ste/ (mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod 〉las/ kā ko la dang nag po yizloshāshā rnyi/ ba /ḍā/la snar ༷ r+sha// zlos tār+sha phyo/// sdo sbyo kā'i/ ga/zugs su bkod pa/1/rdophu nu/ rgyashā po dga' byed kyi nu bo la byu ma na zhes dro bod skad du yid bsdus zhes pa de bstan

tsho'i/ /chung/ 'jigs sde/ dga'o byed spun gsum gyi tha chung ming 'jigs sde zhes pa'o/ /phonanadris tshal bdagado po/ 'dir nags gnas ri dwags gcan gzan dang 'byung bo sogs mi pho)zlogashā /zlo/ /gron po// ga 'gro 'di 'gro'i phyogs ma shes par mgo 'khor ba'i mgron po/6)'theb long / mtheb long ste mthe bong la bskon rgyu'i krad kor/ mtheb kor yang zer/:| pa/byi ༵ rlungalho /phyoḥswākā kāḥkā sna zi/ kā /kā shāt+ta parazlo rdzu 'i rlung / /yinagadong mun can/ sgra gcan te/ nyi zla gdong mun par byed po yin pas gdong mun can nam yishā nā kār+sha/ zhekā rnyiX/ ste /'dir rgyal po rā ma r+ṇa ston pa'o/ /ཿ/ wa ṅgi nās// ba/ trī r+shadī nā shā ༵ / // bye sna/ 'a/dren pa ste bkra mi shis pa'i rnam grangs/yi/nga kā'i baXg po sha ba ri/skrusnang zlo'i bdag po ni nyi ma yin la/ sha ba ri rngon pa yin te/yin ༵ la shā ༵༵ kā nāg sdun su bad/la pa mo ni/ lha/ khyab 'jug bi chung ma yin pa dang / chu yi ma ma ni skabs 'dir sī tā la go dgos te zhing pa'i yur chu las byung ba'i phyir/ sī tā lang tsho phun sum rdogs pa'i dpal dang ldan pa ni lha mo dpal mo dang mtshungs so zhes 'bru mang po'i tshig po)/ shāl /༵// skud pas phrag pa dang mchan khung 'og g.yas g.yon du brtsol te btegs pa'i 4)༵ ༵ sna yi /grin zla/ ya mu na ni rgya gar gyi chu bo zhig ste/ ming ga'an nyi ma'i bu mo yang zer/mngon brjod kyi gzhung la chu bo ya mu na dang lho phyogs gshin rje gnyis spun yin par bshad pas/ rmi mu na yi spun zla zer ba ni 'chi bdag gshin rje'o/ /〈smome dugs/ mer bsro ba'i sman dpyad cig sman rdzas kyis thun hril bzos pa mer bsros yi/shā sdi/ ba/lta /bye /sdu sna sna/ la 'jug 'dir dug sprul la rgo dbos/ཿ/ / lnga/ /sna ya /sna d+ngha ༵ /spya /dang/ lnga zung ni bcu ste se'u bcu can gyi sems med byis pa la go dgos/ 139

byi/ /hā rdzu /rje ṭā/che dī /shā trī tā dī // paX/ ༵ swā/da/ do/ /klu'iyi ge nyams pa/ gtam gyi tshig 'bru gdangs nyams shing zhan pa/〈mekro sā ra/ bkra shis bde legs mtshon pa'i ri dwags khri snyan sa le zhes pa de'o/ /0byed sha thon pa/ shin tu 'jigs shing bred pa'i sha tshugs sam nyams 'gyur thon pa/nyalha yi chu bo ral pa'i yur ba las/ / gyen du 'gro/ / 'di yang sngon gyi gtam rgyud du/ drang srong skal ldan shing rtas rang gi phu bo dug can pa'i bu drug khri dmyal bar skyesapa'i sdug bsngal sbyangasapa'i phyir/ dka' thub drag pos tshangs pa mnyes par byas nas/ gaṅgā tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas sa 'og dmyal ba'i gnas su dbab par gsol pas/ tshangs pas gaṅgā la bka' babs pa ma brtsisapas dbang phyug gi ral bar btson du bzung bas/ haṃ gi ra thas dbangaphyug mnyes par byas pa lasarim gyis mi yul dang sa 'og tu babs par grags la/lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dbang phyug gi ral ba las thur du mi yul dang sa 'og tu babs pa yin mod/'on kyang 'dir gyen du 'gro ba zer ba ni mi 'os pa'i gnas nas rdzun gyi tshig thon pa ni chu 0gā spya ṣ+ṭṛ ༵ ba tār+sha /tsār+shakā hākā sdu'i don/4yispyan sras/ spyan gsum dang ldarno pa'i lha chen gyi rigs sras/4yib shatshe/ dmod pa grub par mkhas pa'i drang srong zhig bod skad du gnas 'jog ces pa ste ming de (rma bya chen po'i gzungs 〉zhes pa'i gzhung las byung /yimathar byed dbyug to/ mthar byed ni gshin rje ste de'i lag na 'dzin pa'i dbyug pa/4yitshangs pa'i 'jig rten/ bsam gtan dang po man chad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams/༷drag po'i bu/'olha dbang phyug chen po'i bu ste/ 'dir mig gsum ldan pa'i spre'u ha nu man tha rgya/rno ཿ/ ༵nga /ba// klu dug can gyi gnas yul te rgya mtsho chen po/yonadogs pa/ 'dir stag ral te stag lpags las bzos pa'i mda' dong /4)ke ke ru/ kha dog ljang ser can gyi rdo rin po che/ dge ta yang zer/4)ka na ya/ mtshon cha'i bye brag ste mdung gi mar sner tha gu btags pa'i mdung zhags/(smogayer bag / rgod bag gam sems 'phang mtho ba dang / ba'ad gad che ba/ snang ba che sa/yitāḥ/ ༵ swā lha/kā snal bzlorno hānā sdi shā dṛ kā ju/grina' /// rnyi sbya rdo/ rta/ mgo can yin pas 140mgyogs mgro'i mgo zhes bya'o/ /

byi/ hā/ snro ༵/ // sdo /nga/ bo brgya byin te/ dzomangon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan 〉las/ sngon ri rnams 'gro 'dug byed pas skye bo mang po la gnod pa na/ brgya byin gyis rdo rje bsnun nas ri'i rkang ba bcag pas 'gro ma shes la/ sī na zhes pa'i ri rgya mtshor bros nas yod ces bshad/6)mgyogs 'gro dmar po'i bzhin pa can/ rlung dmar drag tu 'tshub pa dang kun nas yi/hādī lha lta/ byi//ra nākā ṭī kā ༵/na shin sbyangs kyi bde ba'i zas/༵༵ / // 'a/byu/ bo ༷r+shakā shā//na bcu drug i ya rgyal zhig ste/ ston pa'i bka' bsgos ltar ri bo gangs can na gnas nas bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa/(minag po brtsegs pa/ dug gi ming ste/ sngon gyi dus su bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgya mtsho zhig yod pa/ lha dang lha ma yin rnams kyis bsrubs pa las/ zla ba dang / glang po che sasrungs dang / lha mo dpal mo bcas gsum byung / de nas chang zhes bya ba zhig byung ba lha 'thungab dang lha ma yin gyis 'thung ma nus pas lha dang lha ma yin zhesangaming so sor grags/de nas dug skyes bu nag po brtsegs pa zhes bya ba byung bas khyab 'jug gis mid pas dran pa stor/ lha chen pos de las drangs te mgrin par bzhag pas mgrin pa sngon por song zhesatso/ /sna/ can/ be con 'chang ste lha khyab 'jug dang gshin rje gnyis la 'jug 'dir gshin ༵༵༵ sdo ra/ gār+sha sna/chakā shā /sna kās can ma/ /73sdo yi sna can/ rdo snyermo sra zhing mkhregs pa'i sna can te mi gtsang ba la chags pa'i phag pa/⑨kā trī kā bod /ba bying sbyishā patā rdosapho sa/'i dzī /spyo ༵ ༵༵ rlon la go dbos/141

bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 rtsom yig 'di ni gtam rgyud gang la brten nas rgya gar shar lho'i snyan gzhung gang las brtsams bsam/2 zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig gi snyan rtsom 'di lta bu mi shes par nyes dmigs gang dang gang gsungs 'dug2 gna' bo'i bod kyi mkhas dbang tshang mas zhang zhung chos dbang grags /lha ༵ sdo/ zlo'i rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud 'dir slob sbyong gnang 142

snying gtam bzhi bcu ma/snying gtam rtsom yig 'di ni skabs de'i bod kyi chos lugs grub mtha'i phyogs ris dang / bod rigs nang khul la mthun sgril med pa dang / de bzhin dge slob bar dang / dmangs dpon bar la dam tshig med pa/ dpon ngan dul sungs mkhan mang ba/ khram pa dang rku ma/ jag pa/ zog ro/ mo ma rdzun ma mkhan bcas kyi mthil rtol nas/ bod spyi'i phyogs su langs te/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i lam lugs ngan pa mtha' dag la/ 'thab rtsod mtha' cig tu gnang ba'i dpyad rtsom khyad 'phags shig yin no/'khrug pa kun legs/grub thob 'brug pa kun legs mchog ni/ yul skyid shod du yab nang so rin chen bzang po dang / yum dpon mo mgon skyid gnyis su rab byung brgyad pa'i shing phag 1455lor 'khrungs/ mtshan tshe dbang rgyal por gsol/gnas rnying dgon du gnas rnying chos rje'i drung du rab tu 'byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs/ kun dga' legs pa'i dpal 'byor bzang po zhes mtshan gsol/ zhwa lu rje mkhyen rab mdun dge slong gi sdom pa blangs/ phastu snan

dang 'dul ba/ brtag gnyis sogs mdo sngags kyi zab chos mang du gsan/gnas nges med du phebs/ sku chas kyang skya ser pho mo nges med kyi tshul mdzad/dgung grangs don bzhir phebs pa rab byung dgu pa'i sa pho byi ba lor 152〈'das pa yin nam snyam yang / rnar thar du dus las 'das pa gsal por 'khod med/ sku 'das rjes sras zhing skyong 'brug grags nas gdung rus stod lung lam phar dgon gyi dngul gyi mchod rten du drangs nas bzhugs su gsol/ khong gi gsung rtsom ni mi rnams kyi ngag nas brgyud pa dang / sger gyi lag tu thor ba sogs mang po zhig yod pa grags kyang phyogs bsgrigs byas nas par du bskrun pa'i rigs la chos tshan rnams ka kha'i go rim bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam che legs gcig bzhugs yod do/snying gtam bzhi bcu ma/yang skabs shig na nged rang gi grwa pa rnams chos dang ma mthun sna tshogs zhig 'dug pas snying gtam bzhi bcu ma 'di smras so/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin ye nas stong kyang sprin dang na bun khug sna sogs kyi sgob dang gsal dang sna tshogs cho 'phrul ston pa nam mkha'i bdag po'i dbyings na 'khod pa yin no kye/sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas dag kyang rtog dang mi rtog 'dzin dang mi 'dzin sems la 'char zhing ci yang snang ba gdod ma'i sems la 'char zhing nub pa'i bdag nyid yin no kye/ / khro phu lo tsā'i snying gtam sum cu pa/ / tshig gi legs bshad don dang mthun par 'dug / 'brug pa kun legs rtsed mo'i kha sgo las/ ma bcol bu mo'i chang 'chol 'di smras so/ / dal 'byor mi lus thodi shāka' thob na yang / / don med tshe 'di'i bya gzhag mkhas pas

g.yengs/ / 'chi ba'i nang par 'gyod pas mi 'tshengs pas/ / da lta bsam mno gtong ba snying gtam yin/ / 'chi ba dran nas chos sgor zhugs lags kyang / / ser gzugs skya bo'i sems dang ma bral na/ / tsher ma dar gtums rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu/ / chos dang sems rgyud bsre ba snying gtam yin/ / yon tan cung zad skyes nas dge bshes byas/ / rig pa'i gnas la tshig rigs mkhas na yang / / tshig gi bsnyems pas don la mi stogs pas/ /gnas lugs don la bsam pa snying gtam yin/ / dbang bzhi lus la bskur ba'i sngags pa de/ / yi dam bskyed rdzogs 'bad pas bsgrubs na yang / /gdod nas dkyil 'khor chen por ma shes na/ / rnga brdung 'bag 'chams kyis bslu snying gtam yin/ / khri khar 'dzegs pa'i bla ma slob dpon de/ / grwa slob mdzo rta yon bdag gis bskor kyang / / byams snying rje thugs rje mi ldan na/ / rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / kha mkhas mig btsum thal mo sbyor ba yin/ / dam pa'i chos la mi bsam slob bu la/ / byin rlabs snying la 'jug pa mi srid pas/ / snying nas sangs rgyas sgrub pa snying gtam yin/ / dang po'i dad pa so ma skyes pa yin/ / ma brtags bla mar dam chos zhus nas ni/ / skyon mtshang rtogs nas 'dor dgos bla ma 'dis/ / 'di phyi gnyis ka bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / tshig gi go rim ma 'dzol don ston pa/ /rgyud nas rgyud par gdams pa'i dam chos 'di/ / byin rlabs dngos grub byung ba'i lam yin pas/ / rang bzo'i bstan bcos kyis bslu snying gtam yin/ / dgra gnyen gyis gzir rtab rtab dpon 'tshol ba/ / lan cig mgo bo thon tsam byung na'ang/ / rgyun du mi skyod khral dmag byung dus 'ded/ /brtags shing dpyad nas dpon 'tshol snying gtam yin/ / gzugs dang lang tsho rtsal ldan skad snyan pa/ / gser dngul mdzo rta'i phyag rten 'khur ba yang / / ma brtags bar du blo 'gel byed pa tsho/ / chen po g.yog gis1 dīsna'o

snyingagatam yin/ / zhu rten khur nas sa khang zhu mkhan mang / / bogs khral 'ded tshe kha mtshul rdza ri 'dra/ / chang ban gang gis khal brgya'i gtan khra zhu/ /'di 'dra'i mi des bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / phra rags rtog pa zhi ba'i mnyam bzhag 'dis/ / gsal stong gnyug ma'i rang ngo mthong lags kyang / /rgyu 'bras khyad gsod stod lta had po du'adis/ don gyi gnas lugs mi rtogs snying gtam yin/ / rdzogs chen chos rnams kun gyi mthar thug ste/ /gdod ma'i mgon po'i 'od tsho mi 'gyur la/ / byas chos byis pa'i rtsed mo'i mgo skor 'dis/ / zab lam za chog bsgyur ro snying gtam yin/ / mtha' bral zung 'jug dbu ma'i lta ba 'di/ / yid la mi byed gzung 'dzin lam las 'das/ / gcig dang du bral rtag chad go yul 'dis/ / zab chos rtog ger bsgyur ro snying gtam yin/ / sems can snying rjes rjes su 'dzin pa la/ /rten 'brel bsdu ba bzhi pos sgrig dgos rgyur/ / ri bsnyil mtsho dkrug shing gnyan gcod pa ()'dis/ / 'dre srin sems rgyud dkrug go snying gtam yin/ / rang gi sems kyi gdug rtsub zhi ba na/ / sems can kun gyi don rnams 'bad med 'grub/ / 'gro don byed zer rang 'dod sgrub pa 'dis/ /dkor gyis rang nyid bsreg go snying gtam yin/ / rang gis chos kyi gnad mtshang lta ba 'di/ / gong ma'i chos kyi rnam thar yin na yang / / gzhan la 'phya ba kha ta'i mi gtsang mchu/ / sa gtsang gzhan la 'phyi 'dra'i snying gtam yin/ / 'dul ba chos kyi gzhi mo shin tu yin/ mi dge bcu spong dge bcu yin na'ang / / tshul khrims mchog tu 'dzin pa'i btsun pa tsho/ / zab lam khyad du ma gsod snying gtam yin/ / thor tshugs rus rgyan kha ḍi stag sham brgyan/ / gsang sngags spyod pa'i rgyan cha rnam par dag bong bus seng ge'i lpags pa gyon pa yis/ / lto phyir gsang sgrog 'chor ro snying gtam yin/ /dar+shadī /sum dngos grub ster ba'i rig ma 'di/ / ma gsang sgrub dang sa spyod

sdug bsngal byed/ / bu mo btsun ma'i 'khor gyis bskor ba 'dis/ / rtsa ltung bdun pa phog go snying gtam yin/ / sangs rgyas chos rnams sdig spong dge sgrub gcig / de la 'gal ba spong rgyu gcig kyang med/ / rang rang so so'i zi kha dgag pa la/ / gcig gis gcig la ma smod snying gtam yin/ / rang gi nyon mongs dgra bo thul ba na/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa de'i lag na gnas/ /gzhan gyi srog gcod gtad ser gtong ba 'dis/ / rang gi byang sems mchor ro snying gtam yin/ / gnas lugs gzhug ma rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / / de'i rang mdangs snying rje'i 'du 'bod nyid/ / ri khrod dben pa bsten pa'i snying rus la/ / de gnyis med thabs med do snying gtam yin/ /rang stong mtha' bral dbu ma'i lta ba 'di/ / gdod ma'i dbyings na brjod med ngang du gnas/ / de la gzhan stong hor 'dra'i mgo gnon gyis/ /gnyis ka bden med ma gtong snying gtam yin/ / 'bri khung chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan 'dren 'dis/ / zhwa nag thams cad mkhyen pa mnyes gyur kyang / /'khyugs ltags rta phyugs 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'dis/ / sgar pa'i yi thag ma gcod snying gtam yin/ / mi dbang gong ma chen po'i sku mtshams dang / /kong dkar dpon po thugs cag thag pa legs/ / kun la snyoms pa'i 'dzin skyong ma gnang na/ / sde srid sil bur 'gro'o snying gtam yin/ / rdzong gzhis yul sde 'dzin pa'i gnyer chen tsho/ / gsog 'jog mkhas dang dpon sang 'bul ba legs/ / gnyer pa btsan 'phrog nam yong mi shes pas/ / mngon chung shugs 'dren gyis sheg snying gtam yin/ / gong mas brtsigs pa'i chos kyi sde dgon 'di/ / rten gsum chos skyong bzhugs pa'i pho brang yin/ / zhun mar ja la bsgyur ba'i bla ma rnams/ / 'phral gyi thab khas bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / zhen pa mi skye sgrub ste brje lan 'di/ / sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i skyong tshul lags par 'dug dbyar dgun ston dpyid med pa'i bsod 1snrosnas

'dis/ / thugs dam sprang snyogs khyer ro snying gtam yin/ / bla ma snying gi dkyil du 'jog pa dang / / kha zhe med pas ci gsung sgrub pa legs/ / nam phyed 'o dod gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod 'dis/ / grong pa rnam rtog za'o snying gtam yin/ / byang ra thams cad gsol ba'i sgrub sde 'di/ / rtogs ldan pho mo sdod pa'i gnas tshang yin/ / sgrub pa mtha' ru skyel mkhan gcig kyang med/ / 'bu srin rabs tsho ma gcod snying gtam yin/ / rlung sems dbyer med bde 'drod mchog tu 'bar/ / mi shigs dwangs mas lus kun tshim par 'gyur/ / gzan rkyang sdug sgur grang gzhis lus kun nyams/ / mig sngar mdzes pas bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / dben pa bas mthar sems kyi don la lta/ / ri dwags rnams dang lhan 'grogs bzang na yang / / rgya lam sog spyil lam zan sgug pa 'dis/ / dben pa'i rkang tsho ma 'dren snying gtam yin/ /rgyud bzhi'i dgongs pa tshig don 'dzol ba med/ / nad kyi rigs dang ngo mtshar rtsa bdun shes/ / lha rje'i rtsa 'khrug nad pa'i rtsa la brtag / nyams myong med pas bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / dpyid ka 'bul 'phongs yongs kyi pha ma byed/ / byung tshad bsags nas gzhan la sbyin gtong legs/ / bsags pa 'dzad kyang rgyun du rtag tu re/ / 'chi dus rjes su lus so snying gtam yin/ / gshen lha 'od dkar spyan ras gzigs dbang yin/ / gtsang ma'i bon dang chos la khyad par med/ / cho ga 'khrul zhing mi blud srog chags gtong / / lha 'dre mi gsum bslu'o snying gtam yin/ / sngon dus bcom ldan 'das dang 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /'khor 'das chos rnams rtsis kyis go bar byas/ / da ni gzhi gcig 'dod lugs so sor byung / / rigs drug chu mthong 'dra'o snying gtam yin/ / nye gnas blon tshon skya ser mi cig tsam/ / kun shes skyong mkhas dpon g.yog 'byar rtsi 'dra/ / de gnyis rang 'dod kun la dardidī /sgyur ba/ / khe gyong ma rtsis rang bsru snying gtam yin/ / kun dang

mthun zhing kun las lhag pa yi/ / yon tan 'dzin pa brgya la re re tsam/ / khe gyong bltas pa'i 'dun ma thung thung mthud/ / kun gyis bya bar rigs so snying gtam yin/ / ci bsam 'grub pa bkra shes kun gyi gtso/ / rang gis bsgrigs na mi 'grig gang yang med/ / legs pa'i phyogs la rten 'brel zab mo bsgrigs/ / phun sum tshogs par 'byung ngo snying gtam yin/ / legs bshad 'di ni byis pa'i kha nas kyang / / mkhas pa rnams kyis blang bar 'os pa yin/ / kun legs 'chi ku'i snying gtam bzhi bcu pa/ / rnal 'byor snyan grags rdo rje'i mdun du smras/ / don la bsams na tshig gi smos las dben/ / tshig la bsam na shes bya'i mtha' mi chod/ / kha cig tshig gi sgron mes don 'tshol dang / / kha cig gzhan la mi lta rang la lta/ / gra rgya rtogs ldan gyi dpon po/ / sna tshogs sems kyi bzhag thabs mang po 'dug / rang rang so sor bden no kun rdzob chos/ / nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i rnam rtog 'di/ / rang bzhin chos sku me long gzugs brnyan ltar/ / cir yang 'char la bzung rgyu med pa 'di/ / chos rnams kun la the yang gang yang med/ / 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'di ma gzigs/ / bltas pas mthong ba med do nam mkha'i khams/ / gzugs dang mtshan ma sgra dang dri ro sogs/ / rtsis na mkhas pa brgya yis ga la shes/ / gzugs ngan mtshan dang dpe byad brgyad cu sogs/ / ye nas bskos pa rgyu 'bras rtsal du shar/ / 'di la rtog pas brtags pas mtha' mi chod/ / yid byed mtshan ma 'gro ba kun gyi dag / rtog pas btags pa'i grub mtha' sna tshogs 'di/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis gsan na ni/ / mkhas pa shi ba'i ro khog ji bzhin du/ /smras rgyu med la yid rtsa 'tshab par 'dug / sems kyi gnas lugs nam mkha'i chos nyid do/ / spro bku bum byed cir snang ngos ma 'dzin/ / bod kyi rgyal po gong ma chen po yang / / khrims med mtho po'i mnya' gcog gastu byed

dang / /khrims mthun dma' mo'i sgab skyong khrims lugs zab/ / ngan pa'i blon chen rang 'dod sgrub pa mang / / sde srid mtha' nas nyams pa mi btub pas/ / rgyal khrims chos khrims gnyis la zobs mdzod cig / mi rgan kun dga' legs pa rgad po'i tshig / thams cad nyes kyi dogs nas smras pa 'di/ / ngas ni rta rgyugs me tog bcad zin pas/ / 'jig rten chos la spyod pa'i drag zhan la/ / mi chos gnad kyi 'phreng ba snying gi gtam/ / sha tsha nga ro ches pa mthol lo bshags/ / rus chen bco brgyad pi wang khog pa 'dra/ /rgyud gnyis krong kring mkhas khyad 'byed mkhan 'dra/ / pi wang sga ni bza' med drung skong 'dra/ / gzhu dang lag pa bslus dang mgo g.yogs 'dra/ / rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i pi wang 'di/ / ya po'i lag tu ma gtod dkon mchog mchod/ / ces smras so/ / yang yar lung nas 'ja' tshon phug pa'i dpon mo cig nged kyi zla la yod pa phyir yar lung phyogs la sru mo'i 'gro zer ba la/ / gos zas dang lus rgyan phran tshegs sbyin nas bslab bya 'di bzhin byas ba yin/ / a ho/ / yar lung sog kha'i phyogs 'di mi spyod rtsing / / kha rog khu chud sdod lugs gzo bar gyis/ / skyid shod dbus kyi phyogs 'di mi ngan mang / / 'phrog 'joms rku bsad rnams la gzab par gyis/ / mtshan ldan bla ma 'phrad pa shin tu dka'/ /zog po'i mgo bskor dag la zhe zon gyis/ /snod ldan slob ma zhin skar bas kyang dkon/ / dad med kha mkhas kun la gzab bar gyis/ / sgom chen snang sems 'dres pa shin tu dkon/ / rtag chadago la shor mtha' zhe zon gyis/ / gsung rab dgongs pa lon pa'i dge bshes dkon/ / tshig phyir don nyid stor la gzab par gyis/ / snang srid lha ru 'char ba'i sngags pa dkon/ / ngan sngags mthu yi phyogs la gzab par gyis/ / bcu gsum 'khor rtsis shes pa'i mo ma dkon/ / rdzun g.yos mi mgo bsditā skyil zhe zon gyis/ / khrims lugs kun la snyoms pa'i dpon po

dkon/ / rmog gis mgo po gcog la zhe zon gyis/ / dpon g.yog kun la gces pa'i blon chen dkon/ / phyogs 'dzin lkog zan za la zhe zon gyis/ /phywa mjug mgo dkri ba'i g.yog po dkon/ / bskyangs bas ngo log byed la zhe zon gyis/ / dben gnas dgon pa gang du sdod kyang rung / / kun dang mthun zhing rang tshugs zin par gyis/ / ha cang nye bas mthong ba ma yin pas/ / 'dun ma kun la rgyang tshos shes par gyis/ / 'di phyi'i don du bla ma mtshan ldan bston/ / dad pa'i snying por rang sems 'phrul med skyongs/ /'jig rten byed na dpon po khrims yod bsten/ / dgongs pa long las kun dang mthun par gyis/ / rang las dpon po bsam pa'i g.yog po dkon/ /kha gyong gting gyong thabs kyis sbar bar gyis/ / phywa g.yang nang du 'gugs pa'i dpon po dkon/ / ltogs can gtor lhag sgug la gzab par gyis/ /rtsa bltas nad ngos zin pa'i lha rje dkon/ / sman log gtsag bu khyer la gzab par gyis/ / gzhan gyi nor la ham pa ma che bar/ / rang gi nor la bsris bsdoms dgos dus thongs/ / gzhan rgyud shes pa'i mngon shes ma thob bar/ / pho tshod byas pa'i log lta chung bar gyis/ / rang nyid bya ba kun la mkhas na yang / / gzhan gyi bya ba khyad du ma gsod cig / rang ngam gzhan gyi chos rnams go na yang / / grub mtha' rang sar bden chug ma smod cig /rang gshes ngan pas rang rgyud bsreg 'gyur bas/ / mtho dman soms la bzod pa brtan par gyis/ / rang gis bskyangs bas drin lan log 'jal na/ / lan chags khyer ba'i smon lam legs par thob/ / gzhan ma thams cad mgu ba srid mtha' tsam/ / rang nyid ngo tsha khrel yod brgyan par gyis/ /mdor na ma brtags bya ba 'phar 'bub tshe/ / brtags shing dpyad nas 'gyod pa med par gyis/ / phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i lta ba rtogs par dka'/ /rgyu 'bras spang blang zhib tig tshul bzhin gyis/ / gal te phyag rdzogadi ༵ ba

rtogs lags kyang / / chos kun rten 'brel gnad la gzab par gyis/ /dgon chung btsan btsun nang 'dris smra mchu mang / / dam med grib kyi phyogs la zhe zon gyis/ / rtogs ldan 'phrul 'khor can ni kha po che/ / byis phrug pang du len la zhe zon gyis/ / hril dang bsgril na sdom gsum brtan pa nas/ /mthar thug chos kyi rgyal srid brtan pa gyis/ / kho bo dbus kyi phyogs nas 'brug pa'i bu/ / pha ma kun dang bral nas rgyal khams bskor/ / mi skyon sna tshogs mthong bas rang skyon tshor/ byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rtogs/ / byas pa'i chos 'di rmi lam glog sprin 'dra/ / don la thob shor med par dam pas gsungs/ / byar med lhug par rang sems don la ltos/ / de 'dra'i tshul la ma rmongs mkhas pa rnams/ / du ma ro gcig ()rtogs pa'i don la gzigs/ / de ltar chos kun khong du chud byas nas/ / gzhan phan rgya mtsho'i dpal la longs spyod shog / da ni mi rgan 'chal pa'i gtam la zobs/ / gtam 'di ma gsang rgyal khams yongs la sgrogs/ ces 'brug pa kun legs /spres smras pa a ho nyog phyang /ma/sprad dī kā/na med dam dran 'thor/duganyan gcod pa/ shing gcod pa/ཿ/ sna/ga/ rak+ta //na gyis grub par smra ba/bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 rtsom pa pos yul gang dang gang la bsun 'byin dang dgag pa skyon 2 〉〉 kā pos bod kyi bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs 152nang rang gi snying gtam 'di lta bu btsams phod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/
/ ring sdo

klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/klu kun tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zlos gar ni rgya gar gna' rabs kyi zlos gar nang gi gcig yin zhing / rgya gar gyi rje bo dpal ldan dga' ba'i lhas spyi lo bdun brgya'i skabs su mdzad pa dang / rjes su bod kyi dge slong shong ston lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bod yig tu bsgyur nas bstan 'gyur gyi skyes rabs kyi gras su bkod yod/ spyi lo 1956lor blo mthun wu'u zha'o lin gyis hin rdu'i dpe deb gzhir bzung ste rgya yig tu bsgyur nas mi dmangs rtsom rig dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun/ zlos gar 'di rgya bod gnyis kyi bsgyur yig la le tshan gyi grangs ka cung zad mi mthun pa ma gtogs nang don phal cher mthun par snang / zlos gar 'di rgya yig tu 'khrab tshan lngas rdzogs kyang /bod yig tu dung gi gtsug tor gyis mkha' lding ded pa'i mtshams der zlos gar 'khrab tshan drug pa'i bcoms pa ste/ rgya yig nang gi 'khrab tshan lnga pa de bod yig du 'khrab tshan gnyis su phye pa red/ 'on kyang nga tshos slob deb nang zlos gar 'khyab tshan dang po tshan bshus byas pa 'di ni/ bod kyi bar ma'i dus rabs kyi slob gzhi'i rtsom rig phun sum tshogs pa yong ba dang / slob phrug tshos rtsom de'i lus srog rgyan gsum gyi khyad chos khong du chud par byung na rig rtsal gyi shes rtogs cung rgya che bar 'gro ba la phan pa yong nges snyam nas slob gzhir bkod pa yin/154

klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/(tshan bshus )'go rtsom pa'i 'khrab tshan/mchod brjod/rgyagar skad du/ nā gā nardo nām nā ṭa ka/ bod skad du/ klu kun tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zlos gar/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'ga' ma dga' ba'i zom las skyes pa'i spu langs dag gis bsgribs pa'i lus 'dzin cing / /ni/ /'dzum dang ldan pas rgyal ba'i byang chub dag la bkod pa me tog snying po gshog rtsal rab bskyod sgra sgrogs sbyang rtsi byed rnams sbrang rtsi re bas bsten cing de'i/ /rkang pas bsnun pas kha zum tshogs phye ge sar gsar par gyur pas khyed la bsrungs/ /bsam gtan zol dag nye bar bzung nas skad cig mig phye su la sems par byed/ /skyob pa yin yang lus med mda' gzir skye bo 'di dag srung ba stu/ la

/sa/ snyi/nga rje ldan gra ra brdzus te khyod las gzhan pa'i brtse med skyes bu ga la da/ ba/dud mo rnams kyis byang chub la 'di phrag dog gis brjod rgyal bas khyed la srungs/ /gzhan yang gzhu bkang 'dod pa dang ni rnga gsang brdung zhing sgra sgrogs bdud kyi dpa' bo dang / /smin 'khyog rab 'dar zhal 'dzum logs su lta ba mtho ris bu mo'i skye bo dang / gru/ba pa yan lag mchog bdun rnams dang mtshar bas spu langs lus can nor lha yis/ /byang chub 'thob la bsam gtan g.yo med ces bltas thub pa'i dbang pos khyed la bsrungs/ /shin tu mang bar 'gyur bas dga' bar byas te mdo 'dzin pa'o/ /mdo 'dzin bas/de ring bdag po'i dga' ston la phyogs sna tshogs nas 'ongs pa dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha'i zhabs kyi pad+ma nye bar bsten pa'i rgyal po'i tshogs rnams kyis gus pa dang ldan par bos te/ bdag la smras pa/ 6 ji ltar kho bo cag gi rje dpal ldan dga' ba'i lhas/ sngar med pa'i dngos po'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes rabs las bcoms pa/klu kun tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zlos gar mdzad pa ni kho bo cag rnams kyi nyan pa po'i brgyud pa las thon te/ sbyor ba dag ni ma mthong ngo / /de'i phyir rgyal po de nyid la gus pa dang / kho bo cag la rjes su bzung 15sdu'ichos sbyor ba ji lta ba bzhin du khyod kyis zlos gar dag byos shig mi

ces so/ / de'i phyir re zhig tshon gyi bkod pa dag byas nas ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /'dus pa'i skye bo 'di dag gi yid ni kun tu tshim par gyur to zhes bya bar bdag gis nges te/ gang gi phyir/ dpal ldan dga' ba snyan dngags mkhan po mkhas la 'dus pa 'di dag yon tan 'dzin/ 'jig rten du ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yid 'phrog zlos gar bdag cag mkhas/ /'dir ni dngos po (1)re re dag kyang 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'thob pa'i gnas yin na/ / bdag gi skal pa rgyas pas yon tan kun gyi tshogs 'dus 'di la smos ci dgos/ / des na re zhig khyim pa mo bos te glu dag la gnas par bya'o/ / yongs su bgrod cing phyir mngon par phyogs te bltas /sa 'phags ma (2)re zhig 'dir/ / de nas gar mkhan ma ngu zhig zhugs mdo 'dzin pas/(mthong nas/) 'phags ma klu kun tu dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zlos gar bya ba yin na ci'i don du rgyu med pa nyid du ngu bar byed/gar mkhan mas/jo bo ji ltar mi ngu ste/ gang gi phyir re zhig yab ni yum dang 'grogs nas rgan po'i dngos pos yid byung ste/ da ni khyod kyis gnyen mtshan gyi khur dag 'dzin par bzod do zhes thugs la bzhag nas dka' thub kyi mdo 'apa/ dī gā /gshegs so/ /bdag kyang yongs su btang nas ji ltar yab yum nags su gshegs/(rnam par bsams nas ) de na da ni ci zhig rigs par 'gyur/ sdushā na

bdag bla ma'i (3)zhabs kyi rim gro byed pa'i bde ba yongs su btang nas ji ltar khyim du 'dug par byed/ji ltar sprin gyi bzhon pa bzhin/ /dbang phyug rim pas 'ongs btang ste/ /pha ma'i sri zhu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag kyang nags su 'gro bar bya/ /song bar gyur te skabs dbye ba'o/ /'khab tshan dang po/'dre/ /kā spri/na gyi bzhon pa dang / bi dru ṣa ka dag zhugs te/chags pa'i gnas zhes bya bar bdag gis rig /'jig ces bya bar bdag gis ma rtogs min/ /bya dang bya min rnam par dpyad rnams la/ /phyir phyogs gyur par sa la sus ma rig /pha ma'i sri zhu byed pa bdag gi ni/ /lang tsho dbang bo 'di bar gyur pa 'di/ /gal te gus pas 'di ltar nyid gyur na/ /de ltar smad par 'os kyang dga' byed 'gyur/ /bi dru ṣags/15/khro ba dang bcas par )kye gang gi tshe gson bzhin du shi ba'i rgan gon

'di dag 'di ltar nags na 'dug pa la 'di snyed kyi dus su sdug bsngal nyams su myong yang khyod ni yin byung bar ma gyur to/ / des na rab tu dang bas da dung yang re zhig bla ma'i zhabs kyi sri zhu la chags pa las phyir bzlog la rgyal srid kyi bde ba nyams su myong bar byos shiga'adren pas/ji ltar yab kyi mdun du sar 'dug mdzes pa de lta seng ge'i khri la yod dam ci/ /yab kyi zhabs dag nyed pa (4)las byung bde ba de ni rgyal srid dag la yod dam ci/ / bla ma'i lhag ma spyad pa'i dga' ba gang 'dis sa gsum spyad pa dag la yod dam ci/ /bla mas btang ba'i rgyal srid nges par gdung byed dag ste des na yon tan ci zhig yod/ /tha rū ṣakas/(bdag nyid kyis rtogs par )e ma 'di ni skye bo bla ma'i sri zhu la chags pa zhig go snyam du bsams nas/ des na 'dir yang re zhig brjod par bya'o/ (gsal bar )kye grogs po nges par rgyal srid kyi bde ba 'ba' zhig gi ched du bdag gis 'di brjod pa ma yin te/ gzhan yang khyod la bya ba dag yod pa nyid do/ /'dren pas/nidzum dang bcas par )bya ba bdag gis byas pa nyid ma yin nam ltos rinas par 'os pa'i lam la blon po rnams sbyar dam pa rnams ni bde ba bzhag /de bzhin gnyen gyi skye bo bdag mtshungs nyid byas rgyal srid dag kyang bsrung bar byas/ /159

yid la re ba las lhag 'bras ster dpag bsam shing yang slong ba rnams la byin/ /byide las gzhan pa'i bya ba ci zhig khyod kyi sems la gang zhig gnas pa bi dū r+shar+sha/sa//kye grogs po shin tu thub chod ldan zhing nyams par byed pa'i lha/ ma tang ga 'di mi mthun pa'i phyogs su nye bar gnas pa la gtso bo dang gnyen dag yang dag par gnas kyang khyod med na bdag ni rgyal srid legs par gnas par mi rtog go/ /'dren pas/ma tang gas rgyal srid len par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i dogs pa yod dam ci/ gal te de ltar gyur na de las cir 'gyur/ bdag gi lus la sogs pa thams cad gzhan gyi don nyid du yongs su bsrungs pa ma yin nam/ gang yang rang gis ma byin pa de ni yab kyi dor yin no/ / des na don med pa'i bsam pa 'dis ci zhig bya/ yab kyis rjes su bstan pa nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /bi rū ṣags/kye yab kyis ci zhig bstan/'dren pas/6 ji ltar nyi ma mang por yongs su spyad pas dka' thub kyi nags 'di yam shing dang / ku sha dang / me tog dang / nye bar mkho ba'i rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu dang / sdong bu dang / dri zhim pa dang / rngad mang ba dag ring du byas par gyur gyis/ / de'i phyir/ ma la ya'i ri la song la 160

bste gnas 'ga' zhig rtogs shig ’ ces yab kyis bdag la rjes su bstan to/ / de'i phyir re zhig ma la ya nyid du 'gro'o/ / (zhes te song bar gyur to/ / )bra dru dzikas/(mdun du bltas nas )kye grogs po ltos shig ltos shig / rlan dang bcas shing stug po'i tsan dan gyi nags kyi khrod nas yongs su bskyod pa dri bzang rgya chen pos bsgos pa can ri'i ngos mi zad pa las babs pas dum bur 'gyur ba'i chu rgyun las 'thor ba'i thigs pa bsil po 'dzin pa ma la ya'i rlung 'di ni nges par lam gyis yongs su dub pa dag sel zhing / dang por 'grogs por 'dod pa'i dga' ma la mgrin pa nas bzung ba bzhin du grogs po mdza' bo la spu long rgyas par byed pa 'dra'o/ /'dren pa/(kun tu bltas nas/) a ye bdag cag ri ma la yar slebs par gyur to/(brtags nas/) e ma 'di ni dga' bar bya ba zhig ste/ de ltar yang /dga' ldan phyogs kyi glang po 'gram pa'i ngos brdar tsan dan dag ni chag cing zag / / lung pa dag ni cho nges sgrog / / grub pa'i bud med bgrod pa rnams kyi rkang pa'i smugs rtsis dmar ba mu tig rdo/ /bsten bya ri bo ma la ya 'dis bdag gi sems ni ci yang sred ldan byed/ / des na tshur shog / 'di la 'dzegs te 'dug par 'os pa'i bste gnas dag btsal bar bya'o/ / (gnyis ka 'dzegs par/ 'jig rten mtshan ma gsal bar byas nas/)bdag gi mig ni g.yas pa g.yo/ /'bras bu 'dod pa 'ga' yang med/ /thub pa'i gsung yang brdzun ma yin/ /'di ni ci zhig 'chad 'gyur kyi/ / 161

bra drugs/kye grogs po grogs po la dga' ba 'ga' zhig nye bar ston to/ /'dren pas/nges par ji ltar khyod kyis smos pa de bzhin no/ /bi dru ṣags/kye grogs po ltos shig ltos shig (khyad par dang bcas par )sdug cing snum pa'i rkang 'thung gis nye bar mdzes shing / ba'i mar gyis dri'i snying po can gyi du ba drag tu 'phyur la/ ri dwags kyi tshogs 'jigs pa med cing lam du bag phab ste gnas pa 'di ni dka' thub kyi nags tshal bzhin du mtshon no/ /'dren pas/grogs po yang dag par mtshon no/ / 'di dag ni dka' thub kyi nags tshal nyid de/ gang gi phyir/gos kyi don du shing shun rnams bcad rtsa ba nyid kyis shin tu che ba min/ /ril ba (5)snying pa chag pas mtshan ma'i chu rgyun dag ni mkha' ltar rab tu dwangs/ / 'ga' zhig dag na muñja'i (6)ske rags khyi'us bcad cing dor bar gyur pa mthong / / rtag tu thos pas no tso dag kyang rigakhyed tshig 'di rab tu sgrog par byed/ / des na tshur shog rab tu sdogs te/ nye bar mtshon par bya'o/ / rab tu zhugs te gar dag byed 'dren pas/e ma thub pa'i skye bo (7)rab tu dga' ba rnams ni rig byed kyi tshig 16ཿsa pa la the tshom rnam par gcod par byed la/ khye'u'i skye bo rnams ni

ji ltar bsher ba gsher ba'i yam shing dag gcod cing / dka' thub pa'i gzhon nu ma rnams ni ljon pa gsar pa'i kyo ra 'gongs par byed pa'idaka' thub kyi nags tshal ni rab tu zhi ba dang dga' bar byed pa nyid do/ /'di nyid na/ bung ba'i sgra yis legs par 'ongs sam zhes ni brjod pa bzhin/ / 'di dag mgo ni 'bras bu dud pas 'dud par byed pa bzhin/ / me tog char pa 'thor zhing bdag la mchod yon (8)ster ba bzhin/ / yal ga ldan pa yis kyang mgron gyi bsnyen bkur ji ltar bslabs/ / de'i phyir dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'dir ni 'dug par 'os pa zhig ste/ 'dir gnas na bdag cag gi sems bde bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /bra dru ṣakas/kye grogs po 'on kyang nges par ri dwags 'di dag mgrin pa cung zad bskyogs te g.yo ba med pa'i kha las cung zad zos pa'i rtswa khams nang na gnas pa zag cing rna ba gcig rab tu bslangs te gtad nas mig zum pa dang bcas pas nyan par byed pa lta bur mtshon no/ /'dren pas/(rna ba gtad nas/) gnas thob rab tu gsal ba'i 'gros can gdangs snyan ngag gis rnam par bzhag pa 'dzin byed pa/ / bung ba'i sgra bzhin nges par yid 'phrog rgyud mangs dag gi rgyud mangs sgra dang ldan pa yis/ / gsal zhing rol sgeg tshig ldan glu ni kun tu 'khyog pa'i lus can ri dwags 'di dag rnams/ / so yi bar na gnas pa rtswa yi kham ni gcod pa'i sgra dag bsdams nas nyan par byed/ /163

bi dū ṣakas/kye grogs po dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'di na su zhig glu len par byed/'dren pas/ji ltar sor mo 'jam pa'i 'dab mas mngon par bsnun pa'i rgyud mangs shin tu gsal ba ma yin par sgrogs shing glu yang snyan cing phra ba gtso bor len pa de ltar bdag rtog pa ni gnas 'di na lha dag mnyes sdor byed cing lha'i bud med rgyud mangs dang ldan pa'i glu len par byed bi dū ṣakas/kye grogs po tshur shog / yu bu cag kyang lha'i gnas blta bar bya'o/ /'dren pas/legs par brjod de/ nges par lha ni phyag bya bar 'os pa'o/ / (nye bar song ste 'phral lam 'dug nas/) grogs po gal te na skye bo 'di lta bar mi 'os pa srid do/ / des na re zhig ta ma le'i (9)gel pa (10)'di'i nang du 'dug ste lha lta ba'i skabs btsal bar bya'o/ / de ltar byasate/de nas ma la ya can ma dang / 'bangs mo zhugs te sa la 'dug nas rgyud mangs sbrel bar byed do/ /'dren mas/(klu len pa/)gi rī rab rgyas pad+ma'i ge sar gyi/ /dngul ltar dkar ba'i 'od can bcom ldan ma (11)khyod kyi bka' drin dag gis bdag gi ni/ /14mngon par 'dod pa rab tu grub par mdzod/ /

'dren pas/(rna gtad nas/) e ma ho rol mo/ 'di la gsal byed kyi dbyangs rnam pa bcu po 'dis gsal ba thos cing / myur ba dang / bar ma dang /dal ba'i stobs rnam pa gsum rab tu gsal bar yongs su bcad de/ba lang gi rnga ma sogs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rim pas ngal bso bar byas pa de kho na'i tshogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rol mo'i cho ga yang dag pa gsum bstan no/ /'bangs mos/rjesasras mo nges par yun ring du glu dag blangs nas khyod kyi lag rtse dag yongs su mi ngal lam/'dren pas/grung mo bcom ldan ma'i mdun du rgyud mangs sgrog par byed pa la bdag 'bangashā ṅgi shāl/ /(smod pa dang bcas par ) kye brtse med ma 'di'i mdun du rgyud mangs bsgrags pas ci zhig bya zhes bdag smra'o/ / gang zhig 'di snyed kyi dus su skye bo gzhon nu ma'i dka' thub bsnyen nas nges pa la gnas pas bstan kyang da dung khyod la dang bar mi ston no/ /bi dru ṣags/(thos nas/) kye grogs po 'di ni nges par gzhon nu ma ste ci'i phyir mi lta/'dren pas/skyon ci yod/ gzhon nu ma lta ba ni skyon med pa nyid do/ / 'on kyang gal te na bdag cag mthong nas 'jigs te/ ngo tsha ba gzhon /6 ༵ la

rnyed sla bas 'dir yun ring du mi sdod pa srid do/ / des na re zhig ཿkhri shing gi dra ba 'dis bsgribs te blta bar bya'o/ / (gnyi gas bltas bi dru ṣa /sa/ (ya mtshan dang bcas par/) kye grogs po ltos shig ltos shig ngo mtshar ro ngo mtshar ro/ / rgyud mangs kyi sgras rna ba'i bde ba skyed par byed pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ rnam par shes pa'i rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs 'dis mig gi yang bde ba skyed par byed do/ / de'i phyir 'di ni su zhig yin ci lha mo'am/ klu'i bu mo'am/ yang na rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo'am/ yang na grub pa'i rigs las 'khrungs pa zhig go/'dren pas/(rnam par blta zhing chags pa dang bcas par/) grogs po 'di su zhig yin zhes bdag gis ma rtogs so/ / bdag gis 'di tsam shes te/ gal te mtho ris bu mo yin na 'phrog byed mig stong ldan des don byas 'gyur/ /gal te klu'i bu mo yin na'ang 'di'i gdong yod tshe sa 'og zla bas (12)stong ma yin/ /gal te rig 'dzin ma yin gzhan rigs lam rgyal bdag cag rigs ni 'bras dang bcas/ /gal te grub rigs las skyes de phyir grub pa 'jig rten gsum du grags bai dru ṣasna rāgyu/ra/ /166('dren pa la bltas nas dga' ba dang bcas shing rang gis rtogs par/)

e ma'o/ / yun ring po zhig nas yid srub kyi spyod yul du lhung bar // to/ (bdag nyid la ston cing /) yang na ma yin te/ bram ze bdag 'bangs mos/(mdza' ba dang bcas par/) kye bdag smra'o/ / brtse med ma 'di'i mdun du rgyud mangs bsgrags pas ci zhig bya/ (zhes te rgyud mangs 'phangs so)'dren mas/bu mo bcom ldan mgo rī la ma smad cig / kye ding bcom ldan mas bka' drin mdzad pa bzhin no/ /'bangs mos/rje'i sras mo re zhig ci 'dra ba dag sbos shig /'dren mas/bu mo nges par ding rmi lam du bdag 'di bzhin nyid du rgyud mangs bsgreng ba la bcom ldan mas gsungs pa/ tsa bu mo khyod kyis rgyud mangs bsgreng ba mkhas pa khyad par du 'phags pa 'di dang / bdag la thun mong ma yin pa'i gus pa bu mo'i dngos po la rnyed dka' ba 'dis bdag shin tu tshim par gyur to/ / de'i phyir yun ring po ma yin par rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bas lag pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro ’ zhes so/ /'bangs mos/(dga' ba dang bcas par/) rje'i sras mo/ gal te de ltar yin na rmi lam hā'isdir brjod/ lha mos snying la 'dod pa'i mchog sbyin byin pa nyid na / / 167

bi dru ṣags/nges par bdag cag lha mo lta ba'i skabs su bab bo/ / de'i phyir tshur shog nye bar 'gro bar bya'o (zhes te nye bar btud do/ bi dru ṣa gas mi 'dod bzhin du khyer nas ) jo mo grung mo bdag bden par smra ste/ 'di ni mchog sbyin byin pa nyid do/ /'dren mas/shā'ajigs pa dang bcas par 'dren pa la mtshon te/) bu mo 'di su zhig ces 'bangs mos/gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa 'dis na/ / 'di nyid bcom ldan mas bka' drin mdzad pa yin snyam mo/ / ('dren mas chags pa dang bcas shing ngo tsha ba dang bcas par bltas so/)'dren pas/g.yo zhing yangs pa'i mig ldan dbugs 'byin cing / /'dar zhing mkhregs sdug na ldan 'khrul byed ma/ / ñca lus 'di dka' thub nyid kyis shin tu ni/ /ngal gyur slar yang ci slad gdung bar byed/ /'dren mas/jo mo khyod kyi dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'di na gang zhig mgron po 'ongs pa la tshig tsam gyis kyang phebs par smra ba ma yin pa 'di 'dra ba'i kun tu spyod pa yod dam ci/'bangs mos/168rje'i sras mo/ / mgron po la bsnyen bkur bya ba rigs pa yin no/ /

de'i phyir ji ltar mthu chen po dang ldan pa 'di dag la gus par bya ba la rmongs par gnas/ yang na khyod bzhugs shig kho mo nyid kyis ji ltar rigs pa dag bya'o/ / ('dren pa la mtshon te/) jo bo legs par 'ongs sdum/ jo bos stan yongs su bzung bas phyogs 'di brgyan par mdzod bi dū ṣa/sa//kye grogs po 'di ni legs par smra'o/ / yud tsam zhig 'dug ste ngal bso byar bya'o/ /'dren pas/khyod ni rigs par smra'o/ / (gnyis ka 'khod do/)'dren mas/kwa ye bzhad gad kyi ngang tshul can ma de ltar ma byed/ gal te dka' thub pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong na 'di las bdag dul ba ma yin pa dang ldan par dogs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dka' thub pa zhugs te/dka' thub pa/rigs kyi bdag po kau shi gas bdag la bka' bsgos pa/ 66mnyes gshin shā ṇa ḍi l+ya/ yab kyi bkas/ rgyal tshab bshes gnyen gyi dbyig gzhon nu sprin gyi bzhon pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur ba dag ri ma ya 'di nyid kyi phyogs 'ga' zhig na gnas pa sring mo ma la ya can gyi khyim thab kyi slad du blta ba'i phyir de ring 'ong ste/gal te de blta zhing ma la ya can gyi nyi ma gung gi mchod sbyin gyi dus yol bar 'gyur srid do/ / des na de bos la shog cig mi ces so/ /༵༵ na

bdag re zhig go rī'i khang pa nyid du 'gro'o/ / ('gro zhing sa la rnam par bltas nas/) a ye rdul dang ldan pa'i phyogs na rab tu gsal ba'i 'khor los mtshan pa'i rjes kyi phreng ba dag snang ba 'di su zhig gi yin/(mdun du bltas te sprin gyi bzhon pa la nges par brtags nas/) 'di ni skyes bu chen po 'di yin nam snyam mo/ / gzhan yang /mgo la gtsug tor 'di gsal smin ma'i bar na mdzod spu 'di ni rnam par mdzes/ /mig ni pad+ma'i rjes su mthun zhing brang gdengs 'phrog byed dag la 'gran par byed/ /lag pa 'khor los mtshan pa ji ltar de ltar skyes bu dag ni su zhig 'di/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i gnas dag ma thob 'dug pa yin nam snyam/ /yang na the tshom gyis ci zhig bya ste/ shin tu gsal bar 'di ni sprin gyi bzhin pa yin par nges so/ / (ma la ya can ma la bltas nas/) a ye 'di yang rgyal po'i bu mo'o/ (gnyi ga la bltas nas/) gal te phan tshun rjes su 'tsham po 'di dag 'brel bar byed na byed pa po ni yun ring po zhig na /ga pa byed par gyur to/ (nye bar btud nas/) khyod ni dge bar gyur 'dren pa///sdo/ma ldan sprin gyi bzhon pa phyag bgyid do/ / (zhes te ldang bar 'dod dka' thub pas/170

mngon du ldang mi dgos so/ / kye mngon 'ongs kun gyi bla ma nyid ces pas/ khyod nyid bdag cag gi bla ma yin no/ / des na ji ltar bde bar bzhugs shig /ma la ya can mas/jo bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dka' thub pas/(de mthong nas/) rjes su 'tsham pa'i bdag po'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig rgyal po'i bu mo/ khyod la rigs kyi bdag po kau shi kus bka' stsal ༵/ /khyod kyi mchod sbyin gyi dus yol bar 'gyur gyis myur du shog cig mi 'dren ༵ sa// /(mi dga' ba dang bcas par/) gang bla mas bka' stsal pa nyid do/ /(rang gis rtogs par/)gcig ni bla ma'i gsung dang gzhan/ /mdza' bo blta ba'i rtse dga' bzang /'gro'am mi 'gro 'gal ba la/ /bdag snying 'phyang mo yug par 'gyur/ /(shugs phyung zhing langs te ngo tsha ba dang bcas shing chags pa dang bcas par dre'adren pa la blta zhing dka' thub pa dang lhan cig song bar gyur to/)'a swā zlo/ swā/ dang bcas par shugs phyung nas 'dren ma la blta zhing /)tshang ra'i khyon gyi khur ldan zhing / /dman pa dag tu 'gro ma 'di/ /gzhan du 'gro yang bdag gi ni/ / 171

snying la gom pa bkod par gyur/'bangs mos/tshur shog tshur shog rje'i sras mo/ (zhes te ma la ya can ma 'khor dang bcas pa song bar gyur to/)bra rū ṣags/kye gang zhig blta bar bya ba dag mthong ngo / / da ni nyi ma gung gi nyi ma'i gdung ba nyis 'gyur du byas pa bzhin du bdag gi lto ba'i me dag lhab lhab byed do/ / de'i phyir 'di nas song ste/ gang gis bram ze dag gi mgron du 'gyur bar byas nas thub pa'i skye bo las dngos su rnyed pa'i rtsa ba dang chu ba la sogs pas srog gzung bar bya'o/ /'dren pas/(stong du bltas nas/) a ye/ bcom ldan 'od zer stong phrag ldan ni nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dzegs te bzhugs so/ / de ltar yang /gdung bas de dus tsan dan la brdar thang chus dkar ba'i 'gram pa 'dzin byed cing / / rang gi rna ba bskyod pa'i rlung ni yang dag chags pas bzhin la g.yo ba byed pa la/ / lag pas gtor ba'i chu thigs snying khar khyad par du 'dren glang po'i bdag po 'di/ / da ni bzod dka' zug rngu drag pos zug pa lta bu'i gnas skabs 'dzin par byed/ / ces te gnyi gsong ngo / mtshan ma dang po'o// //mchan 'grel/rjodangos po/ skabs der 'khrab tshan la go dgos/()'phags ma/ bud med la gus tshigadubla ma/ yab yum/()nyed pa/ mnyed pa/172

duril ba/ bum pa lta bu zhig/dumuñja/ gtor gtong /duthub pa'i skye bo/ bsam gtan pa/()mchod yon/ btung ba/()ta ma le/ me tog〈nyegel pa/ yal ga(smobacom ldan ma/ gusatshig(yis 'og zla ba/ klu/bsam gzhigs 'dri ba/1 chos gar 'khrab tshan 'dir rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gye khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin gang dang gang ldan 'dug/nya klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang sprin bzhon gyi rtogs brjod dbar rtsom rig gi 'brel ba gang 'dug/)chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya/rtsom yig 'di ni rtsom pa pos rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyang brtson mthar phyin pa gnang ba las byung ba'i nyams rtogs gsal bar bkod thog/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang bstun nas gsang ba sngags dang bcas pa'i grub mthar bstod cing / lhag don rang gi yab chen rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin pa'i yon tan la bsngags pa'i snyan rtsom khyad 'phags shig yin/173

chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba dul phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya/na moḥthim ra sa ra mā: bud+dha ka la tsa grwa ya/ / bde chen mchog gi ye shes rang gzugs mkha' dbyings min nas 'on kyang mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ / pra phab rang bzhin kun khyab klong yangs snying rje'i gzhu dang stong nyid mda' non zung du sbyor rjo/ / e ma sna tshogs srid pa'i 'chang ba lhug par grol yang las snang so sor sgyu ma'i gar/ / dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal ldan dus 'khor ()bdud dgra'i zhabs sor bkra shis 'khor los 'gro 'di srungs/ / mtshan dpe'i 'od phung dbus su lhung ba'i mdzes sdug sku ni li khri'i rdul brtsegs lhun po ste/ / rab 'byams shes bya'i dngos kun snod gyur yan lag tshad med ngag gi me long rnam par thob/ / 'khor ba'i myu gu drungs nas gcod pa'i brjod bral dbyings kyi stong nyid snying rje ral gri'i rgyun/ / rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i spyi gzugs smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs lhag pa'i lha des skyongs/ / kun dga'i zla dkar zol la 'god pa'i sngon med lang tsho yid srubs dgra/ / mtshungs med glu dang rgyud mang 'dres pa'i rnar snyan lha yi rol mo mkhan/ / srid lam dub pa'i yid kyi gdungs sel snying stobs thig le ga bur rgyun/ / ngag dbang lha mos bdag la dbyangs can mgrin par 'god pa'i dge legs mdzod/ / gnyis 'dzin du'aching ba laṅgā'i grong dun gcig pu sdo sdu'i gzugs/ / 'khrul ba 'gog byed rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs ha nu mar+sha'i dhi

bka'/ / nyan po dga' bskyed dun bar sbyin pa'i bde chen phyag rgya mkhan/ / yab gcig rigs ldan ngag dbang rnam rgyal zhabs la nyer btud de/ / 'di na rig gnas sa chen gsum po rnam dpyod gom pa gcig gis gzhal/ / brda sprod rig pa'i me lce yis/ / log smra'i bud shing za byed mkhan/ / des na spobs pa'i tsan dan rgyas pa'i lhong / / bag chags ga bur rgod pa'i legs ldan dpyid/ / cung zad sngon goms nam mkha'i rgyal mo'i drin/ /'dir snang 'chad rtsod lhag bsam 'phyang mo yug / 'on kyang nges 'byung dbyar gyis mdun bsus te/ / susti'i dbyangs bdun durdzogs pa'i legs bshad sprin/ / bdud rtsi stong gi 'bab stegs dbu ba'i 'dzum/ / ma smad zhing 'di'i bcud len bzhin du 'dren/ / kwa ye 'dzam gling skye 'gro'i bsod nams nor bu'i sgron/ / thub bstan phun tshogs lang tsho gsar du spro mkhas pa'i/ / sa las rnam rgyal rgyal srid kun gyi thig le mchog / bsngags pa'i ut+pal dugazhon nu dar ba rna ba'i rgyan/ / de phyir gnam bskos rgyal srid sā la'i dbang / / dpal 'byor a pa'i 'khri shing gsar ba yis/ / legs khyud de tshe sbyin pa'i phyag yangs ni/ / yongs 'du'i dpag bsam rgyas pa'i dga' ston bzhin / / ris med kun gyi dpung gnyen sgor dkar zhes/ /snyan grags gdungs dkar dgung du 'degs pa yis/ /khrims gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo'i shugs 'chang ba/ / mes po du ma'i shing rtas mi mtshan pa'i/ /ngag gi grags 'bar mtha' dag rigs brgya'i mgor/ / dbang bskur rtags kyi dar dbyangs bcing ba yis/ /rnam dkar byed po sa yi 'byor 'jigs ⑩zol/ / rgyal rnga srol gnyis rdung ba'i mthu chen de/ / nam zhig rgya chen bskal bzang 'gro ba'i sde/ / dpung ba'i grib ma rings pos bsrung pa yis/ /rtags yon yid bzhin nor bu'i cod pan mchog /rigs kyi thig le stat+ta 5

(sto bkod gyur te/ / mtho ris dkar phyogs lha dang ḍā ki'i (ltags/ / phan tshun dri bzang dal bur 'thul pa'i klong / / rnam mang mchod sprin 'dus pa'i gur khang nas/ /spyan 'dren pho nya dang po 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /las rlung dus bzhi'i snang brnyan glo bur du/ / dbu ma'i yomid mthar zhugs te 'od gsal sems/ / stong pa mtshan ma med pa'i rang gzugs ni/ /dpal ldan chos dbyings zhi ba'i khri la 'dzegs (3 / skabs der kun gsal bu mo'i lto ba ru/ / mya ngan mngal gyis lci ldan 'khun pa'i sgra/ /thos nas rang gi grogs mo nor 'dzin ma/ /g.yog la gnas pa'i don bzhin gyen du 'phags/ / de tshe gnad la 'bigs byed lcags mda' bzhin/ /sdug bsngal khur gyis dub pa rdzun ring ste/ /nyin zhag mdza' mos ring du bsgrub pa yi/ /lo zla'i rnga yab bsil bas dran pa sbyin/ /de nas kun gzhi'i (7do rang rnam rtog sems/ / gcig pu du ma'i gar mkhan mi na ka(yi / sna tshogs gar stabs stong gis yid 'dren pa'i/ / srid pa'i snang ba 'di ni blo brid mkhan/ / rang rigs dpung ba'i nags rlung yangs po dus rnams nyams dga' ba'i/ /longs spyod tsū ta'i 'khri shing (rdzangar bo gcig tu 'khor ba'i phyag rgya mkhan/ / dug gsum rtse dga' sbrang rtsis rab myos 'khrul ba'i glu dbyangs dang dir can/ /de ltar myong bya'i rang bzhin 'di ni bgo skal bzhin du dang por grub/ /'di don bcad na snang srid chos sku'i lam/ /zab gsal sems kyi snang tshul ting 'dzin 'phrul/ /gang shar rkyen dang chos nyid ro mnyam ste/ /ma rig 'jig rten zhes brjod da ga re/ /zhes te dngos kun snying po na kra'i grong (3 /gsang ba'i mdud pa lhug por ma grol ba'i/ /bsnyengs bral mgrin pa'i zlos gar rigs sam zhes/ /slar yang yid kyi lha nā de skad smra/ /de lta mod kyi tshe 'di'i legs nyes blang dor 'byed pa'i

cho ga kun/ /dpal gos (krol ba ngom pa'i lte bar skad gdangs zhan par glu len pa'i/ / sprang rtsi 'thung ba'i na chung dang mtshungs yab mes gsungs la gus btud nas/ / rgyal srid spyod tshul gdugs dkar thig le'i grib ma snum po'i cha shas tsam/ / nyams su bstar te gnas po'i ring lugs kyi/ /legs byas phung po zla tshes bskrun las slar/ /snyan ngag kun+da grol ba'i chun po yi/ /nyams brgyad gar la blta bas yid brel tshe/ / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' dbus bral ba 'di/ / snyigs dus lhun pos bsrubs pa'i gzhan dbang las/ / srog 'phrog nag po brtsegs pa khyeto re ba'i/ / mi bsrun skye bo'i tshogs dang chabs cig tu/ / rgyal bstan dpal gyi dum bu g.yur za ba/ /dpyad brdar 'jigs pa'i cho ga dang po ni/ /mi dge'i sta re lag rtser gnas pa yi/ / bdud kyi mdza' shes bstan 'dzin zol can thong / / rnam mang nyes brgya'i rkun po mal+li gas4) / yon tan mig sman ltar mdzes lan bu'i 'phreng / / dam du bcings nas bcol chun rgyan gyi ming / / de 'dra 'gog pa'i rgyal thabs gar yod snyam/ / yid kyi ras dkar ngos la bsam gtan gyi/ / rig byed mkhas po stong gis nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ / dran pa'i tshon lnga pir gyis bkra ba yis/ /rnam dpyod ri mo 'di na ma smad ces/ /legs lam sid+dha wa ra'i me tog(ba ku la'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad )gi/ / yal 'dab rnam par bzhan pa'i gom stabs mkhan/ / mtshungs med bstan las skyes pa'i gzugs can la/ / 'khrul med kun dga'i mdzod ni 'di yin lo/ / yab gcig g.yas su 'khyil ba'i bkra shis dang / / lnga bar gyur kyang snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ / mi zad rdo rje'i glu yi dga' ster ba/ / thabs shes ldan pa gang de'i mtshan tsam yang / / thos pa'i mod la ngan g.yo sgra dbyangs can/ /mi zad rdo rje'i glu yi dga' ster ba/ / thabs shes ldan pa gang de'i mtshan tsam yang / / thos pa'i mod la ngan g.yo dgra 'jom phyir/ / de slad dang1 shāstan

phyag rgya mchog gi gar/ / lhan cig spu long gos dkar g.yo ldan pa/ / 'di 'bras sdig dang sdug bsngal dbyings 'byin yang / / grib ma'i gnyis pa dang bcas ri dwags mo/ / khyu nyams nags mthar lus 'dra rang gi mig / rig rig bgyis kyang yul gzhan gang la lta/ / bsams na yid kyi shes pa rnam par skyo/ / yongs ye snang srid ma lus dag pa'i zhing / / byang phyogs chos kyi pho brang ka lā pa'i4) / rin chen khri steng rigs ldan sku bzhugs pa/ / rang gi bla ma lha cig btsan po de/ / zla 'od 'bum yang red par byed nus pa'i/ / tshems dkar myu gu gsal ba'i 'dzum dkar las/ / rig grol chos kyi 'khor lo'i skyes bzang po'i/ / bcud len snying po ster zhing bzhugs so zhes/ / gtam snyan bdud rtsi'i gru char rgyun/ / rna ba'i be+eḍū dkar po yi/ / bum pa bzang por legs drangs nas/ / snying gi rma bya gar la 'jug / de lta na yang sen mo'i kha ris khra bo'i lus ldan rang stobs kyis/ / grub pa'i zhing khams bgrod par ma nus rang la bshung zhing 'khu bar zad/ / ris med 'gro ba'i don la gzigs kyang las rlabs rmongs pa'i cho 'phrul che/ / rkyen dbang 'di 'dras mngon sum mthong ba'i go skabs cha tsam bdag la med/ / ces te smin ma had kyis gzengs bstod rdzi ma'i rlung yab rol pas dbugs phyung yang / / sems nyid sdug bsngal la sbyor bzhin ras zla ba mchi ma'i rgyun gyi rab rib can/ /shugs ring dbugs kyi bser bus rnam bskyod ut+pal snye ma'i rna rgyan 'gram par lhungs/ / de tshe dran pa'i me long gtsang mar legs byas gzugs can bzhin du 'di shar te/ / lha ma'i bsod nams mthu yis spud pa'i yab rje'i zhabs sen nor bu'i tog / dge legs char 'dod yongs su klubs pa'i sngon med rgyal mtshan gsar ba la/ / 'dod gsol mgrin pa'i tasbru ra bsgyur de slad 'tsho ba don yod kyi/ / srid zhi'i re ba yid bzhin 'byung zhes thub pa rna/lha /sa bsngags pa'i lam/ / ji tsam shar yang thugs rje'i snang brnyan

de/ /snod dang 'tsham par chu zla'i gar bsgyur na/ / kun rmongs bdag gis gsol bas ci zhig bya/ / 'on kyang rang rang mos blos nyer drangs pa'i/ /smon lam rdo rje'i zegs ma 4〉 bu'i shugs/ / bzod dka'i gsang tshig 'di ni legs spring na/ / shis pa ring bor skyong ba'i lha de yis/ / brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par gdon mi za/ / zhes bsam nges med nges 'dzin lus kyi khyim/ /rang rtsal stag gi 'o mas bsrungs pa yis/ / 'jigs tshogs byin za'i gnod pas mi brji ba'i/ / bden stobs grub pa'i mngag bzhug 'ga' yod dam/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar dra ba'i lding khang na/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi thig le ltar phyags pa'i/ / gzhan phan snying bor ston pa'i zla ba khyed/ / brtse bas lhan skyes gtam 'di spro bar mdzod/ / de ni mdzes sdug ri mor bris 'dra'i gzugs/ /'phral du mig la mngar 'i dpal ster mod/ / lan brgyar nga nas gsang sngags bzlas gyur kyang / / smra bcad zol la gnas pas grogs mi byed/ / in+da rnyil ba'i gnas sngon la zhen te/ / rang 'gros gshegs stabs gser gyi khu ba yis/ / sa la bkra shis dpal mo bskrun ba'i gnyen/ / byang phyogs mes po'i gam du 'phrin 'di gsol/ / khyod ni ha cang mthon por bskal pa yis/ / te bor phokyebasnyad kyang sgra tsam de mi gsal/ / nye na tsha ba'i reg bya skad cig kyang / / dus mtha'i me lce rnon po ltar mi bzod/ / mtshungs med rgyags pa'i rngul chu'i dog pa yang / / gdengs can btul pa'i do shal ltar mdzes pa'i/ / gshog rlabs thor rlung drag po'i shugs bskyed pa'i/ /mkha' la mkha' 'gro'i dbang pos mchid 'di rnoms/ / ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar lhung ba'i zhe sdang gi/ / khrag rgyun dbus ba brtsegs pa'i sdig pa'i khur/ / shin tu lci bas tshig don nor bu yi/ / rna rgyan rin chen khyer ba'i skal ba ci/ /dbyar gyi ma mas bstang ba'i sprin dkar khyod/ / lang tsho'i rlan dang bral ba dus kyi chos/ /phyi ma'i don yang legs mod de ltar na/ / byang1 shāḥs

ri bo'i phag tu gshegs par mdzod/ / dgun gsum srin mo khrod pa'i kha rlangs bzhin/ / rlung dmar drag tu langs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ / nges med phyogs bcur rgyu ba'i col chung dzolta/ /'di lta'i blang bya nam yang yod ma yin/ / mtho mdzes gser ri'i phrag par gnas 'cha' ba'i/ / ston dus 'grogs pa'i grogs po ku lā larkyunye / ya mtshan gshog yangs dkar po'i shugs bskyod de/ /don bzang 'bras bus dud pa'i gtam 'di khyer/ /mig mdzes brtse dga' la chags 7ti ka/ / bag yod brtan pa 'jig pa'i rnam 'phrul 'dis/ / yid srubs gnyen du nges so ngang ba'i bu/ / phyogs der 'gro yang khyod kyi brda mi 'phrod/ / kye ma 'jigs med bde chen rgyas pa'i lha des zhing khams bgrod pa la/ / sngon byin bden stobs brtul zhugs grub pa'i 'khor lo 'god mkhas dus kyis bskal/ / da ni rdzu 'phrul phra mo'i gar yang nyin gyi rgyu skar tsam du zad/ / dus 'dir las bzhi'i 'phrin las (khaskul ba'i mthu ldan su yang yod ma yin/ / de phyir bskal pas rmongs pa'i tshul min snyigs dus lang tsho ma/ / kwa ye bsgrub blo med kyang mi bsrun rtse dga'i bslab pa mkhan/ / gcig tu ma nges du ma'i las dbang shin tu nyam nga ba'i/ / mi bden bden par 'dzin pa'i 'khrul ba 'di ni su yis 'gog /de tshe dag pa'i mkha' la rang gzugs las/ / 'khrungs pa min kyang rig grol dar dkar gyi/ /'dab gshog rdzu la brten pa'i 'phur lding can/ / skye ba du ma'i mdza' bshes bzhin du mthong / / de ni mgrin pa 'khyog por phyi mig dag/nan gyis lta ba'i du ris sngon po yis/ / mya ngan grang reg ba mo sel byed mkhan/ / tshur shog tshur shog rig 'dzin grub pa'i bya/ / srid zhi'i gtsug lag gnyis las byung ba yi/ / dge legs tshig gi mchod sbyin me tog gdi/0/ /de ring lhag bsam dag pas lag bstar te/ / brtse ldan khyod la pho

nya'i mnga' gsol sgrub/ / bden tshig brtul zhugs grub pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gnyis 'dzin lta ba'i ri bo nyi shudzotong / / ming gi lhag ma tsam du byed nus na/ /bla dwags lam gyi bar chad47da mo'i gnas/ / 'on kyang bu skye dar bab rtsed 'jo ma/ /chos dang srid kyi yul gru'i mngon 'dod lam/ / phyag rgya stong phrag gsal ba tsū ta'i shing / / bdag gis bslab par bya yi sems la zungs/ /dang por nya dang phag pa'i 'jug pas mthor btegs pa'i/ /kun bzod4)radi na rang rigs rgyal srid gtsang ma yi/ / zil gyis ma non de zla su zhes rtags can bzhin/ / seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis spud pa'i pho brang 'di'i/ / lte bar rin chen khri mngon mtho nor bu'i sa 'dzin rtser/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung lo hi ta yi gur khang na/ / mgon de'i phyag mchod bsod nam dpal zhing dkon mchog gsum gyi rten/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od rab 'bar de la gus pas phyag bgyis te/ /byin rlabs mya ngan med pa dpyid kyi zhal/ / des ni bar chad mdzes ma'i nga rgyal gzugs/ / zos pa'i lce bzhin rtags yon snye ma yi/ / dog pa dmar po rgyas pa'i smon lam mdzod/ /de nas 'di yi mya 'dabs mi ring bar/ / 'dod rgu'i phun tshogs rdzogs ldan longs spyod ltar/ /lha chags srid pa'i grong khyer chen po yod/ / rin chen dra mig gsal ba'i sgo glegs nang / / yid 'phrog pad rtsa 'khri shing gsar ba phra ba'i gzugs bzang dran pa'i mda'/ / nges par rnam bkra rgyan la mkhas te smin mtshams mu tig 'khor lo sa mdzes/ / glang chen dkar po'i myos bum ltar mtho nu ngos do shal mngon dga' zhing / / zur mig ut+pal rna ba'i mgron po khengs ldan bu mo du ma snang / / skye ba du mar yongs 'dris ma dza' mo bzhin/ /yid srubs mtshams sbyor sems kyi ri dwags zhags/ / ci ste dul ba'i brtan pa 'jig nus pa'i/ / lang tsho des kyang kun dga' bcurā spyan

byed/ / gzhan yang bgrang yas skye dgu'i lang long dang / / shis brjod gcig la dbyangs ni bdun rdzogs pa'i/ / glu dang rgyud mang 'dres pa'i zlos gar sogs/ / ya mtshan snang ba ma 'gag de tsam yod/ / gang der dpal 'byor blo brid dug lnga'i bka'/ / shin tu lci yang bag yod rang rgyud kyi/ /rgyan du mdzes so gzhan dang brjer mi rung / / de na spang blang dran pa'i lag pas bzung / /de nas cung zad gom pa 'god pa'i tshe/ /ro myang rnam 'gyur bral ba'i kha mig nas/ / khrag rgyun chal chil 'bab pa dgra bo'i mgo/ /mthon por brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang bzang dbus/ / gtsug rgyan myos bum dom pa'i spyi'u waṃ47sa/ / dri bzang thig le bris pa'i 'gram pa la/ /dpal ni bung ba'i rnga yab bzhad ldan pa'i/ /lag ldan dpa' sgra sgrog pa'i gnya' gong na/ / sde brgyad kun gyi mthu rtsal spyi gzugs la/ / srog bdag chen po li byin ha ra'i4nyang / /spyan gsum sdang mig 'jigs pa'i ri mo yis//srid gsum dus kun gzigs pa de bzhugs shing / /rdo rje 'dzin pa pad+ma ka ra4〉nga / / khyad par sgrub rgyud pu khye dhadza'i4〉gas/ / chos srung gtum por mnga' gsol bstan pa'i khur/ / lha des ring mo zhig nas dzir ma mngon/ /sha chen dud sprin nag po thibs pa'i rum/ /byed po 'di zhes snang du med pa yi/ / zhing bcu47sgral ba'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes zhes/ / brda thabs mi rkang gling bu'i skad 'tsher zhing / /las mkhan gnod sbyin dmar po ral gri'i gnyen/ /zla phyed mche ba gtsigs shing ru mtshon gyi/ / gar la rtse zhingagadong dmar brjid pa'i mdangs/ / gang mchis de ni dam tshig gnyen gcig pu/ / gzhan yang rigs gzugs mi 'dra'i 'dug stangs can/ /rgyu ma'i phreng bas brgyan pa'i kiṅka raposkro / drag tu khros pa'i gdong gi da la 'od1/82/shin tu bzod dka' de kun mthong ma thag / bzhed pa'i gus zung

'dod gsol skud pa yis/ / drub blo yod kyang 'jigs pa'i sor mo'i rtse'i/ / nges par nan gyis bskul ba'i snang sems khab/ / rtse gnyis lam du khyogs la 'phyang mi 'tshal/ / 'byung khungs gcig las sprul pa du ma'i dngos/ / nang du bcud len snying po bdud rtsi'i ro/ / pha rol srog 'phrog nag po brtsegs pa'i rgyun/ / mtshungs pa'i rang lha 'di 'dra gzhan la med/ / des na rang stobs nam mkha'i nor bu yi/ / rgyu thabs 'gog pa'i ri bo 'bigs byed 4yog / phye mar gyis zhes gling 'dir btsugs pa'i lha/ /mig gsum gar gyi dbang phyug de mchod la/ /rim gyis rgyang grags tsam zhig 'das pa'i ngogs/ /gzhan srog bsrub la ring nas chas pa bzhin/ / bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa'i dag byed rgyun/ / gyen du 'phyur bcas sman gyi rdzing bu yod/ / der ni yan lag kun rdzogs khrus bya zhing / / mgrin par myong bya'i bcud len de 'thung dang / / yun ring tshe dang mtshar sdug lang tsho gnyis/ /phyi nang 'gran pa ji bzhin dar bar 'gyur/ / de nas sa la skabs gsum grong / / 'phos gang yul gru de la ni/ / 'byor ba btags pa'i lus can khyim/ / du ma'i ming can bgrod pa'i mthar/ / nyams gro'i khyo dang bral ba yis/ / ku sha'i lam bu phyir phyogs pa'i/ / chags pas gdungs pa'i nor 'dzin ma/ / do shal chad pa'i mu tig kyang / / phye mar gyur te smig rgyu yi/ /thags su btags pa'i gos dkar 'dzin/ / dus der bsam bzhin lam ring bgrod dkas du ba/ / steng nas nyi ma'i khyi'u'i(spra rlangs dang / / 'og nas dpyid kyi dpal mo rgyags pa'i drod/ / rta gdong zhugs 4〉ra me 'bar tsha gdung gis/ / dpral ba'i rgyan du skyed cing sring las slar/ / 'gram pa'i 'bab stegs brgyud pa'i rngul gyi chu/ / khor yug dkar po rlan dang bral ba de/ / cung zad gsher ba'i ngor bzhin lhung bar gyur/ / de tshe rang ༵ /nga

gis dbugs dbyung yang / / bzod med sems la skyo dub che ba'i tshad/ /srog len lta bur smre sngags ldan pa'i tshig / gang smra de phyir 'di don shes par byos/ /phaḍa ces gseng mthor ston pa'i sgra skad kyis/ /bying smugs 'thibs pa phyir sol du kha'i rgyun/ / bde chen klong du dmigs pas rgyas btab ste/ /mig byed gyen du phyogs pa'i skabs shig na/ / 'dab brgya'i lte bar 'khrungs pa'i zhal lung gi/ /snying po'i gsang tshig sbas pa'i 'bigs byed ri/ / (phung po ri bo che )rtse la grub pas byin rlabs bsam gtan khang / /ji snyed yar ngo'i zla ltar dkar ba yod/ / longs dag mkha' 'gros bsrungs pa'i kha rlangs kyis/ / na bun stug po sna lngar bun ni ba/ / mthun phyogs dri len bu mos bskyod pa'i gseb/ / de kun mthong ba'i bu khyod skal ba bzang / / gsang gter zab mo'i sgo brgya myur du phyes/ / bka' brgya'i man ngag mdud pa lhug par khrol/ /thogs med mkha' spyod ral gri ()mag tu longs/ / nub phyogs sa 'dzin phag tu gshegs pa'i tshe/ / tshes bzang lha yi 'dun sa(kyenanyis par mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ / myu gu phul byung bskrun pa'i sa bon mi lus rin chen mchog brnyes pa/ / su zhig 'tshe ba don dang ldan de bslab gsum gtsang ma'i du ku la/ / gang gi 'byung gnas thub bstan gser mdog 'dzin ma'i chod gra ltar bod pa/ / de na rab byung smra ba'i nyi ma'i gzugs/ /bla gos mthun mtshams 'od kyi dra ba can/ / brgya phrag bcu ldan sdom brtson dul ldan pa/ /ngur ba'i rkang 'gros lta bur rgyu ba yod/ / 'chad pa'i rnga sgras mkhas rlom bag yod byed/ / rtsod pa'i rdo rjes phyi rgol snying rab 'gem/ /rtsom pa'i 'phreng bas thub bstan mgul ba mdzes/ / de kun mdzad pa de las gzhan du ci/ / gang gi dbus na tshang yid ri mos kyang / / bris bas mtshon min spyar bu'i gtsug lag khang / /rin chen dra phyed 'phyang ba'i zar tshagasadu

42kyi/ /rtser btags gser gyi dril chung mgrin pa nas/ / skad rigs bzhi yi tshig gis ma smras kyang / / kun gyi yid ga 'gugs byed sil sil sgra/ / rnga yab zla byed bzhad pa'i dbyug gu'i rtse/ / dri bzhon lag pas bzung nas bskul ba yod/ / de nang bstan pa'i 'khor lo mi lus zol/ / mngon sum snang byed paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ / mdor na shes byar gang srid rig gnas kun/ / gang thub gcig pus bsdus pa'i yongs 'dzin byung / / chos kun rngul tsamam grub ye shes sku/ / ltar snang yul la mi snang 'gro gsum gyis/ /dbang por 'tsham phyir phyi rol rdos bcas kyis/ / gzugs can ring bsrel phung bo zhig bzhag pa'i/ /lha mi'i mchod rten che de kai la sha'i/ / rngul gyi dum drugs 'khrigs pa'i sa 'dzin ngos/ / 'ja' ris dra ba 'khyud 'dra dngul dkar gyi/ / na bza' mdzes min za 'og dar gyi snabs/ / der mchis mthong ba'i mod la snying dbus su/ / brjod du med pa'i ngo mtshar ro bda' ba'i/ / zil dang ldan pa'i reg bya had de brjo / blang bya ngo bos stong ba'i gnas skabs su/ /lta stangs gnag tshogs 'char sgo'i gtsos zung la/ / der ni zol med dngos kun gyis btud nas/ / yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i gtsug lag gzhung / / ngag gi bzlas brjod tsam zhig lhur blangs te/ / zho 'thung rus pa (nyan yang byin rlabs kyi/ / nyi ma brdar ba'i 'khor lo 'bar ba'i mtshan/ / rnon po gang gi mtho 'tshams 'og lha'i/ / g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i smon lam mdzod/ / de nas rgyang grags 'ga' zhig 'das pa'i sa/ / bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i rtse mo gang / / mtho ris snyegs la pad+ma rā ga yi/ / brag ri rab mthor brtsegs pa'i cod pan du/ / in+d+ra nī li'i khang bzang mthon mthing gi/ / ba gam gsal bkra ma shir+sha'i (don 'gyur pu shu dang / tshig 'gyur log pa'i rim pa )'dzum/ / ston zla'i 'od kyi skud pa rgyu skar gyi/ / mu tig dog pa tshar du dngar ba'i rtser/ / nor bu'i dbyug ༵ ḍing

bo rnga thub dang / / seng ge chu srin rma bya klu za ba'i0 / ba dan dpyangs shing rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba ni/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i dge mtshan bzhin/ / gser phru 'bar ba'i gzi byin ma bzod par/ / nyin byed mkha' gos sdug pas gdong bsgribs tshe/ / dril chung sil sil rnga yab ku mud tshogs/ /'phreng bar bsgrigs te 'phya bas rgod pa bzhin/ / de dag 'jam por 'bab pa'i dri len gyis/ / dal bur bskyod pa'i lang ling zlos gar dang / / lhang lhang sgra yi glu snyan mi na ka/ / rnam par do rang gar gyi rnam 'gyur bzhin/ / rin chen dra mig mdzes pa'i skar khung la/ / pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs gsal sgo glegs te/ / rab tu bkra ba gtsug lag lugs brgya yi/ /rnam dbye bzang po 'gro la 'byed pa bzhin/ / nor bu'i rna cha rgyan phreng gis sgeg pa'i/ / lha phrug gzhon nu dregs pa'i drung 'khor tshogs/ / 'od 'bar them skad ring bor 'bab 'dzeg gi/ / rnam 'gyur ling ling 'chi med 'dun sa bzhin/ / 'bru nor dar gzab gser dngul bang mdzod dang / / bza' bca' btung myang bdud rtsi'i g.yos bsngags kyis/ / dpal 'byor longs spyod chen po 'jig rten kun/ / smon pa'i gnas gcig rnam rgyal khang bzang bzhin/ / gang gi lte bar rab brjid seng ge'i khri/ / lha rdzas gos kyis bkra ba khrims gnyis kyi/ / 'khor los sgyur ba'i(yinapal du skabs gsum stan/ /zla ba ltar dkar a mo ni ka(1raphos pa bzhin/ / bya 'dab mar gad 'od mdangs gdugs mdzes kyis/ /grib ma snum pos khyab pa'i khor yug kun/ /lha dang mi yi bde chen zla shel gyi/ / khang mig khri phrag grong khyer tshogs pa bzhin/ / gang gi mdun sar 'dzam gling skye rgya'i tshogs/ / mtha' dag spungs 'dra'ispyod tshul me long du/ / ma shar srid pa'i 'khor lo de gang zhes/ /gswākā zlog can dag lha mig thob pa bzhin/ / mthon mthing lan bu grol bas

bzhin zla yi/ /dkar mdangs mdzes pa gsal ba'i ut+pa la'i/ /mig 'dzum g.yo ba rtse dga'i tshon ris kyis/ / lam srang la yang rgyan mang ster ba bzhin/ /su ra'i(3bum brgya ster las myos byed kyi/ /cho ga rab rdzogs khur lci skye bo phal/ / rkang ba'i 'degs 'jog chos dka' 'khyor ba'i lus/ /mig rtsa dmar 'khrug khro 'dzum nyams brgya'i gar/ / ral ba'i thor chog bcings pa phyed grol gyi/ / khur chen g.yas su khyog kyang sdang mig gi/ / lta stangs g.yon du gzur nas ral gri'i mgo/ / lan brgyar gnon cing ngar ngar sgra 'byin yang / / khrims lugs ga bur bsil 'od 'bab pa der/ /nyer 'tshe'i tsha zer 'bar bas bsreg min na/ / 'jig skrag mun pa'i rdul phran phra mo yang / / sems kyi ku mud 'dab rtser gzung mi bya/ / slar yang dpag tshad bgrod pa'i ri bo'i phag / rtse dga'i zla shel rang bzhin nor 'dzin ma/ /dgung zla'i 'od mdangs gos dkar klubs pa'i lus/ /gza' skar me tog tshom bus mdzes 'dra der/ /gangs ri'i mu khyud lta bu'i lcags ri ni/ / ti se'i lcog bcas yongs skor mtsho chen dbus/ / chos sde gser gyi pad tshad rgyas pa'i 'dzum/ / dpal ldan snar thang zhes bya'i gtsug lag khang(3 / di paṃ ka ra4)yi bod lha gcig gi/ / ring lugs dri med li shi'i gur khang du/ / 'phags chen gnas brtan dgra bcom bcu drug4)go/ / rnam 'phrul 'dren mchog du ma'i zhabs sen rdul/ / lha yi me tog gis reg nor bu'i khri/ /byin rlabs sbrang ri'i 'byung gnas nyid drung na/ / khyod kyang zur phud dud pa mthon mthing gi/ / 'od chags bung ba'i gar gyis cis mi rtsen/ /de nas chu ldan4todzes pa'i lang tsho la/ / gcig tu srid der nyin byed gzhon nu dag / phrag dog cher rgyas tsha ba'i zer non gyis/ / bgrod dka'i lam la chu 'dzin ltar rtses pas/ / mu tig dkar po'i cod parā /ga

pa'i tshogs/ / dngul gyi thigs phreng chad pa lhung bzhin du/ / dal bur bgrod las yongs su dga' ldan gyi/ / gzhal med khang brtsegs sa la 'phos pa ltar/ /bzang lung khro bu'i bste gnas4sted lam du/ yongs su dub pa'i ngal gsor thob pa lags/ / gser gyi lhun po bdud rtsi'i char chen gyis/ /lan brgyar bkrus 'dra ma pham rgyal ba'i sku4) / mtshan dpe nyi ma stong gi gzi bo che/ /sdug bsngal mun pa'i lang tsho bcil ba dang / /dgyes 'dzum zla rgyas 'bum gyis nyon mongs kyi/ /tsha gdung bsil ba'i 'phrin las lha cig pa/ /gang der dang po'i dad pa be+e ḍūd+ma'i/ / zhun ma gaṅgā sbreng ba'i arnya dang / /legs dpyad man+da ra ba'i me tog gis/ / lhag bsam snyim pa bkang te gus mchod nas/ /'di nas dpal ldan kai la sha yi bar/ / gegs med ri bo'i snye ma yongs smin slad/ /spro mun sprin gyi sgeg mo'i dgu nang de/ /smon lam dag pa'i cha mngal gyis lcir mdzod/ /slar ni chu ma las kyang byang ngos su/ / cung zad phyogs par dpag tshad 'ga' bgrod tshe/ / dung gzhong 'o mas bkang 'dra'i mtsho chen 'gram/ / ngam ring 47la ba che de'i sa skyong ba/ / rang bzhin cis kyang mi 'gyur mkhregs pa'i shel/ / mdzad bzang sgo brgya'i tshon gyis ches bkra bas/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zlos gar kho na zhes/ /dpyod ldan skye bo'i dbyangs su 'tsher ba yod/ / byin rlabs dpal bzang 'bar ba'i rten gsum dang / /sdom brtson khri phrag 'dus pa'i snam sbyar gyis/ / mkha' yang li khri'i snang ba rgyas byed der/ / dga' zhing rangs pas rnam dkar bsod nams spel/ /de nas nyin zhag zung gi 'khor lo dag / yol bas phyin par dge mtshan rgyas pa'i sa/ / bkra shis rdo thal gyis skya phyogs kun las/ / rnam rgyal sergo cher 'gying mgo bo'i dbyings/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul gzugs ye shes gar/ /'jigs med dpa' bo bdun47)sa grub pa'i gnas//da~X ldan sa skya47sa bya 'jig rten 'di'i/ / brtan g.yo snod bcud

srid dang zhi ba yi/ /dpal yon ngo mtshar legs rgu ci mchis pa'i/ / 'byung gnas gcig pus sa gsum rna lung gis/ / rgyan mdzes ut+pal dar pa'i cho ga ni/ /grags dkar bdud rtsi'i chab kyis brlan pa bzhin/ / khyab par dge legs a mra'i 'khri shing yongs smin 'dab ma bdun pa'i dri bzang gis dngar 'phags yul sā la'i nags su bskrun pa'i rnam dpyod lus kyi stobs stsal rig gnas bcud kyis cher rgyas pa'i/ / dpal ldan 'phrog byed dga' bo4)nas bya mu stegs 4〉nga bo stong gi dbus na rnam par bsgyings par khyu mchog rlabs chen gnas su dam bcas dregs pa'i chang gis shin tu rab myos shes rab 'chal pa'i dris bgos pa'i/ / rig byed bzhi ldan 'gram pa'i phyogs sger grags pa bung ba'i khyu tshogs dar dir sgrog pa dbyar skyes rnga bzhin 'jigs med spobs pa'i sna zhags ring po gnam du bslang pa mthar byed (sprod pa'i be con dang mtshungs par/ / sgra tshad gnam lcags ral gri'i 'khor lo drag po skor bzhin log rtog shugs yan lag chen po'i rdog thabs bskyod pas thub mchog ring lugs 'dam bu'i tshal chen gzhom zhing rgyal bar dka' ba'i 'gros kyis lhags pa gang / / 'di na 'jig rten gsum gyi rnam 'dren kun gzigs dbang po gyur kyang yongs 'dzin gnas lnga rig pa'i zlos gar bsgyur mkhas 'jam dbyangs bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan (zerajigs pa kun bral smra pa'i seṅge bslab gsum dag pa'i lus stobs rab tu rgyas pa de ni mang du gsan pa ser ral ba'i khur chen gyis brjid lung dang rigs pa'i mig rtsa dmar 'khrug phyogs brgyar gzigs shing bgrad pa'i gzi byin nyi ma ltar 'bar zhing / /'jigs rung phaḍa ces phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i nga ro shin tu drag pos lhun po'i brtan pa 'dar ba bzhin du byang phyogs bsil ljongs kha ba'i rdul tshogs lhag par rgyas pa zla shel ga bur dum grubs brtsegs pas8 spya la

sha yi khor yug gis rten dbang phyug bgyis pa'i zhing gi thig le gcig bu dpal ldan sa skya mkhas dang grub pa'i skye bo 'bum phrag 'du ba'i bsti gnas mchog las nyer bzhengs te/ / gang zhig sa chen gsum gyi ma dul g.yo zhing 'degs pa'i gar gyis rgol dang phyi rgol dbang po'i khri stan ci yang bshams pa skye bo mkhas pa'i 'dun sa chen por dgyes par gshegs nas bcu gsum gdugs dang bstan pa dbang du btsugs pa'i phyi nang rtsod pa'i 'khor lo bskor tshe dngos stobs rigs pas rnon por brdar pa'i sgrub dang sun 'byin rdo rje'i mchu sder mtshon cha 'bar bas rgol ngan glang chen dregs pa de'i/ / spobs pa'i spyi bo drag por bkas pas 'khor bcas ral ba'i cod pan lhun zhing zhabs rdul gtsug tu gus bsten bdud las rnam pa ber ber g.yo ba'i cho 'phrul rgya chen de 'dras thub bstan gser gyi rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs shing bshad sgrub chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed la sa chen 'di na 'gran zla su zhes lha mi'i 'jig rten mgrin brgya sdeb/ / de lta'i mkhas mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / blo gros chen po yangs pa'i mkhar/ / kun mkhyen ye shes nyi ma stong / / cig car gsal ba'i gzi byin gyis/ / lugs kyi bstan bcos rig gnas lnga/ / sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ / shes bya'i dal ba rab 'byams la/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom dang bshad sgrub kyi/ / snang ba cher 'bar gangs ri 'di/ / lham mer mdzad las srid zhi bzhad/ / phun tshogs u dum wa ra'i tshal/ / gang du 'dab brgya ches cher bzhad/ / 'on kyang snyigs ma'i rgyad mang ba mo dag / thub bstan dbyar gyi lang tsho yol ba las/ / lnga brgya tha ma'i ston gyi grang reg dang / / dal bur 'grogs rdul tshogs kyis bkas bkag pas/ / 'di na rtsod dus skye rgu'i legs spyod bzhin/ / kun dga'i tshon mdangs ches cher rnyings pa der/ / snod bcud mi rtag g.yo ba dus bsdonā mtharadu / 'khyug por dkyu la yid 'byung mtshon rnon dang / / gong

ma'i rnam thar dran pa'i chu nang du/ / nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin gsal ba'i 'char 'od kyis/ / thog ma med nas 'khor bar 'ching ba'i gzeb/ /'jigs tshogs lta ba'i mun stug de bcil mdzod/ / de nas bsil ba'i reg bya tsan dan chur/ / rab bkrus mthon mthing lan bu g.yo ldan zhing / / ga bur do shal rtse dgar rgod pa'i 'dzum/ / kha ba'i mu tig do shal 'phyang bzhin du/ / ma la ya rlung 'jam pa'i dbugs 'phreng dang / / ston mtshan zla ba'i bsil 'od 'dzum zer gyis/ / rab sgeg dus kyi dpal mo'i sgyu 'phrul las/ / sna tshogs yul gyi rnam 'gyur mang snang yang / / mnyes gshin des pa'i yid kyi gos zur du/ / skyon med pañca li ka()panabs byas te/ / rang sems dngul dkar me long phyis pa'i nang / / rgyu 'bras spangs blangs bzhin gzugs gsal bar ltos/ / bsil ba'i ljongs 'dir pad dkar 'dzin pa yi/ / ye shes rang gzugs bde 'byung cod pan(kyenang / / chos rgyal mes dbon gdung rigs bkod ma'i chuphya / rdul bral shin tu dwangs pa'i me long du/ /gang shar de nyid dpal ldan rdzong kha ba/ / lha rigs dbang po gang gi rgyal khab der/ / dpal 'byor dman pa min pa'i grib bsil la/ / yud tsam blo yi ngal gso bsten pa dang / / skyid grong (75 yi thig le gru 'dzin gyi/ /do zlar chas la 'phags rnams dgyes pa'i gar/ / 'jig rten dbang phyag sprul sku'i(15nga brnyan gyi/ / byin rlabs grib shing lam gyi kun dgar droston/ / de las rig 'das dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chab/ / rab dkar 'dod 'jo'i ba yi 'o rgyun ltar/ /dal 'bab glo bo'i chu mig brgya rtsa zhes/ /grub dbang du ma'i zhal lung gsal ba de/ / skal bzang snyim pas 'thung ba'i mchod yon dang / /bkra shis rnga yab rtses blangs 'thor 'thung du/ /ci yang bstan las bzhin bzang sa ka/ / lha lus dpyid kyi lang tshor bsgyusdu sas
