nas/ /byang phyogs bsil ba'i ljongs kyi spo mthon la/ / ga pur rdul tshogs srungs pa kha ba'i ri/ /rnam snang rigs kyi cod pan nor bu'i thod/ /shel gyi mchod rten 'od kyi gur khang nyid/ / ti se /ti se hi ma la ya yin par rje btsun grags pas kyang gsungs )zhes grags hi ma la ya'i yul/ / rig pa 'dzin pa mchog gi skal ba ni/ /kun dang thun mong min pa te ru gaḥ(3 /rdo rje btsun mor dgyes rol gzhal med khang / / yongs su grags pa dka' thub zlog ma yin/ / reg bya lha yi du kū la 'jam la/ / srid ldan gtsug na zla ba lus med kyi/ / rtse dga'i dpal la dga' mgur spyod pa'i sa/ / khyad par 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung / / dgra bcom stong gi tshogs bcas dgyes spyod kyi/ / gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra dbyangs chos kyi sil snyan dag / mar me mdzad dpal 'dzam gling sgron me de'i/ / lha yi rna bas gsan las gdugs tshod kyi/ /dus gdab rang gi 'khor la stsal ba'i gsung / / gnyis su med sogs gtan tshigs brgya yi 'od/ / ltar snang klan ku'i dri ma sgrub bzhin du/ /'dzam gling lte ba gangs can ri yi rgyal/ / gser gyi bya skyibs mngon dgar brgya byin gyi/ / bzhon pa sa srung dbang po lag ldan 'khor/ / lnga brgya dang bcas rtse zhing rol ba sogs/ / ngo mtshar 'dod pa'i yon tan dbang po drug/ zag med bde bas sil ba'i bcud mang po/ /dka' spyad snying stobs mthar phyin mi la(shes/ /grub pa'i lus (tos dkar gyi/ / 'dab gshos thabs shes zung 'jug shugs drag gis/ / byang chub snying po'i mkha' la bder gshegs pa'i/ /rnam 'dul skyes(2 grub pa'i gnas chen der/ / chu shing ltar du lus bsungs skyil krung dang / /mig dpangs sna rtser gtad nas kun rtog gi/ /rnyog pa rab bkrus ting 'dzin mtsho 'jing du/ / skad cig mnyam pa/ sdusag las myur langs nas/ / mgrin nag ral ba'i sprin skyes bdud

rtsi'i char/ / sa la tshangs pa'i rigs pa bsrungs pa'i chab/ / rang bzhin dag pa'i gtsang byed lha yi rdzing / / ma dros gdengs can dbang po rtse dga'i mtshotu) / bsod nams shel gyi 'bab stegs zla ba 'bum/ / gser gyi ril ba'i gzi byin nyi stong dang / / gya gyur 'dres pa'i 'ja' tshon gur khyim der/ /dri bral khrus kyi 'jug pa lhur longs shig / slar yang nub phyogs sa 'dzin mngon mtho'i sum/ / rtsa ljang mar gad sham bu bkram pa'i phang / /bgrang las me tog grol ba'i ge sar gyi/ / rdul tshogs gser gyi phye mar 'bab pa'i gzhir/ / rang byung rdo ba'i ling ga(mtshan ma 'jig(byed dang )dus (mtshan )gyi/ / gsang ba'i mtshan ma pre ta pu ri〈mang / / zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab mtshon don des/ / bcu drug dga' ba'i lang tsho brtas byas shing / 'jigs rung g.yangs gshin rje'i don 'dra ba/ nags klong stug por dkris pa mun pa'i gos/ / rab gtibs gcan gzan ngar sgras skyi g.ya' ba/ / brag ri srin po khros 'dra'i sa 'dzin dang / / 'phrog byedatu)sdol ba gsig mtshungs drag pa'i rba/ / ri bo'i zom nas gnam du mchong ba'i shugs/ /'ar 'ar bi /khyab 'jug khros pa'i rnga sgra can/ /dpung du tshogs pa'i chu klung mang brgal nas/ / nag po'i rtsa lag gdugs pa'i phud sgrogs kyi/ / nyer 'tshe gzhom la mkha' 'gro'i dbang po bzhin/ / gnas brtan nyi ma gung ba'i skyil krung gis/ / grib ma nyer zhi'i bsil ba stong 'bab pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul lha yi gdugs kyis khengs dan gur kum ge sar gyi/ / skyed tshal dri zhim sman gyi lang tsho can/ / 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug grong khyer gyi/ / phun tshogs dar drag gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ltar/ / khang bzang an+da rnyil gyi lan kun can (ti bu shun/ /chu shel dkar po'i ra bas kun nas bres/ /yid 'ong rdo bas gcal bkram lam sung la/ / ma god pad+ma ra ga be+eḍūr ༵/3 /

gser dngul mu tig byu ru bur len sogs/ / rin chen tshong zong du mas nyer mdzes shing / / 'dzum 'od bdud rtsir 'dzag pa zla ba'i gdong / / mthon mthing mig zung g.yo ba ut+pal 'dzum/ / 'dod pa'i chung ma gzhan bzhin yid 'phrog ma/ / nu rgyas khur gyis dud pa'i dal 'gros can/ / sor gdub me tog bzhad pa lag sor gyi/ / myu gu phan tshun sbrel ba'i kha sgo nas/ / bung ba'i na chung mgrin snyan bsdebs pa'i glu/ / rna ba'i lam nas sred ldan 'ching ba yod/ / de kun mig la bdud rtsi'i char 'beb kyang / / sems la gdung ba'i me lce 'bar ba'i rims/ / me tog gzhu can (r+sāgs pa'i dpung yin na/ / khyod kyang gnyen po'i go cha brtan bgos shig / yang ni me tog tshon brgyas rnam bkra ba'i/ / nags tshal lha yi dar dang kha ba'i rdul/ / rab dkar du kū la yi gos bzang gis/ / ci yang klubs pa'i sa skyong du ma dang / / dba' rlabs rtse dga'i 'dzum dang lbu 'phreng gi/ / mu tig do shal 'chi med na chung bzhin/ / gya gyur 'bab pa'i chu klung bud med tshogs/ / chu bya'i mgrin snyan glu dbyangs len dang ni/ / srid pa'i mgron por thar ba'i lam rtags bzhin/ / bgrod dka' g.yang sa'i lam 'phreng bgrang yas dag/gzhan don ro gcig gyur las ngal dub kyi/ / khur lci bsrabs pa'i shugs kyis ring brgal tshe/ /snod bcud snang ba'i ral la las kyi ni/ / byed po bi shwa kurma'i67 'phrul gyi/ / 'byor rgud bde sdug kha dog brgya ba'i tshon/ / ma 'dres rnam smin pir gyis bris pa'i gzugs/ / sna tshogs yul 'khor grong dang grong khyer longs/ / skyes pa bud med rgyan gos longs spyod sogs/ / ji snyed bgrang bar mi dpyod 'dren byed kyi/ / kun dga' dar drag rtse dga'i bdud rtsir rol/ / khyad par sar sig ces(sham+bha la'i lam na sog pa'i grong khyer yod pa grub chen sha la pa sogs gong ma mang po'i gsungs las 'byung /1bya sog po'i yu//94/rin chen chen po la 'os nor bu'i tshogs/ / gnod gnasahumanas

srung dbang po'i (khang mdzod la/ / 'gran byed byed po'i sgyu mas sprul 'dra mthong / / lus bongs kho lag che ba gnod sbyin gzugs/ / sum ldan yan lag rags sbom mkha' lding gi/ / gshog pa'i shugs 'chang mtshon cha'i 'khrul 'khor yang / / glog 'phreng 'khyug bzhin gnam lcags babs pa bzhin/ /srin bal nang tshangs can gyi gos klubs shing / / la thod zla ltar dkar bas gtsug brgyan te/ / sprin shugs mgyogs 'gro'i stong nas stobs rtsal gyi/ / rdzu 'phrul mi dang mi min som nyir byed/ / sma ra'i dus ris gsal ldan dmar nag bzhin/ / khro 'dzum me lce 'bar bas gzhan sreg kyang / / mthong na dga' ba'i rig 'dzin bu khyod kyis/ / khro ldan de rnams bsil bar gdon mi za/ / de nas byang phyogs dpag tshad du ma'i lam/ / bgrod tshe dbyar sprin chu dang bcas pa bzhin/ / mkha' la mar gad 'od chags /nam mkha'i nags tshal rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs sha la'i lam dang phyogs mthun pa'i bshad khungs 'jam dpal zhal lung 'grel ba sman zhabs kyis mdzad par byung )nags kyi tshal/ / rgya cher 'khrigs pa'i grib ma sa la 'bab/ / nyal 'gro'i klung chen (de dang ha cang mi ring bar rdo chu yod pa'ang gong ma'i lam yig 'ga' las byung )'brub pa'i zil zegs tsam/ / gang la reg pa rdo ba'i dngos byed pa'i/ / nyer 'tshe yod kyi shing lo 'khrul 'khor gyi/ / cig cig mkha' la 'dab chags brtul zhugs bzung / /de brgal sa gzhir rma bya'i mgrin pa dang / / 'chi med bu mo'i lan bu ltar mdzes pa'i/ / rtswa ljang myu gu'i skyed tshal dul ldan gyi/ / ri dwags khyu mchog rtse ba'i do ra yod/ / gdengs can mdzes pa'i bla gos chu zil gyi/ / rlan chags tsan+da grib bsil bla re dang / / gur kum dri dang ldong ros kha dog can/ / tsū ta'i snye ma yongs su smin pa'i zas/ / ri dwags ma ma phru gur bcas pa yi/ /nu zho mngar bas 'o ma'i yol go dag / yongs bkang bkra shes salha lha yi mgron/ / bdag gir blangs pas yud tsam ngal gso bston/ / slar ya~X ḍing

bgrod nags rong mun pa'i sbubs/ / na bun dud sprin 'thibs pa'i kha rlangs gseb/ / mig dang mjug mar me stag dmar 'khyug gi/ / gcan gzan gtum po nags kyi gshed ma'i tshogs/ / 'phral du bsal ba'i sha rus dam dum du/ / mche ba'i sta res gcod pa'i thag thug dang / / zhag ldan khrag gis myos pa'i ngar ngur sgras/ / brtan yang 'jig pa'i spu long zang zing byed/ / khrag bgos dmar sel ral ba'i khur lci bas/ / rngam nag bskal steng mun pa byung 'dra'i lus/ / mig gnyis zangs ltar dmar bas gzhan srog gis/ / mel tshe byed pa gdug pa'i gnod sbyin dang / / nyin gzugs mi lus mtshan gzugs gcan gzan sogs/ / sprul bsgyur du ma'i gar mkhan phra men dang / / mtshan rgyu chen po mi zad sha za'i gdon/ / skabs gsum grong khyer pa yang sgrog skyed de/ /lus can lus can min pa nyer 'tshe'i dpung / /bar ma'i srid paḍū〉thar byed pho nya ltar/ / rngams shing 'jigs pas saces pa'i tshe srog la/ / kham zas byed pa'i gshed ma mang mchis kyang / / gang la bzod med snying rje'i sems bskyed na/ / gnod las rang lus bsrung bar a zad kyi/ / gzhan gyi sdang sems mtshon cha kun gzhom phyir/ / de mtshungs rdo rje'i go cha gnyis pa gang / / de rjes nyi zla'i snang ba chags de'i drod/ / yid srubs mtshams sbyor pho nyas bskul ba las/ / sngo bsangs nam mkha'i gzhon nu 'jom med du/ / dbyig 'dzin bu mo'i lus la 'khyud pa bzhin/ / mgod in+d+ra ni la'i khog pa las/ / khor yug ltar mi mngon pa'i chu gter la/ /bsod nams bzhin du thabs mkhas gzings bsten dang / / mthun pa'i rlung gis mngon 'dod gnas su skyel/ / chu dbang brgal ba'i pha rol mya ngam gyi/ / thang chen 'khor ba'i lam ltar bde ba'i rlan/ / cung zad rnyed min tsha zer gdug byed kyis/ / rab bsregs rdul gyi thigs par zhu ba snyam/ / de la lo rdo shāb zegs shing skam gyi/ / yal ga g.yabs kyang bsil min drod 'bar

bas/ / sar skyes rgan po skyo ba'i si glu dag /len pa'i dbugs kyang tsha ba'i shugs ring bzhin/ / de tshe lce chu 'dod 'jo'i nu rgyas dag / dal bur bzhibs pas nang gi ri bong can/ / bdud rtsir 'dzag pa'i chu rgyun btung shes na/ / bkres skom kun sel 'chi med lang tsho rgyas/ / ('di sogs ma rdo las 'byung ba'i bkod pa 'di rnams rgya shug gi gling du 'gro ba'i yi ge las bshad cing / de yang 'phags yul gyi byang ri gangs can gyi phyogs su bshad pa 'brel cha'o/ / )yang ni zlos 'gro zhes bya'i sa 'dzin ngos/ / drag po'i ser bu'i rab rib mig ldongs byed/ / der ni don yod ces bya'i sman bsten pas/ / lta byed sngon las lhag pa'i skal bzang thob/ / sa gzhi de las yun ring gnod sbyin phyogs4) /song tshe 'jigs rung zangs kyi nags zhes pa/ / pā la chen po'i nags kyi tshang tshing gzhir/ / sbram chen zhes bya sbrul nag brang mig can/ / zla drug gnyid log gyur las lang pa'i gzugs/ / mig sman ri bo 'gul 'dra'i mgrin pa'i sbubs/ / lhun po'i zom4)pas dpag tshad khyab pa yi/ / dug gi kha rlangs na bun cher 'khrugs pas/ / gang reg lus can thal bar byed de las/ / ma ghi ta(ldong ros ) zhes bya ba'i sman bsten na/ / rma bya'i rgyal mo gser du snang ba ltar/ / dug gi zer mas sman gyi bcud len ster/ / de nas ha cang ring ba min pa'i sa/ / rtse gsum zhes bya'i mngon mtho'i ri ngos kun/ / rdo rje ltar no'i tsher mas gtams pa der/ / zang glegs rkang par bcings pa'i man ngag bsten/ / slar yang dpag tshad du ma'i lam brgal bar/ / rtse mo rab 'byung nor bu spungs pa 'dra'i/ / ri ngos spos kyi nags tshal dkrigs pa'i gzhir/ / stang zil4)bug gi bya skyibs gang / / mā l+li ka dbyangs sbrang ldan rkang 'thung gi/ /snye ma yongs smin g.yur za'i grib shing dang / / 'jam ljang ku sha'i gdengs par bsam gtan la/ / rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa'i drang srong mchog / skyil krung brtan par bcings pa rdo rje'i gdan/ 19/snas

bsrangs mi 'khyog chu shing sdong bu bzhin/ / zim bu'i spyan ras g.yo med mthon mthing mdangs/ / man dkyus ri mo'i 'khri shing rnam 'gyur bral/ /gser bcas 'od ltar chags pa'i mdog mdangs shing / / tshul khrims dri bsung dbang po tshim pa'i bad/ / khro chags spangs kyang yid tsam 'dzum pa'i nyams/ /legs byas pir gyi ri mo'i gzugs 'dra yod/ / mthong ma thag tu cod pan grol ba'i gtsug / se la lan brgyar dud pa'i phyag bgyis nas/ /snyan 'jibs tshig gi me tog 'thor mkhas pas/ / 'jigs chen lam gyi gdams pa yang dag zhus/ / de yi gsang sngags grub pa'i bden tshig gis/ / rnam pa g.yo ba'i rlung dmar 'jigs rung dang / / mkha' la 'bar 'dra byin za'i phung bo che/ / rdo rje'i ser chen drag por 'bab pa dang / / srin bu mig dmar srog gi chom rkun ni/ / mkha' lding dus min thog ltar lhung ba sogs/ / brtan dang g.yo ba'i nyes brgya ches 'khrug pa'i/ / 'jig mun bsal nas ring du bsgrod pa na/ / phyogs kun in+da rnyil dang keci ka(3 / chu lha'i gdengs ka ji bzhin ches sngo bar/ / gser dngul kur nyad ta dang dbang sngon gyi/ / rdo ba las grub khang brtsegs 'od 'bar ba/ / chu shel dkar po'i khor yug gis mdzes shing / / rkang 'thung lo ma'i gur lding skyed mos tshal/ / dpag bsam shing las 'dod dgu'i longs spyod can/ / mi'am ci yi grong khyer (dus 'khor las longs spyod kyi sa'i bzhi ba mi'am ci'i yul du bshad pa dang / 'dir mi'am ci'i grong yod par bstan pa la 'gal ba gtan med cing /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snon snyan gyi gong rgyan las 'dzam bu'i gling byang phyogs gang can dang nye ba'i sa na mi'am ci'i grong khyer chen po yod pa'i gangs can yang sham+bha la yin par don gyis bshad pa sogs bshad khungs rnam dag kyang yod pas/ phyogs re'i log rtog la ma zhen par mang du thos pa'i mkhas pa la dris shog mthong bar 'gyur/ / nor bu'i rtsi/ ༵༵ yongs brtan khrus kyi rdzing / / ke ta ka(yiyi rdul gyis rab dwangs

nang / / ha ri tsan dan rgyas pa'i dri zhim pa/ / dpal gos ge sar ut+pal bzhad pa der/ /khrus kyi rtse dga' la chags mi'am ci'i/ / bu mo yid 'phrog lang tsho'i mtshar sdug can/ / gser gyi 'khri shing nor bu'i lcug phran bar/ /'jigs byed rlung gzhon 'jam pos bskul ba bzhin/ / rnam bkra lha yi gos dang dril chung gi/ / sgra ldan ska rags mu tig lan tshar gyis/ / mdzes byas chu yi rol rtsed dbu ba'i phreng / /chu skyes ge sar rdul tshogs chags pa bzhin/ /zla ba'i gdong dang ut+pal 'dzum pa'i mig / me tog mda' yi reg pa dar ba'i dpyid/ / 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur stong gas mtshan mo'i dpal/ / ku muta canaganyen4yimadzes sdug 'phrog pa bzhin/ / rna rgyan rin chen 'od 'phrog kunika(1/ / 'chang bas 'gram pa'i me long sgeg pa gang / / dri zhim lan bu'i ra rig byas pa dag / 'dzum zer gsal ba'i 'od kyis sel ba bzhin/ / pad dkar bzhan pa'i bzhi ldan lha bu khyod/ / mthong na smin legs bung ba de kun yang / / yid srubs rab tu g.yo ba'i 'phur lding dang / / chags bde sbrang rtsir sred pas dar dir byed/ / ha la'i me tog na chung bung ba'i ro/ / rang dgar myangs bas 'tsho ba 'gog byed kyang / / rig sngags zab mo'i sman du byas pa'i zas/ / 'di na bcud len mchog gcig gtsug ldan bzhin/ / de'i phyir gsang ba mchog gi pho brang dang / / nye bar son pa'i mtshan ma mngon gyur der/ / mkha' spyod grub pa'i pho nya mo rnams la/ / snyoms 'jug4)gar gyis rol ba cis mi bsten/ / zur mig rnam 'gyur yid yid gnyis mtshams sbyor bzhin/ / 'dzum dkar gos klubs yan lag 'khri shing 'khyud/ /nus rgyas ge sar rtses shing ro 'dzin gyi/ / sprang chang myang ba lus med rtse dga'i skyes/ / mkha' 'gro gdong gi 'dam skyes ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ / rtsa yi mdzes spyi rkang drug rtse ba'i gar/ / bcu drug ༵ sdus

rdzogs pa lhan skyes kyi/ / sbrang rtsi mngar ba dpyid kyi kun dga' bzhin/ / ho yig dus me gros pa'i gzi byin gyis/ / phung khams dri ma'i tshang tshing kun bsregs shing / / tam yid zla ba bzhu ba bdud rtsi'i chus/ /'khor lo drug(kye89 gi zhing sa rab rlan nas/ / stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis4〉 skyu'i grong / / nyis khri chig stong drug brgya'i sdes(kyenang bas/ / yan lag bdun ldan me shugs rdo rje'i sku4)/ / 'grub byed myur bde'i lam srang gzhan gang zhig / tha mal lcags kyi khams la gser 'gyur ltar/ / zag med bde bas rnam par sbyang ba'i lus/ / 'ja' tshon rang bzhin 'phags pa'i zhing mchog der/ / bgrod la dbugs 'byin kun gyi dang por gyur/ / slar ni rin chen 'od 'bar ri bo dang / /mu tig dbu ba rab brtsegs nyal 'gro'i klung / /lha gnas dum bu chad 'dra'i yul ljongs kun/ / spro dga'i shugs kyis bde bar bgrod pa'i tshe/ / 'jigs byed ri bo slar yang bslangs pa ltar/ / rtse mo mkha' la snyegs 'dra'i sa 'dzin che/ / kha ba'i dum grub rab tu brtsegs pa'i drung / / 'dab bzang rnams kyang rang gi dregs gtong ba/ / bar med ra bas bskor pas phyogs kyi sgo/ / bgegs byed mdun du bgegs ni gzugs can bzhin/ / mngon sum mthong las re ba'i puṣ+ṭha kuyi/ /'bral med rab rnyings thabs brgya'i sgo brdungs tshe/ / kun dga' gsar ba'i myu gu sreg byed kyi/ / yid zhum gdung ba'i sreg za mi sbar ba/ / rgyal ba'i thugs rje yid bzhin re ba skong / / dpag bsam shing 'drar som nyi'i dri bcil nas/ /rnam 'dren mchog gi bsam yas yon tan skor/ /rtse gcig dang ba'i mar me snying nang du/ /'od rab gsal bas chu skyes 'dab ma yi/ / mal 'jam por dran dang ldan pas gnod/ / kun rmongs gnyid mun stug po shel bzhin seswāswāsnyo/ / khyung sngon skyes kyi zol la susna yo/ / rab rib kun sangs 'od

dpal dag pa'i mkha'/ / tho rangs ji bzhin rdul bral mngon sum 'gyur/ /der ni 'phags chen rnams kyi thugs rje'i sprin/ / dum bur lding ba'i bla bre lta li khyogs/ / ston zla'i dregs pa gzhon te dpung ba'i khris/ / shing bal khur ltar blang bzod tshig mda'i bu/ / gser gyi dril chung sil sil rkang gdub kyi/ / sgra snyan rna ba'i rol mor byed pa bzhin/ / gdugs bzhin rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkhar 'degs pa'i/ / bgrod pas mkha' lding la yang skyengs pa ster/ / gang zhig rab mtho'i gtsug tor mkhar snyeg ri bo sum bcas la ni pa gam rim par rtse dgas 'dzeg bzhin rkang ba'i mtsho skyes kyi gnon dang / /gang dag chu tshogs drag por bsrubs pa'i shugs chen gyis bskyod rba rlabs gyen 'thor chu klung dang bcas rgya mtsho gnag rjes ji bzhin bde bar brgal/ / gang yang 'jigs rung gnod gnas khros 'dra'i nags tshal stug po sbrul gdug gcan gzan tshogs kyis gang bar khang bzang nang bzhin dga' bder bgrod byed pa/ / gang gang de der gzhan don spyod la spro dga'i brtson 'grus kyis bsgrubs snying stobs rmad byung de kun e ma ngo mtshar rtag tu bsngags bya'i gnas/ / khyod kyang lam ring ngal dub tsha gdung gis/ / gzhon nu lang tsho'i me tog ches rnyings kyang / / gzhan don ro gcig yongs smin snye ma'i khur/ / skal bzang ston gyi longs spyod de rmad byung / / de nas yongs rdzogs ke la sha yi gnas/ / dpal ldan sham bha la(kye zhes grags pa'i zhing / / zla nang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'phyur ba'i rlabs/ / rgyu skar ku muta tshogs kyis bkra ba bzhin/ / dkar bas yid kyi rmongs mun drungs 'byin zhing / / bsil bas 'khor ba'i zhugs gdung 'phrog mkhas pa/ / dkar sel 'dod lha'i me long me tog gis/ / mda' lnga rdzogs kyang yid srubs dgrar gyur te/ / skal bzang mig gi mgron du 'thob 'gyur gyi/ / bgrod dka'i lam gyi ngur dub dbugs phyung ste/ / mngon 'dod bdud rtsi mngar ba~X sbyang

char ni/ / yid bzhin 'bab pa'i kun dga' rab bsil mdzod/ / dpal ldan lhun po khams drug rin chen gyi rang bzhin/ / zla ba'i gling sogs gling drug dang ni 'od sngon sogs/ / sa 'dzin drug dang sbrang rtsi la sogs mtsho drug gis/ / spel mar yongs bskor longs spyod pa de'i phyi rol gang / / bsil ba'i ri dang lan tsho'i mtsho dbus sa dkyil dag / gling bdun pa nyid 'dzam gling chen po las kyi sa/ / dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga'i zhing ldan phyi mtha'i la/ / sum 'bum dang ni nang mtha' 'bum dang lnga khri ste/ / phyogs bzhi re re mtshams bzhir gnyis gnyis dum bu ni/ / bcu gnyis su bgos re re'i phyir mtha' stong phrag dag / nyi shu rtsa lnga nang mtha'i byed bcas bcu gsum nyid/ / lho yi dum bu dbus ma phyed bgos lho byang ni/ / stong phrag phyed bcas bcu gsum mnyam pa'i byang ma yang / / phyed du bgos la drug stong nyis brgya lnga bcu re'i/ / g.yas phyogs dbus kyi lte ba nas btsams phyogs kun tu/ / lnga brgya'i tshad skor chu zhing mnyam par stong gi sa/ / kai la shar grags gangs ri zlum pa yi/ / pad+ma'i lte ba 'bur dod steng gi yul/ / gang la dpal ldan sham bha lar grags pa'i/ / sham bha bde 'byung zhes pa dbang phyug ming / / la ni 'dzin pa bde 'byung gis bzung phyir/ / sham bha la zhes sa gsum na ba'i rgyan/ / phyi rol pad+ma'i 'dab brgya bye ba'i dbyibs/ / mu khyud lta ba'i gangs ris kun nas bskor/ / gangs ri dang bcas mtha' dag sa yi khyon/ /gsum cha lte ba sum gnyis 'dab ma'i tshul/ / de phyir chu dang zheng yang sum stong du/ / yang dag mnyam pa kun nas zlum por gnas/ / dbus kyi lte bar gnas gtsang lhas bkod pa'i/ / grong khyer chen po dpal ldan ka lā pa/ /zhes bya chos kyi rgyal bo'i pho brang mchog / sa la gnas pa'i 'og min stug po bkod/ / gang gi nye 'khor tshangs pa'i drang srong tshogs/ / kun dgar gnas pa/ /zlo ni bye bas bskor/ / lho na ma la ya yi skyed mos tshal/ / dpal gyi

dum bu yongs rgya tsan da na'i/ / yal 'dab sdug por dkrigs pa chu lha mo'i/ / bla gos mkha' la bkram pa'i lding khang nas/ / ga pur bsil ba 'bab pa'i gru char gyis/ / srid pa'i gdung ba zas su byed pa snyam/ / de dbus chos rgyal zla bzangayigis bzhengs pa'i/ / khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor mchog / rtsa thig la khrus bzhin rgya'i tshad ldan gang / / sna tshogs rin chen las grub gzi 'od 'bar/ / gang du rigs ldan chos kyi rgyala3nyernams kyis/ / ye shes thugs rje rgyas pa'i sprin sngon las/ / skal bzang gdul bya'i zhing la rnam kun tu/ / dbang bzhi'i char rgyun 'bebs pa yongs mi nub/ / shar na nye ba'i yid kyi mtsho dang ni/ / nub na pad+ma dkar po rgyas pa'i mtsho/ / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ / yid kyi rnyog ma ngang gis bgrungs pa bzhin/ / sna tshogs chu skyes yon tan rgyas pa'i tshon/ /'phags pa'i gzigs ngor lang tsho dar drag cing / / dga' zhing 'phyo lding chu bya'i mgrin snyan dang / / sbrang rtsir myong ba bung ba'i glu dbyangs kyang / / rtag tu dam pa'i chos kyi sil snyan ni/ / sgra brgyar 'char ba thub rnams dgyes pa'i gtam/ / pho brang mtsho rdzing gnyis dang skyed mos tshal/ / bzhi dag dpag tshad bcu gnyis gru bzhir mnyam/ / pad+ma'i lte ba dang ni 'dab brgyad kyi/ /dbyibs su gangs ris bcad las yongs grub pa'i/ / 'dab ma re yang lte ba mu khyud bar/ / gnyis gnyis dang ni 'phred du gsum gsum du/ / ri chus bcad las yul can bcu gnyis re/ / yongs dril yul chen dgu bcu rtsa drug la/ / rub ma pu rasba dang tsasba ka / spre'u gser sogs ming yang tha dad yod/ / dbus na byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdunaspyi/ / yongs dag thar ba mchog gi gzhal med khang / / rdo rje'i dbyings zab pho brang ka lā pa/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa rgya che'i gnas/ / sna tshogs mchod pa'i lha mo bgrang yas dag / gar bsgyur kha khyer mdzes pas nyer brten pa/ /ri~X rten

sna lnga'i rtsig pa la 'phos pa'i/ / gzugs brnyan dbang po'i tshon brgya bkra ba bzhin/ / 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi ba gam ni/ / rab mthor brtsegs pa nyi ma 'char kha'i zer/ / yidra tī la'i bya 'dab sprin sngon gyi/ / chu zil dang 'grogs 'ja' tshon 'khrug pa bzhin/ / chu srin kha sgo las dpyangs mu tig gi/ / dra ba dra ba phyed pa dbu ba'i phreng / / rnga yab dang bas nyer bston 'phur lding gi/ / gshog rlung 'jam pos zla tshes bskyod pa bzhin/ / ba ku la 'phreng shar bu 'dzum dkar po'i/ / snang bas phyogs kyi mgron bor 'phrog skyes kyi/ /la du byin nas gser gyi dril chung dang / / gser kha'i sgra yi legs 'ong dri ba bzhin/ / mda' yab chu shel dkar po zla ba 'bum/ / tshar du dngar ba sprin gyi so 'phreng dag / bzhad pa 'dzum 'od 'bar ba rgyu skar gyi/ / 'bru dang 'bras yod me tog 'thor ba bzhin/ / pad+ma rā ga'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i khyams/ / byu ru'i 'khri shing ka bas yongs su btegs/ / mig mang ris bris marnya rnyil ba'i gdungs/ / rdo rje rin chen 'od kyi 'od 'bar bzhin/ / gnyis 'thung phrag par 'phrog byed cher 'gying ba'i/ / spar khyim can dang shā la bhañji'i rtser/ / rta babs gser gdung g.yu yis myos srung bcas/ / re mig lha mo'i gar gyi mdzes pa bzhin/ / nu rgyas lang tsho'i khur gyis lce bzhin du/ / 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan sgreng ba'i zla bzhin ma/ /dkyus ring ut+pal 'dzum pa'i zur mig mda'/ / lcags kyur 'phen pas mdza' ba 'gugs pa bzhin/ / kun gyi rtse mor rdo rje rin po che/ / nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin 'bar ba'i tog / mtho lding sprin gyi sbubs las grol ba'i 'od/ / mkha' snang gser gyi rgya mtsho 'byur ba bzhin/ / gzhal med khang brtsegs pho brang che de'i dbus/ / mi 'jigs bzhi yi seng chen gyis bteg pa'i/ / stobs bcu'i rang bzhin gser gyi khri 'phang mchog / lhun po'i ga(sdu spyar bzhin du mngon mtho'i steng / / skal bzang byang chub sems dang

khro rgyal gyi/ / rnam par 'phrul ba chos rgyal rigs ldan che/ / bsod nams brgya ba mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan zhing / / mngon shes lnga sogs yon tan rin chen gter/ / bye ba dgu bcu rtsa bdun grong khyer na/ / gnas pa'i skye dgu kun gyi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /lha min kla klo'i mun sprul drung byung ste/ /yang dag ye shes lam snang mdzad pa'i phyir/ / lo grangs brgya brgyar chos 'khor 'od stong gi/ / sgron chen sbar mkhas nyin dbang re re dang / / dgu bcu rtsa drug 'dab ma'i yul so sor/ /chos rgyal de yi bka' rtags cod pan can/ / lha dang lha min gdengs can dbang po yi/ / rnam par 'phrul ba'i sa bdag re res kyang / / skye rgu mtha' dag phan bde'i bka' drin gyis/ / rtag tu 'tsho ba'i dpung gnyen bla med mdzad/ / bdud dang nyon mongs g.yo ba ro kyang rlung / /nyis khri tshig stong drug brgya'i4sprog bcom nas/ / bden don bcu gnyisasngonardo rje nyi snang dang / / de nyid bcu drugaX rdo rje zla ba bzang /zung 'jug sgra gcan lto bar rengs pa'i gnad/ / stong chen yig lnga0thig stong yi ge drug(spre/ / e waṃ(sgomi phyed sgyu ma'i phyag rgya chen/ / dang po'i sangs rgyas mkha' khyab chos kyi sku'i/ / gsang ba chen por thams cad ro gcig kyang / / chu snod dwangs par rgyu skar gzugs can bzhin/ / rigs ldan du ma'i sprul gzugs zlos gar nyid/ / so sor rtog pa'i skyes bu'i bsam par bas/ /der ni yab rje chos kyi spyan ldan pa/ / ngag gi dbang phyug rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal/ / rigs ldan kun gyi ye shes spyi yi gzugs/ / rgyal kun 'dus zhal phye ba'i za ma tog /yin phyir gzhan min 'di nyid kho na zhes/ /nyi tshe'i dngos po lta ba'i bag chags rdul/ / ring nas bsrabs pas gcig nyid du ma'i gar/ / bsgyur mkhas chu zlas gsang ba de rigs na/ / de dag seng ge'i khri la dbang bskur nas/ / dgu phrag lo lon rigs ldan chos 2rdozlos

pa/ / mtha' yas rnam par rgyal ba ltar bod pa/ / kho bo'i yab rjer som nyi mi 'tshal bas/ / mngon 'dod dran pa'i gzugs gsar skye mched kyi/ / ri mo kun rdzogs rig pa 'dzin bu khyod/ / sprin sngon ta ma la(nye'od lding khang der/ / gser 'od rab 'khyug glog gi bro bzhin du/ / dang bas gaṅgā'i bye snyed(nyesrul ba'i lus/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi rtse dgar bcas/ /sor bcu snying gar bsnol ba thal mo'i gar/ / cod pan grol ba lan brgya sar btud de/ / yun ring snying la brnags pa gdung ba'i tshig / ngal dub lus kyi b.rangs pa'i yid 'byung gtam/ / shugs ring dbugs kyis nyer drangs srong ba'i zlog / bdag gi zhu 'phrin snyan gyi bdud rtsir mdzod/ /mcha/kye ༵sa py-i rgya/la po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba/ rin spungs mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sras te rtsom 'di'i mdzad po ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyi yab yin/ des rgyal po gong ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas rdzong dpon gyi las ka blangs/ /rig gnas chung ba lnga dang sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa ba'i sogs la blo gros kyi 'jug sgo yangs pa/ gtsang rong gi chos sde rnams 'tsho rkyen sogs dge rgyun bzang po sbyar/ rin srungs nyid du pho brang chen po'i mig ltos kyis gsang sngags kyi dus rim gyi srol btsugs so zhes (deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs (las gsungs/①snying rje'i gzhu dang stong nyid mda' rnon zung du sbyor/ snying rje gzhu'i gzugs su dang stong nyi/spada'i gzupas su //da de thabs mchog snying rje chen po dang shes rab stong ba nyid du/nga kā/ kā ṣ+ṭṛ zlo ༵༵ /shā la /na/ dus 'khor/ dus kyi 'khor lo ste gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag thams cad phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus sbyor dang 'brel ba'i bla med rgyud sde zhig dang /gnyis med rgyud kyi yi dam zhig ste don gnyis la 'jug cing ming gi rnam grangs la dang po'i sangs rgyasazhes kyang bya/ skabs 'dir gnyisamed kyi yodam la go/dugaspras 'dzikā/ baspyan grub tu 'dzin pa'i rtag lta dang / gtan med du 'dod pa'i chad lta (shāska〉 〉mi nā trī ni/ le/gas sbyar gyi skad de seng ga la'i gna' ming yin la 'dir srin po'i 206yul du go dgos te/ srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin
